source: He then returned to guard Luoyang and Yueyang. The king of Han gave Zhongli to Zhou Bo and Guan Ying as a common food town for them. Zhou Bo followed Gaozu as a general to conquer Zang Tu, King of Yan, who rebelled against the Han Dynasty, and defeated them at the gate of Yi County. The soldiers led by Zhou Bo resisted the enemy on the carriage road and made many military exploits. Zhou Bo was granted the title of Marquis, and Emperor Gaozu split the talisman to ensure that Zhou Bo's title would be passed down from generation to generation and would never be extinguished. 8,180 households in Jiang County were given as food towns, known as Jianghou. Zhou Bo followed Gaozu as a general to conquer Han Wangxin who rebelled against the Han Dynasty in Dai, and surrendered Huoren County. Then move forward to Wuquan, attack the Hu cavalry, and defeat them north of Wuquan. Then he moved to Tongtian to attack Han Wangxin's army and defeated them. He returned to the army and surrendered six cities in Taiyuan County. At the foot of Jinyang City, the Hu cavalry attacked King Xin of Han, defeated them, and captured Jinyang. Then he attacked King Xin of Han's army at Rangshi, defeated them, and chased the defeated soldiers for eighty miles. Returning to attack the three cities in Loufan, they took advantage of the situation to attack the Hu cavalry under Pingcheng. The soldiers led by Zhou Bo resisted the enemy troops on the carriage road and gained the most military exploits. Zhou Bo was promoted to Taiwei. Zhou Bo attacked the rebel general Chen Xi and massacred the city in Mayi County. The soldiers he led beheaded Chen Xi's general on horseback. Attacked Han Wangxin, Chen Xi, and Zhao Li's troops in Loufan, defeated them, and captured Chen Xi's general Song Zui and Yanmen County Guards. Taking advantage of the situation, he turned to attack Yunzhong County and captured the county governor, Prime Minister Ji Si and General Xun. The seventeen counties of Yanmen County and the twelve counties of Yunzhong County were pacified. Taking advantage of the situation, he attacked Chen Xi in Lingqiu, defeated his army, beheaded Chen Xi, and captured Chen Xi's prime minister Cheng Zong, general Chen Wu, and captain Gao Si. Pingding Daijun nine counties. King Lu Wan of Yan rebelled, and Zhou Bo led the troops on Fan Kuai's behalf as Prime Minister, captured Jixian, captured Lu Wan's general Da, Prime Minister Yan, County Shou Xing, Tai Wei Ruo, and Yushi doctor Shi, etc., and massacred Hundu City. Defeated Lu Wan's rebels in Shanglan, and defeated Lu Wan's rebels in Juyang. They pursued to the Great Wall and pacified twelve counties in Shanggu County, sixteen counties in Youbeiping County, twenty-nine counties in western and eastern Liaoning, and twenty-two counties in Yuyang County. He followed Gaozu on the expedition and captured one prime minister and two prime ministers, three officials each with an annual salary of two thousand dan. He also defeated two armies, captured three cities, pacified five counties and seventy-nine counties, and captured one prime minister and one general. Zhou Bo was a simple, strong, honest and loyal man. Emperor Gaozu believed that he could entrust him with important matters. Zhou Bo didn't like literature and learning. Whenever he summoned Confucian scholars and lobbyists, he would sit facing east and ask them: Tell me quickly! His simple young literary talent is like this. After Zhou Bo pacified Yan, he returned to the dynasty. Gaozu had passed away, and he served Emperor Hui as a prince. In the sixth year of Emperor Hui's reign, the official position of Taiwei was established and Zhou Bo was appointed as Taiwei. Ten years later, Empress Lu died. Lu Lu served as the general of the Han Dynasty as King Zhao, and Lu Chan served as the Prime Minister of the Han Dynasty as King Lu. They controlled the political power of the Han Dynasty and wanted to overthrow the Liu family. Zhou Bo, as a lieutenant, could not enter the military camp; Chen Ping, as a prime minister, could not handle government affairs. So Zhou Bo and Chen Ping planned to finally annihilate the Lu family and establish Emperor Xiaowen. The intercession on this matter is recorded in "The Chronicles of Empress Dowager Lu" and "The Chronicles of Xiaowen". After Emperor Wen came to the throne, he appointed Zhou Bo as the right prime minister, and gave him five thousand catties of gold and ten thousand households with food. More than a month later, someone persuaded Zhou Bo: You have killed the Lu family and established King Dai as the emperor, which is powerful in the world. You receive generous rewards and are in a distinguished position. If you are favored like this, disaster will befall you over time. Zhou Bo was afraid and felt that he was in danger, so he resigned and asked for the return of the seal. The emperor agreed to his request.
target: Zhou Bo, a native of Peixian County, began his career as a weaver and funeral musician before becoming a warrior. He followed Liu Bang (later Emperor Gaozu) from the early days of his uprising, participating in numerous battles against the Qin dynasty and other forces. Zhou Bo distinguished himself in combat, often being the first to scale city walls, and was granted titles and rewards, including the Marquis of Weiwu and later the Marquis of Jiang, with a fief of 8,180 households. He continued to serve as a general under Gaozu, suppressing rebellions by Zang Tu, Han Xin, Chen Xi, and Lu Wan, pacifying many counties and capturing numerous enemy officials. Zhou Bo was known for his simplicity, strength, and loyalty, though he had little regard for scholarly learning. After Gaozu's death, Zhou Bo served Emperor Hui as a prince and later as Taiwei. Following Empress Lu's death, the Lu family attempted to seize power. Zhou Bo, alongside Chen Ping, plotted to annihilate the Lu clan and established Emperor Wen. For this, he was appointed Right Prime Minister and given generous rewards. However, fearing his own power, he resigned and returned to his fief. Later, he was falsely accused of rebellion, imprisoned, and humiliated by jailers.

id: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家::group-001
article_path: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家
source: Zhou Bo was scared and didn't know how to answer. The jailers gradually bullied and humiliated him. Zhou Bo gave a thousand pieces of gold to the jailer, and the jailer wrote on the back of the wooden slip to remind him: Let the princess bear witness for you. The princess was the daughter of Emperor Wen, and Zhou Bo's eldest son Shengzhi married her, so the jailer taught Zhou Bo to let her come out to testify. Zhou Bo gave all the rewards he received to Empress Dowager Bo's brother Bo Zhao. When the case came to a critical juncture, Bo Zhao interceded with Empress Dowager Bo on behalf of Zhou Bo, and the Empress Dowager also believed that there would be no rebellion. Emperor Wen met with the Empress Dowager. The Empress Dowager grabbed the scarf and threw it at Emperor Wen, saying: It turns out that Jianghou was carrying the emperor's seal and was leading the troops in the Northern Army. He didn't rebel at that time. Now he lives in a small county. Will he rebel instead? Emperor Wen had already seen Jianghou's confession, so he apologized to the Queen Mother and said: The jailer just found out clearly and wanted to let him out. So he sent an envoy with a talisman to pardon Jianghou and restore his title and food. After Jianghou was released from prison, he said: I am leading an army of millions, but how do I know the dignity of the jailer? Jianghou returned to his fiefdom. He died in the eleventh year of Emperor Wen's reign, and his posthumous title was Marquis Wu.
target: He was eventually released after his daughter (the emperor's daughter-in-law) and Empress Dowager Bo interceded. He died in the eleventh year of Emperor Wen's reign, posthumously titled Marquis Wu.

id: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家::group-002
article_path: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家
source: The two sides only had three months to attack and defend, and the Wu and Chu rebellions were defeated and put down. Then the generals realized that the Taiwei's strategy was correct. But because of this counterinsurgency. However, King Xiao of Liang had a grudge against the Taiwei. After Zhou Yafu returned to the court, the imperial court re-established Taiwei officials, Zhou Yafu was promoted to prime minister, and Emperor Jing valued him very much. Later, Emperor Jing deposed Prince Li. Prime Minister Zhou Yafu tried his best to argue but failed to dissuade him. Emperor Jing distanced himself from him. Every time King Xiao of Liang came to Beijing for an audience, he often told the Queen Mother about Zhou Yafu's shortcomings. One day, Queen Mother Dou said: The queen's brother Wang Xin can be made a marquis. Emperor Jing declined and said: At first, the late Emperor Nanpihou and Zhangwuhou did not make them marquises. They waited until I came to the throne to make them marquises. It is not the time to make Wang Xin a marquis. Empress Dowager Dou said: The monarchs all act according to the situation at that time. When my brother Dou Changjun was alive, he could not be granted the title of marquis. After his death, his son Peng Zu was granted the title of marquis instead. I regret this very much. Your Majesty, please make Wang Xin a marquis as soon as possible! Emperor Jing said: This matter needs to be discussed with the Prime Minister. Emperor Jing discussed with the prime minister, and Zhou Yafu said: Emperor Gao had stipulated that people who were not from the Liu family could not be crowned kings, and people who had not made meritorious deeds could not be crowned marquis. Anyone who did not abide by this rule could be attacked by everyone in the world. Although Wang Xin is the elder brother of the queen, he has no meritorious service. Making him a marquis is against the Emperor Gaozu's protocol. Emperor Jing was speechless after hearing this and had to give up. Later, the Xiongnu king Wei Xulu and five others surrendered to the Han Dynasty. Emperor Jing wanted to make them marquis to encourage those who came after them. Prime Minister Zhou Yafu said: A few of them betrayed their monarch and surrendered to Your Majesty. If Your Majesty makes them marquis, how can you blame the unruly ministers? Emperor Jing said: The Prime Minister's opinion cannot be adopted. So Wei Xulu and others were all made marquises. Zhou Yafu therefore claimed to be ill and retired to his home. In the third year of Emperor Jing's reign, Zhou Yafu was dismissed as prime minister due to illness. Soon, Emperor Jing summoned Tiaohou in the palace and rewarded him with food and wine. There was only a large piece of meat on the table, no chopped meat, and no chopsticks. Tiao Hou was dissatisfied, turned around and asked the official in charge of the banquet to bring chopsticks. Emperor Jing smiled when he saw it and said, "Can't these meet your needs?" Tiaohou took off his hat to apologize. The emperor stood up, and Tiao Hou took the opportunity to retreat quickly. Emperor Jing watched him go out. Said: People like this who show dissatisfaction when encountering things cannot be the servants of the young master! Soon after, Tiaohou's son bought five hundred pieces of armor and shields for his father from a worker who specialized in making household supplies. The moving workers were very tired, but they were not paid. When the employees found out that he secretly bought the utensils for the emperor, they became angry and sued Zhou Yafu's son to rebel. Naturally, the matter involved Marquis Tiao.
target: Zhou Bo's son Zhou Shengzhi inherited the title but lost it due to murder. Emperor Wen then selected Zhou Yafu, another son, as Marquis of Tiao. Xu Negation predicted Zhou Yafu would be a marquis, general, and prime minister but would starve to death. Zhou Yafu became a general, famously commanding the Xiliu camp with strict discipline, impressing Emperor Wen. During the Rebellion of the Seven States, he served as Taiwei, successfully defeating Wu and Chu by cutting off their food supplies, though this earned him the enmity of King Xiao of Liang. He later became prime minister but fell out of favor with Emperor Jing over disputes regarding the appointment of marquises, including opposing the enfeoffment of the queen's brother Wang Xin and Xiongnu defectors. Zhou Yafu was eventually dismissed as prime minister. After a banquet where he showed dissatisfaction with the lack of chopsticks, Emperor Jing viewed him as unfit for service.

id: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家::group-003
article_path: 史记/三十世家/绛侯周勃世家
source: The officials questioned Tiaohou one by one according to the contents of the document, but Tiaohou refused to answer. Emperor Jing scolded him and said, "I won't use you anymore." And ordered Zhou Yafu to be handed over to Tingwei. Tingwei asked: "Do you want to rebel?" Zhou Yafu said: The utensils I bought are all for burial. How can I say that I want to rebel? The jailer said: Even if you don't rebel above ground, you should go underground to rebel! The jailer's persecution became more and more intense. At first, when the jailer arrested Tiao Hou, Tiao Hou wanted to commit suicide, but his wife stopped him. Therefore, he did not die and went to Tingwei's prison. Zhou Yafu didn't eat for five days, vomited blood and died. His fiefdom was removed. Zhou Yafu's title was suspended for a year, so Emperor Jing changed the title of Zhou Jian, another son of Jianghou Zhou Bo, to Pingquhou, and succeeded Jianghou's title. Zhou Jian died after reigning for 19 years, and his posthumous title was Gonghou. His son Jiande succeeded him as marquis. Thirteen years later, Zhou Jiande was appointed as the prince's tutor. Due to the poor quality of the gold offered as an acolyte, he was found guilty in the fifth year of Yuanding and his fiefdom was abolished. Tiao Hou Zhou Yafu really starved to death. After his death, Emperor Jing granted Wang Xin the title of Gaihou. Tai Shigong said: When Jiang Hou Zhou Bo was a commoner, he was a rough and simple man, and his talents were no more than mediocre. When he followed Gao Zu to bring peace to the world, he took up the position of general. The Lu family wanted to rebel and cause rebellion. Zhou Bo saved the country from crisis and restored the court to normal. How can even wise men like Yi Yin and Duke Zhou surpass him? Zhou Yafu always maintained dignity and perseverance in his military use. How could a famous general like Sima Ranju surpass him? It's a pity that he was complacent but not open-minded to learn. He was able to observe moral integrity but did not know how to be respectful. In the end, he ended up in embarrassment. How sad!
target: His son's purchase of burial armor led to accusations of rebellion. Zhou Yafu was imprisoned, refused to eat for five days, and died of vomiting blood. His fief was abolished. Sima Qian commented that while Zhou Bo saved the state from crisis, Zhou Yafu, despite his military dignity, lacked humility and met a tragic end.

id: 史记/三十世家/荆燕世家::group-000
article_path: 史记/三十世家/荆燕世家
source: King Jing Liu Jia is from the Liu clan, but it is not known which branch of the Liu clan he belongs to. When the trouble first broke out, it was the first year of the Han Dynasty. The King of Han returned from Hanzhong to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties, appointed Liu Jia as general, and asked him to pacify the Sedi, and then followed the King of Han to attack Xiang Yu from the east. In the fourth year of the Han Dynasty, the King of Han was defeated at Chenggao. He crossed the Yellow River north and got the troops of Zhang Er and Han Xin. They stationed themselves in Xiuwu. They dug deep trenches and built high forts. He sent Liu Jia to lead two armies and hundreds of cavalry to cross Baima Jin and enter the Chu land. They burned the grain and grass stored there and destroyed the industry there so that they could not supply King Xiang with military grain. Soon the Chu army attacked Liu Jia. Liu Jia always held fast to the camp and maintained a mutual dependence with Peng Yue. In the fifth year of the Han Dynasty, the Han Dynasty pursued Xiang Yu to Guling and sent Liu Jianan to cross the Huai River to surround Shouchun. Liu Jia arrived soon and sent people to look for opportunities to recruit Zhou Yin, the great Sima of Chu. Zhou Yin betrayed King Xiang and helped Liu Jia capture Jiujiang. The army of King Wu Yingbu met at Gaixia and jointly attacked Xiang Yu. The king of Han then Liu Jia led the Jiujiang army and together with Taiwei Lu Wan, attacked Linjiang Wang Gongwei to the southwest. After Wei Gong died, Linjiang was renamed Nanjun. In the spring of the sixth year of the Han Dynasty, the Han King Liu Bang met with the princes in Chen County, deposed the Chu King Han Xin, and imprisoned him. His territory was divided into two countries. At this time, Emperor Gaozu's son was young, had few brothers, and had no talents. He wanted to make a member of the same family the king to control the world, so he issued an edict saying: General Liu Jia has military exploits, and he should select the disciples of the Liu family who have military exploits to be crowned king. All the ministers said: Liu Jia should be made King of Jing, commanding fifty-two cities in the east of Huaihe; Liu Jiao, Gaozu's younger brother, should be made King of Chu, commanding thirty-six cities in the west. Liu Bang then appointed his son Liu Fei as King of Qi. Only then did the Liu brothers begin to be crowned kings. In the autumn of the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, King Yingbu of Huainan rebelled and went east to attack Jingdi. Liu Jia, king of Jing, fought with him but failed to win. He fled to Fuling and was killed by Yingbu's army. Gaozu personally defeated Yingbu. In the twelfth year, Peihou Liu Bi was named King of Wu and ruled over the former homeland of King Jing. King Liu Ze of Yan was a distant relative of the Liu family. In the third year of Emperor Gaodi's reign, Liu Ze was appointed as a doctor. In the eleventh year of Emperor Gaodi's reign, Liu Ze used his position as a general to attack Chen Xi, captured the enemy general Wang Huang, and was granted the title of Marquis of Yingling. During the reign of Emperor Gao, Tian Sheng, a native of Qi, was traveling abroad and lacked travel funds, so he asked Liu Ze, Marquis of Yingling, for help by offering suggestions.
target: King Jing Liu Jia was a member of the Liu clan, though his specific branch is unknown. During the early Han Dynasty, he served as a general under the King of Han, pacifying territories and joining campaigns against Xiang Yu. In the fourth year of the Han Dynasty, after the King of Han’s defeat at Chenggao, Liu Jia crossed the Yellow River into Chu territory, burning grain supplies and disrupting enemy logistics. He held his position against Chu attacks, coordinating with Peng Yue. By the fifth year, Liu Jia crossed the Huai River, recruited Chu’s Grand Sima Zhou Yin, who betrayed Xiang Yu, and captured Jiujiang. He then joined King Yingbu at Gaixia to attack Xiang Yu. Later, Liu Jia led the Jiujiang army with Taiwei Lu Wan against Linjiang King Gongwei, who died, leading to the renaming of Linjiang to Nanjun. In the sixth year, Emperor Gaozu deposed the Chu King Han Xin and divided his territory. Seeking to install family members as kings, Gaozu appointed Liu Jia as King of Jing, commanding fifty-two cities east of the Huai, while his brother Liu Jiao became King of Chu. Liu Jia was killed in battle against the rebellious King Yingbu in the eleventh year. His territory later passed to Liu Bi, King of Wu.

source: While the wine was in full swing, Tian Sheng asked the left and right to step back and persuaded Zhang Qing: "I have seen more than a hundred residences of princes and kings, all of whom were meritorious officials during the reign of Emperor Gaozu." Now the Lu family has always helped Gaozu complete the great cause of unifying the world. His contribution is very great, and he is honored by his relative the Queen Mother. The Queen Mother was old and the Lu clan was weak. The Queen Mother wanted to make Lu Chan the king and the king of the vassals on behalf of the land. The Queen Mother wants to speak out about this matter seriously, but she is afraid that the ministers will not agree. Now that you are most favored by the Queen Mother and respected by the ministers, why not politely persuade the ministers to report this matter to the Queen Mother. The Queen Mother will definitely be happy. After Zhu Lu is crowned king, all the princes will also be yours. The Queen Mother wants to do this in her heart, but you are a minister. If you don't propose it quickly, I'm afraid disaster will befall you. Zhang Qing agreed very much with this, so he politely persuaded the minister to report the matter to the Queen Mother. When the Queen Mother went to court, she asked the ministers about this matter. The ministers petitioned to establish Lu Chan as King Lu. The Queen Mother gave Zhang Qing a thousand catties of gold, and Zhang Qing gave half of it to Tian Sheng. Tian Sheng did not accept the gift, and took the opportunity to persuade Zhang Qing: "Lü Chan was crowned king, but the ministers were not completely convinced." Now the Marquis of Yingling, Liu Ze, is a member of the Liu clan and serves as a general. He is the only one who is still dissatisfied. Now you report to the Queen Mother and designate more than a dozen counties to make him king. He will get the throne and leave happily. The throne of the Lu family will be more consolidated. Zhang Qing went to the palace to report the matter, and the Queen Mother thought it was right. So Liu Ze, the Marquis of Yingling, was granted the title of King Langxie. King Langxie and Tian Sheng went to the fiefdom. Tian Sheng advised Liu Ze to leave quickly and not to stay. As soon as they left Hangu Pass, the Queen Mother indeed sent people to chase and stop them, but Liu Ze had already left the pass, so the pursuers had to go back. After the death of the Queen Mother, Langxie King Liu Ze said: The emperor is young, Zhu Lu controls the government, and the Liu family is lonely and weak. So he led the army and planned with Qi King Liu Xiang to march westward, intending to kill the Lu family. When he arrived in Liangdi, he heard that the imperial court had sent General Guan Ying to garrison troops in Xingyang, so Liu Ze returned to strengthen the defense of his western border, and then quickly rushed to Chang'an. King Dai also happened to arrive from Dai. The generals, ministers and King Langxie jointly supported King Dai as the emperor. The emperor then moved Liu Ze to the title of King of Yan, returned Langxie to King Qi, and restored King Qi's original territory. Liu Ze died in his second year as King of Yan, and his posthumous title was King Jing. The throne was passed to his son Liu Jia, who became King Kang. When the throne passed to Liu Ze's grandson Liu Dingguo, he committed adultery with his father, King Kang's concubine, and gave birth to a boy.
target: King Liu Ze of Yan, a distant Liu relative, began as a doctor and later became Marquis of Yingling for capturing an enemy general. During Empress Lu’s reign, Tian Sheng, a Qi native, advised Liu Ze to gain favor by supporting the Lu clan’s rise. Through Zhang Qing, a favored emissary, Tian Sheng persuaded the court to make Lu Chan king, then proposed making Liu Ze a king to secure Lu power. Liu Ze was thus made King of Langxie. After Empress Lu’s death, Liu Ze allied with Qi King Liu Xiang to oppose the Lu clan, eventually supporting King Dai as emperor. He was then made King of Yan, dying in his second year. His descendants included his son Liu Jia and grandson Liu Dingguo, who committed heinous crimes—adultery with relatives and murder—leading to his suicide and the abolition of his state.

The emperor then moved Liu Ze to the title of King of Yan, returned Langxie to King Qi, and restored King Qi's original territory. Liu Ze died in his second year as King of Yan, and his posthumous title was King Jing. The throne was passed to his son Liu Jia, who became King Kang. When the throne passed to Liu Ze's grandson Liu Dingguo, he committed adultery with his father, King Kang's concubine, and gave birth to a boy. He also took his younger brother's wife as his concubine. He also committed adultery with his three daughters. Liu Dingguo planned to kill the Ying people, the magistrate of Feiru County. The Ying people and others reported Liu Dingguo's crimes. Liu Dingguo sent envoys to report, arrest and kill the Ying people under the pretext of other laws to silence him. In the second year of Yuanshuo, the brothers of the Ying people once again wrote to report Liu Dingguo's ulterior scandal, and Dingguo's crimes were exposed. The emperor ordered the ministers to discuss the case, and the ministers all commented: "Liu Dingguo acted like a beast, corrupted human relations, violated the laws of nature, and should be executed for his crime." The emperor granted permission. Liu Dingguo committed suicide, the feudal state was abolished and changed to a county. Tai Shigong said: King Jing was granted the title of king because the Han Dynasty had just been established and the world had not yet been completely unified. Therefore, although Liu Jia was a distant relative of the Liu family, he was granted the title of king for his military exploits and held a powerful position between the Jiang and Huaihe Rivers. Liu Ze was named king because he used power and intrigue to arouse the Lu family, so that Liu Ze could be king in the south for three generations.
target: Tai Shigong noted that Liu Jia was made king for his military exploits during the Han’s early instability, while Liu Ze gained his title through political maneuvering, enabling his line to rule for three generations.

source: Xiao Xiangguo Xiao He was born in Fengyi, Peixian County. His knowledge of the law was unparalleled, and he was an official under the magistrate of Peixian County. When the great ancestor Liu Bang was still a commoner, Xiao He relied on his authority as an official to protect him many times. Liu Bang became the chief of the pavilion, and Xiao He often helped him. Liu Bang went to Xianyang to serve as an official. All the officials gave him three hundred coins, but Xiao He gave him five hundred coins. When the censor of the Qin Dynasty went to Sishui County to supervise the work of the county, Xiao He followed his subordinate officials and always handled things in an orderly and clear manner. Xiao He then took on the job of being the historian of Sishui County, and ranked first in the official assessment. The censor of the Qin Dynasty planned to enter the court to make suggestions to recruit Xiao He, but Xiao He repeatedly declined and refused to be transferred. When the great ancestor Liu Bang rose up and became Pei Gong, Xiao He often served as his assistant to supervise the affairs. When Pei Gong entered Xianyang, the generals rushed to the Qin Dynasty's treasury to collect gold and silk property. Only Xiao He entered the palace first to collect legal documents, geographical atlases, household registration files and other documents and materials in charge of the Qin Dynasty's prime ministers and censors, and treasured them. Pei Gong became the queen of Han Dynasty and appointed Xiao He as prime minister. Xiang Yu and the princes' troops entered Xianyang, slaughtered and burned them, and then left. The reason why the King of Han was able to have a detailed understanding of the world's dangerous fortresses, the number of families and populations, the strength and weakness of various places, the sufferings of the people, etc. was all because Xiao He had completely obtained the maps, books and other materials of the Qin Dynasty. Xiao He recommended Han Xin to the King of Han, and the King of Han appointed Han Xin as general. This incident is recorded in "The Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin". The King of Han led his troops eastward and pacified the Three Qin Dynasties. Xiao He stayed behind as prime minister to govern Bashu, pacify the people, issue decrees, and provide food and fodder for the army. In the second year of the Han Dynasty, the king of Han and other princes attacked the Chu army. Xiao He guarded Guanzhong, served the prince, and governed Yueyang.
target: Xiao He, born in Fengyi, Peixian County, was a legal expert and official under the county magistrate. He protected Liu Bang when Liu Bang was a commoner and later as a pavilion chief. When Liu Bang served in Xianyang, Xiao He gave him five hundred coins, more than others. Xiao He became historian of Sishui County, ranking first in assessments, but declined a transfer recommended by a Qin censor. When Liu Bang became Pei Gong, Xiao He assisted him. After entering Xianyang, while others seized treasure, Xiao He collected Qin legal documents, maps, and household records. This allowed Liu Bang to understand the realm's geography and population. Xiao He recommended Han Xin as general. As prime minister, he governed Bashu and Guanzhong, managing laws, temples, and supplies. He reported to Liu Bang or acted as needed, recruiting soldiers to replenish the army.

source: How can one's temporary achievements be overridden by eternal merits? Xiao He should be ranked first, followed by Cao Shen. Gaozu said: OK. So Xiao He was determined to be the first, and he was specially allowed to bring a sword and wear shoes to the palace, and he could walk quickly without following etiquette when going to court. Emperor Gaozu said: I heard that recommending talented people will receive high rewards. Although Xiao He's contribution was very high, it became even more prominent after being commended by E Jun. So based on the original title of Marquis of Guannei, E Jun was granted the title of Marquis of Anping. On that day, more than ten people including Xiao He, his father, his son and his brothers were granted food fiefs. Later, Xiao He was granted the title of two thousand households. This was because when Gaozu went to serve in Xianyang, Xiao He gave him an extra two hundred coins. In the eleventh year of the Han Dynasty, Chen Xi rebelled, and Gaozu personally led his army to Handan. Before the suppression of the rebellion was over, Han Xin, the Marquis of Huaiyin, rebelled again in Guanzhong. Empress Lu adopted Xiao He's strategy and killed the Marquis of Huaiyin. This incident was recorded in "The Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin". Emperor Gaozu had already heard that the Marquis of Huaiyin had been killed, so he sent an envoy to worship Prime Minister Xiao He as the Prime Minister, granted five thousand households, and ordered 500 soldiers and a captain to serve as the Prime Minister's bodyguard. Many people came to congratulate him, but Zhao Ping expressed his condolences. Zhao Pingyuan was the Marquis of Dongling in the Qin Dynasty. After the fall of the Qin Dynasty, he became a commoner, his family was poor, and he grew melons in the east of Chang'an City. The melons he planted tasted sweet, so people in society called them "Aventurine melons", which was named after Zhao Ping's title. Zhao Ping said to the Prime Minister Xiao He: The disaster began from now on. Your Majesty is out in the cold weather, and your troops are outside, but you stay in the middle of the court and are not in danger of war. Instead, you increase your fiefdom and set up guards. This is because the Marquis of Huaiyin has just rebelled in the capital and has doubts about your heart. The purpose of setting up a guard to protect you is not to favor you. I hope that you will refuse the reward and donate all your property and assets to the army. Then the emperor will be happy. Xiao Xiangguo followed his plan. Emperor Gao was indeed very happy. In the autumn of the twelfth year of the Han Dynasty, Yingbu rebelled. Gaozu personally led an army to conquer him and sent people many times to ask what Xiao Xiangguo was doing. Because the emperor was in the army, Xiao Xiangguo comforted and encouraged the people in the rear and donated all his wealth to the army, just like when he attacked Chen Xi. A retainer advised Xiao Xiangguo: The day when your clan will be exterminated is not far away. You are in the prime minister's position and have the highest number of merits. Can you add more merits? You won the hearts of the people when you first entered Guanzhong. It has been more than ten years since the people have attached themselves to you. You are still so diligent in your work, have a harmonious relationship with the people, and are loved. The reason why the emperor has repeatedly asked about your situation is that he is afraid that you will shock Guanzhong. Now why don't you buy more land, use low prices, borrow money, etc. to ruin your reputation?
target: In the third year of Han, Liu Bang sent envoys to Xiao He, suspecting him. Bao Sheng advised Xiao He to send his family to the army, which Liu Bang approved. After Xiang Yu's defeat, Liu Bang ranked Xiao He first among heroes, comparing him to a hunter versus hounds, and citing Xiao He's clan contributions. E Qianqiu supported this, noting Xiao He's consistent support during crises. Xiao He was ranked first, allowed special court privileges, and granted fiefs. During Chen Xi's rebellion, Xiao He helped Empress Lu kill Han Xin. Liu Bang rewarded him with guards, but Zhao Ping warned this indicated suspicion. Xiao He refused the reward and donated to the army, pleasing Liu Bang. During Yingbu's rebellion, a retainer advised Xiao He to ruin his reputation by buying land cheaply to ease Liu Bang's fears. Xiao He complied, and Liu Bang was happy. Later, Liu Bang imprisoned Xiao He for requesting Shanglin Garden for the people, but a guard argued Xiao He's duty, and Liu Bang released him.

source: Gaozu was not very happy after hearing this. On the same day, Gaozu sent someone to pardon and release the prime minister. The Prime Minister was old and always humble and cautious. When he came to see Gao Zu, he walked barefoot to apologize. Emperor Gaozu said: Forget it, Prime Minister! The prime minister asked for a garden for the people, but I refused. I am just a monarch like Jie and Zhou, and you are a wise prime minister. The reason why I put you in chains is to let the people know my fault. Xiao He and Cao Shen had never been on good terms with each other. When Xiao He was seriously ill, Emperor Xiaohui personally went to check on Xiang Guo's condition and asked by the way: "If you pass away, who can replace you?" Xiao He replied: There is no one who understands his subordinates better than the monarch. Emperor Xiaohui said: How about Cao Shen? Xiao He kowtowed and said: Your Majesty has found a suitable candidate! Even if I die, I will have no regrets! Xiao He's purchase of land and housing must be in a poor and remote area, and he did not build a house with low walls when building his home. He said: If my descendants are worthy, they can learn from my frugality; if their descendants are not worthy, they can avoid being taken away by powerful people. In the second year of Xiaohui's reign, Prime Minister Xiao He passed away, and his posthumous title was Wen Zhonghou. There were four generations of Xiao He's descendants who lost the title of marquis due to crimes. Every time the title was cut off, the emperor always sought Xiao He's descendants again and renewed their titles as Marquis of Fou. No one among the heroes could compare with him. Tai Shigong said: Prime Minister Xiao He was just a small civilian official in the Qin Dynasty. He was ordinary and had no amazing achievements. When the Han Dynasty prospered, relying on the emperor's remaining glory, Xiao He strictly adhered to his duties. Based on the fact that the people hated the harsh laws of the Qin Dynasty, he followed the trend of history and updated them. Han Xin, Ying Bu, etc. have all been killed, but Xiao He's achievements are even more brilliant.
target: Xiao He and Cao Shen were not on good terms, but on his deathbed, Xiao He recommended Cao Shen as his successor. Xiao He bought land in poor areas and built simple homes to teach frugality. He died in the second year of Xiaohui's reign, posthumously named Wenzhong Hou. His descendants lost the title four times but were reinstated, unmatched among heroes. Sima Qian noted Xiao He's rise from a minor official to a prominent figure, adapting laws to people's needs and achieving lasting fame.

source: The ancestors of the Zhao family and the Qin people have the same ancestor. When it was passed to Zhongyan, he became the person who drove horses and chariots for Emperor Taiwu of the Shang Dynasty. His descendant Feilian had two sons. One son was named Eilai and served King Zhou. He was later killed by the Zhou people. His descendants were the Ying Qin family. Erlai's younger brother was named Ji Sheng, and his descendants were the Zhao people. Ji Sheng gave birth to Meng Zeng. Meng Zeng was favored by King Zhou Cheng, and this was Zhai Gaolang. Gaolang begat Hengfu, and Hengfu begat Zaofu. Zaofu was favored by King Mu of Zhou. Cepheus selected eight horses and presented them to King Mu along with the famous horses such as Robber, Hualiu, and Luer obtained in Taolin. King Mu asked Zaofu to drive his chariot to the west for inspection. He met the Queen Mother of the West and was so happy that he forgot to go back. Soon, King Xu Yan launched a rebellion. King Mu rode a carriage and traveled thousands of miles a day to attack King Xu Yan and completely defeat him. So he gave the city of Zhao to Zaofu, and he became the Zhao family from then on. From Zaofu down through six generations, it was passed down to Yanfu, whose courtesy name was Gongzhong. When King Xuan of Zhou attacked the Rong people, he drove his chariot for King Xuan. In the Battle of Thousand Acres, Yanfu saved King Xuan from danger. Am's father gave birth to his uncle. During the reign of his uncle, King You of Zhou was debauched and immoral, so he left the Zhou Dynasty and went to Jin, where he served Marquis Wen of Jin and began to establish the Zhao family in Jin. From the uncle down, the Zhao family became more and more prosperous, and after five generations it was passed down to Zhao Su. Zhao Su, in the 16th year of Duke Xian of Jin, conquered the three kingdoms of Huo, Wei, and Geng. He led the army to conquer the Huo Kingdom. Huo Gongqiu fled to Qi State. This year there was a severe drought in the Jin State, and the divination result said: The gods of Mount Huo Tai are causing trouble. So Zhao Su was sent to Qi State to welcome back the king of Huo State, restored his status, and asked him to preside over the sacrifices at Mount Huo Tai. Only then did Jin State have a good harvest again. Duke Xian of Jin gave the land of Geng to Zhao Su. The year when Zhao Su came down to share the throne with Meng was the first year of Lu Min. Mencius was born in the same family as Zhao Shui, whose courtesy name was Ziyu. Zhao Shui used divination to decide whether to serve Duke Xian of Jin or other princes, but the result was unlucky. When the divination revealed that he was serving Prince Chong'er, the result was auspicious, so he went to serve Chong'er. Chong'er fled to Zhai State due to the Liji Rebellion, and Zhao Shui followed him. The Zhai people attacked Yao Jiuru and got two women. Zhai Jun gave the young girl to Chong'er as his wife, and the older girl to Zhao Shui as his wife, and they gave birth to Zhao Dun. When Chong'er was in Jin, Zhao Shuai's first wife had already given birth to Zhao Tong, Zhao Kuo and Zhao Yingqi. Zhao Shui fled with Chong'er for a total of nineteen years before he was able to return to Jin. Chong'er became Duke Wen of Jin, and Zhao Shui became the official of Yuan. He lived in Yuan City and presided over state affairs. The reason why Duke Wen of Jin was able to return and become the overlord was mostly due to Zhao Shuai's strategy. These things are all recorded in "Jin Family". After Zhao Shui returned to Jin, his first wife in Jin insisted on welcoming back the wife he married in Zhai, and made Zhai's wife's son Zhao Dun the official heir, while his three sons served him in lower positions.
target: The Zhao family shares a common ancestor with the Qin people. Their lineage traces back to Zhongyan, who served as a charioteer for Emperor Taiwu of the Shang Dynasty. His descendant Feilian had two sons: Eilai, who served King Zhou and was killed by the Zhou people, becoming the ancestor of the Ying Qin family; and Ji Sheng, whose descendants became the Zhao family. Ji Sheng's line included Meng Zeng, favored by King Cheng of Zhou, and eventually Zaofu, who served King Mu of Zhou. Zaofu presented eight fine horses to King Mu and drove his chariot westward, where the king met the Queen Mother of the West. When King Xu Yan rebelled, Zaofu drove King Mu thousands of miles in a day to crush the rebellion, and was rewarded with the city of Zhao, establishing the Zhao family name. Six generations later, Yanfu served King Xuan of Zhou as a charioteer and saved him at the Battle of Thousand Acres. His son Shudai left the debauched court of King You of Zhou to serve Marquis Wen of Jin, beginning the Zhao family's rise in Jin. Five generations later, Zhao Su conquered the states of Huo, Wei, and Geng for Duke Xian of Jin. When a drought struck Jin, divination revealed the god of Mount Huo Tai was angry, so Zhao Su restored the king of Huo to appease the god, and the drought ended. Zhao Shui, a descendant, used divination to decide to serve Prince Chong'er, following him into exile for nineteen years. After Chong'er became Duke Wen of Jin, Zhao Shui became a high official and helped him become hegemon.

source: Zhao Shui used divination to decide whether to serve Duke Xian of Jin or other princes, but the result was unlucky. When the divination revealed that he was serving Prince Chong'er, the result was auspicious, so he went to serve Chong'er. Chong'er fled to Zhai State due to the Liji Rebellion, and Zhao Shui followed him. The Zhai people attacked Yao Jiuru and got two women. Zhai Jun gave the young girl to Chong'er as his wife, and the older girl to Zhao Shui as his wife, and they gave birth to Zhao Dun. When Chong'er was in Jin, Zhao Shuai's first wife had already given birth to Zhao Tong, Zhao Kuo and Zhao Yingqi. Zhao Shui fled with Chong'er for a total of nineteen years before he was able to return to Jin. Chong'er became Duke Wen of Jin, and Zhao Shui became the official of Yuan. He lived in Yuan City and presided over state affairs. The reason why Duke Wen of Jin was able to return and become the overlord was mostly due to Zhao Shuai's strategy. These things are all recorded in "Jin Family". After Zhao Shui returned to Jin, his first wife in Jin insisted on welcoming back the wife he married in Zhai, and made Zhai's wife's son Zhao Dun the official heir, while his three sons served him in lower positions. In the sixth year of Duke Xianggong of Jin Dynasty, Zhao Shui passed away, and his posthumous title was Cheng Ji. Two years after Zhao Dun succeeded Cheng Ji in presiding over the state affairs, Duke Xianggang of Jin passed away and Prince Yigao was young. Because the country was in trouble, Zhao Dun wanted to make Yong, the younger brother of Duke Xiang, the king of the country. Yong was in Qin at that time, so he sent envoys to meet him. The prince's mother cried day and night, kowtowed to Zhao Dun and said: "What sin did the late king have? Why did he abandon his legitimate son and establish another king?" Zhao Dun was worried about this and was afraid that her clan members and officials would attack and kill her, so he appointed the crown prince, Duke Linggong of Jin, and sent troops to intercept the group of people who came to Qin to meet Duke Xianggong's younger brother. After Duke Linggong ascended the throne, Zhao Dun took more control of the political affairs of Jin. Fourteen years after Ling Gong succeeded to the throne, Zhao Lai became more and more arrogant. Zhao Dun remonstrated many times, but Duke Linggong did not listen. Once he ate bear paws, but because they were not cooked properly, he killed the catering officer and had his body carried out, where Zhao Dun happened to see him. Duke Ling was frightened and wanted to kill Zhao Dun. Zhao Dun was always kind and kind to others. He once gave food to a man who was hungry and fell under a mulberry tree. The man stepped forward to rescue Zhao Dun, and Zhao Dun was able to escape. Before he could escape from the country, Zhao Chuan killed Duke Ling and made Heihui, the younger brother of Duke Xiang, the king. This was Duke Cheng of Jin. Zhao Dun returned to preside over state affairs. The gentleman ridiculed Zhao Dun: As a minister, he fled without leaving the country, and did not punish the rebels when he returned. Therefore, the historian recorded that Zhao Dun killed his king. Zhao Dun died during the reign of Duke Jinggong of Jin Dynasty. His posthumous title was Xuan Meng, and his son Zhao Shuo inherited the title. In the third year of Duke Jinggong of Jin Dynasty, Zhao Shuo led the Jin army to rescue Zheng State and fought with King Zhuang of Chu on the Yellow River.
target: After Zhao Shui's death, his son Zhao Dun succeeded him. When Duke Xiang of Jin died, Zhao Dun initially planned to install a younger brother as ruler due to the young age of the crown prince, but the prince's mother's pleas led him to install the crown prince as Duke Ling of Jin. Duke Ling grew tyrannical, and when he tried to kill Zhao Dun, Zhao Dun fled. Before he could escape the country, Zhao Chuan killed Duke Ling. Zhao Dun returned to preside over state affairs, but historians recorded that he killed the king because he did not punish the rebels. Zhao Dun's son Zhao Shuo married Duke Cheng of Jin's sister. During Duke Jing's reign, the official Tu Anjia, seeking to destroy the Zhao family, falsely accused Zhao Dun of regicide and attacked the Zhao residence, killing Zhao Shuo and his brothers, though Zhao Shuo's pregnant wife escaped to the palace.

source: You couldn't die when you were in trouble in the palace, and you plotted with me to hide the Zhao orphans, but now you betrayed me. Even if you can't support him with me, how can you bear to betray him! He held the baby and shouted: Oh my God! Oh my gosh! What crime did the Zhao orphans have? Please let him live and just kill me, Chujiu. The generals did not agree and immediately killed Chujiu and the orphan. The generals thought that the orphan Zhao was indeed dead and were very happy. However, the real Zhao orphan was still alive, and Cheng Ying ended up hiding in the mountains with him. Fifteen years later, Jin Jinggong fell ill and performed a divination. The divination revealed that Daye's descendants were causing trouble due to the cessation of sacrifices. Jinggong asked Han Jue. Han Jue knew that the orphan of the Zhao family was still alive, so he said: Among the descendants of Daye who have now cut off their incest in Jin, isn't it the Zhao family? The descendants descended from it all bear the surname Ying. Zhongyan, a man with a human face and a bird's beak, came to the world to assist Emperor Taiwu of Yin, and the several emperors of Zhou assisted by his descendants all had good virtues. So Jinggong discussed with Han Jue to create an orphan of the Zhao family, and first found him and hid him in the palace. The generals entered the palace to inquire about Jinggong's condition. Jinggong relied on Han Jue's many followers to force the generals to meet the Zhao orphans. The orphan of the Zhao family is named Zhao Wu. The generals had no choice but to say: The incident in the palace was instigated by Tu'anjia. He falsely conveyed the emperor's orders and issued orders to the ministers. If not, who would dare to initiate a rebellion! Even if the monarch is not sick, we ministers must support the descendants of the Zhao family. Now that you have given the order, this is also our wish! So Zhao Wu and Cheng Ying were asked to thank the generals one by one. The generals in turn joined Cheng Ying and Zhao Wu to attack Tu'anjia and annihilate his family. Jinggong gave Zhao Wu the fiefdom that originally belonged to the Zhao family. When Zhao Wu had the crowning ceremony and he was already an adult, Cheng Ying said goodbye to all the officials, and then said to Zhao Wu: "Everyone can die for the Lord because of what happened in the palace." It's not that I can't die, I just want to support the descendants of the Zhao family. Now that Zhao Wu has inherited his ancestral legacy, grown up, and restored his original title, I will go underground to report to Zhao Xuan and Gongsun Chujiu.
target: Zhao Shuo's wife gave birth to a son, Zhao Wu. Tu Anjia searched for the baby, but it was hidden. Zhao Shuo's retainers, Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu, devised a plan: Chujiu hid with a substitute baby, and Cheng Ying "betrayed" him to the generals. The generals killed Chujiu and the substitute, believing the Zhao line extinct. Cheng Ying then hid the real Zhao Wu in the mountains for fifteen years. When Duke Jing fell ill, divination revealed the Zhao family's sacrifices were causing trouble. Han Jue, knowing the truth, told the duke, who then restored Zhao Wu and destroyed Tu Anjia's family. After Zhao Wu came of age, Cheng Ying committed suicide to report to his fallen comrades.

source: In the seventeenth year of the Jin Dynasty, Zhao Jianzi died and was succeeded by the crown prince Wuxie, who was Zhao Xiangzi. In the first year of Zhao Xiangzi, the State of Yue surrounded the State of Wu. Xiangzi reduced the stipulated diet during the period of mourning and sent his retainer Chu Long to visit King Wu. Xiangzi's sister was originally the wife of the king. After Jianzi was buried, Xiangzi had not yet taken off his mourning clothes, so he went north to climb Xiawu Mountain, invited King Dai, and asked the chef to use a copper spoon to invite King Dai and his entourage to have a meal. While pouring wine, he secretly asked the cook named Gege to beat King Dai and his attendants to death with a copper spoon, and then sent troops to pacify the land of Dai. When his sister heard about this, she cried and called to heaven, sharpened her hairpin and committed suicide. The local people sympathized with her and called the place where she committed suicide the Mountain of Moji. Xiangzi granted the land of Dai to Zhao Zhou, Bolu's son, and made him the king of Dai. Bolu is Xiangzi's brother and the original prince. The prince died young, so his son was given the title. Four years after Xiangzi came to the throne, Zhibo and the three families of Zhao, Han and Wei divided up all the original territories of Fan and Zhongxing. Duke Chu of Jin was furious and notified Qi and Lu, hoping to rely on them to attack the four ministers. The four ministers were afraid, so they attacked Jin Chugong together. He fled to Qi State on duty and died on the way. Uncle Duan appointed Zhaogong's great-grandson Jiao to take the throne, and this was Jin Yigong. Zhibo became more and more arrogant. He asked Han and Wei to cede their territory, and Han and Wei gave it to him. Zhao was asked to cede territory, but Zhao refused because Zhibo had insulted him when he besieged Zheng. Uncle Zhi was angry and led the Han and Wei families to attack the Zhao family. Zhao Xiangzi was afraid, so he fled to Jinyang to retreat. Yuan Guo followed Xiangzi and fell behind. When he arrived at Wangze, he saw three people. They could be seen from above the belt, but not from below. The three of them gave Yuan a bamboo stick with two sections, but there was no passage in the middle. He said to him: Give this bamboo stick to Zhao Wuxie for us. After Yuan Guo arrived, he told Xiangzi the situation. Xiangzi fasted for three days and cut open the bamboo stick himself. Inside, there were vermilion characters written: Zhao Wuxie, we are the angels of the Yanghou of Mount Huotai. On Bingxu day of March, we will ask you to destroy Zhishi in turn.
target: Zhao Wu's descendants grew powerful. His son Zhao Yang, Zhao Jianzi, became a dominant minister. He defeated the Fan and Zhonghang clans, expanded Zhao territory, and was named Shangqing, effectively monopolizing Jin's government. His son Zhao Wuxie, Zhao Xiangzi, succeeded him. Xiangzi killed the king of Dai and annexed his land. When Zhibo demanded territory, Xiangzi refused, leading to a siege of Jinyang. With divine guidance from the gods of Mount Huotai, Xiangzi allied with Han and Wei to destroy Zhibo and divide his lands. Zhao became stronger than Han and Wei.

source: Han, Wei and Zhao conspired. On Bingxu in March, the three countries in turn destroyed the Zhi family and jointly divided his land. So Xiangzi made a reward, and the Gao Communist Party ranked first in merit. Zhang Mengtong said: During the time of trouble in Jinyang, only the Communist Party of China did not make meritorious deeds. Xiangzi said: When Jinyang was in crisis, all the ministers were indifferent. Only the Communist Party of Gao did not dare to violate the etiquette of ministers, so he will receive a reward. At this time, Zhao occupied Dai territory in the north and annexed the Zhi clan in the south, becoming stronger than Han and Wei. So he built a temple to offer sacrifices to the three gods in Baiyi, and sent Yuan Guo to preside over the sacrifices at the Hotai Mountain Temple. Later, Xiangzi married Kongtong and gave birth to five sons. Because Bolu failed to succeed to the throne, Xiangzi refused to make his own son the crown prince, and insisted on passing the throne to Bolu's son Dai Chengjun. Chengjun died first, so he chose Zhao Huan, Chengjun's son, as the crown prince. Xiangzi died in the 33rd year of his reign, and Zhao Huan came to the throne. He became the Marquis of Xian. Xianhou came to the throne at a young age, and his capital was Zhongmu. Xiangzi's younger brother Huanzi expelled Xianhou and established himself as a marquis in Dai. He died a year later. The people of Zhao thought that Huanzi's accession to the throne was not Xiangzi's wish, so they jointly killed his son and welcomed Xianhou to the throne. In the tenth year of Xianhou's reign, Duke Wu of Zhongshan State began to ascend the throne. In the thirteenth year, a city was built in Pingyi. In the fifteenth year, Xianhou died, and his son Liehou Zhao Ji came to the throne. In the first year of Liehou, Wei Wenhou attacked Zhongshan Kingdom and sent Prince Wei to garrison it.
target: Xiangzi refused to make his own son heir, instead passing rule to his grandson Zhao Huan, who became Marquis Xian. After a brief usurpation by Xiangzi's brother, Xianhou's line continued. Subsequent rulers included Liehou, Jinghou, Chenghou, and Suhou. During Suhou's reign, Shang Yang of Qin attacked Wei. Suhou's son, King Wuling, ascended the throne. King Wuling, seeking to strengthen Zhao against enemies like Zhongshan and the Hu tribes, famously adopted Hu clothing and cavalry archery, overcoming opposition from nobles. He conquered Zhongshan and expanded Zhao's territory significantly. He later abdicated in favor of his son, King Huiwen, but a succession struggle led to his death by starvation after his son Zhao Zhang rebelled.

source: The next day, King Xiaocheng summoned a historian named Gan to divine fortune. He said: Wearing left and right clothes in a dream symbolizes incompleteness. Riding a flying dragon to fly to the sky but then falling down before reaching the sky symbolizes momentum but no strength. Seeing gold and jade piled up like a mountain symbolizes sorrow. Three days later, Feng Ting, the guard general of Shangdang in South Korea, sent an envoy to Zhao. He said: If South Korea cannot hold Shangdang, it will be merged with Qin. The officials and people there were willing to belong to the State of Zhao but not to the State of Qin. Shangdang has seventeen cities and is willing to surrender to the State of Zhao again. Please judge how the king shows kindness to the officials and the people. King Xiaocheng was overjoyed and summoned Pingyang Lord Zhao Bao to tell him: "Does Feng Ting offer seventeen cities? How about accepting it?" Zhao Bao replied: The sage regards unprovoked benefits as great harm. King Xiaocheng said: People are inspired by my kindness, how can you say it is for no reason? Zhao Bao replied: The Qin State encroached on South Korea's land and immediately cut it off, preventing the two sides from communicating with each other. I originally thought that I would get the Shangdang's land safely. The reason why South Korea did not submit to Qin was because it wanted to blame Zhao. Qin has worked hard but Zhao has benefited in vain. Even strong and big countries cannot benefit from small and weak countries at will. Can small and weak countries benefit from strong and big countries? How can we say this is not an unwarranted benefit? Moreover, Qin State used the waterways of Niutian to transport grain and encroached on Korea. It used its best tanks to fight hard and divide the land of Korea. Its decree has been implemented. You cannot be an enemy of it and you must not accept it. King Xiaocheng said: Now if we send out a million troops to attack, we will not be able to get a single city in a year and a half. Now people have given seventeen cities as gifts to our country. This is great benefit! After Zhao Bao went out, King Xiaocheng summoned Lord Pingyuan and Zhao Yu to tell them about the incident. They replied: If we send out an army of millions to attack, we will not be able to get a single city in a year. Now we have obtained seventeen cities in vain. Such a huge bargain cannot be thrown away. King Xiaocheng said: OK. So Zhao Sheng was sent to receive the land. Zhao Sheng told Feng Ting: I am Zhao Sheng, the envoy of our country. The monarch of our country sent me to convey the order. Grant three cities with thousands of households to the prefects, and three cities with thousands of households to each county magistrate. Feng Ting shed tears and did not see the envoy. He said: I cannot be in the position of three injustices: guarding the land for the monarch and not being able to defend it to the death, which is one injustice; the king of Han transferred Shangdang to Qin State, but I did not obey the monarch's order, which is two injustices; selling the monarch's land to get a reward, which is three injustices. Zhao then sent troops to occupy Shangdang. Lian Po led his troops to Changping. In the sixth year of King Xiaocheng's reign, Lian Po was dismissed from his post and Zhao Kuo succeeded him in leading the army. Qin general Bai Qi led his army to surround Zhao Kuo. Zhao Kuo died in the battle and the Zhao army surrendered. More than 400,000 soldiers were killed.
target: Under King Huiwen and his successor King Xiaocheng, Zhao faced the rising power of Qin. King Xiaocheng accepted the surrender of Shangdang from Korea, provoking Qin. This led to the disastrous Battle of Changping, where Zhao Kuo replaced Lian Po and was defeated by Bai Qi, with over 400,000 Zhao soldiers killed. Qin besieged Handan, but Zhao was saved by reinforcements from Chu and Wei. Later, King Xiaocheng's son, King Daoxiang, and his grandson, King Youmiao, ruled as Qin's power grew. Li Mu, a capable general, won victories against Qin, but was killed due to slander. Finally, in 228 BCE, Qin captured Handan, ending the Zhao state. Zhao Jia, a brother of the last king, briefly ruled in Dai before being defeated, and Zhao was made into a Qin commandery.

source: The ancestor of King Gou Jian of Yue was a descendant of Xia Yu and the son of a concubine of Emperor Shaokang of the Xia Dynasty. Emperor Shaokang's son was sealed in Kuaiji, where he respectfully worshiped and inherited Xia Yu's sacrifices. They tattooed their bodies with patterns, cut their hair short, opened up barren land, and built cities. After more than twenty generations of reproduction, it was passed down to Yunchang. When Yunchang was in power, he and King Wu Helu had resentment and attacked each other. After Yunchang's death, his son Gou Jian came to the throne and became the king of Yue. In the first year of King Goujian of Yue, King Helu of Wu heard that Yunchang had passed away, so he raised troops to attack Yue. King Gou Jian of Yue sent warriors who dared to die to challenge the Wu army. The warriors lined up in three lines and rushed into the Wu army's position, shouting that they would kill themselves. The Wu soldiers were stunned. The Vietnamese army took the opportunity to attack the Wu army. They defeated the Wu army at Jianli and shot and wounded the king of Wu in his house. When Helu was dying, he warned his son Fucha: Never forget the country of Yue. Three years ago, Gou Jian heard that King Wu Fu Chai was training his soldiers day and night to avenge Yue, so he planned to strike first and attack Wu before Wu sent troops. Fan Li remonstrated and said: "No, I heard that weapons are dangerous weapons, attacking is immoral, and taking things by force is the lowest behavior in dealing with things." Those who conspire to do immoral things, like to use weapons, and personally participate in low-level things will definitely be opposed by the Emperor of Heaven, and this will not bring good results. The King of Yue said: I have made a decision. So he raised his troops and marched into the state of Wu. After King Wu heard the news, he mobilized the country's elite troops to attack the Vietnamese army, and defeated the Vietnamese army in Fujiao. The King of Yue only gathered 5,000 remaining soldiers and the defeated generals retreated to Kuaiji. King Wu took advantage of the victory to pursue and surrounded Kuaiji. The King of Yue said to Fan Li: I ended up in this situation because I didn't listen to your advice. What should I do? Fan Li replied: Those who can protect themselves must imitate the way of heaven, which is full but not overflowing; those who can calm down crises and overturns must understand that humanity advocates humility; those who can control things will follow the way and adapt to local conditions. Now, you must be humble and courteous to the King of Wu, and send people to give generous gifts to the King of Wu. If he does not agree, go and serve him personally, and pledge yourself to the King of Wu. Gou Jian said: OK! So he sent the official Zhong to ask for peace from Wu. Zhong knelt on the ground and kowtowed as he walked forward and said: Gou Jian, the king's subjugated subject, asked me to boldly tell your subordinates: Gou Jian asks you to allow him to be your slave and his wife to be your concubine. King Wu will agree to plant it. Zixu said to the King of Wu: God has given the Kingdom of Yue to the Kingdom of Wu, so don’t agree to it. Zane returned to Echigo and told Gou Jian about the situation. Gou Jian wanted to kill his wife and children, burn his treasures, and go to the battlefield to fight to the death.
target: King Gou Jian of Yue was a descendant of Xia Yu, son of a concubine of Emperor Shaokang of Xia. Emperor Shaokang's son was enfeoffed at Kuaiji, where he maintained Xia Yu's sacrifices. His descendants tattooed their bodies, cut their hair short, developed wasteland, and built cities. After more than twenty generations, rule passed to Yunchang, who had conflicts with King Helu of Wu. After Yunchang's death, his son Gou Jian became king. In Gou Jian's first year, King Helu of Wu attacked Yue. Gou Jian sent death-defying warriors who lined up in three rows and rushed into Wu's position, shouting they would kill themselves. The stunned Wu soldiers were attacked by Yue forces, defeated at Jianli, and Helu was wounded. Dying, Helu warned his son Fucha never to forget Yue. Three years later, Gou Jian learned Fucha was training soldiers to avenge Wu. Despite Fan Li's warning that weapons were dangerous and attacking immoral, Gou Jian attacked Wu. Fucha mobilized elite troops, defeated Yue at Fujiao, and surrounded Kuaiji with only 5,000 Yue soldiers remaining. Gou Jian regretted ignoring Fan Li's advice. Fan Li advised humility and generous gifts to Wu. Gou Jian sent official Zhong to beg for peace, offering himself as a slave and his wife as a concubine. Wu's Zixu advised against accepting, but Dazai Pi, bribed with treasures, persuaded King Wu to pardon Yue. Zixu warned that Gou Jian was a wise monarch with capable ministers who would cause chaos if allowed to return, but King Wu ignored him.

source: Dazai Pi took the opportunity to persuade the King of Wu: The King of Yue has become an obedient minister. If he is pardoned, it will be beneficial to our country. King Wu agreed to plant it again. Zixu remonstrated again and said: If we don't destroy Yue now, we will definitely regret it in the future. Gou Jian is a wise monarch, and the officials Zhong and Fan Li are both wise ministers. If Gou Jian can return to Yue, he will definitely cause chaos. The King of Wu did not listen to Zixu's advice and finally pardoned the King of Yue and withdrew his troops back to the country. When Gou Jian was trapped in Kuaiji, he once sighed and said: Am I going to end my life here? Zhong said: Tang of Shang was imprisoned in Xiatai, King Wen of Zhou was besieged in Youli, Chong'er of Jin fled to Zhai, and Xiaobai of Qi fled to Ju. They all finally became kings and dominated the world. From this point of view, is it possible that our situation today cannot be a blessing? The King of Wu pardoned the King of Yue. After Gou Jian returned home, he thought deeply and worked hard to hang gall on the seat. He could look up and taste the gall while sitting or lying down, and he could also taste the gall while eating. Said: Have you forgotten the humiliation Kuaiji suffered? He farmed by himself, his wife weaved by herself, and he never had meat dishes in his meals. Never wear two layers of gorgeous clothes, be courteous to wise men, be able to accept humiliation, entertain guests with enthusiasm and sincerity, be able to help the poor, mourn the dead, and work together with the people. The King of Yue wanted Fan Li to manage the government affairs of the country. Fan Li replied: "I am not as good as a soldier in fighting a war. I am not as good as a farmer in calming down and appeasing the country and getting the people to come close to me." So he entrusted the government affairs to the official Zhong, and asked Fan Li and the official Zheji to seek peace and serve as hostages in the state of Wu.
target: After returning home, Gou Jian worked tirelessly, hanging gall where he could taste it, asking himself if he had forgotten Kuaiji's humiliation. He farmed personally, his wife wove cloth, ate no meat, wore no fine clothes, treated worthy men with courtesy, helped the poor, and shared hardships with the people. He entrusted government to Zhong while Fan Li served as hostage in Wu for two years.

source: Besides, when a ferocious big bird attacks a target, it must hide first. Now, the Wu army is attacking Qi and Jin, and has a deep hatred with Chu and Yue. Although it is famous in the world, it has actually jeopardized the prestige of the Zhou royal family. Wu lacks morality but has many military exploits, so he must be arrogant and arrogant. If you really care about the Yue State, it is better for the Yue State to make friends with the Qi State, get closer to the Chu State, submit to the Jin State, and treat Wu favorably. The state of Wu has lofty ambitions and must treat war with contempt. In this way, our country can contact the forces of the three countries and let the three countries attack the state of Wu, and the state of Yue can take advantage of its fatigue to conquer it. Gou Jian said: OK. Two years later, King Wu was about to attack Qi. Zixu remonstrated and said: No. I heard that Gou Jian never cooked two kinds of delicious dishes and shared the joys and sorrows with the people. If this person doesn't die, he will definitely become a worry for our country. The state of Wu had the state of Yue, which was a serious problem, but Qi was just like a scabies to Wu. I hope the king will give up attacking Qi and attack Yue first. The King of Wu refused to listen, so he sent troops to attack Qi, defeated the Qi army in Ailing, and captured Qi's Gao and Guo clans and returned to Wu. King Wu scolded Zixu, and Zixu said: "Don't be too happy!" The King of Wu was very angry and Zixu wanted to commit suicide. The King of Wu heard about it and stopped him. Zhong, the official of the Yue State, said: I have observed that King Wu is too arrogant in power. Please allow me to test it out and borrow food from him to gauge King Wu's attitude towards the State of Yue. Zhong asked King Wu to borrow grain. The King of Wu wanted to lend it to him, but Zixu suggested not to lend it. The King of Wu lent it to Yue anyway, and the King of Yue was secretly very happy. Zixu said: If the king does not listen to my advice, the country of Wu will be in ruins in three years! After Dazai Pi heard this, he argued with Zixu many times about the strategy to deal with the Yue Kingdom. He took the opportunity to slander Zixu and said: "Wu Yuan is loyal on the surface, but in fact he is cruel. He doesn't even care about his father and brother. How can he care about the king?" The king wanted to attack Qi State last time, and his soldiers strongly remonstrated with him. Later, you fought successfully, but he resented you for it. If you don't guard against him, he will definitely cause trouble. Pi also conspired with Feng to slander Zixu again and again in front of the king. The king did not listen to the slander at first, so he sent Zixu as an envoy to Qi. When he heard that Zixu had entrusted his son to the Bao family, the king was furious and said: "Wu Yuan really deceived me!" After Zixu returned from his mission to Qi, the King of Wu sent someone to give Zixu a carved sword and asked him to commit suicide. Zixu laughed and said: I assisted your father to dominate and made you king. At first you wanted to divide the country of Wu equally with me, but I didn't accept it. Not long after that, today you killed me for slander. Alas, alas, you can never build a country by yourself! Zixu told the envoy: I must take out my eyes and hang them on the east gate of the capital of Wu, so that I can see the Vietnamese army entering the capital with my own eyes. So the king of Wu reused Pei to take charge of the state affairs.
target: Seven years after returning, Gou Jian wanted revenge. A counselor advised patience, noting Wu was attacking Qi and Jin while lacking morality. Yue should befriend Qi, Chu, and Jin while treating Wu favorably. Two years later, when Wu prepared to attack Qi, Zixu warned that Gou Jian shared hardships with his people and would become Wu's worry, urging attack on Yue first. King Wu refused, defeated Qi, and scolded Zixu. Yue's Zhong tested Wu by requesting grain; King Wu lent it despite Zixu's objections. Dazai Pi slandered Zixu, and when Zixu entrusted his son to the Bao family while on a mission to Qi, King Wu sent him a sword to commit suicide. Zixu laughed, saying he should have his eyes hung on Wu's east gate to see Yue's army enter.

Only the old, weak and remnant soldiers and the prince stayed in Wudu. Gou Jian asked Fan Li if he could attack Wu. Fan Li said: That's all. The Wu army was defeated, and the Vietnamese army also killed the prince of Wu. The envoy from the State of Wu quickly reported the situation to the King of Wu. The King of Wu was meeting the princes in Huangchi. He was afraid that the people of the world would hear the news of this tragic defeat, so he insisted on keeping it a secret. King Wu had already made an alliance with the princes in Huangchi, so he sent people with generous gifts to ask for peace with Yue. The King of Yue estimated that he could not destroy the State of Wu, so he made peace with the State of Wu. Four years later, Yue attacked Wu again. The army and people of Wu were exhausted, and all their elite soldiers died in the battles with Qi and Jin. Therefore, the State of Yue defeated the Wu army and besieged Wu's capital for three years. When the Wu army was defeated, the State of Yue besieged the King of Wu on Mount Gusu. The King of Wu sent Gong Sunxiong to take off his shirt, expose his arms, kneel forward, and ask for peace with the King of Yue. He said: The helpless minister Fu Cha took the liberty to express his wish. I have offended you in Kuaiji in the past. I dare not disobey your order. If I can make peace with you, I will withdraw my troops and return home. Today you come here to punish me, and I will obey your orders, but my private intention is to forgive my husband Chai's sins just like Kuaiji Mountain did to you! Gou Jian couldn't bear it and wanted to agree to King Wu. Fan Li said: What happened in Kuaiji was that God gave the State of Yue to the State of Wu, but the State of Wu did not take it away. Now that God has given the Kingdom of Wu to the Kingdom of Yue, can the Kingdom of Yue violate the destiny of heaven?
target: Three years later, Gou Jian asked Fan Li about attacking Wu. Fan Li said no. Yue agreed, unable to destroy Wu. Four years later, Yue attacked again, besieged Wu's capital for three years, and trapped King Wu on Gusu Mountain. The king of Yue buried the king of Wu and killed Dazai Pei. After Gou Jian pacified the state of Wu, he sent troops north to cross the Huaihe River, met with the princes of Qi and Jin in Xuzhou, and paid tribute to the Zhou royal family. King Zhou Yuan sent people to reward Gou Jian with sacrificial meat and called him Uncle. Gou Jian left Xuzhou, crossed the Huaihe River and went south. He donated the land in the Huaihe River Basin to the Chu State and returned the land that Wu had invaded from the Song State to the Song State. He donated a hundred miles of land east of Surabaya to the State of Lu. At that time, the Yue army marched unimpeded east of the Yangtze River and Huaihe River. The princes came to celebrate, and the Yue King was called the Overlord. Fan Li then left the King of Yue and sent a letter to Dr. Zhong from Qi. The letter said: When the birds are gone, the good bow is hidden; when the cunning rabbit dies, the running dogs are cooked. The King of Yue is a long-necked bird with a beak. You can only share adversity with him, but you cannot share happiness with him. Why don't you leave? After reading the letter, Zhong claimed that he was ill and would no longer go to court. Someone slandered Zhong and was about to cause rebellion. The King of Yue rewarded Zhong with a sword and said: You taught me seven strategies to attack Wu. I only used three of them to defeat Wu. The four are still with you. Go to the late king for me and try those four!
target: After pacifying Wu, Gou Jian marched north, met with Qi and Jin princes at Xuzhou, and paid tribute to Zhou. King Yuan of Zhou rewarded him. Gou Jian donated land to Chu, Song, and Lu. The Yue army marched unimpeded, and Gou Jian became overlord. Fan Li then left, sending a letter to Zhong from Qi, saying: "When birds are gone, the good bow is hidden; when cunning rabbit dies, running dogs are cooked. You can only share adversity with the king, not happiness." Zhong claimed illness but was slandered as rebellious. The king sent him a sword, saying he had used three of Zhong's seven strategies against Wu and should try the remaining four with the late king. Zhong committed suicide.
