article_path: 史记/三十世家/越王勾践世家
source: I've heard that people who plan to be king can't be king, but they can still be king. However, those who cannot dominate will lose their royal power completely. Therefore, I sincerely hope that you will attack Chu instead. So Yue gave up Qi and attacked Chu. King Chu Wei sent troops to attack the Yue army, defeated the Yue army, killed the Yue King Wuqiang, captured all the land from Wu to Zhejiang, and defeated the Qi army in Xuzhou in the north. From then on, the Yue Kingdom fell apart, and the children of various ethnic groups competed for power. Some claimed the title of king, and some claimed the title of emperor. They lived on the coast south of the Yangtze River and paid tribute to the Chu Kingdom obediently. Seven generations later, the throne passed to Fujian Junyao, who assisted the princes to overthrow the Qin Dynasty. Emperor Gao of the Han Dynasty resumed his role as the king of Yue and continued the worship of the country of Yue. Dongyue and Minjun are both descendants of Yue. Fan Li served King Gou Jian of Yue, worked hard physically and mentally, and tried his best to plan with Gou Jian for more than 20 years. Finally, he destroyed the state of Wu and wiped out the shame of Kuaiji. The Vietnamese army marched north to the Huaihe River and approached the borders of Qi and Shanxi. They ordered all the countries in the Central Plains to respect the Zhou Dynasty and make Gou Jian the hegemon. Fan Li became the general.
target: Gou Jian died, and his descendants ruled for generations until King Wuqiang. During King Wei of Chu's reign, Yue attacked Qi. Qi's envoy persuaded Yue to attack Chu instead, arguing that Chu's forces were dispersed. Yue abandoned Qi and attacked Chu. King Wei of Chu defeated Yue, killed King Wuqiang, and seized all land from Wu to Zhejiang. Yue disintegrated, with various descendants competing for power, some claiming kingship, living south of the Yangtze and paying tribute to Chu. Seven generations later, Fujian Junyao helped princes overthrow Qin. Emperor Gao of Han restored Yue's kingship. Dongyue and Minjun were both Yue descendants.

id: 史记/三十世家/越王勾践世家::group-006
article_path: 史记/三十世家/越王勾践世家
source: Seven generations later, the throne passed to Fujian Junyao, who assisted the princes to overthrow the Qin Dynasty. Emperor Gao of the Han Dynasty resumed his role as the king of Yue and continued the worship of the country of Yue. Dongyue and Minjun are both descendants of Yue. Fan Li served King Gou Jian of Yue, worked hard physically and mentally, and tried his best to plan with Gou Jian for more than 20 years. Finally, he destroyed the state of Wu and wiped out the shame of Kuaiji. The Vietnamese army marched north to the Huaihe River and approached the borders of Qi and Shanxi. They ordered all the countries in the Central Plains to respect the Zhou Dynasty and make Gou Jian the hegemon. Fan Li became the general. After returning home, Fan Li thought that it would be difficult to live long under such a great reputation. Moreover, Gou Jian was a man who could share hardships with him but not happiness with him. He wrote a farewell letter to Gou Jian and said: I heard that when the king is worried, his ministers will work hard, and when the king is insulted, his ministers will die. You were humiliated in Kuaiji in the past, and the reason why I didn't die was to avenge you. Now that I have avenged my humiliation, I beg you to grant me the death penalty for the humiliation my lord suffered in Kuaiji. Gou Jian said: I will divide the country of Yue equally with you. Otherwise, you will be blamed. Fan Li said: The monarch can carry out your orders, but the ministers still follow their own wishes. So he packed up the fine jewelry and left by boat with his entourage, never returning to Yue. In recognition of Fan Li, Gou Jian made Kuaiji Mountain his fief. Fan Li took a boat and drifted across the sea to the state of Qi. He changed his name and surname and called himself "Gui Yi Zipi". He farmed on the seaside, endured hardships and worked hard to produce, and his father and son worked together to manage the industry. After living there for a short time, he accumulated hundreds of thousands of property. The people of Qi heard that he was a virtuous man and made him prime minister. Fan Li sighed and said: If you live at home, you can accumulate thousands of gold and property, and if you become an official, you can reach the high position of minister. This is the highest status that ordinary people can achieve. It is unlucky to enjoy a distinguished name for a long time. So he returned the seal and distributed all his property to his close friends, fellow villagers and neighbors. He took the valuables with him and left secretly to live in Taodi. He believed that this was the center of the world, with smooth roads for transactions and that one could make a fortune by doing business. So he called himself Tao Zhu Gong. It was also agreed that both father and son would farm and raise livestock, and wait for the opportunity when buying and selling, so as to obtain one-tenth of the profit. Soon after, the family assets accumulated to tens of millions. Everyone in the world praises Tao Zhugong.
target: Fan Li served Gou Jian for over twenty years, destroying Wu and making Gou Jian hegemon. Recognizing that great fame was difficult to sustain and Gou Jian could not share happiness, Fan Li left by boat with valuables, never returning. He changed his name, farmed in Qi, accumulated wealth, became prime minister, then resigned, distributed his property, and moved to Taodi, calling himself Tao Zhugong. He farmed and traded, accumulating millions.

id: 史记/三十世家/越王勾践世家::group-007
article_path: 史记/三十世家/越王勾践世家
source: Zhuang Sheng asked in surprise: "Didn't you leave?" The eldest son said: He never left. I came here because of my younger brother. Today, the State of Chu is discussing amnesty, and my younger brother will naturally be released, so I came here specifically to say goodbye to you. Zhuang Sheng knew that he wanted to get the gold back, so he said, "Go to the room and get the gold yourself." The eldest son broke into the house, took away the gold and left Zhuang Sheng, secretly rejoicing that the gold was recovered. Zhuang Sheng felt deeply ashamed that he had been betrayed by his younger generation, so he went to the palace again to meet with the King of Chu and said: "What I told you about a certain star last time, you said you wanted to repay it by doing good deeds." Now, I heard from passers-by outside that the son of the rich Taoist Zhu Gong was imprisoned by Chu after killing someone. His family sent people to bribe the people around the king of Chu with a lot of money. Therefore, the king did not implement the amnesty out of sympathy for the people of Chu, but he gave the amnesty because of Zhu Gong's son. The King of Chu was furious and said: Although I am not virtuous, how could I give favors to Duke Zhu's son? He ordered Zhu Gong's son to be killed first, and then issued an edict of pardon the next day. The eldest son of Lord Zhu had no choice but to carry his younger brother's body home. After returning home, my mother and neighbors were all very sad. Only Mr. Zhu laughed and said: I knew that the eldest son would not be able to save his younger brother! It's not that he doesn't love his brother, he just has something he can't bear to give up. He has lived with me since he was young, has experienced all kinds of hardships, and knows how difficult it is to make a living, so he values ​​money very seriously and does not dare to spend money easily. As for my little brother, he has only seen me being extremely wealthy since he was born. He rides in fine cars, drives thousands of miles of horses, and goes hunting in the countryside. He doesn’t know where the money comes from, so he takes money very lightly and throws it away without mercy. It turned out that I planned to let the younger son go because he was willing to give up money, but the eldest son couldn't give up money, and ended up killing his younger brother. This is reasonable and not worthy of grief. What I was looking forward to day and night was for my second son’s body to be returned. Fan Li moved three times and became famous all over the world. He didn't just leave somewhere randomly. He became famous wherever he lived. In the end, he died of old age in Taodi, so people in the world called him Tao Zhugong. Tai Shigong said: Xia Yu's contribution was great. He channeled the nine great rivers and stabilized the land of Kyushu. To this day, the whole of Kyushu is safe and sound. When his descendant Gou Jian arrived, he worked hard and thought far, and finally destroyed the powerful Wu State, marched north to the Central Plains, worshiped the Zhou Dynasty, and became the overlord. Can you say that you are not virtuous? This is probably the legacy of Xia Yu. Fan Li moved three times and left a glorious reputation that will last forever.
target: His second son killed someone in Chu. He sent his youngest son with gold to bribe his old friend Zhuang Sheng, but his eldest son insisted on going. The eldest son delivered the gold but later retrieved it when he thought amnesty would free his brother. Zhuang Sheng, ashamed, told the Chu king that the amnesty was due to bribery. The king killed Zhu Gong's son first, then issued amnesty. Zhu Gong had expected this, knowing his eldest son valued money while his youngest would spend freely. Fan Li died of old age in Taodi. Tai Shigong commented: Xia Yu's contributions were great, channeling rivers and stabilizing Kyushu. His descendant Gou Jian worked hard, destroyed Wu, and became overlord—truly virtuous, likely Xia Yu's legacy. Fan Li moved three times, leaving a glorious reputation.

source: King You appointed him as Situ. He made the people of Zhou Dynasty live in harmony, and the people were very happy. People in the Yellow River and Luoshui basins missed him. When he was a Situ for a year, because King You doted on Bao Si and neglected political affairs, the problems became difficult to recover. Some princes betrayed King You. So Huan Gong asked Tai Shibo: "The royal family is in serious disaster. How can I escape from death?" Tai Shibo replied: Only the east of Luoshui and the south of the Yellow River can live in peace. Duke Huan asked: Why? Tai Shibo replied: The kings of the neighboring countries of Guo, Hao, Guo and Hao in that area were greedy and liked to take advantage of small things, so the people did not obey them. Now, you are Situ, and the people love you. If you really ask to live in that area, the kings of Guo and Hao will easily give you land if they see that you are legitimate. If you really live in that area, the people of Guo and Hao will be your people. Duke Huan: I want to live in the Yangtze River Basin in the south. How about it? Taishi replied: In the past, Zhu Rong controlled fire for the Gao Xin family and made great contributions, but his descendants did not prosper in the Zhou Dynasty. Chu State is his descendant. If the Zhou royal family is weak, Chu will surely prosper. If the state of Chu prospers, it will definitely not be beneficial to the state of Zheng. Duke Huan said; I want to live in the west, how about it? Tai Shibo replied: The people there are greedy and profit-seeking, and it is difficult to live there for a long time. Duke Huan said: If the Zhou royal family is weak, which country will prosper? Tai Shibo replied: Qi, Qin, Jin, Chu, right? Qi State, whose surname was Jiang, was a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Yao in managing the ceremonial system. Qin, whose surname is Ying, is a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Shun in bringing many tribes into submission. As for the ancestors of the Chu State, they have also established meritorious deeds for the people of the world. After King Wu of Zhou defeated King Zhou, King Cheng granted the Tang Dynasty to Shuyu. The mountains and rivers there were dangerous. With these virtuous descendants coexisting with the weak Zhou family, the Jin Kingdom would definitely be able to prosper. Duke Huan said: OK. So he quickly asked King You for instructions and moved his people to the east of Luoshui. As expected, the kings of Guo and Xi donated ten cities to him, and he finally established the state of Zheng. In the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at the foot of Mount Li. The people of Zheng supported Duke Huan's son Jutu, who was Duke Wu. In the tenth year of Duke Wu's reign, he married the daughter of Marquis Shen as his wife, named Wu Jiang. Wu Jiang gave birth to the prince Wusheng, but it was difficult to deliver the baby. After the birth, his wife did not like Wusheng. Later, Wu Jiang gave birth to a younger son, Shu Duan, who was born naturally. His wife loved Shu Duan very much. In the twenty-seventh year, Duke Wu fell ill. His wife asked him to make Duan the crown prince, but Duke Wu refused. At that time, Duke Wu passed away and Wansheng came to the throne. This was Duke Zhuang. In the first year of Emperor Zhuang's reign, Duke Zhuang granted his younger brother Uncle Duan a title to the capital, and he was known as Taishu. Ji Zhong said: The capital is larger than the capital, so it cannot be granted to a younger brother. Duke Zhuang said: Wu Jiang wants to do this, and I dare not object.
target: Duke Huan of Zheng, the youngest son of King Zhou Li, was granted the title of Zhengdi and served as Situ under King You. Loved by the people, he sought advice from Tai Shibo on escaping the Zhou royal family's impending disaster. Tai Shibo advised moving east of Luoshui and south of the Yellow River, where the greedy rulers of Guo and Hao would cede land. Duke Huan relocated his people there, establishing the state of Zheng. However, in the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at Mount Li. Duke Huan's son, Duke Wu, succeeded him. Duke Wu's wife, Wu Jiang, favored their younger son Shu Duan over the crown prince Wusheng (Duke Zhuang). After Duke Wu's death, Duke Zhuang granted Shu Duan the capital, leading to rebellion. Duke Zhuang defeated Shu Duan, exiled Wu Jiang, but later reconciled with her through a tunnel.

source: In the fourth year of Li Gong's reign, he offered sacrifices to Zhong Zhuanquan. Duke Li was concerned about this matter and secretly asked Ji Zhong's son-in-law to kill Ji Zhong. Yong Jiu's wife was Ji Zhong's daughter. When she found out about this, she asked her mother: Which one is closer, father or husband? The mother said: There is only one father, but there are many choices for husbands! Ji Zhongnu told Ji Zhong about this, but Ji Zhong killed Yong Jiu and exposed his body in the busy market. Duke Li was helpless with Ji Zhong, but he was very angry with Yong Jiu, saying: After discussing with the woman, he deserved to die. In the summer, Duke Li was driven to live in Queyi on the border. Ji Zhong welcomed Zhao Gonghu, and on Yihai day in the sixth month, Hu returned to Zhengdu and ascended the throne. In the autumn, Duke Li of Zheng relied on the people of the city to kill Uncle Shan, the official of Liyi, and settled in Liyi. When the princes heard that Duke Li had escaped, they attacked Zheng Guo, but they left without defeating Zheng Guo. The State of Song gave Duke Li a large number of troops and asked him to stand guard in Liyi. Therefore, the State of Zheng stopped attacking the city. In the second year of Duke Zhao, when Duke Zhao became the crown prince, his father, Duke Zhuang, wanted to make Gao Qumi his minister. The prince suddenly disliked Gao Qumi. Duke Zhuang did not listen to Hu's advice and finally made Qumi his minister. When Zhaogong came to the throne, Qumi was worried that Zhaogong would kill him. On Xinmao day in October in winter, Qumi and Zhaogong went hunting and shot Zhaogong in the countryside. Ji Zhong and Qu Mi did not dare to accept Duke Li, so they made Zhao Gong's younger brother Zi Qi the king instead, and they called him Zi Qi. He had no posthumous title. In the seventh month of the first year of Ziqian, Duke Xiang of Qi met with the princes at the first stop. Zheng Ziqian went to the meeting, assisted by Gao Qumi, who followed Ziqian there. Ji Zhong excused himself from illness.
target: Duke Zhuang's reign saw conflicts with Zhou, Song, and Wei. He defeated King Huan of Zhou in battle but refrained from pursuing him. After Duke Zhuang's death, his son Duke Zhao briefly ruled but was ousted by Duke Li, who was backed by Song. Duke Li killed Ji Zhong but was later driven out, and Duke Zhao returned. Duke Zhao was assassinated by Gao Qumi, leading to a succession of short-lived rulers. Duke Li eventually returned, executed those who betrayed him, and reigned until his death. His son Duke Wen succeeded him.

source: Yan Yan told Wen Gong about this dream, and Wen Gong slept with her. And gave her bluegrass as a voucher. So Yan Ji gave birth to a son, named Lan. In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Chong'er of Jin passed by the state of Zheng, and Duke Wen of Zheng was not polite to him. Uncle Zhan, Wen Gong's younger brother, said: "Chong'er is a wise man and has the same surname as us. He passed by you when he was in poverty. You cannot be rude to him." Duke Wen said: "There are many fugitive princes from the princes passing by here. How can I receive them according to the courtesy?" Uncle Zhan said: "If you don't treat him politely, kill him. If you don't kill him, if he returns to the country, he will be a worry to the state of Zheng." Duke Wen did not listen to Uncle Zhan's advice. In the spring of the thirty-seventh year, Duke Chong'er of Jin returned to Jin and ascended the throne. He was Duke Wen of Jin. In the autumn, the State of Zheng invaded the State of Hua, and the State of Hua only obeyed Zheng's orders. Soon, the State of Hua joined the State of Wei, so the State of Zheng attacked the State of Hua again. King Zhou Xiang asked Bo Fu to intercede on behalf of the Hua Kingdom. Zheng Wengong resented King Hui for fleeing to Yue. It was Wen Gong's father, Li Gong, who escorted King Hui back to the throne. However, King Hui did not reward Duke Li with a salary for the throne. He also resented King Xiang for joining the Wei Kingdom and the Hua Kingdom. Therefore, Wen Gong did not listen to King Xiang's intercession for the Hua Kingdom and instead imprisoned Bo Fu. King Xiang was very angry and united with the Zhai people to attack Zheng State, but failed to win. In winter, the Zhai people attacked King Xiang of Zhou, and King Xiang fled to Zheng State. Zheng Wengong asked King Xiang to live in Chi. In the thirty-eighth year, Duke Wen of Jin sent King Xiang of Zhou back to Chengzhou. In the forty-one year, Zheng Guo helped Chu State attack Jin State. Because Jin Wengong passed by Zheng and Zheng was rude to him, Zheng betrayed Jin and helped Chu. Forty-three years ago, Duke Wen of Jin and Duke Mu of Qin jointly besieged the capital of Zheng. They attacked Jun Zheng for helping Chu to attack Jin, and Wen Gong passed by Jun Zheng for his rude crime. At the beginning, Zheng Wengong had three wives and five beloved sons, all of whom died early due to their crimes. Zheng Wengong hated Zi Xia and drove away the princes. Zilan fled to Jin and followed Duke Wen of Jin to besiege Zhengdu. At that time, Zilan served Duke Wen of Jin with great respect, and Duke Wen of Jin favored him very much. He acted secretly in Jin and took the opportunity to ask to return to Zheng to be the crown prince.
target: Duke Wen's reign involved conflicts with Jin and Chu. He was rude to Chong'er (later Duke Wen of Jin), who later besieged Zheng. Duke Wen's son Zilan, favored by Jin, became crown prince and later Duke Mu. Duke Mu's reign saw Qin's failed attack on Zheng, exposed by merchant Xian Gao. Zheng allied with Jin against Qin. After Duke Mu's death, Duke Lin was killed by Zigong over a turtle soup dispute. Duke Xiang succeeded him, facing Chu attacks and shifting alliances between Jin and Chu. Duke Xiang surrendered to Chu but was spared by King Zhuang.

source: Tai Ni could inherit the official position of his predecessors, dredged the Fen River and Tao River well, built embankments for Daze, and lived in Taiyuan. Emperor Zhuanxu rewarded him for this and sealed Fenshui to him. Shen, Si, Piao, and Huang Guo were actually in charge of his sacrifices. Now, Jin ruled the Fen River Basin and destroyed the countries in this area. From here, Tai Ni is the god of Fen and Tao rivers. However, these two gods will not harm your body. For the gods of mountains and rivers, sacrifices should be made when floods and droughts occur. For the gods of the sun, moon and stars, sacrifices should be made when snow, frost, wind and rain come out of season. If you are sick, it is caused by eating, drinking, music, and women. After discussing this with Zichan, Duke Ping and his uncle praised him and said: Yes, you are truly worthy of being a knowledgeable gentleman! Give your son a generous gift. In the summer of the twenty-seventh year, Duke Jiang of Zheng went to pay homage to the king of Jin. In the winter, the state of Zheng was afraid that King Ling of Chu was powerful, so he paid homage to the state of Chu, and Zichan followed him. In the twenty-eighth year, Zheng Jun fell ill and sent Zichan to meet with the princes and make an alliance with King Ling of Chu in Shen. King Chu killed Qi Guo Qingfeng. In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Jian passed away, and his son Ding Gongning came to the throne. In autumn, Duke Dinggong paid homage to Duke Zhao of Jin. In the first year of Ding AD, the prince of Chu State Qi Ji killed the king of the country, King Ling, and established himself as king. This was King Ping. King Ping wanted to do something benevolent and moral among the princes, so he returned all the land that King Ling had invaded from Zheng to Zheng. In four years, Jin Zhaogong passed away. The six ministers of Jin became stronger and the country's power weakened. Zichan said to Han Xuanzi: To hold power must be based on benevolence, righteousness and morality, and do not forget the reasons for the consolidation of power. In the sixth year, a fire broke out in the state of Zheng, and Duke Din wanted to pray to ward off the disaster. Zichan said: It is better to practice virtuous government. In the eighth year, Prince Jian of Chu State fled to Zheng State. In the tenth year, Prince Jian discussed with Jin State to attack Zheng State. Zheng Guo killed Prince Jian, and Prince Jian's son fled to Wu. In the eleventh year, Duke Dinggong arrived in Jin. Jin and Zheng negotiated to kill the rebellious ministers of the Zhou royal family and send King Jing back to Zhou. In the thirteenth year, Duke Ding passed away and his son Xiangong Hui came to the throne. Duke Xian died in the thirteenth year, and his son Sheng Gongsheng ascended the throne. At this time, the six ministers of Jin became stronger and invaded Zheng's territory, causing Zheng to decline. In the fifth year of Duke Sheng's reign, the Prime Minister of Zheng died. The people of Zheng all cried, mourning for him as they mourned for their own relatives. Zichan is the youngest son of Zheng Chenggong. Be kind and caring to others, serve the king with loyalty and honesty. Confucius once passed by the state of Zheng and was as close as brothers to Zichan. When he heard that Zichan had died, Confucius cried sadly: Zichan's benevolence is really a legacy from ancient times!
target: Later rulers included Duke Cheng, who was captured by Jin for allying with Chu, and Duke Li, who was poisoned by Zi Si. Duke Jian's reign featured Zichan, a wise minister who stabilized Zheng through diplomacy and reforms. Zichan's advice to Jin's Duke Ping on gods and governance earned him praise. After Zichan's death, Zheng declined under pressure from Jin's six ministers and Han's invasions. Duke Sheng's reign saw Zichan's death, mourned by all. Confucius wept for Zichan, calling his benevolence a legacy from ancient times.

source: In the twenty-second year, King Hui of Chu destroyed the state of Chen. Confucius passed away. In the thirty-sixth year, Zhibo of Jin State attacked Zheng State and captured nine cities. In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Sheng passed away, and his son Duke Ai came to the throne. In the eighth year of Duke Ai, the people of Zheng killed Duke Ai and made Chou, the younger brother of Duke Sheng, the king of the country. In the third year of Gong Gong's reign, the three Jin Dynasties destroyed Zhibo. In the thirty-first year, Gonggong passed away, and his son Yougong came to the throne. In the first year of Yougong, Han Wuzi attacked Zheng Guo and killed Yougong. The people of Zheng appointed You Gong's younger brother as the king of the country. This was Duke Fang. In the fifteenth year of Gong Gong's reign, Han Jinghou attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yongqiu. Zheng Guo built the capital. In the 16th year, Zheng Guo attacked South Korea and defeated the Korean army in Fushu. In twenty years, Han, Zhao, and Wei became vassal states. In the twenty-third year, Zheng Guo surrounded Yangzhai in South Korea. In the twenty-fifth year, Zheng Jun killed Yang, the Prime Minister of the country. In the twenty-seventh year, Ziyang's followers killed Gong Xi and made You Gong's younger brother Yi the king of the country. This was Zheng Jun. Two years after Zheng Junyi took the throne, the people who were occupied by Zheng Guo rebelled and returned to Korea. In the eleventh year, South Korea attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yangcheng. In the twenty-first year, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed the State of Zheng and annexed it. Tai Shigong said: As the saying goes, people who rely on power and interests to bond together will become estranged when the power and interests end. This is exactly the case with Fu Xia. Although Fu Xia kidnapped and killed Zheng Zi and accepted Li Gong back as king, Li Gong eventually abandoned him and killed him. What is the difference between this approach and Jin's Rick? But if someone like Xun Xi sticks to his integrity, he will not be able to save Xi Qi even if he dies.
target: Zheng's final years were marked by internal strife and Korean aggression. Duke Ai was killed, and subsequent rulers faced Korean attacks. In the twenty-first year of Zheng Junyi's reign, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed Zheng, annexing its territory. Tai Shigong reflected on the fickle nature of power and loyalty, citing Fu Xia's betrayal of Zheng Zi and Li Gong's eventual execution of him, comparing it to Jin's Rick. He noted that even steadfast figures like Xun Xi could not prevent disaster, as unforeseen events often alter outcomes.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-000
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: Prime Minister Chen Ping was a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County. Chen Ping's family was poor when he was a boy, but he loved studying. His family had 30 acres of land, and he lived with his brother Chen Bo. Brother Chen Bo usually farmed at home, leaving Chen Ping to study abroad. Chen Ping is tall and handsome. Someone said to Chen Ping: How could a poor family eat and become so fat? Chen Ping's sister-in-law was angry that Chen Ping didn't take care of the family and was not engaged in labor and production. She said: "It's just eating bran and throat vegetables. It's better to have such a brother-in-law than not." When Uncle Chen heard these words, he divorced his wife and kicked her out of the house. When Chen Ping grew up and it was time to marry a wife, no one from a wealthy family would marry his daughter to him, and Chen Ping felt ashamed to marry a daughter-in-law from a poor family. After a long time, there was a rich man named Zhang Fu in Hufu. His granddaughter married five times, and each husband died. No one dared to marry her again. Chen Ping wanted to marry her. There was a funeral in the township. Because Chen Ping's family was poor, he went to help with the funeral. He went early and came back late to earn more money to supplement his family's income. Zhang Fu met him at the mourning house and fell in love with the tall and burly Chen Ping; for this reason, Chen Ping left the mourning house very late. Once, Zhang Fu followed Chen Ping to his home. The Chen family was in a remote alley near the outer city wall. They used a shabby mat as the door, but there were many wheel marks left by noble people outside the door. After Zhang Fu returned home, he said to his son Zhang Zhong: I plan to marry my granddaughter to Chen Ping. Zhang Zhong said: Chen Ping is poor and not engaged in productive labor. Everyone in the county laughs at what he does. Why did you marry your granddaughter to him? Zhang Fu said: How could a man as handsome as Zhang Ping remain poor and humble for a long time? Finally, he married his granddaughter to Chen Ping. Because Chen Ping was poor, the Zhang family lent him money to hire him and gave him money to buy banquets to get married. Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve others disrespectfully because the Chen family is poor. Serve your elder brother Chen Bo as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother. After Chen Ping married a girl from the Zhang family, his wealth became increasingly abundant and his contacts became wider and wider. Kushangli, where Chen Ping lived, worshiped the earth god. Chen Ping was the person who presided over the cutting of the meat. He distributed the sacrificial meat evenly.
target: Chen Ping, a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County, was born into poverty but loved studying. His brother Chen Bo farmed while Chen Ping studied abroad. Tall and handsome, Chen Ping faced criticism for his lack of labor, leading his sister-in-law to complain. Chen Bo divorced her upon hearing this. When Chen Ping sought marriage, wealthy families refused him, and he hesitated to marry a poor woman. Eventually, he married Zhang Fu's granddaughter, who had been widowed five times. Zhang Fu, impressed by Chen Ping's appearance and potential, lent him money for the wedding, advising his granddaughter to serve the Chen family respectfully. After marriage, Chen Ping's wealth and connections grew.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-001
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: Zhang Fu said: How could a man as handsome as Zhang Ping remain poor and humble for a long time? Finally, he married his granddaughter to Chen Ping. Because Chen Ping was poor, the Zhang family lent him money to hire him and gave him money to buy banquets to get married. Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve others disrespectfully because the Chen family is poor. Serve your elder brother Chen Bo as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother. After Chen Ping married a girl from the Zhang family, his wealth became increasingly abundant and his contacts became wider and wider. Kushangli, where Chen Ping lived, worshiped the earth god. Chen Ping was the person who presided over the cutting of the meat. He distributed the sacrificial meat evenly. The fellow villagers said: Well, the Chen family’s children are really good at cutting up sacrificial meat! Chen Ping said: Alas, if I were allowed to rule the world, I would divide the meat like this! After Chen Sheng raised an army, he proclaimed himself king in Chen County, sent Zhou Shi to pacify the Wei area, established Wei Jiu as the king of Wei, and fought with the Qin army in Linji. Before that, Chen Ping had bid farewell to his brother Chen Bo and went to Linji with some young people to work under Wei Wang Jiu. The king of Wei appointed him as his servant. Chen Ping spoke to the King of Wei, but the King of Wei did not listen. Some people said bad things about him, so Chen Ping had no choice but to flee. After a long time, Xiang Yu captured the land and reached the edge of the Yellow River. Chen Ping went to Xiang Yu and followed Xiang Yu into the Pass to conquer Qin. Xiang Yu gave him the title of Qing. Xiang Yu returned eastward and proclaimed himself king in Pengcheng. The King of Han returned to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties and marched eastward. The King of Yin rebelled against Chu. Xiang Yu then named Chen Ping Lord Xinwu and asked him to lead Wei Wang Jiu's men who had stayed in Chu to defeat and surrender King Yin and return in triumph. King Xiang sent Xiang Han to appoint Chen Ping as a lieutenant and rewarded him with twenty yi of gold. Not long after, the king of Han conquered Yin again. King Xiang was furious and prepared to kill the generals who had conquered Yin the previous time.
target: Chen Ping presided over cutting sacrificial meat for the earth god, distributing it evenly, and remarked, "If I ruled the world, I would divide it like this." During the Chen Sheng uprising, he served Wei Wang Jiu but left after his advice was ignored. He then joined Xiang Yu, who appointed him Lord Xinwu. Fearing execution after a failed campaign, Chen Ping fled to the Han king, Liu Bang, who made him a captain. Despite slander from generals like Zhou Bo and Guan Ying about his past and alleged bribery, Chen Ping defended himself, and Liu Bang rewarded him generously, appointing him to supervise the army.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-002
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: If your Majesty is willing to spend tens of thousands of kilograms of gold to carry out counter-insurgency strategies, alienate the relationship between the kings and ministers of Chu State, and make them suspicious of each other. King Xiang is suspicious and easy to listen to slander, and they will definitely kill each other among themselves. The Han army can take the opportunity to send troops to attack them, and they will definitely defeat the Chu army. The King of Han thought that Chen Ping was right, so he gave Chen Ping 40,000 kilograms of gold and allowed him to use it without asking about his expenditure. Chen Ping spent a lot of gold to create discord among the Chu army. He threatened among the generals that Zhongli Mei and others, as generals of King Xiang, had made a lot of contributions, but they could not allocate territory and become kings. They planned to join forces with the King of Han to eliminate King Xiang, divide the land of Chu, and make each of them king. Xiang Yu became suspicious and no longer trusted Zhong Limei and others. King Xiang had already suspected Zhong Limei and others, so he sent envoys to the Han army to find out. The king of Han prepared a sumptuous banquet and ordered people to bring it in. When he saw the envoy from the King of Chu, the King of Han pretended to be surprised and said: I thought it was Yafu's envoy, but it turned out to be the envoy from the King of Chu! He also asked people to take away the wine and food, and replaced them with poor food to serve to the envoy of the King of Chu. After the King of Chu's envoy returned, he reported the situation to King Xiang. As expected, King Xiang was greatly suspicious of Kia's father. Fan Zeng wanted to capture Xingyang City quickly, but King Xiang did not trust him and refused to obey. When Fan Zeng heard that King Xiang was doubting him, he said angrily: "The major events in the world are basically settled. The king can do it himself!"
target: Chen Ping advised Liu Bang to use gold to sow discord among Xiang Yu's ministers, leading to Xiang Yu's suspicion of Fan Zeng and others. Fan Zeng resigned and died.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-003
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: After the King of Chu's envoy returned, he reported the situation to King Xiang. As expected, King Xiang was greatly suspicious of Kia's father. Fan Zeng wanted to capture Xingyang City quickly, but King Xiang did not trust him and refused to obey. When Fan Zeng heard that King Xiang was doubting him, he said angrily: "The major events in the world are basically settled. The king can do it himself!" I beg to resign and return home! Before he reached Pengcheng when he returned to his hometown, he died of a sore attack on his back. Chen Ping then asked two thousand women to leave the east gate of Xingyang City at night. The Chu army launched an attack, and Chen Ping and the King of Han fled out of the city through the west gate of Xingyang City. The King of Han then entered Guanzhong, collected the scattered soldiers and marched eastward again. The next year, Han Xin, the Marquis of Huaiyin, defeated the State of Qi and proclaimed himself King of Qi. He sent an envoy to report the incident to the King of Han. The king of Han was furious and scolded Han Xin. Chen Ping secretly stepped on the King of Han's toes, and the King of Han also realized it, so he entertained the King of Qi's envoy generously and sent Zhang Zifang to immediately make Han Xin the King of Qi. The king of Han granted the town of Hufu to Chen Ping.
target: Chen Ping then helped Liu Bang escape Xingyang by sending women out the east gate while they fled west. Later, he advised against attacking Han Xin directly, instead capturing him during a meeting in Chen County. Liu Bang granted Chen Ping the title of Huyouhou, which Chen Ping attributed to Wei Wuzhi's recommendation.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-004
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: When he became the Prime Minister of Zuo and lived in the palace, all officials had to use him to decide national affairs. Lu Yan often slandered Chen Ping many times because he had made plans for Emperor Gao to arrest Fan Kuai: Chen Ping ignored government affairs when he was prime minister, drank fine wine every day, and played with women. After hearing this, Chen Ping started drinking and having fun more and more. When Empress Dowager Lu heard about this, she was secretly happy. She said to Chen Ping in front of Lu Yan: As the saying goes, "The words of children and women cannot be trusted. It depends on how you treat me." Don't be afraid that Lu Yan will say bad things about you. Empress Dowager Lu made a member of the Lu family king, and Chen Ping pretended to obey. After the death of Empress Dowager Lu, Chen Ping conspired with Taiwei Zhou Bo, and finally killed all the Lu family and installed Emperor Xiaowen on the throne. Chen Ping was the main planner of this matter. After examining the food, he was dismissed from the post of Prime Minister Zuo. After Emperor Xiaowen came to the throne, he believed that Taiwei Zhou Bo had made great contributions by personally leading troops to annihilate the Lu clan. Chen Ping wanted to give up the title of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo, so he retired due to illness. Emperor Xiaowen had just ascended the throne and felt that Chen Ping was strangely ill, so he went to inquire about him. Chen Ping said: During the reign of Emperor Gaozu, Zhou Bo's contribution was not as good as mine, Chen Ping. When it came time to annihilate the Lu family, my contribution would not be as good as Zhou Bo's. I am willing to give up the position of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo. So Emperor Xiaowen appointed Jianghou Zhou Bo as Prime Minister of the Right, ranking first; Chen Ping was transferred to Prime Minister of the Left, ranking second. Chen Ping was given a thousand pieces of gold as a reward, and three thousand households were granted food fiefs. After a period of time, Emperor Xiaowen gradually became more familiar with national affairs. When he was interviewed by ministers, he asked Zhou Bo, the right prime minister: How many cases were judged in the country in a year? Zhou Bo apologized and said: I don’t know. Emperor Xiaowen asked again: How much is the country's annual expenditure on money and grain? Zhou Bo apologized again and said he didn't know. He was so anxious that he was sweating profusely and felt ashamed that he couldn't answer. So the emperor asked Chen Ping, Prime Minister Zuo. Chen Ping said: There is a person in charge who is responsible. The emperor said: Who is in charge? Chen Ping said: If your Majesty asks about the status of the judgment case, you can ask the Tingwei; if you want to ask about the income and expenditure of money and food, you can ask the history of Zhi Su Nei. The emperor said: If each has a person in charge, then what is it that you are in charge of? Chen Ping apologized and said: I am truly terrified! Your Majesty did not know that I was of low intelligence, so I reluctantly held the position of prime minister. The position of prime minister is to assist the emperor to regulate yin and yang and comply with the four seasons, to nurture all things to grow in time, to calm the barbarians and princes externally, to care for and unite the people internally, so that the ministers and officials can fulfill their duties. After hearing this, Emperor Xiaowen praised him for his good answer.
target: Chen Ping devised six secret strategies, including rescuing Liu Bang from a Xiongnu siege at Pingcheng. After Liu Bang's death, Chen Ping avoided Empress Lu's suspicion by pretending to indulge in drinking and women. He conspired with Zhou Bo to eliminate the Lu clan and install Emperor Xiaowen. Chen Ping later ceded the position of Right Prime Minister to Zhou Bo, citing Zhou Bo's greater role in suppressing the Lu family. When Emperor Xiaowen questioned the prime ministers about state affairs, Zhou Bo faltered, while Chen Ping explained the prime minister's role in regulating yin and yang and ensuring officials fulfilled their duties. Zhou Bo resigned, and Chen Ping served as sole prime minister until his death in 166 BC.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家::group-005
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈丞相世家
source: Chen Ping smiled and said: "You are in a position, don't you know your responsibilities?" If Your Majesty asks about the number of thieves in Chang'an City, will you have to make up the numbers to answer? At this time Jianghou Zhou Bo knew that his talents were far inferior to Chen Ping. After a while, Jianghou Zhou Bo was ill and asked to be relieved of the post of Prime Minister You, and Chen Ping took on the entire post of Prime Minister alone. In the second year of Emperor Xiaowen's reign, Prime Minister Chen Ping passed away, and his posthumous title was Xianhou. His son Gonghou Chenmai succeeded him. Chen Mai died after reigning for two years, and his son Chen Hui, Marquis of Jian, succeeded him. Chen Hui died in the 23rd year of his reign, and his son Chen He succeeded him. In the twenty-third year of Chen He's reign, he committed the crime of seizing other people's wives and was sentenced to death. The feudal state was abolished. Chen Ping once said: I often use secretive strategies, which is taboo in Taoism. If my descendants are deposed, they will stop and will not rise again in the end. This is because I secretly accumulated a lot of troubles. Afterwards, Chen Ping's great-grandson Chen Zhang relied on his relationship with the Wei family to hope to inherit the original title of the Chen family, but this failed in the end. Tai Shigong said: When Prime Minister Chen Ping was young, he originally liked the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi. As he sliced ​​the sacrificial meat on the chopping block, his ambitions were already high. He wandered between Chu and Wei, and finally surrendered to Emperor Gao. He often comes up with ingenious ideas to resolve numerous crises and eliminate disasters in the country. During the reign of Empress Lu, many things happened, but Chen Ping was still able to avoid disasters, stabilize the Han Dynasty, maintain a glorious reputation throughout his life, and was called a virtuous prime minister. Isn't this a good beginning and a good end? Without wisdom and strategy, who could achieve this?
target: Chen Ping's descendants inherited his title but lost it due to crimes. He once remarked that his secretive strategies were taboo in Taoism, predicting his descendants' decline. Sima Qian praised Chen Ping for his wisdom and ability to navigate crises, maintaining a glorious reputation as a virtuous prime minister.

source: Things cannot develop fully in both aspects. It will probably take until the fall of Chen State that his descendants will prosper, right? Duke Li of Chen married a woman from the State of Cai, who committed adultery with a man from the State of Cai. Duke Chen Li also went to the State of Cai many times to have sex with other women. In the seventh year, the three younger brothers of Prince Huan, who was killed by Duke Li, were named Yue, Lin, and Chujiu. They asked the Cai people to seduce Duke Li with beautiful women. Then the three of them killed Duke Li together with the Cai people, and Li Yue became the king, which is Duke Li. Duke Li was the son of Duke Huan. Duke Li died five months after he ascended the throne, and his second brother Lin succeeded him as Duke Zhuang. Duke Zhuang died after reigning for seven years, and his youngest brother Chujiu succeeded him as Duke Xuan. In the third year of Xuangong's reign, King Wu of Chu passed away, and the state of Chu began to become stronger. In the seventeenth year, King Zhou Hui married Chen Jun's daughter as his queen. In the twenty-first year, Duke Xuan later gave birth to a son named Ji, whom he favored. Duke Xuan wanted to make him the prince, so he killed the original prince Yu Kou. The imperial bandit had always liked Li Gong's son Wan, but Wan was afraid that he would be harmed, so he fled to Qi. Duke Huan of Qi wanted Chen Wan to be his minister. Chen Wan said: As a minister living abroad, I am lucky enough not to do hard work. It is the favor you have given me. I dare not hold a high official position. Duke Huan asked him to be an official of work and integrity. Qi Yizhong wanted to marry his daughter to Chen Wan, so he first performed a divination. The divination said: Husband and wife are like male and female phoenixes flying together, with loud and clear chirps. The descendants of the surname Gui will thrive in the country of the surname Jiang. After the Five Dynasties, he will be prosperous and his status will be on par with the chief ministers. Eight generations later, no one can compare with it. In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Huan of Qi attacked the State of Cai, and the State of Cai was defeated. The Qi soldiers took advantage of the situation and invaded the territory of the State of Chu, heading south to Zhaoling. The army passed by the State of Chen when returning to Qi. Chen Guo's official Yuan Taotu suspected that the Qi army was harassing them across the border, so he deceived Duke Huan of Qi and said that it would be better to return to Qi via the east road along the coast. The road to the east was very dangerous. When Duke Huan of Qi learned the truth, he was furious and had Yuan Taotu arrested. This year, Duke Xian of Jin forced his own prince Shen Sheng to death. Forty-five years later, Duke Xuan died, and his son Qian succeeded him as Duke Mu. In the fifth year of Duke Mu, Duke Huan of Qi passed away. In the 16th year, Duke Wen of Jin defeated the Chu army in Chengpu. In this year, Chen Mugong died, and his son Gong Gongshuo succeeded to the throne. In the sixth year of Duke Gong of Chen, Shang Chen, the crown prince of Chu, killed his father, King Cheng of Chu, and established himself as king, King Mu of Chu. In the eleventh year, Duke Mu of Qin passed away. In the eighteenth year, Gonggong Chen passed away and his son Lingping Guo succeeded to the throne. In the first year of Chen Ling, King Zhuang of Chu came to the throne.
target: The lineage and history of the State of Chen, founded by Duke Hu, a descendant of Emperor Shun. After Shun’s death, his descendants held intermittent titles until King Wu of Zhou enfeoffed Guiman (Duke Hu) in Chen to continue Shun’s sacrifices. The succession of Chen rulers is detailed, including Dukes Shen, Xiang, Xiao, You, Li, Wu, Yi, Ping, Wen, Huan, Li, Zhuang, Xuan, Mu, Gong, Ling, Cheng, Ai, Hui, Huai, and Min. Key events include Duke Li’s son Wan fleeing to Qi after fearing persecution, where his descendants later rose to power. During Duke Xuan’s reign, internal strife led to the killing of Crown Prince Yu Kou. Duke Ling’s adultery with Xia Ji and subsequent murder by her son Xia Zhengshu prompted King Zhuang of Chu to invade Chen, initially annexing it but later restoring it after advice from Minister Shen. Chen later broke its alliance with Chu, leading to repeated Chu invasions. Duke Ai’s death involved a succession crisis where his brother Zhao killed the crown prince, leading to Chu’s destruction of Chen under King Ling. King Ping of Chu later restored Chen by enfeoffing Wu (Duke Hui). The state was finally destroyed by King Hui of Chu during Duke Min’s reign. The text also briefly covers the Qi state (descendants of Yu), noting its fall 34 years after Chen. It concludes with a reflection on the enduring legacy of Shun’s descendants, contrasting their prosperity with the decline of Yu’s line, and mentions other ancient states like Teng, Xue, and Zou as minor and unrecorded.

source: Chen Sheng, a native of Yangcheng, was named She. Wu Guang, a native of Yangxia, was given the courtesy name Uncle. When Chen She was young, he was hired to plow the fields with others. Once when he stopped plowing and went to rest on the ridge of the field, he lamented and resented for a long time and said, "If anyone becomes rich in the future, let's not forget each other." The companions who were employed with him smiled and replied: You are hired to plow the fields, how can you be rich? Chen She sighed and said: Alas! How can small birds such as swallows and sparrows understand the lofty aspirations of geese and swans! In July of the first year of Qin II, the poor living on the left side of the lane were recruited to defend Yuyang. A total of 900 people were stationed in Daze Township.
target: Chen Sheng, a native of Yangcheng, and Wu Guang, from Yangxia, were conscripted in July of the first year of Qin II to defend Yuyang, along with 900 others stationed in Daze Township.

Wu Guang deliberately threatened to escape many times to anger the county captain, provoke him to humiliate him in public, and anger everyone. As expected, the county lieutenant whipped Wu Guang, and the county lieutenant drew his sword again. Wu Guang rose up, grabbed the sword, and killed the county lieutenant. Everyone has missed the deadline to go to Yuyang. If you miss the deadline, you will be beheaded according to regulations."

article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家
source: The companions who were employed with him smiled and replied: You are hired to plow the fields, how can you be rich? Chen She sighed and said: Alas! How can small birds such as swallows and sparrows understand the lofty aspirations of geese and swans! In July of the first year of Qin II, the poor living on the left side of the lane were recruited to defend Yuyang. A total of 900 people were stationed in Daze Township. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang both joined the ranks of this expedition and became village commanders. It happened to be raining heavily and the roads were blocked. They probably missed the deadline to reach Yuyang. After the prescribed time limit, everyone should be beheaded according to the law. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang discussed it and said: Now it is death to escape, and it is death to rise up and do a great cause. It is also death. Is it good to die for national affairs? Chen Sheng said: The world has been suffering from the rule of the Qin Dynasty for a long time. I heard that the second emperor was the youngest son of the first emperor. He should not succeed to the throne. The one who should succeed was the young master Fusu. Because Fusu repeatedly advised the emperor, the emperor sent him to lead troops to station in other places. Now some people heard that he was not guilty of any crime, but was killed by the second emperor. The common people heard that he was very virtuous, but they didn't know that he was dead. Xiang Yan was originally a general of the Chu State. He had made many meritorious deeds and loved his soldiers. The people of Chu State loved him. Some people thought he was dead, others thought he was on the run and hiding. Now, if we use the names of Princes Fusu and Xiang Yan to call for uprising to the people of the world, many people will respond. Wu Guang thinks it is right. So he went to divine good and bad luck. The fortune teller knew their intentions and said: "You can succeed in everything and make achievements." But have you ever asked ghosts and gods about good or bad luck? Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were very happy. They tried to figure out what the fortune teller meant by asking ghosts and gods about good or bad luck, and said, "This is to teach us to establish prestige among others first." So he wrote the words "King Chen Sheng" on a piece of white silk with cinnabar, and stuffed it into the belly of the fish caught by others in a net. The garrison soldier bought the fish and cooked it. He found the silk book in the fish belly and naturally felt very strange about it. Chen Sheng also secretly sent Wu Guang to an ancient temple overgrown with vegetation near the station, lit a bonfire at night, and imitated the voice of a fox and shouted: "Great Chu Xing, King Chen Sheng." The garrison soldiers were frightened when they heard this cry in the middle of the night. The next morning, there was a lot of discussion among the garrison troops, and everyone was pointing and looking at Chen Sheng.
target: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang discussed that fleeing or rising up both led to death, but dying for a national cause was preferable. Chen Sheng noted the world’s suffering under Qin rule, suggesting using the names of Prince Fusu and Chu general Xiang Yan to rally support, as both were respected. Wu Guang agreed. They consulted a fortune teller, who hinted at establishing prestige through supernatural means. Chen Sheng wrote “King Chen Sheng” on silk, hid it in a fish, and had Wu Guang mimic a fox’s cry at night, shouting “Great Chu will rise, King Chen Sheng.” The garrison soldiers were startled and discussed it the next day.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家::group-004
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家
source: Even if they are not beheaded, six out of ten people will definitely die while guarding the border in the future. Besides, as long as a man dies, he must be famous for future generations. Are princes, generals and ministers all born noble? After hearing this, all the subordinates said in unison: We are willing to obey the orders. So Chen Sheng and others staged an uprising in the name of Prince Fusu and Chu general Xiang Yan to comply with the people's wishes. Everyone showed their right arms as a sign, under the banner of "Great Chu". They also built a high platform to take the oath and used the general's head as a sacrifice. Chen Sheng appointed himself as general and Wu Guang as captain. First they attacked Daze Township, and after that they attacked Qixian County. After Qixian was captured, he sent Ge Ying from Fuli to lead his troops to capture the area east of Qixian. They attacked Qi, Feng, Kuzhe and Qiao in succession and captured them all. As they marched, they continued to replenish their troops and expand their ranks. By the time they reached Chen County, they had six to seven hundred chariots, more than a thousand cavalry, and tens of thousands of infantry. When Chen County was attacked, the county guards and magistrates there were not in the city. Only the county magistrate who stayed behind led the troops and fought with the rebels under the city gate. As a result, the county magistrate was defeated and died, so the rebel army entered the city and occupied Chen County. A few days later, Chen Sheng ordered the three elders in charge of education and local heroes to be summoned for a meeting. Everyone present said: General, you are wearing armor and holding sharp weapons. You have attacked the unprincipled king, destroyed the tyrannical Qin Dynasty, and re-established the Chu State. In terms of merit, you should be called the king. Chen She then proclaimed himself king and named his country Zhang Chu. At this time, the people in various counties and counties who suffered due to the governance of the officials of the Qin Dynasty responded to Chen She by hijacking the officials to judge their crimes and killing them. So Wu Guang was appointed as the acting king and led the generals to attack Xingyang westward. He ordered Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu from Chen County to capture the original jurisdiction of Zhao, and ordered Deng Zong from Ruyin to capture Jiujiang County. At this time, thousands of rebels from the Chu region gathered together, too many to count. Ge Ying arrived at Dongcheng and established Xiang Qiang as King of Chu. Ge Ying later heard that Chen Sheng had proclaimed himself king, so he killed Xiang Qiang and reported back to Chen Sheng. As soon as he arrived in Chen County, Chen Sheng killed Ge Ying. Chen Sheng ordered Wei people Zhou Shi to go north to capture the places that originally belonged to the Wei state. Wu Guang surrounded Xingyang. Li You was appointed as the governor of Sanchuan County to defend Xingyang, but Wu Guang could not attack it for a long time. Chen Sheng summoned the heroes of the country to discuss countermeasures and appointed Cai Ci, the Lord of Shangcai Renfang, as the Shangzhu Kingdom. Zhou Wen was a well-known sage in Chen County. He was once an official in Xiang Yan's army who divined good and bad times, and also served under Huang Xie, Prime Minister of Chu Chunshen. He claimed to be familiar with military affairs, so King Chen awarded him the seal of general and ordered him to lead troops west to attack the Qin army. He gathered troops and horses as he walked along the way. When he arrived at Hangu Pass, there were thousands of chariots and hundreds of thousands of soldiers. When they arrived at the theater, they stationed themselves. The Qin Dynasty sent Shaofu Zhang Han to pardon those who had committed crimes and served in Lishan Mountain, as well as the sons of domestic slaves, and recruited them all to attack Zhang Chu's army and defeated all the Chu army. After Zhou Wen failed, he escaped from Hangu Pass and stayed in Caoyang for two or three months. Zhang Han chased him again and defeated him. Zhou Wen fled to Mianchi and stayed there for more than ten days.
target: He declared that princes and generals were not born noble. The troops pledged obedience. They rebelled in the names of Fusu and Xiang Yan, baring their right arms under the banner “Great Chu.” They built an altar, sacrificed the captain’s head, and Chen Sheng declared himself general, Wu Guang as captain. They attacked Daze Township and Qi County, then sent Ge Ying to capture eastern areas, taking Qi, Feng, Kuzhe, and Qiao. As they marched, their forces grew to six to seven hundred chariots, over a thousand cavalry, and tens of thousands of infantry by the time they reached Chen County. The county magistrate was killed, and they occupied the city. Chen Sheng summoned local elders and heroes, who praised him for attacking the tyrannical Qin and re-establishing Chu, urging him to become king. He proclaimed himself king of Zhang Chu. People in various counties responded by killing Qin officials. Wu Guang was appointed acting king to attack Xingyang westward. Chen Sheng ordered Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu to capture Zhao, and Deng Zong to take Jiujiang. Ge Ying killed Xiang Qiang, whom he had made king of Chu, after hearing of Chen Sheng’s kingship, but Chen Sheng executed Ge Ying. Zhou Shi was sent north to capture Wei lands. Wu Guang besieged Xingyang but failed to take it. Chen Sheng appointed Cai Ci as Shangzhu Kingdom and Zhou Wen as general to lead troops west. Zhou Wen gathered forces, reaching Hangu Pass with thousands of chariots and hundreds of thousands of soldiers, but was defeated by Qin’s Zhang Han, who recruited criminals and slaves. Zhou Wen fled and committed suicide after repeated defeats.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家::group-005
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家
source: Zhou Shi went north to capture the city and reached Di County. Tian Dan, a native of Di County, killed the magistrate of Di County and proclaimed himself the king of Qi. He relied on the power of Qi to counterattack Zhou Shi. Zhou Shi's army was defeated and retreated to Wei, intending to make Ningling Junjiu, a descendant of King Wei, king of Wei. At that time, Jiu was with King Chen and could not return to Wei. After Wei was pacified, everyone wanted to support Zhou Shi as King of Wei, but Zhou Shi refused to accept it. The envoys went back and forth between King Chen and Zhou City five times. King Chen agreed to make Ningling Jun Jiu the king of Wei and sent him back to Wei. Zhou Shi finally became the prime minister of Wei. General Tian Zang and others jointly planned and said: Zhou Zhang's army has been defeated, and the Qin Dynasty's army will arrive sooner or later. Our army surrounds Xingyang City and cannot conquer it. If the Qin army comes, it will be defeated. It is better to leave less troops, enough to surround Xingyang, and lead all the elite troops to meet the Qin army. Now the false king Wu Guang is arrogant and rude, and does not know the tactics of using troops to fight. We cannot discuss with him. If we don't kill him, the matter may fail. Therefore, they falsely reported that King Chen had ordered Uncle Wu to be killed and his head was dedicated to King Chen. King Chen sent an envoy to give Tian Zang the official seal of Ling Yin of Chu State and appointed him as the general. Tian Zang sent his general Li Gui and others to surround Xingyang City, and he led his elite troops westward to Aocang to meet the Qin army. Fighting with the Qin army, Tian Zang died in the battle and the army was defeated. Zhang Han marched to Xingyang City to attack Li Gui and others, defeated them, and Li Gui and others died in the battle. Deng Yue, a native of Yangcheng, led his troops to station in Jiacheng, but was defeated by a force led by Zhang Han's general. Deng Yue led his army to flee to Chen County. Wu Xu, a Zhi man, led his troops to station in Xu County, but Zhang Han's army defeated him. Wu Xu's army broke up and fled to Chen County. King Chen killed Deng and said. When Chen Sheng first became king, Qin Jia from Ling County, Dong Jie from Zhi County, Zhu Jishi from Fuli, Zheng Bu from Qilu, and Ding Ji from Xu County all formed an army to rebel against Qin. They led their troops and besieged the governor of Donghai County named Qing in Tancheng. After King Chen heard about it, he sent Wu Pingjun as a general to supervise and lead all the armies under Tan City. Qin Jia refused to accept this order and established himself as Grand Sima, not wanting to be subordinate to Lord Wuping. Then he told his military officials: Mr. Wu Ping is young and does not understand military affairs. Don't listen to him! Then he killed Wu Pingpan under the pretense of King Chen's order. After Zhang Han defeated Wu Xu, he then attacked Chen County. Cai Ci, the king of Chen's state, was killed in the battle. Zhang Han then led troops to attack Zhang He's troops stationed in the west of Chen County. King Chen personally came out to supervise the battle, but the Chu army was still defeated and Zhang He was killed. In December, King Chen retreated to Ruyin. When he returned to Xiachengfu, his coachman Zhuang Jia killed him and surrendered to the Qin army. After Chen Sheng's death, he was buried in Dang County, and his posthumous title was King Yin.
target: Wu Chen proclaimed himself King of Zhao in Handan. Chen Sheng, angered, imprisoned Wu Chen’s family but released them on Cai Ci’s advice, sending congratulations to Zhao. Zhao’s generals advised against marching west, instead expanding north into Yan. Han Guang became King of Yan. Zhou Shi was defeated by Tian Dan, who declared himself King of Qi. Zhou Shi made Ningling Jun Jiu King of Wei. Tian Zang killed Wu Guang, claiming Chen Sheng’s order, and led elite troops west but died in battle. Zhang Han defeated other Chu forces. Chen Sheng killed Deng Yue and Wu Xu after their defeats. Qin Jia killed Wu Pingpan and made Jing Ju king of Chu. Zhang Han attacked Chen County, killing Cai Ci. Chen Sheng was defeated and killed by his charioteer Zhuang Jia in December. He was buried in Dang County with the posthumous title King Yin. Lu Chen killed Zhuang Jia and made Chen County Chu’s capital. Song Liu surrendered to Qin and was executed. Chen Sheng reigned for six months. His former friend visited but was killed for speaking of past events, causing others to leave.

id: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家::group-006
article_path: 史记/三十世家/陈涉世家
source: After General Lu Chen failed to escape, he regrouped his troops. He joined forces with the army led by Yingbu, who had been a thief in Poyang and was named Dangyang Lord, and attacked the army of Qin's left and right captains again, defeated them at Qingbo, and once again made Chen County the capital of Chu. Just when Xiang Liang supported King Huai of Chu, his grandson Xin became King of Chu. Chen Sheng was king for a total of six months. After becoming king, Chen County was made the capital. Once upon a time, a fellow who had been hired to plow fields with him heard that he had become king. He came to Chen County, knocked on the palace door and said, "I want to see Chen She." The officer guarding the palace gate wanted to tie him up. After he repeatedly explained, he was released, but still refused to inform him. When King Chen went out, he blocked the road and called Chen She's name. After hearing this, King Chen summoned him and took a carriage back to the palace with him. After walking into the palace and seeing the halls, houses and curtains, the guest said: Hello! King Chen She's palace is so tall and profound! The people of Chu called Duo Huo She the king, so the saying that Huo She was the king started from Chen She. This guest came and went in and out of the palace more and more freely, and often told people about Chen She's past events. Someone said to King Chen: Your guest is ignorant and talks nonsense, which is detrimental to your majesty. King Chen killed the visitor. From then on, all the old and close friends of King Chen left voluntarily, and no one was close to King Chen anymore. King Chen appointed Zhu Fang to be the Zhongzheng and Hu Wu to be the Supervisor of Supervision to supervise the faults of the ministers. The generals captured the place and returned to Chen County. If they disobeyed the orders, they would arrest and punish them, and they would harshly seek the faults of the officials as a sign of loyalty to King Chen. Anyone they don't like, once they make a mistake, they will punish them without giving it to the officials in charge of justice. King Chen trusted them very much. Because of these reasons, the generals no longer stayed close to him. This is the reason why King Chen failed. Although Chen Sheng was dead, the princes and generals he appointed and sent finally destroyed the Qin Dynasty. This was due to Chen She's first uprising against Qin. During the reign of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty, thirty families were placed in Dang County to guard Chen She's tomb, and they still kill animals on time to offer sacrifices to him.
target: Chen Sheng appointed Zhu Fang and Hu Wu, who harshly punished officials, leading to his failure. Despite his death, his uprising led to Qin’s downfall. Emperor Gaozu of Han later honored his tomb.

source: The ancestors of the Wei family are descendants of Bi Gonggao. Bi Gonggao has the same surname as Emperor Zhou. After King Wu defeated Zhou, Gao was granted the title Bi, so he took Bi as his surname. His descendants had their titles discontinued and became commoners, some living in the Central Plains and some living in Yi and Di. One of his descendants was named Bi Wan, who served Duke Xiang of Jin. In the sixteenth year of Duke Xiang of Jin, Zhao Su drove a chariot with Bi Wan as the right guard to conquer Huo, Geng, and Wei, and destroyed them all. Duke Xian granted Geng to Zhao Su and Wei to Bi Wan, and both of them became high officials. Bu Yan, who was in charge of divination, said: Bi Wan's descendants must be very prosperous. Wan is the full number; Wei is the name of tall people. Starting a reward with such a name is God's sponsorship for him. What the emperor rules is called Zhaomin, and what the princes rule is called Wanmin. Now that his name is Da, followed by the full number, he will definitely have the people. At the beginning, Bi Wan divined the good and bad fortune of serving Jin Jun, and obtained the tunzhūn, and the Yin Ping Zhun hexagram became the Bi hexagram. Xin Liao concluded: Good luck. Tun Gua symbolizes solidity and Bi Gua symbolizes entry. What could be more auspicious than this? It will be prosperous and prosperous in the future. Eleven years after Bi Wan was granted the title, Duke Xiang of Jin died. His four sons competed with each other for the throne, and Jin was in civil strife. There were more and more descendants of Bi Wan, and the country was named Wei after them. Bi Wan gave birth to Wu Zi. Wei Wuzi served Jin Gongzi Chong'er as a member of the Wei family.
target: The Wei family traces its ancestry to Bi Gonggao, a descendant of the Zhou royal family. After King Wu of Zhou defeated the Shang, Gao was granted the territory of Bi and adopted Bi as his surname. His descendants eventually became commoners, with some living in the Central Plains and others among the Yi and Di peoples. One descendant, Bi Wan, served Duke Xian of Jin and was granted the territory of Wei after military victories. A diviner predicted that Bi Wan's descendants would prosper greatly, and indeed the Wei family grew increasingly powerful within the state of Jin.

source: Tun Gua symbolizes solidity and Bi Gua symbolizes entry. What could be more auspicious than this? It will be prosperous and prosperous in the future. Eleven years after Bi Wan was granted the title, Duke Xiang of Jin died. His four sons competed with each other for the throne, and Jin was in civil strife. There were more and more descendants of Bi Wan, and the country was named Wei after them. Bi Wan gave birth to Wu Zi. Wei Wuzi served Jin Gongzi Chong'er as a member of the Wei family. In the 21st year of Duke Xiang of Jin, Wei Wuzi followed Chong'er into exile. Nineteen years later, when he returned to China, Chong'er ascended the throne as Duke Wen of Jin, allowing Wei Wuzi to inherit the titles of the descendants of the Wei family and rise to the status of a high official. His official residence was located in Wei Yi. Wei Wuzi gave birth to a son. Wei Daozi moved the government office to Huoyi. He gave birth to Wei Jiang. Wei Jiang served Duke Ao of Jin. In the third year of mourning for the Duke, he made an alliance with the princes. Yang Qian, the younger brother of the duke, caused chaos in the queue, and Wei Jiang killed Yang Qian's servants to humiliate him. Duke Mourning said angrily: "I am proud of joining the princes, but now I am insulting my brother!" Wei Jiang will be killed. Some people tried to persuade him to mourn, but he gave up. Later, Wei Jiang was finally appointed to be in power, and he was sent to repair with Rong and Di. From then on, Rong and Di became close and attached to Jin. In the eleventh year of the reign of Duke Mourning, Duke Mourning said: Since I appointed Wei Jiang, in eight years, I have met with the princes nine times, and Rong and Di have made peace with us. This is all due to your efforts! Wei Jiang was given musical instruments and a band, but Wei Jiang declined three times before accepting. Wei Jiang moved his government to Anyi. After Wei Jiang's death, his posthumous title was Zhaozi. He gave birth to Wei Ying, and Wei Ying gave birth to Wei Xianzi.
target: Wei Wuzi followed Chong'er into exile and later served him as Duke Wen of Jin. The family continued through generations: Wei Daozi, Wei Jiang, Wei Ying, and Wei Xianzi. During Wei Jiang's service to Duke Mourning of Jin, he killed a servant of the duke's brother who had caused disorder, initially angering the duke but eventually earning his trust. Duke Mourning credited Wei Jiang with eight years of successful alliances and peace with the Rong and Di tribes.

source: Wei Jiang moved his government to Anyi. After Wei Jiang's death, his posthumous title was Zhaozi. He gave birth to Wei Ying, and Wei Ying gave birth to Wei Xianzi. Wei Xianzi served Duke Zhao of Jin. After the death of Duke Zhao, the six ministers of Jin became stronger and stronger, while the official family declined. In the twelfth year of Jin Qinggong's reign, Han Xuanzi became old and Wei Xianzi took charge of state affairs. The Qi clan and the Yangyu clan of the Jin State slandered each other. The Six Qing Dynasties killed them, took back all their fiefdoms and divided them into ten counties. The Six Qing Dynasties sent their sons to serve as officials in the ten counties. Wei Xianzi, Zhao Jianzi, Zhongxing Wenzi, and Fan Xianzi were all ministers of Jin. For the next fourteen years, Confucius served as acting prime minister of the State of Lu. Four years later, due to the Jinyang Rebellion, Zhao Jianzi, together with the Han family and the Wei family, attacked the Fan family and the Zhonghang family. Wei Xianzi gave birth to Wei Chi, who together with Zhao Yang attacked the Fan family and the Zhongxing family. Wei Chi's grandson was Wei Huanzi. He, Han Kangzi and Zhao Xiangzi joined forces to defeat Zhibo and divide his territory. Huanzi's grandson was Wenhou Weisi. The first year of Wei Wenhou was the first year of Qin Ling. Wei Wenhou was at the same time as Han Wuzi, Zhao Huanzi, and Zhou Weilie. In the sixth year of Marquis Wen's reign, he built a city in Shaoliang.
target: As the Jin state declined, the six ministers grew stronger. Wei Xianzi served as a minister of Jin alongside Zhao Jianzi, Zhongxing Wenzi, and Fan Xianzi. Later generations including Wei Chi, Wei Huanzi, and eventually Wei Wenhou continued the family's rise.

source: If the poor and humble people do not agree with their behavior and their opinions are not accepted, they will leave here and go to Chu and Yue, just like taking off their straw sandals. How can they be the same as the rich and noble people! Zicheng left unhappy. He attacked the Qin State to the west, returned to the Zheng State, and built cities in Luoyin and Heyang. In the 22nd year of Marquis Wen, Wei, Zhao and Han were recognized as princes. In the twenty-fourth year of Marquis Wen's reign, the Qin army attacked Wei and reached Yanghu. In the twenty-fifth year of Marquis Wen's reign, his son gave birth to a son. Marquis Wen studied the Confucian classics under Zixia and treated Duan Qianmu as a guest. When he passed through his hometown, he never failed to pay tribute to Ping Shi. Qin once wanted to attack Wei. Some people say: The king of Wei has special respect for wise men. People in Wei praise his benevolence and he is harmonious and united, so he cannot have any intentions against him. As a result, Marquis Wen received praise from the princes.
target: Wei Wenhou's reign marked the formal establishment of Wei as a state. He studied under Zixia, treated Duan Qianmu as a guest, and gained praise from the princes for his respect toward worthy men.

source: Li Ke walked out quickly and visited Zhai Huang at his home. Zhai Huang said: Today I heard that the monarch summoned Mr. to choose the prime minister. Who will be the prime minister? Li Ke said: Wei Chengzi has become prime minister. Zhai Huang's face changed with anger, and he said: Based on what I saw and heard with my ears and eyes, in what way am I worse than Wei Chengzi? The defender of Xihe is my recommendation. The monarch is most worried about Yejun in the mainland, so I recommended Ximen Bao. The monarch planned to attack Zhongshan Kingdom, and I recommended Le Yang. After Zhongshan was conquered and no one could be sent to guard it, I recommended Mr. The monarch's son had no master, so I recommended Quhou Yu. In what way am I worse than Wei Chengzi! Li Ke said: Is your purpose of recommending me to your monarch to form a party for personal gain and seek to become a high official? The monarch asked to arrange for the prime minister to be either Chengzi or Zhai Huang. What about the two of them? I replied: This is because you did not pay attention to the investigation. Look at the people he is close to in ordinary times, look at the people he recommends when he is powerful, look at the things he does not do when he is frustrated, and look at the things he does not want when he is poor. These five points are enough to make the decision. Why do I need Li Ke? Therefore, we knew that Wei Chengzi was going to be the prime minister. How can you compare with Wei Chengzi? Wei Chengzi had a thousand-minute salary, nine-tenths of which were spent outside and one-tenth at home, so he hired Bu Zixia, Tian Zifang, and Duan Qianmu from the east.
target: When selecting a prime minister, he consulted Li Ke, who advised examining five aspects of candidates: whom they associate with, whom they recommend when powerful, what they avoid when frustrated, and what they reject when poor. Li Ke determined that Wei Chengzi was the better choice over Zhai Huang, noting that Wei Chengzi spent nine-tenths of his income on employing worthy men like Bu Zixia, Tian Zifang, and Duan Qianmu.

source: Xu Zi said: I originally wanted to present it to you. He went on to say: The prince personally leads the troops to attack Qi. Even if he wins a great victory and captures the land of Ju, his wealth will only be that of owning the Kingdom of Wei, and his wealth will only be that of being the king of Wei. If we cannot defeat Qi, our descendants will not be able to capture Wei for eternity. This is my winning formula. Prince Shen said: Well, I will definitely follow your advice and return to China. Xu Zi said: Although the prince wants to go back, it is no longer possible. There are too many people who persuade the prince to fight and want to benefit from it. Although the prince wants to go back, I'm afraid it's impossible. The prince then wanted to go back, but his driver said: "Going back as soon as the general leads the troops is the same as losing the battle." As expected, Prince Shen fought against the Qi army and was defeated at Maling. The Qi army captured Wei Prince Shen and killed general Pang Juan. The Wei army was finally defeated. In the 31st year of King Hui, Qin, Zhao, and Qi attacked Wei together. Qin general Shang Yang defrauded and captured Wei general Gongzi Yan, and then attacked and captured his army, defeating the Wei army. Qin appointed Shang Yang, and the territory to the east reached the Yellow River. Qi and Zhao defeated Wei many times, and Anyi was close to Qin, so Wei moved its capital to Daliang. Prince He was made the crown prince. In the thirty-third year of King Hui, Duke Xiao of Qin passed away. Shang Yang fled from Qin and went to Wei. The people of Wei were angry and did not take him in. In the thirty-fifth year, King Wei and King Xuan of Qi met in the south of Pingyang. King Hui suffered repeated military defeats, so he used courteous etiquette and generous gifts to recruit wise men. Zou Yan, Chunyu Kun, and Meng Ke all came to Wei.
target: After Wei Wenhou's death, his son Wei Wuhou succeeded him. The state faced various military campaigns against Qi, Zhao, Qin, and Chu. Following Wuhou's death, a succession dispute arose between Ziyi and Gongzhong Xu. The states of Han and Zhao disagreed on how to handle the situation, which ultimately saved Wei from partition. King Hui of Wei suffered repeated military defeats and sought to recruit worthy men, attracting Zou Yan, Chunyu Kun, and Meng Ke.

source: Meng Ke said: A monarch cannot talk about interests like this.
