source: Move Han Wangxin to Taiyuan. In the seventh year, the Xiongnu attacked Han Wangxin in Mayi, and Han Wangxin rebelled with the Xiongnu in Taiyuan. Baitu Manqiuchen and Wang Huang established Zhao Li, the original Zhao general, as king and rebelled against the Han Dynasty. Gaozu went to crusade in person. The weather was so cold that two or three of the ten soldiers lost their fingers from the cold, and finally arrived at Pingcheng. The Xiongnu besieged Gaozu in Pingcheng, and they withdrew their troops after seven days. Fan Kuai was ordered to stay and pacify Daidi. He made his elder brother Liu Zhong the acting king.
target: After establishing the Han Dynasty, Gaozu faced rebellions from various kings including Zang Tu, Han Xin, Chen Xi, and Yingbu. He personally led campaigns against them, executing or defeating the rebels.

source: In October of the twelfth year, Emperor Gaozu defeated Yingbu's army in Huizhen, and Yingbu fled. Gaozu ordered other generals to pursue him. Emperor Gaozu led his army back, passed by Peixian County, and stopped. A banquet was held in Peigong, and all the friends, fathers and children from the past were called together to have a feast. Selecting Peizhong children, one hundred and twenty were obtained and taught them to sing. After drinking to his heart's content, Emperor Gaozu was building a building, composed a poem by himself, and sang: The strong wind is blowing, the clouds are flying, the sea is full of power, we are returning to our hometown, and the warriors are safe and guarding the four directions!
target: During a visit to his hometown Peixian County, Gaozu composed the famous Song of the Great Wind and exempted the county from corvée service.

id: 史记/十二本纪/高祖本纪::group-016
article_path: 史记/十二本纪/高祖本纪
source: Emperor Gaozu said: Fengyi is the place where I grew up, and I will never forget it. I only went to help the Wei state because Fengyi rebelled against me because of Yong Chi. The fathers and brothers of Peixian County insisted on their request, and then they exempted Fengyi from the corvee. Like Peixian County, they made Peihou Liu Bi the king of Wu. The generals of the Han army pursued Yingbu's army on both the north and south sides of the Taoshui River. They defeated Yingbu's army and captured and killed Yingbu in Poyang. Fan Kuai led another army to pacify Daidi and killed Chen Xi in the city. In November, Emperor Gaozu returned to Chang'an from the army that conquered Yingbu. In December, Emperor Gaozu said: The First Emperor of Qin, King Chen She of Chu Yin, King Anli of Wei, King Qi Min, and King Zhao Daoxiang all died without heirs, and were given to ten families to guard their tombs, twenty families of Qin Shihuang, and five families of Wei Gongzi Wuji. All local officials and people who were coerced by Chen Xi and Zhao Li were pardoned. When Chen Xi's surrendered generals said that Chen Xi was rebelling, King Lu Wan of Yan sent people to Chen Xi to participate in the conspiracy. Emperor Gaozu sent Marquis Piyang to pick up Lu Wan, but Lu Wan refused to come because he was ill. Marquis Piyang came back and explained in detail that there were signs of Lu Wan's rebellion. In February, Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo were sent to lead an army to attack Lu Wan, King of Yan. Pardon the officials and people of Yan who participated in the rebellion. The prince Liu Jian was granted the title of King of Yan. When Emperor Gaozu attacked Yingbu, he was shot by a stray arrow and fell ill during the march. The condition was serious, so Empress Lu invited a good doctor. The doctor went in to see Gaozu. Gaozu asked the doctor. The doctor said: The disease can be cured. So Emperor Gaozu scolded the doctor and said: I conquered the world as a commoner with a three-foot sword. Isn't this destiny? Destiny is in the sky, even if there is a Bian Que, what's the use! Emperor Gaozu refused to let the doctor cure the disease, rewarded him with fifty pounds of gold, and told him to leave. Soon Empress Lu asked Gaozu: If your Majesty, Xiao Xiangguo, dies in a hundred years, who will succeed him? Emperor Gaozu said: Cao Shen can do it. When asked about the next step, Emperor Gaozu said: "The royal tomb is fine." However, Wang Ling is a bit naive and Chen Ping can help him. Chen Ping is very wise, but it is difficult for him to act alone.
target: He died from an arrow wound sustained during the campaign against Yingbu, refusing medical treatment by declaring his fate determined by heaven. Before death, he designated successors for key positions, including Cao Shen, Wang Ling, Chen Ping, and Zhou Bo. Gaozu was buried in Changling with the posthumous title Emperor Gao, having established the Han Dynasty from humble beginnings.

source: The Yi are divided into nine branches, they are the Yi, Yu, Fang, Huang, Bai, Chi, Xuan, Feng and Yang. So Confucius wanted to live in the Jiuyi area. In the past, Yao ordered Xizhong to live in Woyi. There was a place called Yanggu, where the sun rose. Emperor Taikang of the Xia Dynasty lost his virtue and the Yi people began to rebel. Since Shaokang, the Yi people have admired the teachings of the imperial court for generations, so they submitted themselves to the emperor and presented their music and dance. Jie's rule was brutal, and barbarians from various tribes invaded the interior. Chengtang of the Yin Dynasty changed the destiny, attacked and pacified Xia. By the time of Zhongding, Lan Yi invaded the interior. In the more than three hundred years since then, the Yi people sometimes surrendered and sometimes rebelled. When Wu Yi declined, Dongyi gradually became stronger and stronger, so they moved to the Huaihe River and Mount Tai areas respectively, and gradually lived in the Central Plains. When King Wu of Zhou destroyed Zhou, Sushen came to contribute arrowheads made of stone and arrows made of wood. Guan Shu and Cai Shu betrayed the Zhou court, so they recruited and seduced the Yi Di. Zhou Gong conquered Guan Shu and Cai Shu and finally pacified Shu Yi. During the reign of King Kang of Zhou, Sushen came again. Later, Xu Yi usurped the title of emperor and led the nine barbarians to attack Zongzhou and attack westward to the bank of the Yellow River. King Mu of Zhou was afraid that Xu Yi would be strong, so he separated the princes in the east and asked King Xu Yan to rule them. King Xu Yan lived in Shumian, Huangchi. The land was five hundred miles in circumference. King Yan promoted benevolence and righteousness, and thirty-six countries came to worship him from all over the land. King Zhou Mu later got the horses Chiji and Quer, so he sent Zaofu to ride the horses to inform the Chu State and order the Chu State to attack the Xu State. They arrived in one day. So King Wen of Chu raised a large number of troops to attack Xu State and destroyed Xu State. King Xu Yan was kind but ignorant of political skills and could not bear to let his countrymen fight, so he failed. King Xu Yan was finally defeated at the foot of Shushan Mountain in Wuyuan County, Pengcheng City. Tens of thousands of people followed him, so Shushan Mountain was called Xushan Mountain. King Zhou Li was cruel and unruly, and Huaiyi invaded. The emperor sent Guo Zhong to attack Huaiyi, but failed to win. King Xuan of Zhou ordered Duke Zhao to go and conquer Huaiyi, and pacified Huaiyi. When King You of Zhou became debauched and violent, the barbarians from all sides invaded alternately. It was not until Duke Huan of Qi established his hegemony that he repelled the barbarians. When King Chu Ling was applying for an alliance, Huaiyi also came to participate in the alliance. Later, the Yue Kingdom moved to Langye and fought with the Huaiyi. From then on, they invaded and harmed all the countries in the Central Plains and invaded and destroyed small countries. Qin State annexed the six countries, and Huaiyi and Siyi were scattered into ordinary people's houses. Chen She raised an army and the world collapsed. Weiman, a native of Yan State, took refuge in North Korea and thus ruled North Korea. More than a hundred years later, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty destroyed North Korea, and since then the Yicai have been banned from visiting Kyoto. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, the Qi people invaded the border. In the early years of Jianwu, the Qi people came to pay tribute again.
target: The historical and cultural evolution of the Eastern Yi peoples, beginning with their origins and characteristics. The Yi, meaning "root," were considered docile and easily governed by morality, leading to the emergence of a "country of gentlemen" and a "country of immortality." They were divided into nine branches, and Confucius once expressed a desire to live among them. Early interactions with Chinese dynasties included Yao sending Xizhong to Woyi and the Yi submitting to Xia rulers, though rebellions occurred under tyrants like Jie. Over centuries, the Yi fluctuated between submission and revolt, with notable events such as Xu Yi usurping the title of emperor and attacking Zongzhou, only to be defeated by King Wen of Chu. Later, during the Zhou and Han dynasties, the Yi peoples, including Huaiyi and Siyi, were scattered, conquered, or assimilated, with periods of tribute and conflict under rulers like Wang Mang and Emperor Wu of Han.

source: Dongyi generally have settled in one place for generations and like to drink, sing and dance. Sometimes they wear crowns, silk clothes, and utensils such as zu and beans. This is the reason why China lost its etiquette and can be found in Siyi. The barbarians, barbarians, Rong, and Di are collectively called the four barbarians, just like the dukes, lords, uncles, sons, and men are all called princes. Fuyu country is a thousand miles north of Xuantu. It borders Gaoguli to the south, Yilou to Shumian, Xianbei to the west, and Weishui to the north. The area has a radius of two thousand miles, and it is originally a territory for reducing people. At first, the king of the Northern Yi Suoli Kingdom went out on a tour, and his maid became pregnant. When the king came back, he planned to kill her. The maid said: I saw an air mass in the sky as big as an egg before, and it landed on my body, and I became pregnant. The king imprisoned her and she later gave birth to a boy. The king ordered the boy to be thrown into a pigsty, and the pigs breathed on him to prevent him from dying. Then he threw him into the stable to be breaded, and the horse also panted at him like a pig. The king thought he was a god, so he allowed the child's mother to adopt him and named him Shuming. When Shuming grew up, he was good at archery. The king hated his bravery and wanted to kill him. Dongming escaped, went south to Yishui, and struck the water with his bow. As a result, all the fish and turtles gathered and floated to the surface. Shuming was able to cross the river on the fish and turtles, and he went to Fuyu and became the king there. The land of Fuyu State is the flattest and most open among the Dongyi regions, and the soil is suitable for growing grains. That bundle produced famous horses, red jade, mink uranium, and jade beads as big as jujubes. They built a walled city with palisades, and within the city were palaces, warehouses, and prisons. The people there are strong and brave but cautious and kind-hearted, and do not engage in invasion and looting. They used bows and arrows and swords and spears as weapons.
target: The text then details specific Yi groups, starting with Fuyu, located north of Xuantu. Fuyu was a flat, fertile land producing horses, jade, and mink. Its people were strong, brave, and kind, using bows and swords, and practicing rituals like the "Yinggu" festival.

source: The custom in Nabu was to use severe punishment, and all the family members of those who were executed were taken into slavery. The penalty for stealing something is twelve times the amount. Adultery between men and women was punished to death, especially vicious and jealous women. After being killed, their bodies were placed on the mountain. When the elder brother dies, the younger brother takes his sister-in-law as his wife. After death, there is an outer coffin but no inner coffin. They killed living people and buried them in hundreds of people. The king was buried in a jade box. The Han court often gave the jade box to Xuantu County in advance. When the king died, he sent people to pick up the jade box and bury the king.
target: They had severe punishments, including execution for adultery and theft, and practiced levirate marriage. Burial customs involved jade boxes for kings, provided by the Han court.

source: The king was buried in a jade box. The Han court often gave the jade box to Xuantu County in advance. When the king died, he sent people to pick up the jade box and bury the king. During the Jianwu period, all the countries in Dongyi came to contribute and pay homage. In the twenty-fifth year, King Fuyu sent envoys to offer tribute, and Guangwu rewarded them generously. From then on, the envoys communicated with each other every year. In the fifth year of Emperor An's reign, King Fuyu led seven or eight thousand infantry and cavalry troops to invade and plunder Lelang for the first time, killing and injuring officials and people, and later surrendered again. In the first year of Yongning, King Fuyu sent Crown Prince Weiqoutai to the court to pay tribute. The emperor gave Weiqoutai a seal ribbon, gold and silk fabrics. In the first year of Yonghe reign of Emperor Shun, King Fuyu came to the capital to pay homage. The emperor performed Huangmen Guangchuang and Jiaodian Opera to see him off. In the fourth year of Yanxi reign of Emperor Huan, King Fuyu sent an envoy to pay tribute and congratulations.
target: Fuyu engaged in tribute and conflict with Han, including invasions under King An and later defeats by Gongsunyu.

source: They have no king or officials, and each tribe has its own leader. They live in the mountains and forests, and the local climate is extremely cold. They usually live in caves, and the depth of the caves is considered noble. Rich families have such deep caves that they need nine ladders to connect them. They like to raise pigs, eat pork, and wear clothes made of pig skins. In winter, lard is smeared on the body, which is somewhat thick, to resist the wind and cold. In the summer they were naked, covering their front and back with a foot of cloth. The people there were stinky and unclean. The toilet was built in the middle and people lived around it. After the rise of He, Lou was sent to go to He. Although the Tanlou tribe has a small population, they are brave and powerful. They live in dangerous mountainous areas and are good at archery, and their shots can hit people's eyes. The bow is four feet long and has the same power as a crossbow. The arrows are made of ash wood, one foot and eight inches long, and the arrowheads are made of bluestone. The arrowheads are smeared with poison, and the person who is shot will die immediately.
target: Yilou, northeast of Fuyu, was a mountainous, cold region where people lived in caves and wore pigskin. They were brave archers using poisoned arrows and were known for plundering.

source: Gaoguli is a thousand miles away from Shumian in Liaodong. It borders Korea and Jiaqi to the south, Shumian and Woju, and Fuguan to the north. The area is two thousand miles in radius, with many mountains and deep valleys, and people live in the valleys. Gaoguli lacks farmland and agriculture, and hard work cannot meet their own needs. Therefore, the custom is to save money on food, but like to build palaces. According to legend in Saiyi, Bao Li was sewn into another branch, so his language and laws were many the same, but he dragged one foot when he knelt down and always ran when walking. In the first year of the Zhongyuan Dynasty, Piyong, Mingtang and Lingtai were built. Emperor Ming ascended the throne and saluted in person. The emperor began to wear a crown that reached the sky, and wore the clothes of the sun, moon and stars. He was a chariot with dharma objects. After the guests were dined and the rituals with the princes were completed, the emperor was sitting down to give a lecture. Confucian scholars were holding scriptures and asking questions. There were countless ministers and scholar-bureaucrats who walked around the bridge gate to watch and listen to the lecture. After that, for the descendants of the meritorious officials and the last members of the four surnames, separate schools were established, and talented people were selected to teach. Although they did not establish academic officials, they all promoted Gao Di to be a lecturer and give them a close handle. This was to catch the omissions and recluse, and to attract many families. Xiaohe also visited Dongguan many times and read many books. When Empress Deng exercised the power of the emperor, many scholars were slack. At this time, both Fan Zhun and Xu Fang wrote letters stating the importance of teaching, and saying that there were too many Confucian positions for which they were not qualified, so they ordered the ministers to carefully select, and all the doctors in the three departments who were proficient in Confucian classics were elected. After Emperor An took over the government, he did not pay attention to art and literature. Doctors reclined on seats without giving lectures. Friends looked at me and I looked at you. They were lazy and undisciplined. The school building was also ruined and became a vegetable garden. Here, shepherds and woodcutter gathered firewood and cut grass. Emperor Shun was inspired by Zhai Youfu's words, so he rebuilt the school and built a total of 240 rooms and 1,850 rooms. After taking the Ming Jing examination, the first disciples were recruited, and ten members of the first and second departments were added. Except for the senior scholars in the county and country, all the disciples were recruited. In the first year of Benchu, the Empress Dowager Liang issued an edict: All the generals, down to six hundred stones, would send their children to school. Every year, they would dine with guests and gather with the princes in this month. This was a common practice. Since then, the number of people studying abroad has increased, reaching more than 30,000 students. However, the chapters and sentences gradually became sparse and more pompous, and the Confucian spirit declined. The party members were executed, and most of the famous and philanthropic people were exiled and abandoned. Later, they accused each other out of anger, some secretly traded gold goods, and changed the characters of the Lantai lacquer script to match his private documents. In the fourth year of Xiping's reign, Emperor Ling ordered all the Confucian scholars to rectify the Five Classics and engrave them on stone tablets, using ancient Chinese, seal script, and official calligraphy to verify each other. At first, Guangwu moved the capital back to Luoyang, and those documents and secretaries were carried in 2,000 vehicles. From then on, the number was three times as many as before. When Dong Zhuo moved the capital, the officials and the people were disruptive, and the classics and articles collected in Piyong, Dongguan, Lantai, Shishi, Xuanming, and Hongdu were lost one after another. The large ones were connected into curtains, and the small ones were made into bags. When Wang Yun packed up and transported to Chang'an, there were only more than seventy cars. The road was difficult and half of them were lost! Later, there was great chaos in Chang'an, and they were all burned down and wiped out!
target: During the reigns of Wang Mang and Gengshi, the world fell into chaos, causing the collapse of rituals and music and the loss of documents. Emperor Guangwu, who favored classical studies, gathered scholars and restored texts. Scholars from across the land brought their books to the capital. Emperor Ming personally performed rituals, lectured on classics, and established separate schools for descendants of meritorious officials. The Xiongnu even sent their children to study. When Dong Zhuo moved the capital, many texts were lost or destroyed, with only seventy carts remaining after transport to Chang'an, half of which were lost. I have never heard of sheep tongue saying thank you, and Qi Lao seems to be taking credit." No words of thanks were said in the end. In the second year of Jianning, a large number of party members were executed, and an order was issued to urgently arrest Fan Pang and others. Supervisor Wu Dao went to the county, hugged the imperial edict, closed the post, and cried on his bed. After hearing this, Fan Pang said: "It must be for me!" Go to jail yourself immediately. The county magistrate Guo Yi was shocked. He came out to remove the seal and wanted to escape with Fan Pang. Said: The world is so big! Why are you here? Fan Pang said: "If Pang dies, the disaster will be over. How dare I implicate you with my crime and make my mother homeless?" Fan Pang's mother said goodbye to Fan Pang immediately. Fan Pang said to his mother: "Zhongbo's filial piety is enough to support your old man. Pang will return to Huangquan from Longshujun. The living and the dead will each have their own place. I hope you will cut off your unbearable kindness and don't be sad." Mother said: Now you can be as famous as Li Ying and Du Mi, and you will die with no regrets! I already have a good reputation, and if I seek longevity exams, is it possible to have both?
target: After release, he returned south but was later arrested again. His mother encouraged him to die for a good reputation, and he was executed at age thirty-three.

source: Confucius said: Has the Tao been abandoned? Or is it destiny? ◆The biography of Yin Xun, whose courtesy name is Boyuan, was born in Gongxian County, Henan Province. It has been the home of officials for generations. His uncle Yin Mu is a Situ, his brother Yin Song is a Taiwei, and many of the Yin family occupies important positions. Yin Xun only adheres to the integrity and integrity and does not use status and power to overwhelm others. The prefectures and counties were conquered many times, promoted filial piety and integrity, and moved to Handan three times, with extraordinary political achievements. Later, he was promoted to high rank and moved to the ministerial order in the fifth year. Emperor Huan killed the general Liang Ji, and Yin Xun participated in the plan and was granted the title of Marquis of the capital. Moved to runan prefecture. The letter was written to explain to Fan Pang that Yuan Zhong and others suggested that he be imprisoned and not allowed to be an official because of the party disaster. Soon, he recruited generals to be chief craftsmen and transferred them to agricultural departments. Because of Dou Wu and other incidents, he was thrown into prison and committed suicide.
target: Yin Xun, from Henan, adhered to integrity despite his family's power. He participated in killing Liang Ji and was granted marquis. He wrote to explain Fan Pang's case but was later imprisoned and committed suicide due to Dou Wu's incident.

source: ◆Cai Yan's biography, Cai Yan's courtesy name is Meng happy, a native of Xiang County, Runan County. When he was young, he was proficient in Confucian classics, taught his disciples, and educated the villagers with courtesy. When there were disputes in the village, they often went to Cai Yan's house to ask for settlement. After Cai Yan mediated, everyone said they had no objection. He was promoted to the title of Xiaolian and the governor of Jizhou. Ju Yuan, the official in charge of the imperial office, asked Cai Yan to nominate his younger brother as a maocai, but Cai Yan refused and ordered him to be arrested and asked to deliver letters. He also impeached Cao Ding, the Prime Minister of Hejian, for embezzling millions of dollars in stolen goods. Cao Ding is the younger brother of Zhongchang Shi Cao Teng. Cao Teng sent General Liang Ji to write a letter to Cai Yan asking him to intercede, but Cai Yan ignored him. Cao Ding was therefore convicted and sent to Zuo School for labor reform. The imperial court recruited Cai Yan to serve as Yi Lang and Fu Jie Ling. Liang Ji heard that Cai Yan was talented and asked him to meet him. Cai Yan was ill and refused to go, so Liang Ji hated him. At this time, Nanyang Governor Cheng Wang Jin and others were interrogated by the court captain for taking in the eunuchs. Cai Yan and Yilang Liu Yu came to rescue them. Emperor Ling ascended the throne and was appointed Yilang again. He died of illness. ◆The biography of Yangzhi, the descendant of Yangzhi, was a native of Liangfu County, Taishan. Generations are the family of officials.
target: Cai Yan, from Runan, was proficient in Confucian classics and mediated village disputes. He refused to nominate a eunuch's relative and impeached corrupt officials. He died of illness after Emperor Ling ascended.

source: ◆The biography of Yangzhi, the descendant of Yangzhi, was a native of Liangfu County, Taishan. Generations are the family of officials. When Yang Zhi was young, he was upright and knowledgeable. He was promoted as Xiaolian and conscripted into Taiwei Li Gu's mansion. Because of his excellent performance, he was promoted to a high rank and was appointed as Shi Yushi. When Li Gu was executed, Yang Zhi was banned from being an official for many years because he was Li Gu's old official. Because of his outstanding performance, he was promoted to the provincial governor of Jizhou. Report cases of corruption and corruption, and wherever they go, corruption and perversion of the law will disappear.
target: Yangzhi, from Taishan, was upright and knowledgeable. He reported corruption cases and recommended honest officials.

source: He was promoted to Huben Zhonglang General, Chengmen Xiaowei, and Shangshu Ling three times. At this time, Taiwei Zhang Hao, Situ Fanling, Da Honglu Guo Fang, Tai servant Cao Ling, and Da Sinong Feng Fang all had marriages with eunuchs, got together, and openly bribed eunuchs. Yang Zhi petitioned them one by one to remove them and expel them, but the emperor did not accept it. Former Taiwei Liu Chong, Sili Colonel Xu Bing, Youzhou Governor Yang Xi, Liangzhou Governor Liu Gong, and Yizhou Governor Pang Ai were honest and upright in public affairs. Yang Zhi recommended them and promoted them. The emperor commended him and appointed him as Henan Yin. He received salary on a daily basis, often ate dry rice and vegetables, and suppressed powerful people. All the officials in the capital were afraid of him. When troubles with the party occurred, he was removed from office, and he was imprisoned as an official. He died at home.
target: He suppressed powerful people as Henan Yin but was removed during the party disaster and died at home.

Zhang Jian was initially recommended as a talented person by the villagers. He thought that the governor was not suitable for him, so he refused to go because of illness. In the eighth year of Yanxi's reign, the governor Zhai Chao asked him to be the postal supervisor in the east. At this time, Zhongchang Shihou Lan's family was in Fangdong, and he was cruel to the people and lawless. Zhang Jian exposed the crimes of Hou Lan and his mother and asked the court to execute them. Hou Lan withheld Zhang Jian's seal, but the emperor did not see it, so he and Hou Lan became enmity.
target: Zhang Jian, from Shanyang, exposed Hou Lan's crimes but was framed by Zhu Bing. He fled for his life, with many houses sheltering him despite the risk of execution. Dozens were killed for hiding him.

source: Li Du was able to send Zhang Jian out of the fortress, and Zhang Jian was finally saved from death. Dozens of people were executed in every house where Zhang Jian passed by, and all their clan relatives were killed, leaving the county in ruins. In the first year of Zhongping, the party's imprisonment was lifted, and Zhang Jian returned to his hometown. The generals and three princes all recruited him and recommended him with sincerity. He had the characteristics of the official carriage of the imperial court and was appointed to pay homage to the Shaofu, but he was not accepted. In the early years of Emperor Xian's reign, the people were in famine, and Zhang Jian's family was relatively wealthy, so he shared his property with his fellow villagers. There are hundreds of people who survive on these properties. In the early years of Jian'an, the imperial court recruited him as a guard, but he accepted it as a last resort. Zhang Jian saw that Cao Cao had usurpation ambitions, so he closed his door and hung up his car. More than a year later, he died in Xuzhou at the age of eighty-four.
target: After the party ban was lifted, he returned home and shared his wealth with villagers. He died at age eighty-four during Jian'an.

source: ◆Cen Hao's biography, Cen Hao's courtesy name was Gongxiao, and he was a native of Jiyang County, Nanyang County. His father, Cen Yu, served as the governor of Nanjun and was killed for corruption. When Cen Hao was young and not well-known, he went to see Zong Ci of the same county. Zong Ci was recruited for being a good man. The house was full of guests. They thought Cen Hao was not a good family son and were unwilling to meet him. Cen Hao stayed outside the door for many days before being brought in. Zong Ci talked to him and praised him greatly, so he took him to Luoyang to study at Taixue. Cen Hao had superb talents, and Guo Linzong, Li Gongshu, etc. all became friends with him. Li Ying and Wang Chang said that he had the ability to govern the country. Although he was in the countryside, he was high-spirited and had the ambition to govern the world. When the prefect, Hongnongcheng, came to the Jin Dynasty, he wanted to establish his authority. After hearing Cen Hao's name, he asked him to serve as a meritorious officer, and also appointed Zhang Mu as a thief officer. King Cheng Jin trusted Cen Hao and Zhang Mu, rewarded good deeds and corrected mistakes, and purged the palace. There was a wealthy businessman named Zhang Xun in Wan County, who was a relative of Emperor Huan's beauty. He could carve some ingenious and interesting things, and often gave them to eunuchs with bribes. As a result, he also obtained a prominent official position. With his skills, he could do whatever he wanted. Cen Hao and Zhang Mu persuaded Wang Jin to arrest Zhang Xun and others. Later, when they were pardoned, Cen Hao still killed them and arrested their clan guests. He killed more than 200 people before reporting to the court. So the wife of Zhang Xun, the official in charge of Zhang Xun, sent a letter to complain. Emperor Huan was furious and conscripted King Jin into prison and died in prison. Cen Hao and Zhang Mu were hiding between Qi and Lu. Meet pardon and come out. Later, he was elected by the state and county, and he was not accepted by the three governments. After Li Gu and Du Mi were killed, he fled again and was heard to have died in the Jiangxia Mountains.
target: Cen Hao, from Nanyang, studied at Taixue and befriended Guo Linzong. He served as a meritorious officer under Wang Jin, arresting and killing over 200 corrupt individuals. Emperor Huan imprisoned Wang Jin, and Cen Hao fled, later dying in the Jiangxia Mountains.

source: After Li Gu and Du Mi were killed, he fled again and was heard to have died in the Jiangxia Mountains. ◆Chen Xiang's biography, Chen Xiang's courtesy name is Zilin, a native of Shaoling County, Runan County. Grandfather Chen Zhen, Sili Xiaowei. Chen Xiang was famous for his social skills when he was young. He was promoted to Xiaolian, and Taiwei Zhou Jing promoted him with a high rank and appointed him as Shi Yushi. At this time, on the first day of the first lunar month of the lunar calendar, Liang Ji, the general, showed his unkempt appearance and unkempt appearance. Chen Xiang reported to the emperor that Liang Ji was disrespectful to the emperor because of his good fortune, so he should be arrested and punished. People at the time thought he was a strange person. He was promoted to prefect of Dingxiang, conscripted as Yilang, and promoted to governor of Yangzhou. The emperor reported that Wang Yong, the prefect of Yuzhang, was a senior official, and Xu Shen, the prefect of Wu County, had committed corruption in office, and both were expelled from the imperial court.
target: Chen Xiang, from Runan, reported Liang Ji's disrespect and was promoted to governor of Yangzhou.

source: He was promoted to prefect of Dingxiang, conscripted as Yilang, and promoted to governor of Yangzhou. The emperor reported that Wang Yong, the prefect of Yuzhang, was a senior official, and Xu Shen, the prefect of Wu County, had committed corruption in office, and both were expelled from the imperial court. Xu Shen is the younger brother of Xu Huang, the imperial minister. As a result, his reputation grew. He was also appointed as Yilang to supplement the imperial censor Zhongcheng. He was interrogated by the Huangmen Beisi Prison due to party misfortune, but was exonerated because there was no evidence, and died at home. ◆The biography of Kong Yu, whose courtesy name was Yuan Dynasty, was from Lu County, Lu State. Kong Ba, the seventh generation ancestor, served successively as Jiuqing when he became emperor, and was granted the title of Marquis. From Kong Ba to Kong Yu, the title of nobility continued, and there were fifty-three ministers and ministers, including seven princes. When Kong Yu was a child, he studied "Shang Shu" and was summoned by the general Liang Ji, but he did not respond. Taiwei Ju Fangzheng disagreed with the emperor's questions, so he resigned due to illness. Later, he was banned from serving as an official due to party disaster. When Emperor Ling came to the throne, he conscripted Yilang in a public car to supplement the Luoyang order. Because of the death of his teacher, he abandoned his official position and died at home.
target: He expelled corrupt officials but was imprisoned during the party disaster. He was exonerated and died at home. Kong Yu, from Lu, studied "Shang Shu" and refused Liang Ji's summons. He was banned from office due to the party disaster and later died at home after serving as Luoyang magistrate.

source: Raise filial piety and integrity, and then move to Yingyin Order. Known for his ability. He was promoted to Taishou of Taishan. Many surnames in the county were engaged in illegal activities. When Yuan Kang took office, he acted aggressively, got angry, and promulgated strict laws. No one dared to break the law. Those who had invaded other people's fields and houses in the past were quickly returned to their original owners. At this time, Zhang Jian of Shanyang killed Hou Lan's mother, who was often serving as a servant. Yuan Kang investigated her clan guests, some of whom were hidden in Taishan. He always hated eunuchs, so he arrested them all without missing or running away. Hou Lan hated Yuan Kang to the extreme. He falsely accused Yuan Kang, Yanzhou Governor No. 5 and Duwei Hujia of surrendering, and summoned Yuan Kang to Tingwei Prison. He was commuted to the death penalty and demoted to Rinan. Yingyin and Taiyangzhi waited until the court appealed for Yuankang and were pardoned. They were sent back to their own county and died at home. ◆Tanfu Zhuan, Tanfu Ziwenyou, a native of Xiaqiu, Shanyin County. When I was young, I was Zhusheng. Although my family was poor, I had high ambitions and did not accept benefits from the wealthy people in the village. In order to promote filial piety and honesty, the government called for him many times, but he still failed.
target: Yuan Kang, from Bohai, was strict as Taishan prefect, returning stolen lands. He arrested Hou Lan's clan guests hiding in Taishan. Hou Lan falsely accused him, and Yuan Kang was sentenced to death but later pardoned. He died at home.

source: Yingyin and Taiyangzhi waited until the court appealed for Yuankang and were pardoned. They were sent back to their own county and died at home. ◆Tanfu Zhuan, Tanfu Ziwenyou, a native of Xiaqiu, Shanyin County. When I was young, I was Zhusheng. In order to promote filial piety and honesty, the government called for him many times, but he still failed. Jingshe teaches students, and hundreds of people often come to study from far away. During the reign of Emperor Huan, he was recruited with a doctorate degree, but he was not successful. When Emperor Ling came to the throne, Taiwei Huang Qiong promoted him to be Fangzheng. He answered the emperor's questions and met the requirements of the administration at that time. He was promoted to Yilang and supplemented the county magistrate of Meng. Because the county guard was unpopular, he abandoned his official position and returned home. The family has no property, but they live in the same clothes as their children and grandchildren, and eat by the sun. He died at home at the age of eighty. ◆The biography of Liu Ru, whose courtesy name is Shulin, was from Yangping County, Dongjun. Guo Linzong once said that although Liu Ru stuttered in speech, he was very smart and had an essence as white as jade. He was promoted to be filial and honest, and he was promoted to a high rank due to his outstanding performance. During the reign of Emperor Huan, disasters often occurred, and he issued edicts to ask for outspoken opinions. Liu Ru secretly wrote ten articles, expressing the gains and losses of the court with great loyalty and sincerity. Emperor Huan could not accept it and appointed him as the Prime Minister of the city. Soon, he was appointed Yilang. After encountering Dou Wushi, he was imprisoned and committed suicide. Jia Biao's biography, Jia Biao's courtesy name is Weijie, a native of Dingling County, Yingchuan County. When he was young, he traveled to the capital. He had extraordinary integrity and impassioned generosity, and was as famous as Xun Shuang, a native of the same county. He began to serve as an official in the state and county, promoted filial piety and integrity, and served as the county magistrate of Xinxi. The people were poor and did not raise their children. Jia Biao established a strict legal system. Those who did not raise their children were as guilty as murdering people.
target: Tanfu, from Shanyin, was poor but had high ambitions. He taught hundreds of students and refused multiple summons. He died at home at age eighty. Liu Ru, from Dongjun, was intelligent despite stuttering. He wrote ten articles on governance but was imprisoned and committed suicide after Dou Wu's incident. Jia Biao, from Yingchuan, was known for his integrity. As Xinxi magistrate, he punished those who did not raise children and stopped infanticide.

source: Jia Biao said to his colleagues: If I don't go westward, the disaster will not be relieved. So he went to Luoyang and told the city gate captain Dou Wu, Shangshu Huo, Dou Wu and others to appeal to the emperor, and Emperor Huan therefore pardoned the party members. Li Ying came out and said: I was able to avoid the party disaster because of Jia Sheng's strength! At one time, Cen Hao was on the run due to party troubles, and his relatives and friends hid him. Jia Biao stayed behind closed doors and refused to accept him. People at that time hated him. Jia Biao said: "The Biography" says: Act according to time and do not harm future generations. Gongxiao brought the blame on himself for threatening the emperor to commit crime. Just because I cannot treat each other with hostility and hate him, how can I shelter him and hide him? Due to party troubles, he was prohibited from becoming an official and died at home.
target: During the party disaster, he appealed to Dou Wu and Huo, leading to the party members' pardon. He refused to shelter Cen Hao and was banned from office, dying at home.

source: Due to party troubles, he was prohibited from becoming an official and died at home. At first, the three Jia Biao brothers were all famous, and Jia Biao was the best. Therefore, there is a legend in the world: Among the three tigers of the Jia family, Wei Jie is the most angry. ◆The biography of He Yong, named Boqiu, was a native of Xiangxiang County, Nanyang County. When he was young, he traveled to the capital to study. Although He Yong is a junior, Guo Linzong, Jia Weijie and others are very close to him. Famous Imperial Academy. His friend Yu Weigao had not avenged his father and was seriously ill and was about to die. He Yong went to see him. Yu Weigao cried to him. He Yong was moved by his righteousness and avenged him. He sacrificed the head of his enemy to the grave of Yu Weigao's father. After Chen Fan and Li Ying failed, He Yong was framed by the eunuchs because of his friendship with Chen Fan and Li Ying. He then changed his name and fled to Runan County. Wherever he went, he gathered heroes and became famous in Jingzhou and Yuzhou. Yuan Shao admired his character, secretly interacted with him, and became his sworn friend. At this time, the party was in trouble and many people in the world suffered. He Yong often went to Luoyang privately to discuss with Yuan Shao. For some poor and helpless people, help them survive the disaster. For some people who were being hunted, he made great suggestions, allowing them to escape or hide, and saved many people from party disasters. After the party disaster was resolved, He Yong was recruited by Sikong Mansion. In every meeting of the three governments, He Yong was always recommended as the leader. Promoted several times. Dong Zhuo was in power and forced He Yong to become a long history officer. He refused to accept it on the pretext of illness, and conspired with Sikong Xunshuang, Situ Wang Yun and others to kill Dong Zhuo. Xun Shuang died, and He Yong was arrested by Dong Zhuo for other matters, and he died of sorrow and anger. At first, when He Yong saw Cao Cao, he sighed and said: The Han family is about to perish, and this man must be the one who will bring peace to the world. Cao Cao was very happy. He once praised Yingchuan Xun as the weapon of Wang Zuo.
target: He Yong, from Nanyang, avenged his friend's father and fled after Chen Fan and Li Ying's failure. He secretly helped many escape the party disaster. After the disaster ended, he was recruited but refused Dong Zhuo's offer. He conspired to kill Dong Zhuo but died of sorrow and anger after arrest. He once praised Cao Cao as the one to pacify the world.

source: Feng Yi, also known as Gongsun, was a native of Fucheng County, Yingchuan County. He loves reading and is familiar with Zuo's Spring and Autumn Annals and Sun Tzu's Art of War. When the Han army rose, Feng Yi supervised the five counties as a county magistrate, and guarded the city together with Miao Meng, the magistrate of Fucheng County, to resist the Han army for Wang Mang. Guangwu took over the territory of Yingchuan, unable to attack his father's city, and stationed troops in Dongxiang. Feng Yiwei traveled to the county and was captured by Han soldiers. At that time, Feng Yi's cousin Feng Xiao and fellow county residents Ding Jinlin and Lu Yan all followed Guangwu, so they jointly recommended Feng Yi and was summoned by Guangwu. Feng Yi said: My role alone is not enough to make people stronger or weaker. There is an old mother in the city who is willing to go back and occupy five cities to repay her kindness with her service. Guangwu said: OK. Feng Yi went back and said to Miao Meng: "Now all the generals are strong men, most of them are tyrannical and tyrannical. Only General Liu does not plunder wherever he goes." Judging from his words and deeds, he is not a mediocre person, so he can surrender to him. Miao Meng said: I live and die with you, and I respectfully listen to your opinions. When Guangwu returned to Wan in the south, more than ten people from Gengshi generals led their troops to attack the father city, but Feng Yi could not hold on. When Guangwu became the commander of the Sili school and passed by the father city, Feng Yi and others opened the door and offered cattle and wine to welcome him. Guangwu ordered Feng Yi to be the principal for the time being, and Miao Meng to be the principal. Feng Yi then recommended Yaoqi, Shushou, Duan Jian, Zuo Long and others from Tongyi. Guangwu all made them his governors and followed him to Luoyang. Gengshi wanted to send Guangwu to capture Hebei several times, but all the generals thought it was impossible. At this time, Cao Xu, the son of Cao Jing, the prime minister of the left, was the minister, and the father and son were in power. Feng Yi persuaded Guangwu to make a good marriage with them. Later, when he crossed the Yellow River and headed north, Cao Xu helped him a lot. Since Guangwu's brother Bosheng was killed by Gengshi, Guangwu did not dare to show his sadness. He often lived alone, did not eat food and wine, and often cried on his pillow and mat. Feng Yi kowtowed to Guangwu alone to comfort him and comfort him. Guangwu stopped him and said, "Don't talk nonsense." Feng Yi therefore took the opportunity again and said to Guangwu: "The whole world suffers from Wang Mang and has been thinking about the Han Dynasty for a long time."
target: Feng Yi, also known as Gongsun, was from Fucheng County, Yingchuan. He was well-read in the Zuo's Spring and Autumn Annals and Sun Tzu's Art of War. When the Han army rose, he served as a county magistrate and defended the city for Wang Mang alongside Miao Meng. Guangwu (Liu Xiu) captured Yingchuan but could not take Fucheng. Feng Yi was captured by Han soldiers while traveling. His cousin Feng Xiao and others recommended him to Guangwu. Feng Yi offered to return to the city and secure five counties in exchange for service. He persuaded Miao Meng to surrender to Guangwu, noting that Guangwu did not plunder like other generals. When Guangwu passed by, Feng Yi and Miao Meng opened the gates and welcomed him with gifts. Guangwu appointed Feng Yi as a principal, and Feng Yi recommended several others for positions.

Every time they were stationed for a break, the generals would sit together to discuss their merits. Feng Yidu would hide under a tree. The army called him General Big Tree. After Handan was defeated, some of the generals were replaced, each with his own subordinates. The sergeants all said they would like to belong to General Dashu, and Guangwu valued Feng Yi from then on.
target: Feng Yi advised Guangwu to build ties with Cao Xu, which proved helpful when Guangwu crossed the Yellow River northward. After Guangwu's brother Bosheng was killed, Feng Yi comforted him and urged him to act independently, perform kindness, and win over the people. When Wang Lang rebelled, Guangwu fled south, and Feng Yi provided him with bean porridge and other food during the harsh journey. Feng Yi was later made a partial general and granted the title of Marquis Ying after defeating Wang Lang. He was known for his humility, often hiding under a tree during discussions of merit, earning the nickname "General Big Tree." His troops were loyal to him, and Guangwu valued him highly.

source: If we wait until the fierce generals march in and the stern soldiers surround the city, even though we regret it, it will be too late. At first, Li Yi and Guangwu first formed a pact and fell in love with each other. When Gengshi came to the throne, they jointly framed Bo Sheng. Although he knew that Chang'an was already in danger, he wanted to surrender but felt uneasy. He wrote back to Feng Yi and said: I originally planned to revitalize the Han Dynasty with Chief Guangwu, and we made a life-and-death agreement to plan success or failure together. Now I am guarding Luoyang, you are guarding Mengjin, and we are both guarding key towns. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and we want to become close friends. source: Liu Xuan, also known as Shenggong, was the elder brother of Emperor Guangwu. Because his younger brother was killed, he made friends with guests and prepared to avenge his brother. The guests broke the law, and Liu Xuan fled to Pinglin to avoid being pursued by the officials. Officials arrested his father Liu Zizhang. Liu Xuan pretended to be dead and had his coffin carried back to Chongling. The officials released Liu Zizhang, and Liu Xuan fled. In the last years of Wang Mang, there was a famine in the south. People went to the wild swamps in groups to dig some water chestnuts to satisfy their hunger, and even robbed each other. Wang Kuang and Wang Feng from Xinshi often mediate for them and were promoted as leaders, followed by hundreds of people. So some people who were on the run, such as Ma Wu, Wang Chang, Cheng Dan and others, went to join them to attack Li Xiangju and hid in the green forest mountains. In a few months, the team grew to seven or eight thousand people. In the second year of Emperor Wang Mang's reign, someone from Jingzhou Mu sent 20,000 "Ben Ming soldiers" to attack them. Wang Kuang and others led their troops to attack them in Yundu. They defeated Jingzhou Mu's army, killed thousands of people, seized all the enemy's military equipment, and then captured Jingling. They turned to attack Yundu and Anlu, plundered many women, and returned to the Green Forest Mountains. By now there were more than 50,000 people, and the prefectures and counties could no longer control them. In the third year of the Emperor's reign, a great plague occurred. Nearly half of the people in Green Forest Mountain died, and the teams dispersed.
target: Liu Xuan, also known as Shenggong, was the elder brother of Emperor Guangwu. After his younger brother was killed, he sought revenge but fled to Pinglin when his guests broke the law. In the first month of the fourth year of Emperor Di Huang's reign, he defeated the troops commanded by Wang Mang's former officer Zhen Fu and Zhengliang Qiuci, and killed them. Liu Xuan was promoted to General Gengshi. Although there were many troops in the uprising, there was no unified leadership, so the generals discussed together to make Liu Xuan the emperor. On the Xinsi day of February, a mandala was set up on the beach of Feishui to gather troops and horses. Liu Xuan ascended the throne of God and stood facing south to meet the officials. Liu Xuan has always been a coward, and he was so ashamed that he was sweating profusely. He raised his hands but couldn't even say a word. After that, a general amnesty was given to the whole country, and Jianyuan was the first year of Gengshi. At this time, heroes from all over the country rose up in response, killed the governors of the prefectures and counties, proclaimed themselves generals, adopted the reign name of Gengshi, and waited for the emperor's edict. article_path: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传
source: When people in the world see this situation, they will inevitably secretly plot to subjugate the Han Dynasty. It’s not that I hate being jealous of certain people and want to seek promotion, but I deeply regret His Majesty’s actions. Appointing incompetent people will mess up the country. This is the most important thing to consider. I hope to correct the absurd and arrogant mistakes of the past, and pursue the beauty of the prosperous age when King Wen of Zhou was able to stabilize the country with the help of many wise men. Emperor Gengshi was furious and imprisoned Li Shu. From then on, people in Guanzhong turned away from each other, and people in all directions resented betraying the imperial court. When the generals went out to fight, they each appointed prefectures, pastors, and county guards. The prefectures and counties established were intertwined with each other, and the people did not know whose instructions to follow. In December, the red eyebrow army entered the pass westward. In the first month of the third year, Fang Wang, a native of Pingling, made his former son Liu Ying the emperor.
target: In December, the Red Eyebrow Army entered the pass. In the first month of the third year, Fang Wang made Liu Ying emperor.

id: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传::group-005
article_path: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传
source: Gengshi sent Li Song and general Su Mao to defeat Fang Wang and others, killing several of them. He also ordered Su Mao to resist Chimei in Hongnong. Su Mao's army was defeated and more than a thousand people died. In March, Li Song was sent to join Zhu Tuna and Chimei to fight in Guixiang. Li Song and others were defeated, abandoned the army and fled, with more than 30,000 people killed. At this time, Wang Kuang and Zhang Xuan were stationed in Hedong. They were defeated by Deng Yu and rushed back to Chang'an. Zhang discussed with the generals and said: "Red Eyebrow is close to the underworld of Zheng and Hua, and will be here day and night." Now there is only Chang'an, which is about to be wiped out. It is better to command the army to plunder the property in the city to make a fortune, then attack the places along the way from here, return east to Nanyang, and collect the soldiers of King Wan and others. If things don't work out, just go into the lake and become a robber again. Shen Tujian, Liao Zhan and others all agreed, so they went together to persuade Gengshi. Gengshi was furious after hearing this and refused to agree. Zhang Xun and others did not dare to say anything more. When Chi Mei made Liu Penzi emperor, Gengshi sent Wang Kuang, Chen Mu, Cheng Yue and Zhao Meng to garrison Xinfeng and Li Song to garrison the city to resist them. Zhang Xian, Liao Zhan, Hu Yin, Shen Tujian and others conspired with the imperial censor Kui Xiao to use force to hijack Gengshi during the Liqiu Festival in order to complete the plan proposed above. Attendant Liu Nengqing learned of their plot and reported it to Gengshi. Gengshi pretended to be ill and did not leave the palace, so he summoned Zhang Xuan and others. Zhang Xuan and others came in, and Gengshi prepared to kill them all, but only Wei Xiao could not reach them. Gengshi was suspicious and ordered Zhang Xian and four others to wait in the house outside temporarily. Zhang Xun, Liao Zhan, and Hu Yin suspected that something had happened and rushed out. Only Shentu Jian was there, and Gengshi killed him. Zhang Xuan, Liao Zhan, and Hu Yin then led their troops to plunder the east and west cities. When it was dark, they broke into the palace and fought in the palace. Gengshi was defeated. Early the next morning, he led his wife and more than a hundred chariots and rode eastward to Zhao Meng's place in Xinfeng. Gengshi also suspected that Wang Kuang, Chen Mu, Cheng Dan and Zhang Xuan were conspiring, so he summoned them at the same time. Chen Mu and Cheng Dan arrived first and were beheaded immediately. Wang Kuang could not be frightened and led his army to Chang'an to meet Zhang and others. Li Song returned to Gengshi and joined forces with Zhao Meng to attack Wang Kuang and Zhang Xuan in the city. After fighting for more than a month, Wang Kuang and others were defeated and Gengshi moved to Changxin Palace. When Chimei arrived at Gaoling, Wang Kuang and others surrendered to Chimei, so he and Chimei marched together. Gengshi defended the city and sent Li Song to fight, but failed and more than two thousand people died. Chimei captured Li Song alive. At this time, Li Song's younger brother Li Fan was the captain of the city gate. Red Eyebrow sent an envoy to Li Fan and said: "Open the city gate and spare your brother's life." Li Fan opened the door. In September, Red Eyebrow entered the city. Gengshi fled alone and came out of the kitchen city gate. Many women shouted from behind: Your Majesty should dismount his horse and seize the city! Gengshi dismounted and thanked him, then mounted his horse and ran away.
target: Gengshi sent forces to defeat them but was later defeated by Red Eyebrow. Wang Kuang and Zhang Xuan proposed plundering and retreating east, but Gengshi refused. When Red Eyebrow made Liu Penzi emperor, Gengshi sent generals to resist. Zhang Xuan and others plotted to hijack Gengshi but were discovered. Gengshi killed some conspirators, but Zhang Xuan and others plundered the city and attacked the palace, defeating Gengshi. Gengshi fled to Zhao Meng, suspected Wang Kuang and others, and killed Chen Mu and Cheng Dan. Wang Kuang joined Zhang Xuan. After a month of fighting, Gengshi moved to Changxin Palace. Red Eyebrow arrived, and Wang Kuang surrendered. Gengshi defended the city but was defeated; Li Song was captured. Li Fan opened the city gate, and Red Eyebrow entered in September. Gengshi fled but was captured by Yan Ben.

id: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传::group-006
article_path: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传
source: Chimei passed down a letter saying: If the Holy Duke is willing to surrender, he will be named King of Changsha. But after twenty days, I refused to accept it. Gengshi sent Liu Gong to ask for surrender from Chimei, who sent his general Xie Lu to accept the surrender. In October, Gengshi followed Xie Lu naked to Changle Palace and dedicated the emperor's seal and ribbon to Liu Penzi. Chimei's guilt was changed and he was placed in the court and prepared to be killed. Liu Gong and Xie Lu interceded for Gengshi, but Chimei didn't agree, so they took Gengshi away. Liu Gong chased after him and said: I am trying my best to protect the Holy Duke. Please let me die in front of the Holy Duke. He drew his sword and wanted to commit suicide. Fan Chong, the commander of the red eyebrows, and others quickly rescued him, so they pardoned Gengshi and made him a Marquis of Weiwei. Liu Gong once again interceded for Gengshi, and actually made Gengshi the King of Changsha. Gengshi often lived with Xie Lu, and Liu Gong also protected him. The three assistants suffered from the tyranny of Chimei and all sympathized with Gengshi, but Zhang Xun and others were deeply concerned and said to Xie Lu: Now the commanders of the battalions want to capture Shenggong. Once you lose Shenggong and everyone joins forces to attack you, you will be destroying yourself. So Xie Lu sent his soldiers to go to the countryside to herd horses with Gengshi, and secretly ordered his soldiers to strangle Gengshi. Liu Gong went to collect Gengxi's body at night. Guangwu was very sad when he heard the news, and ordered Deng Yu, the chief minister, to bury Gengshi in Ba Ling. Gengshi had three sons: Liu Qiu, Liu Xin, and Liu Li. In the summer of the next year, Liu Qiu's brothers and their mother went east to Luoyang. The emperor named Qiu the Marquis of Xiangyi and offered sacrifices to Gengshi; Liu Xin was the Marquis of Shu, and Liu Li was the Marquis of Shouguang. Liu Qiu later moved to the title of Marquis of Xianyang. After Qiu's death, his son Liu Xun succeeded him and then moved to Zehou.
target: He surrendered to Red Eyebrow in October, was made Marquis of Weiwei, then King of Changsha. He lived with Xie Lu but was strangled on Xie Lu's orders. Guangwu buried him at Ba Ling. Gengshi had three sons, later enfeoffed by Guangwu. Liu Penzi, a descendant of Liu Zhang, King of Chengyangjing, was captured by Red Eyebrow.

source: The first person to attack is rarely unscathed. Chen Sheng and Xiang Yu have not achieved imperial status, let alone mediocre people! Liu Penzi was a native of Taishan County and a descendant of Liu Zhang, King of Chengyangjing. His grandfather Liu Xian was granted the title of Shihou during the Yuan Dynasty, and his father Liu Meng succeeded him. After Wang Mang usurped the throne, the feudal state was removed, so he became a native of Shixian County. In the first year of Tianfeng, there was a mother Lu in Haiqu County, Langfu County. Her son was a county official. He committed a minor crime and was killed by the county magistrate. Lu's mother resented the county magistrate and secretly gathered guests to plan revenge for her son.
target: Lu's mother, seeking revenge for her son, gathered followers and killed a county magistrate before returning to the sea.

source: Among them, the highest-ranking ones are the three elders, followed by the engaged ones, and the third ones are the pawns. They are generally called "giants". Fan Chong and others prepared to fight, but he was worried that his subordinates would be confused with Wang Mang's soldiers, so he ordered his subordinates to paint their eyebrows red to distinguish them, and they were known as red eyebrows from then on. Chimei defeated Lian Dan and Wang Kuang's army, killing more than ten thousand people, and chased them to Wuyan. Lian Dan died in the battle and Wang Kuang fled for his life. Fan Chong led more than 100,000 troops and returned to surround Ju County for several months. Someone said to Chong: Ju is the hometown of our parents, why should we attack it? Fan Chongnai came to the rescue and left. At this time, Lu's mother died of illness, and her subordinates joined the Red Eyebrow, Qingdu, and Bronze Horse tribes. The Red Eyebrow Army invaded Donghai County and fought against Wang Mang Dayin of Yiping County. They failed and thousands of people died. Then they left Donghai and plundered Chu, Pei, Runan, and Yingchuan. They returned to Chenliu, captured Lu City, and moved to Puyang. It happened that Gengshi decided to make his capital Luoyang and sent envoys to persuade Fan Chong to surrender. When Fan Chong and others heard that the Han Dynasty was revived, they left their troops behind and personally led more than 20 generals to accompany the envoys to Luoyang to surrender and reform. They were all granted the title of marquis.
target: Fan Chong raised troops in Ju, and with others, formed the Red Eyebrow Army, painting their eyebrows red. They defeated Wang Mang's forces and grew to over 100,000. After Lu's mother died, her followers joined Red Eyebrow. They fought across regions, and when Gengshi made Luoyang his capital, Fan Chong and others surrendered but later rebelled.

source: Although the Red Eyebrow tribe had won many battles, they were exhausted and tired of fighting. They cried day and night and wanted to return eastward. Fan Chong and others discussed and considered that once they returned eastward, the tribe would inevitably disperse, so it was better to attack Chang'an westward. In the winter of the second year of Gengshi, Fan Chong and Pang An arrived at Wuguan, while Xu Xuan and others advanced from Luhun Pass in two directions. In the first month of the third year, they all arrived in Hongnong County and won consecutive battles with Gengshi generals, and the army developed greatly.

source: In the first month of the third year, they all arrived in Hongnong County and won consecutive battles with Gengshi generals, and the army developed greatly. So ten thousand people were divided into one battalion, and a total of thirty battalions were built. Each battalion had three elders and one person in charge; they entered Huayin. In the army, Qi witches often played drums and danced to worship King Cheng Yangjing for blessings and peace. The wizard was talking nonsense, and King Jing was furious and said: When you are the emperor, why should you be a thief? Those who laughed at the witches became ill, and the army was frightened. At this time, Fang Wang's younger brother Fang Yang resented Gengshi for killing his brother, so he wrote to Fan Chong and others, saying: Gengshi was in chaos and the government's orders were ineffective, which is why the general reached this point. Now the general has millions of people marching west to the imperial capital Chang'an, but he has no title and is called a group of thieves. This cannot last long. It is better to establish the Liu clan and carry out executions under the banner of justice. Who dares to disobey this order? Fan Chong and others thought this was good. Fan Chong advanced to Zheng County and discussed with the generals: Now that our army is approaching Chang'an, and ghosts and gods appear like this, we should ask the Liu clan to jointly establish him as emperor. In June, Liu Penzi was made emperor and named himself the first year of the founding of the world.

source: The three elders and businessmen gathered under the steps. Liu Penzi, Liu Mao, and Liu Xiao stood in the middle, picking up wood chips in order of age. Liu Penzi was the youngest and the last one to touch it, and happened to touch the middle piece of wood. All the generals in the audience congratulated Liu Penzi on his submission. Liu Penzi was only fifteen years old at this time, with his hair disheveled, bare feet, and rags. He was blushing and sweating and was so frightened that he almost cried when he saw everyone kneeling down to him. Liu Mao said to him: Hide the wood pieces well. Liu Penzi immediately bit off the wood pieces and threw them away, then returned to Liu Xiaqing. Liu Xiaqing made Liu Penzi a bright red singlet, an empty red hat, and shoes with a straight pattern, and asked him to ride in a high carriage and a big horse. There was a red mud screen in front of the carriage and a red curtain around the carriage, but Liu Penzi still played with the shepherds. Although Fan Chong started out as a warrior and was admired by everyone, he was uneducated and did not know his skills. Xu Xuan worked as a jailer in the county government and knew the Book of Changes. So everyone recommended Xu Xuan as the prime minister, Fan Chong as the imperial censor, Pang An as the left Grand Sima, Xie Lu as the Right Grand Sima, and everyone from Yang Yin on down as Lieqing. The army arrived at Gaoling and joined forces with Gengshi's rebel general Zhang Xian and others, so they attacked Dongdu Gate and entered Chang'an City, whereupon Gengshi surrendered. Liu Penzi lived in Changle Palace, and the generals gathered every day to discuss who had the greater merit. They argued and shouted, drew their swords and struck pillars, but they could not reach an agreement.
target: Penzi, fifteen, was terrified. Xu Xuan became prime minister, Fan Chong imperial censor, and others held high ranks. They entered Chang'an, and Gengshi surrendered. Penzi lived in Changle Palace, but the generals were disorderly, robbing and killing. Penzi cried daily. Liu Gong taught him to resign, but Fan Chong refused. After more plundering, they left Chang'an westward, suffering heavy losses from snow.

id: 后汉书/列传/刘玄刘盆子列传::group-012

source: Liu Penzi rode in the king's chariot, driving three horses, followed by hundreds of horsemen. So he plundered from Zhongnan Mountain to the big city and Xiaoyi, fought with Gengshi General Yan Chun in the county, defeated Yan Chun and killed him, and then entered Anding and Beidi. When they arrived at Yangcheng and Fanxuzhong, they encountered heavy snow and the pits and valleys were full. Many soldiers froze to death. So they returned, excavated the tombs in the mausoleums, and stole the treasures in the tombs. Empress Lu's body was also insulted. In the tombs excavated by Chimei, most of the jade boxes containing the remains looked like they were alive, so Chimei was able to do a lot of dirty work. The great Situ Deng Yu was in Chang'an at this time and sent troops to attack Yu Yi. However, he was defeated by Chi Mei, and Yu had to leave Yunyang. In September, Chimei returned to Chang'an and lived in Guigong. At this time, the Hanzhong thief Yancen sent troops to disperse the pass and stationed himself in Duling. Pang'an led more than 100,000 people to attack Yancen.
target: They returned, looted tombs, and insulted Empress Lu's body. Deng Yu attacked but was defeated. In September, they returned to Chang'an. After battles with Yancen and others, a great famine struck Sanfu.

source: Yancen and others were defeated and more than ten thousand people died. Li Bao surrendered to Pang'an. Yancen gathered the scattered soldiers and fled. Li Bao sent someone to inform Yancen, saying: "You try your best to fight back. I will turn back from the inside and attack from both inside and outside, which can greatly destroy Pang'an." Yancen immediately returned to challenge, Pang'an Kongying fought back, and Li Bao pulled out all the red eyebrow army flags from behind and replaced them with his own banners. Pang An and others returned to camp after being exhausted from the battle. When they saw that the flags had been replaced by white flags, they ran in panic and threw themselves into a valley. More than 100,000 people died. Pang An and thousands of others escaped and returned to Chang'an. At this time, there was a great famine in Sanfu, people were eating people, the city walls were empty, and the fields were full of bones. The people who stayed often formed camps to protect each other, and each of them stood firm. Chimei couldn't grab anything, so in December, he led his troops back eastward, leaving more than 200,000 people scattered along the way. Guangwu then sent General Hou Jin and others to garrison in Xin'an County, and General Jianwei Geng Yan and others to garrison in Yiyang, dividing the troops into two groups to intercept their return. He ordered the generals to say: If the thieves go east, they can lead Yiyang's troops to join Xin'an; if the thieves go south, they can lead Xin'an's troops to join Yiyang. In the first month of the second year, Deng Yu crossed from Hebei and attacked Chimei in Hu County. Deng Yu was defeated again, so Chimei left the pass and marched south. General Feng Yi defeated the Red Eyebrow Army in Guodi. After Guangwu heard the news, he personally led his army to Yiyang and blocked their escape with a powerful army. Chimei suddenly encountered a large army and was so shocked that he didn't know what to do, so he sent Liu Gong to beg Guangwu for surrender, saying: "Penzi has surrendered millions of people to your majesty. How will your majesty treat them?" The emperor said: I will just not kill you. Fan Chong then stripped Liu Penzi, Prime Minister Xu Xuan and more than 30 people and asked Guangwu to surrender.
target: In December, they returned east, losing many. Guangwu intercepted them, and in the first month of the second year, they surrendered. Guangwu spared them, gave them land in Luoyang, but Fan Chong and Pang An later rebelled and were executed. Liu Penzi became blind and was given land in Xingyang for life.

id: 后汉书/列传/刘赵淳于江刘周赵列传::group-000

source: ◆The biography of Liu Ping, named Gongzi, was from Pengcheng, Chu County. His real name was Kuang, but it was changed to Ping after he became emperor. During Wang Mang's time, he became a county official, guarding the Qiu chief, and flourished in politics and religion. Later, when there were thieves in each county, Liu Ping was sent to guard them. Wherever he went, he was controlled. From then on, every county praised his ability. During the Gengshi period, the world was in chaos, and Liu Ping's younger brother Liu Zhong was killed by thieves. Later, the thieves suddenly arrived. Liu Ping supported his mother and ran away. Liu Zhong's posthumous daughter was only one year old. Liu Ping embraced Zhong's daughter and abandoned his biological son. The mother wanted to go back to get her son, but Liu Ping refused to listen and said: "I cannot support two children, and the second child cannot have offspring." So he left without caring, and hid in Nozawa with his mother. Liu Ping went out to look for food in the morning. He met a hungry thief and was about to cook him. Liu Ping kowtowed and said, "I will find some wild vegetables for my mother to satisfy her hunger this morning. My mother is waiting for me to survive. I wish I could go back first. When my mother finishes eating, I will definitely come back and let you kill her." So the tears continued. The thief saw that he was sincere, sympathized with him and let him go home. When Liu Ping went back, after his mother finished eating, he said to his mother: "I just made an appointment with a thief, so I can't deceive others." So he returned to the thief. Everyone was shocked and talked to each other: "I often hear about martyrs, but today I actually saw them." Just go away, we can't bear to eat you. As a result, Liu Ping's life was saved. In the early years of Jianwu, General Pang Meng of Pingdi made troops in Pengcheng and defeated the governor of the county, Sun Meng. Liu Ping was working as a county official at that time. He risked his life by lying on Sun Meng's body and suffered seven stab wounds. He was so trapped that he didn't know what to do, so he cried and begged: "I am willing to replace the king with my body." The thieves gathered their weapons and stopped killing, saying, "This man is a righteous man, don't kill him." So dismissed and walked away. Sun Meng was seriously injured and died. After a while, he came back to life. He was thirsty and looked for water. Liu Ping took blood from his own wound and gave it to him to drink.
target: Biographies of several individuals from the Han dynasty. Liu Ping, originally named Kuang, was from Pengcheng. During Wang Mang's time, he was a county official. During the Gengshi period, when thieves arrived, he fled with his mother, abandoning his own son to save his orphaned niece. He later encountered a hungry thief who wanted to eat him, but Liu Ping begged to feed his mother first and promised to return. The thief, moved by his sincerity, let him go. Liu Ping kept his promise and returned, but the thief spared him. In the early Jianwu years, he risked his life to protect the wounded governor Sun Meng, suffering seven stab wounds and even offering his own blood to the thirsty Sun Meng.

source: When Bi Liwei Chan passed away nine years later, Duan Chen, the general of Zhonglang, led his troops to express his condolences, offered wine and rice as a memorial, and assigned troops to protect the southern Xiongnu. From then on, whenever the Shanyu passed away, it was a common practice for the Han Dynasty to pay condolences, pay homage, offer condolences and reward him. target: Bi reigned for nine years. After his death, his brother succeeded him. The Han Dynasty established a routine of condolences and rewards for each Shanyu's death. Over the years, various Shanyu succeeded each other, with conflicts between the northern and southern Xiongnu. The Northern Xiongnu, weakened by internal strife and attacks from Xianbei and others, eventually collapsed. The Southern Xiongnu, under various Shanyu, sometimes rebelled and sometimes surrendered, causing ongoing border troubles. The Han Dynasty sent generals to attack and defend, with mixed results. Eventually, the Xiongnu split into northern and southern courts, with the southern court serving as a vassal to Han. The Han Dynasty established the Du Liao military camp to guard against both. Despite occasional rebellions, the southern Xiongnu remained largely submissive, while the northern Xiongnu gradually weakened and disappeared. The Han Dynasty's policy of using barbarians to attack barbarians proved effective, but also led to ongoing conflicts and instability.

When they looked at it, they found it was General Wu's head. He wanted to repay the dog but did not know how to do it. When the daughter found out, she thought that the emperor had given an order and she could not violate her faith, so she asked to marry Panhu. The emperor had no choice but to marry his daughter to Panhu. After Panhu got the emperor's daughter, he carried her to Nanshan and lived in Shidongbao. The place where Panhu is located is dangerous, isolated and inaccessible to humans. So the emperor's daughter took off her clothes, combed her hair into a bun like a servant, and put on independent clothes. The emperor missed his daughter and was very sad. Emperor Xianzong established Ailao and Bonan counties there, and divided the six counties under the jurisdiction of the western captain of Yizhou County into Yongchang County. At that time, Bonan Mountain had just been opened to cross the Lancang River, and the journey was difficult.
target: Yongchang County was established. During Emperor Huan's reign, King Leilao rebelled and was killed.

source: Suzong recruited and dispatched 9,000 Yi and Han people from Yuejun, Yizhou, and Yongchang to conquer Leilao. In the spring of the next year, Kunming Yilicheng and others from Xielong County responded to the recruitment and led people from the same tribe to attack Lei Lao in Bonan with the troops guarding the county. They defeated and killed Lei Lao. The head of Lei Lao was sent to Luoyang. The emperor rewarded Lu Cheng with 10,000 pieces of cloth and named him Marquis of Polu Pangyi. In the sixth year of Yongyuan, King Mo Yan of Dunren Yi outside the border of Yongchang County admired Deyi and sent an interpreter to present rhinos and elephants. In the ninth year, Yongyou, the king of the barbarians and Shan outside the border, sent people to send domestic treasures through various translators. Emperor He gave them gold seals and purple ribbons, and the small chiefs also gave them seals, ribbons and money. In the first year of Yongchu, more than 3,000 people from outside the border, including Yi Lulei and others, submitted their entire tribe and presented ivory, buffalo, and cows. In the first year of Yongning, King Yongyou Diao of Shan sent envoys to the court to pay homage and celebrate, presenting music and performers of illusions. They could change their bodies, breathe fire from their mouths, dismember themselves, and swap the heads of cows and horses.
target: In Yongyuan's sixth year, King Mo Yan presented rhinos and elephants. In Yongning's first year, King Yongyou Diao presented musicians who performed illusions.
