source: Kaixiao, courtesy name Jimeng, was from Chengji County, Tianshui County. When he was young, he served as a state and county official. Wang Mang's imperial advisor Liu Xin introduced Kai Xiao as his Yuanshi. After Liu Xin died, Wei Xiao returned to his hometown. His uncle, Kui Cui, had always been bold and chivalrous, and was supported by everyone. When he heard that Gengshi was proclaimed emperor and that Wang Mang's troops were defeated, he planned to raise troops to respond to the Han army with his brother Wei Yi, Yang Guang from Shanggui, and Zhou Zong from Ji. Wei Xiao stopped him and said: "Sending troops to fight is a dangerous thing!" What sin does our clan have? Wei Cui refused to listen, so he gathered thousands of people to attack Pingxiang and killed Wang Mang's Zhenrong Dayin. Wei Cui, Yang Guang and others thought that if they wanted to take action, they should appoint a general to unify everyone's thoughts. They all said that Wei Xiao was well-known and loved scriptures, so they jointly recommended Wei Xiao as the general. Wei Xiao resigned and had no choice but to say: "Fathers and wise men think highly of me, young man, and must use my opinion before I dare to obey." Everyone said: OK. After Kuai Xiao was established, he sent an envoy to hire Fang Wang from Pingling as a military advisor. Fang Wangzhi suggested to Kaixiao: "I want to obey the destiny of the people and support the Han Dynasty and start an uprising. Today, I am standing in Nanyang. Wang Mang is still guarding Chang'an. Although he wants to act in the name of the Han Dynasty, he has not actually received the order from the Han Dynasty. What will he do to convince everyone?" We should quickly build a temple for Emperor Gaozu, worship him as a minister, and use the so-called "Shinto teachings" to seek help from humans and gods. Moreover, etiquette may be added or deleted from time to time, and there is no standard between simplicity and splendor.
target: Kui Xiao, courtesy name Jimeng, was from Chengji County, Tianshui. He began his career as a local official and later served under Wang Mang's advisor Liu Xin. After Liu Xin's death, Kui Xiao returned home. His uncle, Kui Cui, a bold and chivalrous figure, planned to raise troops to support the Han dynasty after hearing of Gengshi's proclamation and Wang Mang's defeat. Kui Xiao initially advised against it, warning of the dangers of war, but Kui Cui proceeded, gathering thousands to attack Pingxiang. The group then appointed Kui Xiao as general due to his reputation and knowledge of scriptures. Kui Xiao accepted on condition that his advice be heeded.

source: The corpses of the dead were thrown into the wild and could not be buried, the living fled and fled, and young orphans and women were displaced and plundered. This is his grave sin against humanity. Therefore, God took pity on the people and punished Wang Mang. Several of his sons were killed by himself, and his wife was also angry to death. The ministers rebelled against him, and the situation for his demise was already set. Grand Sima Dong Zhong, Imperial Advisor Liu Xin, and General Wei Wang She all united to disintegrate from within; Si Ming Kong Ren, Nayan Yanyou, and Zhizong Chen Mao surrendered outside. Today, there are more than two million soldiers in Shandong. They have pacified Qi, Chu, Xia Shu, and Han, and pacified Wan and Luo. They are based in Aocang, guarding Hanguan, and spreading their orders everywhere, proclaiming their reputation in Zhongyue. Guangwu lost his father at the age of nine and was raised by his uncle Liu Liang. He is seven feet three inches tall, has thick eyebrows, a wide mouth, a protruding nose, and a full forehead. He is industrious by nature and enjoys farming. His elder brother Bo Sheng was fond of chivalry and raising people. He often ridiculed Guang Wu for only working in the fields and compared him with Liu Bang's second brother Liu Zhong. It was not until the reign of Wang Mang and Tianfeng that Guangwu came to Chang'an to study "Shang Shu" as a disciple and roughly understand the gist of the book. In Wang Mang's last years, there were successive locust plagues in the country, and bandits and bandits were raging. In the third year of Emperor Di Huang's reign, there was a serious famine in Nanyang, and most of the family's guests went out to rob and steal. In order to avoid the government, Guangwu fled to Xinye County and transported the harvested grain to Wancheng to sell. Li Tong and others from Wan used prophecies and talismans to tell Guangwu: The Liu family has risen again, and the Li family will be the assistant. Guangwu didn't dare to act rashly at first, but then he thought that his brother Bo Sheng would do great things by making friends with diners. Moreover, Wang Mang's regime showed signs of decline and destruction, and the world was in turmoil, so he planned with the Li family and decided to raise an army, so he began to purchase various weapons.
target: Emperor Guangwu Liu Xiu, courtesy name Uncle Wen, was born in Caiyang, Nanyang, as the ninth-generation grandson of Liu Bang. He lost his father at age nine and was raised by his uncle Liu Liang. Described as tall with distinctive features, he was industrious and enjoyed farming, unlike his elder brother Bo Sheng who favored chivalry. During Wang Mang's reign, Liu Xiu studied the "Shang Shu" in Chang'an. When locust plagues and famine struck, Liu Xiu fled to Xinye County to avoid government persecution. After receiving prophecies about the Liu family's revival, he initially hesitated but eventually planned with the Li family to raise an army.

Guangwu then fought fiercely with them in Puyang, defeated the enemy forces across the board and made them surrender, and named their generals as marquises. The surrendered generals still felt uneasy. Guangwu knew their doubts and asked them to return to their respective armies to manage the soldiers, and then he leisurely rode on horseback to inspect each battalion. The surrendered people talked among themselves and said: King Xiao confides in us, how can we not retaliate with death? From then on they were all convinced. Guangwu distributed all the surrendered troops to the generals, and his troops expanded to hundreds of thousands. The people in Kansai therefore called Guangwu the "Bronze Horse Emperor".
target: As chaos spread across the empire, Liu Xiu pacified various rebel groups including the Bronze Horse Army. He won over surrendered troops by personally inspecting their camps, earning their loyalty. His forces grew to hundreds of thousands.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上::group-007
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上
source: The opportunity cannot be delayed, and the wishes of the people cannot be violated! Geng Chun's words were very sincere. Guangwu was deeply moved and said, "I'll think about it again." When they marched to Haoxian County, Qianghua, who lived in the same room as Guangwu when he was studying in Chang'an, brought the "Red Fu Fu" from Guanzhong, which said: Liu Xiu sent troops to deal with the unruly people, and all the tribes from all directions gathered together, like dragons fighting in the wild. In the 228th year, the virtue of fire is dominant. The ministers took the opportunity to speak further and said: "It is important to accept the fate of destiny and comply with human affairs. Now the destiny thousands of miles away is consistent with things and coincides with it. Even if it is the white fish response of King Wu of Zhou, how can it be compared with this?" Now that there is no emperor above and chaos in the sea, Fu Rui's fulfillment must be clearly repaid to the gods in heaven to satisfy everyone's wishes. Guangwu then ordered the officials to build an altar for worshiping heaven in the Qianqiu Pavilion in the south of Haocheng. On June 22, Guangwu ascended the throne as emperor.
target: After repeated requests from his generals, Liu Xiu ascended the throne on June 22, establishing the Jianwu reign period.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上::group-008
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上
source: On August 16th, sacrifice to Sheji. On August 17, sacrifices were made to Emperor Gaozu, Emperor Taizong and Emperor Shizong in Huai Palace. Guangwu marched to Heyang, and Gengshi Linqiu King Tianli surrendered. In September, the Red Eyebrow Army entered Chang'an and Gengshi fled to Gaoling. On the sixth day of the lunar month, Guangwu issued an edict saying: Gengshi was ruined, they abandoned the city and fled, their wives, families and children were naked and scattered on the road. I pity them very much. Now Gengshi has been granted the title of King of Huaiyin. Any officials or civilians who dare to kill him will be punished with treason. On the 19th, when he was appointed Emperor Ping, Gao Mi ordered Zhuomao to be the Taifu. On the 26th, Zhu Kun led the entire city of Luoyang to surrender. On the eighteenth day of the tenth month in winter, Guangwu entered Luoyang. Fortunately, Nangong was not the palace, so he made Luoyang his capital. On Xinmao day, Cen Peng was sent to attack the bandits in Jingzhou. On November 30, Guangwu arrived in Huai County. Liu Yong claimed to be the emperor. In December Bingxu, Guangwu returned to Luoyang from Huai County. The Red Eyebrow Army's killing spree begins. Wei Xiao occupied Longyou, Lu Fang raised troops in Anding, and Shu Shou, the general who broke the captives, attacked the bandits of the Five Schools in Quliang, and Shu Shou died in the battle. On the first day of the first lunar month of the second year of spring, there was a solar eclipse. Grand Sima Wu Han led nine generals to attack the Tanxiang bandits in the east of Ye, defeated the Tanxiang bandits and forced them to surrender. On the 17th, all the meritorious officials were enfeoffed as princes. The larger ones were enfeoffed to four counties, and the rest were of varying degrees. The edict said: After people's desires are satisfied, what they fear most is to be unruly, seeking only temporary happiness and forgetting to be cautious about punishment.
target: He granted amnesty, appointed officials, and made Luoyang his capital. He enfeoffed meritorious officials as princes, warning them to remain cautious and respectful.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上::group-009
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上
source: On the first day of the second lunar month, a memorial ceremony was held in the high temple, and Guangwu accepted the imperial seal. Liu Yong falsely named Dong Xian King of Haixi and Zhang Bu King of Qi. Zhang Bu killed Fulong, the official of Guanglu, and rebelled. Emperor Guangwu went to Huai County and sent Wu Han and two generals to attack Qingdu in the west of Zhejiang. They defeated the Qingdu army and forced them to surrender. On March 16, Zhifu Zhan was appointed as the Great Situ. Peng Chong occupied Jicheng and proclaimed himself King of Yan. Guangwu personally led the troops to conquer Deng Feng and arrived at Duyang. In April of Xia, he defeated Deng Feng in Xiao Chang'an and killed him. Feng Yi and Yancen fought in Shanglin and defeated Yancen. Wu Han led seven generals to fight Liu Yong's general Su Mao in Guangle, and defeated Su Mao.
target: The Red Eyebrow Army captured Chang'an and looted Guanzhong. Liu Xiu personally led campaigns against various rebels, defeating the Red Eyebrows and recovering the imperial seal. He continued military campaigns against Liu Yong, Dong Xian, and others while implementing administrative reforms, including releasing prisoners during drought and restoring Han dynasty institutions.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上::group-010
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪上
source: On the fourth day of the seventh lunar month in autumn, Emperor Guangwu went to Peixian County to offer sacrifices to Gaodi Temple. An imperial edict was issued to restore the imperial tombs in Chang'an. He marched to Huling and conquered Dong Xian, and then to Fan County and attacked Dong Xian in Changli and won a great victory. On the sixth day of August, Emperor Guangwu marched to Tan County, leaving Wu Han behind to attack Liu Yu, Dong Xian and others. Emperor Guangwu then inspected Pengcheng and Xiapi. Wu Han captured Tan County and captured Liu Yu; Wu Han then marched to Qu County and besieged Dong Xian and Pang Meng. In the tenth month of winter, Emperor Guangwu passed by Lu on his way back to Luoyang. The great Sikong was sent to worship Confucius. Geng Yan and others fought with Zhang Bu in Linzi and defeated Zhang Bu. Emperor Guangwu arrived in Linzi and marched to Ju County. Zhang Bu killed Su Mao and surrendered, and Qi was pacified. Taixue was established. Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang, inspected the Imperial Academy, and rewarded his Ph.D. disciples respectively. On the first day of November, Grand Situ Fu Zhan was dismissed from his post and appointed Shangshu Ling Hou Ba as Grand Situ. In December, Lu Fang proclaimed himself emperor in Jiuyuan. General Kai Xiao of Xizhou sent his son Kai Xun to the palace to guard Emperor Guangwu. Jiaozhi Mu Dengrang led the prefects of the seven counties to send people to Beijing to pay tribute. The imperial edict exempted Jiyang County from corvee service for two years. This year, the number of wild grains gradually decreased and more and more fields were cultivated.
target: He established the Imperial Academy and promoted agriculture as wild grains gradually decreased and cultivated fields increased.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-000
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: On the 16th day of the first lunar month in the sixth year of spring, Chongling Township was renamed Zhangling County, and the corvee was exempted from generation to generation. According to the old practices in Fengyi and Pei County, the hometown of Emperor Gaozu, the people of Zhangling County no longer worried about the possibility of corvée in the future. On the 21st, an edict was issued saying: Floods, droughts, and locust plagues in previous years caused grain prices to skyrocket and the people suffered. I feel very sad when I see the people unable to feed themselves. The counties and states that still have food reserves are ordered to provide relief to the elderly, widowers, widows, orphans, the old and childless, those who are seriously ill and needy, as well as those who are homeless and unable to support themselves. Everything must comply with the provisions of the Han Code. The county governor should work hard to appease the people and not neglect his duties. General Yangwu Ma Cheng and others captured Shu County and captured Li Xian. In February, Grand Sima Wu Han captured Qu County, captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng, and pacified everything east of the Taihang Mountains. The generals returned to the capital, where they were given banquets and rewards. In March, Gongsun Shu sent general Ren Man to invade Nanjun. On the eighth day of the fourth lunar month in the summer, Emperor Guangwu arrived in Chang'an and began to pay homage to the Gaomiao Temple and worship the Eleven Tombs. He sent General Huya General Gai Yan and other seven generals from Longdao to attack Gongsun Shu. On May 21, Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang from Chang'an. Kuai Xiao rebelled, and Gai Yan fought with Kuai Xiao in Longnandi, and Gai Yan and others were severely defeated. Xin Chou, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict: Officials in Tianshui, Longxi, Anding, and Beidi who were implicated in Kaixiao's deception, as well as those who violated the law and did not follow the right path when the third assistant was in trouble with Chimei, will be exempted from punishment if they are sentenced to less than beheading.
target: In the sixth year of spring, Chongling Township was renamed Zhangling County, and its people were exempted from corvée, following the precedent of Fengyi and Pei County. An edict ordered counties with food reserves to relieve the elderly, widowers, widows, orphans, the childless, the seriously ill, and the homeless, in accordance with the Han Code. General Ma Cheng captured Shu County, and Grand Sima Wu Han pacified the area east of the Taihang Mountains. In March, Gongsun Shu invaded Nanjun. Emperor Guangwu visited Chang'an to pay homage at the Gaomiao Temple and the Eleven Tombs, then sent General Gai Yan to attack Gongsun Shu. After returning to Luoyang, Gai Yan was defeated by Kuai Xiao. An edict exempted officials in Tianshui, Longxi, Anding, and Beidi from punishment for crimes less than beheading if implicated in Kuai Xiao's rebellion.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-001
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: On December 27, the Grand Sikong Song Hong was dismissed from his post. On the 28th, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict saying: In the past, due to the constant wars and the high cost of the army, a tax of one out of ten was implemented. Now the army has implemented farming and has a small amount of grain reserves. Now the counties and counties are ordered to restore the old system of thirty taxes and one tax. In December, Kaixiao sent generals to patrol Fufeng. General Feng Yi resisted and defeated him.
target: Another edict ordered the reduction of officials, resulting in the merger of over 400 counties and a tenfold reduction in staff.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-002
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: In June, Liu Xing, the prefect of Daijun, attacked Lu Fang's general Jia Lan in Gaoliu, and Liu Xing died in the battle. In the past, Wang Tiao, a Lelang man, occupied the county and refused to accept it. In the autumn of this year, Wang Zun, the prefect of Lelang, was sent to attack. The county officials killed Wang Tiao and surrendered. He sent former general Li Tong and two generals to fight with general Gongsun Shu in Xicheng and defeated him. Summer, locust plague. On the fourth day of the ninth lunar month in autumn, those who commit crimes against Lelang will be exempted from punishment unless they are guilty of treason. On the 30th, dusk, solar eclipse. On the 11th day of the tenth month in winter, the edict said: I have weak virtues and lack of wisdom. Bandits have harmed me, raped and bullied the weak, and the common people have been displaced. "The Book of Songs" says: There are ominous signs in the sun and moon, which are signs of failure. I often think about my mistakes and feel sad inside. The ministers are now ordered to recommend a virtuous person and an upright person, and all officials must submit a sealed report. Do not hide any concerns; officials must abide by the legal system when performing their duties. On Ding Mao in the eleventh month, Wang Mang issued an edict that all officials and people who were not slaves and who were not in compliance with the old law should be exempted from becoming commoners. On December 27, the Grand Sikong Song Hong was dismissed from his post. On the 28th, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict saying: In the past, due to the constant wars and the high cost of the army, a tax of one out of ten was implemented. Now the army has implemented farming and has a small amount of grain reserves. Now the counties and counties are ordered to restore the old system of thirty taxes and one tax. In December, Kaixiao sent generals to patrol Fufeng. General Feng Yi resisted and defeated him. This year, officials in the prefectures and counties began to be dismissed. He began to send lieutenants into his own kingdom. The Xiongnu sent envoys to offer gifts, and Emperor Guangwu sent Zhonglang General to return the visit. On the second day of the first lunar month in the seventh year of spring, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict to the central government officials, three assistants, counties, and states to release prisoners in custody. Except for capital crimes, all prisoners were exempted from investigation and prosecution. Those serving hard labor were exempted from punishment and became civilians. Those who had been sentenced to more than two years and escaped, their names were recorded for investigation. He also issued an edict saying: People in the world regard generous burials as a virtue and despise those practices of frugal funerals. As a result, the rich are excessively extravagant and the poor exhaust their property. Laws cannot prohibit it and etiquette cannot restrict it. Only in troubled times do we realize the harm of generous burial. I am announcing this to the world, hoping that everyone will understand that being a loyal minister, a filial son, a kind brother, and a wise brother, and giving a low burial to the deceased is a wise and moral act.
target: Liu Xing, the prefect of Daijun, died in battle against Lu Fang's general. Wang Tiao of Lelang was killed by his own officials, and General Li Tong defeated Gongsun Shu's forces. A locust plague struck, and a solar eclipse occurred. An edict called for recommendations of virtuous and upright individuals. Wang Mang decreed that non-slaves not complying with old laws be made commoners. Grand Sikong Song Hong was dismissed. Emperor Guangwu restored the thirty-to-one tax rate. Kuai Xiao's invasion of Fufeng was repelled by General Feng Yi. Officials began to be dismissed, and the Xiongnu sent envoys. In the seventh year, an edict released prisoners except those guilty of capital crimes. Emperor Guangwu condemned lavish burials and advocated frugality.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-003
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: On February 17, the captain of the canal guard was dismissed. On the fourth day of March, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict stating: Now that the country has a large number of troops, most of which are elite, the light chariots, knights, craftsmen, ship officers and temporarily added officers in the army should be reduced, and they should be allowed to return to their hometowns and serve the people. Gongsun Shu established Kaixiao as King Shuoning. On the 30th, dusk, solar eclipse. Emperor Guangwu avoided the main hall, did not engage in fighting, and ignored state affairs for five days. The edict was issued: My poor moral conduct has led to disasters. Heaven's condemnation appears in the sun and moon. I am trembling and fearful. What can I say? Now I should reflect on my mistakes and hope to eliminate them. Officials must fulfill their duties faithfully, abide by disciplines and laws, and benefit the people. All the officials should go to the meeting in a sealed manner and do not keep secrets.
target: The canal guard captain was dismissed, and military forces were reduced. Gongsun Shu made Kuai Xiao King of Shuoning. A solar eclipse led to a five-day suspension of state affairs. An edict blamed the emperor for disasters and called for officials to fulfill their duties.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-004
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: On April 19th in the summer, Emperor Guangwu issued an edict saying: Recently, the yin and yang have been reversed, and the sun and the moon are approaching and eclipsing each other. If the people have any mistakes, blame it on me alone, and grant amnesty to the world. The Duke, Qing, Sili, and Zhou Mu recommend each one of them to be a virtuous person and a person who is upright. Come to the bus door and I will meet them and take the exam. On the sixth day of May, former general Li Tong became the Grand Sikong. On the 22nd, the officials were ordered to go or stay, according to their own wishes, if they suffered from famine, war, or were robbed by Qingzhou and Xuzhou thieves as slaves and wives.
target: Another edict granted amnesty and ordered recommendations of virtuous individuals. Li Tong became Grand Sikong.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-005
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: On the 22nd, the officials were ordered to go or stay, according to their own wishes, if they suffered from famine, war, or were robbed by Qingzhou and Xuzhou thieves as slaves and wives. Those who dare to detain and refuse to release them will be charged with human trafficking. This summer, it rained continuously. Wang Chang, the loyal general of the Han Dynasty, was appointed as the general of Hengye. On August 26, Liu Shao, the former King of Hejian, was granted the title of King of Hejian. Wei Xiao invaded An Ding, and General Feng Yi and General Ji Zun of Zhengxi drove him back. In winter, Lu Fang appointed Tian Sa, the prefect of Shuofang, and Qiao Hu, the prefect of Yunzhong, to lead the entire county to surrender. This year, the lieutenants of Changshui and Shesheng schools were omitted. In the first month of the spring of the eighth year, Zhonglang attacked Lueyang from behind, killed the guard general Weixiao and occupied the city. In April of summer, Sili school captain Fu Kang died in prison. Wei Xiao came to attack She, but failed to capture it. In the leap month, Emperor Guangwu personally marched against Kaixiao. Hexi General Dou Rong led the prefects of five counties to meet Emperor Guangwu in Gaoping. Wei Xiao was defeated at Longyou and fled to the west city. Emperor Guangwu sent Grand Sima Wu Han and General Zhengnan Cen Peng to surround Xicheng. When Emperor Guangwu arrived at Shangguiquan, Kaixiao refused to surrender, so he sent General Huya Gai Yan and General Jianwei Geng to attack him. Yingchuan bandits invaded and captured the counties under Yingchuan. The governor of Hedong and the guards also rebelled, causing shock and commotion in Kyoto.
target: Slaves captured during famines or wars were to be released. Continuous rain fell. Wang Chang was appointed general. Liu Shao was made King of Hejian. Wei Xiao was driven back from Anding. Lu Fang's generals surrendered. The Changshui and Shesheng school lieutenants were omitted. In the eighth year, Zhonglang Lai She attacked Lueyang. Sili school captain Fu Kang died in prison. Wei Xiao failed to capture She. Emperor Guangwu personally campaigned against Wei Xiao, who was defeated and fled to Xicheng. Yingchuan bandits revolted, causing panic in the capital.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-006
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: In August, Emperor Guangwu drove east from Shangguang day and night. On the first day of September, I returned to Luoyang. On the sixth day of the lunar month, Emperor Guangwu personally conquered the Yingchuan thieves and surrendered. Anqiu Marquis Zhang Bu rebelled and returned to Langfu. Chen Jun, the governor of Langfu, attacked Zhang Bu and captured him alive. On the 24th, Emperor Guangwu returned to Beijing from Yingchuan. On the twenty-second day of the tenth month in winter, Emperor Guangwu arrived in Huai County. On November 12, he returned to Beijing from Huai County. Gongsun Shu sent troops to rescue Wei Xiao, and Wu Han, Gai Yan and others led the army back to Chang'an. Tianshui and Longxi rebelled and joined Kuaixiao. In December, the King of Goguryeo sent an envoy to pay tribute. This year, there was a flood. In the first month of the spring of the ninth year, Wei Xiao died of illness. His subordinates Wang Yuan and Zhou Zong made Wei Xiao's son Kai Chun king. Moved Yanmen officials and people to Taiyuan. On the first day of March, the Qingjin Left School Lieutenant began to be appointed. Gongsun Shu sent generals Tian Rong and Ren Man to occupy Jingmen. On the sixth day of the sixth lunar month in the summer, Emperor Guangwu went to Fengshi and climbed Mount Fuyuan. He sent Grand Sima Wu Han to lead four generals to attack Lu Fang's general Jia Lan in Gaoliu, but the battle was unfavorable. In the eighth month of autumn, Zhonglang was sent to supervise General Feng Yi and other five generals in Tianshui's crusade against Wei Chun. The hussar general Du Mao fought with Jia Lan in Fanri, and Du Mao was defeated. In this year, the Guandu Lieutenant was abolished and the Qiang School Lieutenant was restored. In the first month of the spring of the tenth year, Grand Sima Wu Han led the captured general Wang Ba and other five generals to attack Jia Lan in Gaoliu. The Huns sent cavalry to rescue Jia Lan, and the generals fought with them and drove them back. Repair the high temple in Chang'an. In the summer, Feng Yi, the general who conquered the west, defeated Gongsun Shu's general Zhao Kuang in Tianshui and killed him. General Feng Yi died. On the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month in autumn, Emperor Guangwu went to Chang'an to worship at the Gaomiao Temple and the Eleven Tombs. In the Wuxu period, Emperor Guangwu marched to the county, and Weixiao general Gao Jun surrendered. In the tenth month of winter, Zhonglang came to She and others to defeat Wei Chun at Luomen. Wei Chun fled Wang Yuan to Shu. Wei Chun and Zhou Zong surrendered, and Longyou was pacified. First, the Qiang bandits harassed Jincheng and Longxi. Later, Lai She led his generals to attack the Qiang people in Wuxi and defeated the Qiang people. On the 17th, Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. This year, Dingxiang County was abolished and the people moved to Xihe. King Liu She of Sishui and King Liu of Zichuan died. On the eighth day of the second lunar month in the spring of the eleventh year, an edict was issued saying: Human beings are the most precious spiritual being between heaven and earth. Even if the person killed was a slave or a maid, the crime of murder would not be mitigated.
target: Floods occurred. Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang and subdued the Yingchuan bandits. Zhang Bu rebelled but was captured. Gongsun Shu sent troops to rescue Wei Xiao, but they retreated. Tianshui and Longxi rebelled. The King of Goguryeo paid tribute. Floods continued. In the ninth year, Wei Xiao died, and his son Wei Chun became king. Yanmen officials were moved to Taiyuan. The Qingjin Left School Lieutenant was appointed. Gongsun Shu occupied Jingmen. Emperor Guangwu climbed Mount Fuyuan. Wu Han attacked Lu Fang's general but was unsuccessful. Lai She led a campaign against Wei Chun. Du Mao was defeated. The Guandu Lieutenant was abolished, and the Qiang School Lieutenant was restored. In the tenth year, Wu Han drove back Xiongnu cavalry. The Gaomiao Temple in Chang'an was repaired. Feng Yi defeated and killed Gongsun Shu's general. Feng Yi died. Emperor Guangwu visited Chang'an. Wei Xiao's general Gao Jun surrendered. Wei Chun fled to Shu but later surrendered, pacifying Longyou. Lai She defeated the Qiang. Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. Dingxiang County was abolished. In the eleventh year, an edict stated that killing a slave or maid was still murder.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-007
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: First, the Qiang bandits harassed Jincheng and Longxi. Later, Lai She led his generals to attack the Qiang people in Wuxi and defeated the Qiang people. On the 17th, Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. This year, Dingxiang County was abolished and the people moved to Xihe. King Liu She of Sishui and King Liu of Zichuan died. On the eighth day of the second lunar month in the spring of the eleventh year, an edict was issued saying: Human beings are the most precious spiritual being between heaven and earth. Even if the person killed was a slave or a maid, the crime of murder would not be mitigated. On the ninth day of the third lunar month, Emperor Guangwu went to Nanyang; on his way back to Luoyang, he passed by Zhangling and paid homage to the tomb in the garden. Liu Zhi, King of Chengyang, passed away. On the 30th, Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. In the third month of the leap month, Cen Peng, the general who conquered the south, led three generals to fight Gongsun Shu's generals Tian Rong and Ren Man at Jingmen. They defeated him and captured Ren Man alive. Weilu general Feng Jun besieged Tian Rong in Jiangzhou. Cen Peng led the navy to attack Gongsun Shu and pacified Bajun. On April 28th of the summer, Great Situ was dismissed as the direct official. First there were no Qiang bandits plundering Lintao. In the sixth month, Zhonglang came to She and led Yangwu general Ma Cheng to defeat Gongsun Shu generals Wang Yuan and Huan'an in Xiabian. Huan'an sent spies to assassinate Zhonglang and later She. Emperor Guangwu personally conquered Gongsun Shu. In the seventh month of autumn, he was stationed in Chang'an. In August, Cen Peng defeated Gongsun Shu's general Hou Dan at Huangshitan. General Zang Gong of Auxiliary Wei fought against Gongsun Shu's general Yancen in Shenshui, and Yancen was defeated. Wang Yuan surrendered. Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang from Chang'an. On August 26, the edict stated: Anyone who dares to burn slaves or maids will be punished according to the law, and the burned slaves will be exempted from civilian status. In the tenth month of winter, at Renwu, an edict was issued to abolish the law that required slaves and maids to be executed in public if they shot someone. Gongsun Shu sent spies to assassinate Cen Peng, the general who conquered the south. Ma Cheng pacified Wudu. Taking advantage of the Longxi prefect Ma Yuan's defeat of the Xianling Qiang, he moved the people of Wudu to Tianshui, Longxi, and Fufeng. In December, Grand Sima Wu Han led the navy to attack Gongsun Shu. In this year, Shuofang Mu was eliminated and merged with the state. The system of state pastors going to Beijing to report on government affairs at the end of the year began to be stopped. In the first month of the spring of the twelfth year, Grand Sima Wu Han fought with Gongsun Shu's general Shi Xing in Wuyang and killed Shi Xing. On the ninth day of the third month, it was decreed that the people of Long and Shu who were robbed to be slaves and maidservants and then went to the government to sue, as well as those who had not been judged by the judicial officials, were exempted from becoming civilians.
target: Emperor Guangwu visited Nanyang and Zhangling. Cen Peng defeated Gongsun Shu's generals and captured Ren Man. Feng Jun besieged Tian Rong. Cen Peng pacified Bajun. Lai She defeated Gongsun Shu's generals but was assassinated. Emperor Guangwu personally campaigned against Gongsun Shu. Cen Peng defeated Hou Dan. Zang Gong defeated Yancen. Wang Yuan surrendered. An edict banned the burning of slaves and abolished the law requiring slaves to be executed for shooting someone. Gongsun Shu assassinated Cen Peng. Ma Cheng pacified Wudu. Wu Han led a naval attack on Gongsun Shu. The Shuofang Mu was eliminated. In the twelfth year, Wu Han killed Shi Xing. An edict freed those robbed as slaves in Long and Shu.

id: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下::group-008
article_path: 后汉书/本纪/光武帝纪下
source: In summer, timely rain falls in Nanxingtang. In June, a yellow dragon appears in Dongyang. In the seventh month of autumn, Weilu general Feng Jun captured Jiangzhou and captured Tian Rong. In September, Wu Han defeated Gongsun Shu's general Xie Feng in Guangdu and killed him. General Zang Gong of Auxiliary Wei captured Fucheng and killed Gongsun Hui. Grand Sikong Li Tong was dismissed from office. On November 18th in winter, Wu Han and Zang Gong fought with Gongsun Shu in Chengdu and defeated Gongsun Shu. On the first day of the twelfth lunar month, General Yangwu Ma Cheng took over the duties of the Great Sikong. source: On September 14, an earthquake occurred. On the twenty-fifth day, another earthquake occurred, and the edict issued an order for atonement for those who committed crimes under the death penalty and those who fled, and the atonements varied. Landslides occurred in five places in the county. In October of winter, Taiwei Zhao Jie was dismissed from his post, and Situ Yuan Tang was appointed as Taiwei, and Da Sinong Hanoi Zhang Xin was appointed as Situ.
target: Earthquakes, floods, and locust plagues occurred frequently. The emperor issued edicts for relief and tax reductions.

source: If the civilians are unable to support themselves or are dispersed and relocated, grain relief will be provided as per the existing regulations. The prefectures and counties must inspect and inspect these, and must show mercy so that the people can live in peace. On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Heping, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country, and the Yuan Dynasty was changed to Heping. On the second day of the Lunar New Year, the edict said: In the past, the family suffered misfortune, and the late emperor died early. He had long considered the importance of the origin of the original energy of heaven and earth, and deeply thought about the blessings of his descendants. He consulted the Sangong and Jiuqing to examine the fortune and misfortune.
target: In the first year of Yongshou, amnesty was granted. Famines led to cannibalism; the emperor ordered relief and grain loans.

source: If the carriage and horse clothing system is too extravagant and ostentatious, it should be reduced or omitted. Counties and counties must remain frugal and reaffirm the original regulations, just as they did during the Yongping period. In June, the Surabaya River in Pengcheng surged and flowed backwards. The imperial edict said: "The locust plague has caused damage, floods have occurred one after another, the grain has not been harvested, and the people have no overnight rations. We now order the affected counties to plant turnips widely to supplement the people's food."
target: Floods and landslides caused damage. The emperor established military offices and suppressed rebellions.

source: The houses were damaged and the grain was washed away. The particularly poor people were given two husks of grain each. Landslides occurred in Bajun and Yizhou counties. In autumn and July, Taishan and Langyi captaincy officers were set up for the first time. The southern Xiongnu rebelled against Zuo Tatai Qi, Qiqu Bode and others and harassed Meiji. The captain of Anding's vassal state defeated them and eliminated them. In the first month of spring of the second year, middle officials were allowed to wear mourning clothes for three years. On February 26th, Liu Zhen, King of the East China Sea, passed away In March, the barbarians from the vassal state of Shu County rebelled. In the autumn of July, the Xianbei bandits disturbed the clouds.
target: In the second year, officials were allowed mourning leave. Bandits were defeated. Earthquakes and locust plagues continued.

source: In March, the barbarians from the vassal state of Shu County rebelled. In the autumn of July, the Xianbei bandits disturbed the clouds. Taishan bandit Gongsun Ju and other bandits harassed the three states of Qing, Yan and Xu. He sent Zhonglang General Duan Yu to attack them, break them and kill them. In November of winter, the right eunuch and the chengguan were appointed. In December, there was an earthquake in the capital. At the end of the first month of the spring of the third year, a general amnesty was granted to the whole world.
target: In the third year, amnesty was granted. Rebellions by barbarians were suppressed.

source: In the fourth month of summer, the Jiuzhen barbarians rebelled. The prefect Ershi attacked and died in battle; he sent Jiuzhen Captain Wei Lang to defeat them. Restore troops to guard Rinan. Leap May 30th, solar eclipse. In June, Xiaohuang Gate was used as the guarding order, and redundant servants and archers were set up. There was a locust plague in the capital. In autumn, in July, the ground cracked in Hedong. In November of winter, Situ Yinsong died. The barbarians rebelled in Changsha and the bandits harassed Yiyang. Sikong Hanyan was appointed Situ, and Taichang Beihai Sun Lang was appointed Sikong. On the fourth day of the third month in the first year of Yanxi, the order of Hongdeyuan was established. On the fourth day of the fifth lunar month in the summer, the generals and ministers and below will receive various rewards. On the 29th, there was a solar eclipse. There was a locust plague in the capital. On the fourth day of the sixth lunar month, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country, and the Yuan Dynasty was changed to Yanxi. On the 12th, Zhongshan was divided into Boling County to commemorate the imperial mausoleum. Drought ceremony to pray for rain. On the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month in autumn, the ground in Yunyang cracked. On the 20th, Taiwei Huang Qiong was dismissed from his post and Taichang Hu Guang was appointed as Taiwei. In October in winter, I was hunting in Guangcheng, so I went to Shanglinyuan. In December of winter, Xianbei invaders raided the border, and the Xiongnu Zhonglang general Zhang Huan led Nan Shanyu to defeat them. In the spring and February of the second year, the Xianbei bandits raided Yanmen. On the 29th, King Liu Ben of Fuling passed away. The Yi invaders in Shu County killed the county magistrate. In March, the three-year mourning ceremony implemented by the governor and Erqianshi was suspended again. In summer, it rains a lot in the capital.
target: Solar eclipses and locust plagues occurred. The emperor established offices and conducted hunts. In the first year of Yanxi, amnesty was granted. Earthquakes and locust plagues continued. The emperor hunted and visited Shanglinyuan. Xianbei invaders were defeated. In the second year, Xianbei raided Yanmen. The emperor suspended mourning leave for officials. Heavy rains and floods occurred.

source: The Yi invaders in Shu County killed the county magistrate. In March, the three-year mourning ceremony implemented by the governor and Erqianshi was suspended again. In summer, it rains a lot in the capital. In June, the Xianbei bandits raided Liaodong. In autumn and July, the construction of Xianyang Garden and Chengcheng began. On the second day of the Lunar New Year, Queen Liang passed away. On the 21st, Queen Yixian was buried in Yiling. General Liang Ji conspired to cause rebellion. On the fourth day of August, the emperor went to the front hall and ordered the commander Zhang Biao to lead troops to surround Liang Ji's residence. After confiscating the general's seal and ribbon, Liang Ji and his wife committed suicide. Wei Lieutenant Liang Shu, Henan Yin Liangyin, Tunqi Colonel Liang Rang, Yueqi Colonel Liang Zhong, Changshui Colonel Liang Ji, and dozens of Chinese and foreign clan members were all executed. Taiwei Hu Guang was dismissed from his post. Situ Han Jinyin and Sikong Sunlang were imprisoned. On the ninth day of the lunar month, Queen Deng was established, and Yiling was abandoned and turned into a tomb for nobles. The edict said: Liang Ji was treacherous and cruel, causing chaos in the royal family. The filial emperor was smart and mature early, but Liang Ji was jealous and fearful, so he committed poisonous crimes without permission. The Empress Dowager Yongle respected Mo Er personally, and Liang Ji further blocked her from returning to the capital from the Expo Garden. As a result, mother and son could not be reunited to repay the kindness of raising her. The harm is profound and widespread, and the omens of sin are becoming increasingly serious. Fortunately, thanks to the power of the ancestors, Shan Chao, Xu Huang, Ju Yuan, Zuo Xuanguan, Tang Heng, Shangshu Ling Yinxun, etc. were indignant and suggested countermeasures, and coordinated actions inside and outside the palace. In an instant, the rebellious owl was eliminated. This is truly a blessing to the country, and for the hard work of the ministers, meritorious deeds should be announced, celebrated and rewarded to reward the heroes who served the country loyally. Today, five people including Shan Chao are granted the title of County Marquis, and seven including Yin Xun are granted the title of Ting Marquis. Other old personal benefactors were often knighted. He appointed Da Si Nong Huang Qiong as Taiwei, Guanglu Dafu Zhongshan Zhu Tian as Situ, Da Honglu Liang Guosheng Yun as Sikong. Start setting up secretarial supervisors. On the fifth day of October in winter, the emperor visited Chang'an.
target: Queen Liang died. General Liang Ji conspired to rebel; the emperor ordered his execution, along with many relatives. The emperor established Queen Deng and issued an edict condemning Liang Ji. He rewarded eunuchs who helped him. He appointed new officials and visited Chang'an.

source: Shaodang and other eight kinds of Qiang people rebelled and raided Longyou. Duan Yin, the guard Qiang school captain, pursued them in Luoting and defeated them. Tianzhu came to offer gifts. On the first day of the first lunar month of the third year of spring, a general amnesty was granted to the whole world. On the 11th, the chariot general Shuang Chao died. In the first month of the leap year, the Shaodang Qiang rebelled and raided Zhangye. Duan Yin, the captain of the Qiang Guard, pursued them in Jishi and defeated them.
target: In the third year, amnesty was granted. Qiang rebellions were suppressed.

source: The imperial edict ordered the public and ministers to secretly submit criticisms and suggestions, and to report and expose. On the 27th, a fire broke out in the Chenglu Office of Zhongzang Prefecture. On the eighth day of the seventh lunar month in autumn, a fire broke out in Nangong Chengshan. The Qiang bandits raided Hanyang. In Longxi and Jincheng, soldiers from various counties attacked and defeated him. On August 20, the order was issued to reduce the salary of Huben and Yulin to half the salary of those who were retained in official residences by the weak military, and not to give them winter clothes; to the officials and ministers below, they were given half the salary. The bandits in Ai County burned down the counties in Changsha, invaded Yiyang, and killed the chief officials.
target: Fires and earthquakes occurred. The emperor ordered salary reductions for officials.

source: There was a drought in the capital, famine in Rencheng and Liang, and people were eating people. Situ Zhang Xin was dismissed and Guang Luxun and Wu Xiong were appointed as Situ. In autumn and July, the Wuling barbarians rebelled. In October of winter, Sikong Hu Guang was dismissed. On November 28, there was an earthquake in the capital. On the fourth day of April in the summer, Queen Xiao Chong passed away.
target: Rebellions by barbarians and bandits continued. In the fourth year, fires and epidemics struck.

source: On the 22nd, hail fell in the capital, as big as an egg. In June, there were earthquakes in Jingzhao, Fufeng and Liangzhou. On the 13th, Daishan Mountain and Youlaishan Mountain in Bo County collapsed together. On the 22nd, a general amnesty was granted to the whole world.
