The barbarian bandits from Jianwei's vassal state harassed and plundered the people, but Shan Yu, the governor of Yizhou, defeated him. The Lingwu Qiang and the Xianling tribes rebelled together and plundered Sanfu. In autumn and July, the capital holds the Autumn Rain Sacrifice. The salaries of officials below the rank of Gongqing were reduced, and the land rent of Marquis Feng was reduced to half.
target: The emperor granted amnesty and reduced salaries. Rebellions were suppressed. In the fifth year, fires and earthquakes occurred.

source: Yichou, there was a fire on the east side of the gate of Gongling Tomb. On Wuchen, a fire broke out at the side door of the palace where Huben was located. Now, the Ximen of Taixue has been damaged by itself. In May, a fire broke out in Kanglingyuan's bedroom. Bandits arose in Changsha and Lingling, and they attacked Guiyang, Cangwu, Nanhai, and Jiaozhi. They sent Yushi Zhongcheng Shengxiu to supervise the prefectures and counties to attack them, but they were unable to overcome them. On the 18th, there was an earthquake in the capital. The imperial edict ordered the public and ministers to secretly submit criticisms and suggestions, and to report and expose.
target: The emperor ordered criticisms and reports. Rebellions by bandits and barbarians continued. The emperor reduced salaries and lent funds.

source: Lend the minister the following salary. They also exchanged the rent of the prince's land to help pay for the army, and used the money from the government's treasury in Zhuolong Garden to repay it. In November, Feng Zui defeated the rebels in Wuling. Jingzhao Huya Captain Zong Qian was imprisoned for corruption. The Qiang bandits from Yunnan plundered Wuwei, Zhangye and Jiuquan. Taiwei Liu Ju was dismissed and Taichang Yang Bing was appointed as Taiwei. On February 11th in the spring of the sixth year, Situ Fan passed away. On March 22nd, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country.
target: In the sixth year, amnesty was granted. Fires and rebellions occurred.

source: Guiyang bandit Li Yan and other bandits plundered the county boundary. The Wuling barbarians rebelled again, and the prefect Chen Feng fought with them, defeating the enemy and forcing them to surrender. Sun Qiang, the governor of Longxi, attacked the Dian Qiang and defeated them. In August, General Feng Kui was dismissed from his post. On October 13th in winter, the imperial school hunted Guangcheng and went to Hangu Pass and Shanglinyuan. In November, Sikong Liu Chong was dismissed from office. Southern pirates and bandits plundered the county borders. In December, Weiwei Zhou Jing was appointed Sikong. On the 18th day of the first lunar month in the seventh year of spring, King Pei Liu Rong passed away. In the third month of Guihai, a meteorite fell in Hu. On April 26th in summer, King Liu Cheng of Liang passed away. On May 19, hail fell in the capital. On July 22nd in autumn, King Zhao Liu Qian passed away. There is a dead dragon on Yewang Mountain. Du Shang, the governor of Jingzhou, attacked Lingling and Guiyang bandits and barbarians, defeated and pacified them. On the fifth day of the tenth lunar month in winter, the emperor visited the south.
target: The emperor hunted and visited various locations. In the seventh year, meteorites fell. Hail and earthquakes occurred. Rebellions were suppressed. The emperor visited the south and returned.

source: Duan Yin, the captain who protected the Qiang, attacked the Dangjian Qiang and defeated them. On the fourth day of December, the king returned to Luoyang. In the spring of the eighth year, in the first month of the first lunar month, I sent the official Zuo Xian, a regular servant of the Central Government, to Ku County to offer sacrifices to Lao Tzu. Liu Kui, King of Bohai, conspired to rebel and was demoted to King of Tartao. On the 30th, there is a solar eclipse. The princes, ministers, and lieutenants were ordered to recommend virtuous and upright people. On February 13, a yellow dragon appeared in the Nangong Jiade Office, and a fire broke out in the Qianqiu Long Live Hall. The servant Zuo claimed that he was guilty and committed suicide. On the 27th, Queen Deng was deposed.
target: In the eighth year, a solar eclipse occurred. Queen Deng was deposed.

source: On the 22nd, all ancestral halls in the county and country were destroyed. The Yellow River water in Jiyin, Dongjun and Jibei is clear. On the eighth day of the fifth lunar month, I left and went to Taishan as the captaincy officer. On the 22nd, Taiwei Yang Bing passed away. On June 22nd, the Goushi earthquake occurred. Hu Lan and Zhu Gai rebelled again in Guiyang, captured the prefectures and counties, and turned to Lingling. Chen Qiu, the prefect of Lingling, resisted them. The emperor sent Zhonglang General Du Shang and the prefect of Changsha to resist Xu and others to fight against Hu Lan and Zhu Gai. They were defeated and killed.
target: Fires and earthquakes occurred. Rebellions were suppressed. The emperor ordered tax increases.

source: Da Sinong is now ordered to stop the collection of land rent and taxes this year, and any unfinished collection of land rent and taxes from the previous year will no longer be collected. Counties that have been damaged by floods, droughts, epidemics, and thieves will not collect rent, while other counties will charge half rent. On the fourth day of March, there was a fire in the capital, and people were surprised and noisy. Four or five out of ten people in Sili and Yuzhou died of starvation, and even the entire household died, so the three prefectures were sent to distribute grain for relief.
target: In the ninth year, a solar eclipse occurred. The emperor ordered tax reductions and relief.

source: In the winter of October, Xianling Qiang bandits plundered Sanfu, and the Xiongnu Zhonglang general Zhang Huan defeated them. In November, Xihe reported sightings of white tigers. On December 23, King Taotao was restored to King Bohai. On the 28th, the emperor passed away in the front hall of Deyang at the age of thirty-six. On the 29th, the queen was honored as the empress dowager, and the empress dowager came to court.
target: Fires and famines occurred. Rebellions by barbarians and bandits continued. The emperor recommended warriors.

source: The houses were damaged and the grain was washed away. The particularly poor people were given two husks of grain each. Landslides occurred in Bajun and Yizhou counties. In autumn and July, Taishan and Langyi captaincy officers were set up for the first time. The southern Xiongnu rebelled against Zuo Tatai Qi, Qiqu Bode and others and harassed Meiji. The captain of Anding's vassal state defeated them and eliminated them. In the first month of spring of the second year, middle officials were allowed to wear mourning clothes for three years.
target: Officials were executed for corruption. The Southern Xiongnu surrendered. Party members were imprisoned.

source: In the winter of December, the bamboos and cypresses beside Luocheng withered. Ren Guangluxun and Runan Xuanbang were appointed Sikong. The Southern Xiongnu and Wuhuan led their troops to surrender in front of Zhang Huan. More than 200 people including Li Ying, the captain of Sili School, were falsely accused of being party members, so they were imprisoned together and were named Wangfu. In the first month of spring of the first year of Yongkang, the first Qiang bandits plundered Sanfu, and Zhang Huan, the general of Zhonglang, defeated them and put them down.
target: In the first year of Yongkang, Qiang rebellions were suppressed. Earthquakes and floods occurred.

source: On the eighth day of the sixth lunar month, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country, and all party shackles were lifted, and the Yuan Dynasty was changed to Yongkang. On the 14th, King Liu Tong of Fuling passed away. In autumn and August, Wei County reported the growth of golden crops and timely rains. A yellow dragon was reported in Berkshire. There are floods in the six states, and the sea water of Bohai Sea overflows. The prefectures and counties were ordered to give two thousand dollars to each drowned person over seven years old; if the whole family was killed, they would all be buried; if there was grain lost in the drift, each person would be given three dendrobium grains. In the winter of October, Xianling Qiang bandits plundered Sanfu, and the Xiongnu Zhonglang general Zhang Huan defeated them. In November, Xihe reported sightings of white tigers. On December 23, King Taotao was restored to King Bohai. On the 28th, the emperor passed away in the front hall of Deyang at the age of thirty-six.
target: The emperor granted amnesty and lifted party shackles. He died at age thirty-six.

source: In the winter of October, Xianling Qiang bandits plundered Sanfu, and the Xiongnu Zhonglang general Zhang Huan defeated them. In November, Xihe reported sightings of white tigers. On December 23, King Taotao was restored to King Bohai. On the 28th, the emperor passed away in the front hall of Deyang at the age of thirty-six. On the 29th, the queen was honored as the empress dowager, and the empress dowager came to court. This year, the two counties of Boling and Hejian were restored, just like Feng and Pei. Historians commented: Previous history books said that Emperor Huan loved music and was good at playing the piano and sheng. Zhuolong Palace Garden is decorated with trees, flowers and plants. Setting up a canopy to offer sacrifices to the Buddha and the Elders may be the so-called "our country is about to perish. Let's listen to the gods!" When Liang Ji was executed, he was vigorous and angry, and the whole world was eager to rest and recuperate. However, he doted on the five eunuchs such as Shanchao, who had a thick seal, so that the five evils were rampant and the poison spread everywhere.
target: Historians commented that Emperor Huan loved music and decorated gardens, but his reliance on eunuchs led to chaos.

source: However, he doted on the five eunuchs such as Shanchao, who had a thick seal, so that the five evils were rampant and the poison spread everywhere. If it weren't for Li Ying and other loyal and virtuous righteous men who spoke out and repeatedly killed the traitors, even if Emperor Huan wanted to have the same result as Emperor Xia's attachment to the princes and King Li of Zhou's escape to pig, he would not have achieved the same result. Historians praised: Emperor Huan came from a distant branch of the Liu family, transcending the order and ascending to the throne of heaven. The political power was indiscriminately transferred to Shan Chao and other five eunuchs, and the punishment and imprisonment were indiscriminately imposed on Li Gu and other three prisons. There are three queens and five or six thousand maids. Although the palace was filled with beauties, there were no heirs in the end, and the emperor's body could not be continued.
target: Despite loyal officials, his reign was marked by corruption and disaster. He had three queens and many concubines but no heirs.

source: Emperor Xiaoling, Liu Hong, was the great-great-grandson of Emperor Suzong. His great-grandfather Liu Kai, the Xiaowang of Hejian, his grandfather Liu Shu, and his father Liu Chang. Both his grandfather and father sealed the title of Marquis of Duting, and Liu Hong attacked the Marquis. Mother, Mrs. Dong. After the death of Emperor Huan, who had no children, the Empress Dowager Dou and her father, Chengmen school captain Dou Wudingce, sent the acting Guanglu doctor Liu Xian to hold the talisman and lead the left and right Yulin troops to Hejian to meet Liu Hong. On the third day of the first spring of the first year of Jianning, Dou Wu, the captain of the city gate school, was appointed as the general. On the 20th, Liu Hong came to Xiamen Pavilion in Luoyang, sent Dou Wu to hold the talisman festival, and used Wang Qingqing's chariot to welcome him into the palace. On the 21st, he became emperor and was twelve years old. Changed to Jianning. Chen Fan, the former Taiwei, was appointed Taifu, and together with Dou Wu and Situ Huguang, he participated in the affairs of the general secretary. Duan Yu, the captain who protects the Qiang, is sent to attack the Xianling Qiang.
target: Emperor Xiaoling, Liu Hong, was the great-great-grandson of Emperor Suzong. His great-grandfather Liu Kai was the Xiaowang of Hejian, his grandfather Liu Shu and father Liu Chang were both Marquises of Duting, a title Liu Hong inherited. His mother was Mrs. Dong. After Emperor Huan died without children, Empress Dowager Dou and her father Dou Wu sent officials to escort Liu Hong to Luoyang. He became emperor at age twelve in the first year of Jianning (168 CE), with Chen Fan as Taifu and Dou Wu and Hu Guang assisting in governance. The early years saw military campaigns against the Xianling Qiang, natural disasters including earthquakes and floods, and political purges.

source: The ministers and ministers below were ordered to write secretly to make criticisms and suggestions on the state affairs, to report and expose, and to recommend one person to the governor of the county and the country. The former governor, Erqianshi Qinggao, who had left a legacy and was supported by the masses, all came to the bus door. Liu Ju, the Taizhong doctor, was appointed Taiwei. In June, it rains a lot in the capital. In the autumn of July, General Duan Yin of Po Qiang defeated the Xianling Qiang again in Jingyang. In August, Sikong Wang Chang was dismissed, and Zongzheng and Liu Chong were appointed as Sikong. On the seventh day of the ninth lunar month, the official Cao Jie falsely claimed that the emperor had issued an order to kill Tai Fu Chen Fan, General Dou Wu, Shangshu Ling Yin Xun, Shi Zhong Liu Yu, and Tunqi Colonel Feng Shu. Their families were all killed. The Empress Dowager moved to Nangong.
target: In 169 CE, eunuch Cao Jie falsely claimed an imperial order to kill Chen Fan, Dou Wu, and others, with their families executed. The Empress Dowager was moved to Nangong.

source: On October 19th in winter, Hou Lan, the minister of the Central Committee, ordered the stewards to participate in the performance of the former Sikong Yufang, the imperial servant Du Mi, the Changle Shaofu Li Ying, the Sili school captain Zhu Yu, the Yingchuan prefect Ba Su, the Pei prime minister Xun Yu, and the Hanoi prefect Wei. Lang and Zhai Chao, the prefect of Shanyang, were all members of the gang who led each other. They were arrested and imprisoned, and more than a hundred people died. Their wives were sent to remote areas. Anyone with incidental affiliations and relatives within five servers were imprisoned. The emperor ordered the prefectures and counties to report and expose party members on a large scale, so all the heroes of the world and those who practiced Confucianism and righteousness were entangled into party members. On the 30th, there was a solar eclipse.
target: Party member persecutions intensified, with over a hundred people imprisoned and their families exiled. Solar eclipses, epidemics, and barbarian rebellions occurred frequently.

source: In July of autumn, Sikong Laiyan was dismissed from his post. Guichou made the noble Song family the queen. Situ Qiaoxuan was dismissed. Taichang Zongji was appointed Sikong, and Xu Xu, the former Sikong, was appointed Situ. In winter, Xianbei bandits plundered Bingzhou. On the eighth day of the third spring of the first year of Xiping, Taifu Hu Guang passed away. On May 16th in the summer, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country and changed to Yuan Xiping. Hou Lan, the servant of Changle, was guilty and committed suicide. In June, it rains a lot in the capital. On the tenth day of the lunar month, Empress Dowager Dou passed away. On the second day of July in autumn, Queen Huansi was buried. The eunuch ordered Duan Yu, the captain of the Sili school, to arrest more than a thousand people from the Imperial Academy.
target: In 172 CE, the reign name changed to Xiping. Empress Dowager Dou died, and eunuch Hou Lan committed suicide after being found guilty.

source: On the fourteenth day of the tenth month in winter, it was ordered that all prisoners in custody who had not been sentenced should be punished by imprisonment. In November, Zang Min, the governor of Yangzhou, led Chen Wei, the prefect of Danyang, to defeat Xu Sheng in Kuaiji and killed him. Liu Bo, the king of Rencheng, passed away. In December, the Xianbei bandits raided the north, and Xia Yu, the governor of the north, pursued and defeated them. Xianbei invaders plundered Bingzhou again. Sikong Tangzhen left and appointed Xu Xun, the young master of Yongle, as Sikong. In the spring and March of the fourth year, he ordered the Confucians to correct the text of the Five Classics, carve it into a stone tablet and set it up outside the gate of Taixue. Liu Tuo, the son of Liu Jian, the king of Hejian, was granted the title of King of Rencheng. In the summer of April, there were floods in seven places in the county.
target: The Xianbei raided Bingzhou. In 175 CE, the Five Classics were carved on stone tablets outside the Taixue. Floods, locust plagues, and Xianbei raids continued.

source: Xianbei bandits raided western Liaoning. Wang Min, the servant of Yong'an Palace, was imprisoned and died. In the first month of spring in the first year of Guanghe, Hepu and Jiaochang stopped the Wuhu barbarian rebellion, and attracted Jiuzhen and Rinan people to attack the counties. Taiwei Meng (Youyu) was dismissed. On the first day of February, there is a solar eclipse. On the third day of junior high school, he appointed Guang Luxun, Chen Guo and Yuan Pang as Situ. On the ninth day of the lunar month, an earthquake occurred. Start setting up Hongdumen students. On Xinchou Day in March, a general amnesty was granted to the whole country, and the name was changed to Guanghe.
target: In 178 CE, the reign changed to Guanghe, and the Hongdumen school was established. The West Residence began selling official positions, with prices varying by rank. Earthquakes, solar eclipses, and the deposal of Empress Song occurred.

source: On June 19, there was hail. In autumn and July, Henan reported that a phoenix appeared in the new city, followed by a flock of birds; the new city order and the three elders and Litian cloth were rewarded in varying amounts. On the first day of September, there is a solar eclipse. Taiwei Liu Kuan was dismissed from his post, and Weiwei Xu Youyu was appointed as Taiwei. On the second day of the leap September, a fire broke out in the Yongxiang Office in East Yeting, Beigong. Situ Yangci left. In the tenth month of winter, Taichang and Chen Dan were appointed as Situ. Xianbei bandits plundered You and merged two states. This year, the emperor built a series of shops in the inner palace where the concubines lived, allowing many colorful girls to do business. They stole from each other, fought and fought. The emperor wore the clothes of a businessman and held banquets, drinking and having fun. He also played with dogs in the West Garden and made the dogs wear the crowns and ribbons used by civil servants. He also harnessed the chariot to four donkeys, and the emperor personally drove and pulled the bridles. They galloped around, and the capitals followed suit.
target: In 179 CE, party members were pardoned. In 180 CE, Empress He was established. The emperor built shops in the inner palace where concubines traded, and he dressed as a merchant, playing with dogs and driving donkey carts.

source: In summer, severe drought occurs. In autumn, the Jincheng River overflows. The Wuyuan mountain bank collapsed. A nursery and confinement office was set up, with eunuchs as orders. In winter, the ice in Donghai, Donglai and Langfu wells is more than a foot thick. This year is a year of great harvest. In the spring and February of the first year of Zhongping, Zhang Jiao from Julu called himself "Huang Tian". Thirty-six commanders under his command, all wearing yellow scarves, rebelled on the same day. The people of Anping and Ganling each took their kings Liu Xu and Liu Zhong hostage and rose up to respond. On the third day of March, he appointed Henan Yin Hejin as the general and led his troops to garrison in the capital pavilion. Set up the eight passes of Hangu, Guangcheng, Yique, Dugu, Longyuan, Xuanmen, Xiaopingjin and Mengjin. On the seventh day of the lunar month, all party members in the world were pardoned, and all those who had been exiled were recalled to their hometowns. Only Zhang Jiao was not pardoned. The ministers were ordered to present their horses, bows and crossbows, and the descendants of the generals, officials and people who were shrewd in war strategies were recommended to come to the carriage door. Send Bei Zhonglang's general Lu Zhi to attack Zhang Jiao, Zuo Zhonglang's general Huangfu Song, and You Zhonglang's general Zhu Jun to attack the Yingchuan Yellow Turbans. Gengzi, Nanyang Yellow Turban Zhang Mancheng attacked and killed the governor Chu Gong.
target: In 184 CE, Zhang Jiao led the Yellow Turban Rebellion, with followers wearing yellow scarves. The emperor appointed He Jin as general, established eight passes, and pardoned party members except Zhang Jiao. Generals Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, and Zhu Jun suppressed the rebellion, killing Zhang Jiao and his brothers.

source: Strange grass grows in the county, taking the form of dragons, snakes, birds and beasts. In the first month of the spring of the second year, the epidemic spread. Langya King Liu Ju passed away. On the tenth day of February, there was a big fire in Nangong. It took half a month to put out the fire. On the 24th, the outer house of Guangyang Gate collapsed on its own. In addition to regular taxes, taxes were levied based on the number of acres of land. Ten coins per mu were used to build palaces. Black Mountain bandit Zhang Niujiao and more than a dozen other people got up together, harassed everywhere and looted property. Situ Yuan Wei was dismissed. In March, Tingwei Cui Lie was appointed Situ. Beigong Boyu and other bandits plundered Sanfu and sent General Huangfu Song of the Left Chariot to attack them, but failed to win.
target: In 185 CE, Nangong caught fire, and taxes were levied per mu for palace construction. Black Mountain bandits and Xianbei raids continued.

source: June 16, strong wind. Taiwei Fan Ling leaves. The Yellow Turban Ma Prime Minister of Yizhou attacked and killed hope Jianjian, the governor, claiming to be the emperor. He also plundered Bajun and killed the county governor Zhao Bu. Jia Long, the governor of Yizhou, attacked Ma Prime Minister and killed him. Floods occurred in seven places in the county. In the autumn of July, Ma Rishidan, the captain of Shesheng School, was appointed as Taiwei. In August, eight captains were set up in Xiyuan: the upper army, the middle army, the lower army, the dian army, the left army, the right army, the assistant army left, and the assistant army right. Situ Xu resigned and appointed Sikong Dinggong as Situ. Ren Guang Luxun Nanyang Liu Hong was appointed Sikong. He appointed Weiwei Dong Chong as General of Hussars. In September, Nan Shanyu rebelled and raided Hedong with Baibo bandits. He sent Zhonglang General Meng Yi to lead the cavalry captain Gongsun Zan to attack the Yuyang bandit Zhang Chun and others. In October of winter, the Yellow Turbans rose again in Qingzhou and Xuzhou and raided counties. On the 16th, the emperor proclaimed himself "Supreme General" and reviewed the army in Pingtang. In November, the Liangzhou bandit kingdom surrounded Chencang, and the right general Huangfu Song went to help. He sent military captain Bao Hong to attack the Yellow Turbans in Gebei. The Banchen barbarians in Bajun rebelled, and Sima Zhao Jin of the Shanxi Army was sent to attack them and quell the rebellion. Gongsun Zan fought with Zhang Chun at Shimen, and Zhang Chun was defeated. This year, the governor was changed and a new pastor was established. In the spring and February of the sixth year, the left general Huangfu Song defeated the kingdom in Chencang.
target: In 186 CE, Zhao Ci rebelled and was killed. In 187 CE, Zhang Chun and Zhang Ju rebelled in Yuyang, claiming emperorship. In 188 CE, the emperor proclaimed himself "Supreme General" and reviewed the army. Eight captains were established in Xiyuan. The Liangzhou bandit kingdom surrounded Chencang.

source: On the 16th, the emperor proclaimed himself "Supreme General" and reviewed the army in Pingtang. In November, the Liangzhou bandit kingdom surrounded Chencang, and the right general Huangfu Song went to help. He sent military captain Bao Hong to attack the Yellow Turbans in Gebei. The Banchen barbarians in Bajun rebelled, and Sima Zhao Jin of the Shanxi Army was sent to attack them and quell the rebellion. Gongsun Zan fought with Zhang Chun at Shimen, and Zhang Chun was defeated. This year, the governor was changed and a new pastor was established. In the spring and February of the sixth year, the left general Huangfu Song defeated the kingdom in Chencang. In February, Liu Yu, the shepherd of Youzhou, offered a reward for killing the Yuyang bandit Zhang Chun. Bao Hong, the lieutenant of the military academy, died in prison. On the first day of April in summer, there is a solar eclipse. Taiwei Ma Rishidan was dismissed from his post and Liu Yu, the shepherd of Youzhou, was appointed as Taiwei. On the eleventh day, the emperor passed away in the Jiade Hall of Nangong. Year thirty-four. On the 13th, Prince Bian became emperor at the age of seventeen. Respect the queen as the empress dowager, and the empress dowager is in court. He granted amnesty to the world and changed his name to Guangxi. The emperor's younger brother Liu Xie was granted the title of King of Bohai. Later, General Yuan Wei was appointed as Taifu, and he and General He Jin participated in the affairs of the general secretary. Jian Shuo, the captain of the military academy, died in prison. On the sixth day of the fifth lunar month, Dong Chong, the hussar general, died in prison. On the seventh day of June, Empress Xiaoren Dong passed away. On the 17th, Emperor Xiaoling was buried in Wenling. Lots of rain. In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhong, the king of Ganling, passed away. On the 16th, Queen Xiaoren was buried in Shenling Mausoleum in Hejian. Liu Xie, the king of Bohai, was transferred to King Chenliu. Let's go to Situ Ding Palace. On August 25, Zhang Rang, Duan Wanggui and others killed the general He Jin, so Huben Zhonglang sent Yuan Shu to burn the East and West palaces and attack the eunuchs. On the 27th, Zhang Rang, Duan Wanggui and others kidnapped the young emperor and Chenliu King Liu Xie to the Deyang Hall of the North Palace. He Jin's troops fought Wu Kuang and the cavalry general He Miao under the Zhuque Tower. He Miao defeated and beheaded Wu Kuang. On the 28th, Sili Colonel Yuan Shao led the army to arrest the puppet Sili Colonel Fan Ling, Henan Yin Xuxiang and many eunuchs, and killed them all regardless of their junior or senior status. Zhang Rang, Duan Wanggui and others kidnapped the young emperor and Chenliu King Liu Xie to Xiaopingjin. Shangshu Lu Zhi chased Zhang Rang, Duan Wanggui and others, beheading several of them, while the rest threw themselves into the Yellow River and drowned. The emperor and Chenliu Wang Liu Xie walked for several miles in the dark, following the weak fluorescent light. They got into an open carriage without a scarf and curtains, which was used by ordinary people to carry things, and they rode together. On the 28th, the emperor returned to the palace. He granted amnesty to the world and changed Guangxi to Zhaoning. Dong Zhuo, the governor of Bingzhou, killed Jinwu Dingyuan. Liu Hong was dismissed as Sikong, and Dong Zhuo became Sikong. On the first day of September, Dong Zhuo deposed the emperor as King Hongnong.
target: In 189 CE, Huangfu Song defeated the kingdom. The emperor died in Nangong at age thirty-four. Prince Bian became emperor at seventeen, with Empress Dowager He regent. Eunuch Zhang Rang and others killed General He Jin, leading to Yuan Shu burning the palaces and Yuan Shao massacring eunuchs. The young emperor and Prince Xie were kidnapped but later returned. Dong Zhuo deposed the emperor as Prince Hongnong. Heavy rain fell from June to September.

source: Xiaoxian Emperor Liu Xie, the neutron son of Emperor Ling. Why did the queen harm the beautiful mother? In April of the sixth year of Zhongping, the young emperor Liu Bian ascended the throne and was granted the title of King of Bohai. He was also granted the title of King of Chenliu. On the first day of September, Liu Xie became emperor at the age of nine. Moved the Queen Mother to Yong'an Palace. Amnesty to the world. Change Zhaoning to Yonghan. On the third day of the lunar month, Dong Zhuo killed the Empress Dowager He. At the beginning, there were six servants in the palace and six servants in Huangmen. Give the minister a person from the family of the minister of Huangmen, down to Huangmen, as a minister to supplement the offices led by the eunuchs and serve in the palace. On September 12, Taiwei Liu Yu was appointed as Grand Sima. Dong Zhuo appointed himself Taiwei, and added Fu Yue and Huben. On the 13th, Yang Biao, the Taizhong doctor, was appointed Sikong. On the 21st, Huang Wan, the shepherd of Yuzhou, was appointed as Situ. Envoys were sent to pay homage to the late Taifu Chen Fan and General Dou Wu. On the third day of October in winter, Queen Lingsi was buried. Baibo bandits raided the east of the river, and Dong Zhuo sent his general Niu Fu to attack. On the first day of November, Dong Zhuo appointed himself Prime Minister. In December of 1898, Situ Huang Wan was appointed Taiwei, Sikong Yang Biao was appointed Situ, and Guang Luxun Xun Shuang was appointed Sikong. The captain of Fufeng was omitted and the captain of Han'an was set up. The imperial edict abolished the titles of Guangxi, Zhaoning and Yonghan in the third year, and returned them to the sixth year of Zhongping. In the first month of spring in the first year of Chuping, the prefectures and counties in Shandong raised troops to attack Dong Zhuo. On the tenth day of the first lunar month, there is a general amnesty for the whole world. On the third day of February, Dong Zhuo killed Hongnong King Liu Bian. Baibo bandits raided Dongjun. On the fifth day of February, Taiwei Huang Wan and Situ Yang Biao were dismissed from their posts. On the tenth day of the lunar month, Dong Zhuo killed Wu Qiong, the captain of the city gate, and Zhou Mi, the captain of the military governor. He appointed Guang Luxun and Zhao Qian as Taiwei, and appointed his servant Wang Yun as Situ. On February 17, the capital was moved to Chang'an. Dong Zhuo drove all the people in the capital to move westward and entered the Pass, while he stayed in Biguiyuan. On February 22nd, a white rainbow penetrated the sun. On the fifth day of March, the emperor entered Chang'an and went to Weiyang Palace. On the ninth day of the lunar month, Dong Zhuo burned palaces, temples and people's homes in Luoyang. On March 18, Dong Zhuo killed the Grand Tutor Yuan Wei and the Imperial Servant Yuan Ji, and wiped out their relatives. In May of summer, Sikong Xunshuang passed away. In Xinchou in June, Dr. Guanglu was appointed Sikong Fu. Dahonglu Han Rong, Shaofu Yinxiu, Zhijinwu Hu Muban, General Wu Xiu, the great craftsman, and Yueqi captain Wang Gui'an gathered in Guandong. Later general Yuan Shu and Hanoi prefect Wang Kuang captured and killed them respectively. Only Han Rong was spared. Dong Zhuo destroyed five baht coins and exchanged them for small coins.
target: Xiaoxian Emperor Liu Xie, the son of Emperor Ling, ascended the throne at age nine in September 189, moving the Empress Dowager to Yong'an Palace and granting amnesty. Dong Zhuo soon killed the Empress Dowager and appointed himself Prime Minister. In 190, prefectures raised troops against Dong Zhuo, who killed the former emperor Liu Bian and moved the capital to Chang'an, burning Luoyang's palaces. Dong Zhuo destroyed five-baht coins for small coins. In 191, Dong Zhuo became Grand Master, and Sun Jian defeated his general. Dong Zhuo excavated imperial tombs. In 192, Dong Zhuo was executed, and his clan was wiped out. His generals Li Jue and Guo Si rebelled, capturing Chang'an and killing over 10,000 officials and civilians. Li Jue killed Wang Yun and others. In 193, Yuan Shu killed the Yangzhou governor and occupied Huainan.

source: In March, Han Sui and Ma Teng fought with Guo Si and Fan Chou at Changpingguan. Han Sui and Ma Teng failed. Liu Fan, the general of Zuo Zhonglang, and Zhongshao, the former governor of Yizhou, were killed in the battle. On the first day of June in summer, the four counties of Liangzhou and Hexi were divided into Yingzhou. On the second day of the lunar month, there was an earthquake; on the third day of the lunar month, there was another earthquake. On the 30th, there is a solar eclipse. The emperor did not enter the main hall, did not use weapons, and ignored the government for five days. Great locust plague. On the seventh day of July in autumn, Captain Zhu Jun was dismissed from his post. On the 13th, Taichang Yang Biao was appointed as Taiwei, acting as Shangshu. There is a severe drought in Sanfu area from April to July.
target: In 194, a severe drought and locust plague caused famine, with grain prices soaring and cannibalism. The emperor personally inspected relief efforts.

source: On the first day of July in autumn, Emperor Xian arrived in Luoyang and went to his hometown to serve Zhao Zhong at his residence. On the fourteenth day, sacrifices were made to heaven in the suburbs and a general amnesty was granted to the whole world. On the 16th, I visited the Ancestral Temple. On the eighth day of August, Emperor Xian went to the Yang'an Hall of Nangong. On the tenth day of the lunar month, Zhang Yang, the general of Anguo, was appointed as the Grand Sima, Han Xian as the Grand General, and Yang Feng as the Chariot and Cavalry General. At this time, the palace was burned down, and the officials cut off the thorns and lived among the walls. The prefectures and counties each had strong soldiers, but food supplies were not transported. Many officials were hungry, and the officials below the minister went out to eat their own crops to satisfy their hunger. Some starved to death between the walls, and some were killed by the soldiers. On August 18, Cao Cao, the general of Zhendong, took the post of Sili Xiaowei and Shangshu on his own initiative. Cao Cao killed his servants Zhong Taichong, Shangshu Feng Shuo and others. Dong Cheng, the general of the Wei Dynasty, was appointed as the general of the auxiliary state. Thirteen people including Fu Wan were appointed as lieutenants, and Ju Zi was given as the prefect of Hongnong. On the 27th, the capital was moved to Xuchang, Jisi, and Emperor Xian arrived at Cao Cao's military camp. In September, Taiwei Yang Biao and Sikong Zhangxi left. On November 25th in winter, Cao Cao appointed himself Sikong and acting general of chariots and cavalry, and all officials obeyed him. In the spring of the second year, Yuan Shu claimed to be the emperor. In March, Yuan Shao appointed himself general. In the summer of May, there was a locust plague. In autumn and September, the Han River overflows. There was a famine this year, and people in the Jianghuai River were cannibalistic. Yuan Shu killed Chen Wang Liu Chong. Sun Ce sent envoys to pay tribute. In the summer and April of the third year, Pei Mao, the envoy, was sent to lead Duan Xuan, the general of Zhonglang, to attack Li Chu and annihilate Li Chu's father, mother and wife. Lu Bu rebelled. In November of winter, thieves killed the great Sima Zhang Yang. On December 24, Cao Cao attacked Lu Bu in Xuzhou and killed him. In the spring and March of the fourth year, Yuan Shao attacked Gongsun Zan in Yijing and captured him. General Dong Cheng of Wei was appointed general of chariots and cavalry. In June of summer, Yuan Shu died. This year, the ministers began to set up left and right servants. Li E, a woman from Wuling, died for fourteen days and was resurrected. In the first month of the spring of the fifth year, the cavalry general Dong Cheng, the partial general Wang Fu, and the Yue cavalry captain Zhong Ji received a secret edict from Emperor Xian to kill Cao Cao, and the incident was leaked. On the ninth day of the lunar month, Cao Cao killed Dong Cheng and others, destroying his father, mother, and wife clans. In the seventh month of autumn, Prince Liu Feng was made King of Nanyang. On the 12th, Nanyang King Liu Feng passed away. On the first day of September, there is a solar eclipse. Emperor Xian ordered the Three Dukes to recommend two people who were of the highest filial piety, and the Jiuqing, Xiaowei, and Prime Minister each recommended one person. They are all secretly submitting letters to state their interests in government affairs, and there should be no taboos. Cao Cao and Yuan Shao fought in Guandu, and Yuan Shao was defeated and fled.
target: In 195, Li Jue killed Fan Chou and fought Guo Si, forcing the emperor to flee. The emperor began his journey back to Luoyang, facing attacks from Li Jue and Guo Si, with many officials killed. In 196, the emperor arrived in Luoyang, but the palace was burned, and officials suffered from hunger. Cao Cao took control, moving the capital to Xuchang and appointing himself Sikong. In 197, Yuan Shu claimed emperorship. In 198, Cao Cao killed Lü Bu. In 199, Yuan Shao captured Gongsun Zan. In 200, Dong Cheng's plot to kill Cao Cao failed, and Cao Cao killed him. Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu. In 207, Cao Cao defeated the Wuhuan. In 208, Cao Cao became Prime Minister, defeated Liu Biao's son, but was defeated by Sun Quan at Red Cliffs. In 213, Cao Cao became Duke of Wei. In 214, Cao Cao killed Empress Fu. In 215, Cao Cao captured Hanzhong. In 216, Cao Cao became King of Wei. In 220, Cao Cao died, and his son Cao Pi succeeded. Emperor Xian abdicated, becoming Duke of Shanyang. Liu Bei proclaimed himself emperor of Shu, and Sun Quan became king of Wu, dividing the realm into three. Emperor Xian died in 234 at age 54, buried with Han rites.

source: His son Cao Pi succeeded to the throne. On the first day of February, there was a solar eclipse. In March, it was changed to Yankang. On October 13th in winter, Emperor Xian abdicated and King Cao Pi of Wei became emperor. Emperor Xian was granted the title Duke of Shanyang, with a fiefdom of 10,000 households, and his status was higher than that of the princes and kings. He refused to submit to Wei Emperor Cao Pi's duties, and did not kneel down when receiving Wei Emperor's orders. He worshiped heaven and earth in the suburbs with the emperor's chariots and costumes. The Han Dynasty's ancestral temples, ancestral tombs, and sacrifices in the twelfth lunar month were all according to the Han Dynasty system. The capital was built in Zhuolu City, Shanyang.
target: Historians note that Han's decline began long before his reign, and he was a victim of his era.

source: Filial piety to the emperor Mingbao, son of Emperor An. His mother, Mrs. Li, was killed by Queen Yan. In the first year of Yongning, he was established as the crown prince. In the third year of Yanguang, Emperor An's wet nurse Wang Sheng, Dachangqiu Jiang Jing, and Zhongchang Shi Fan Feng framed the prince's wet nurse Wang Nan and the kitchen supervisor Bing Ji. Wang Nan and Bing Ji were killed, and Prince Liu Bao sighed several times. Wang Sheng and others were afraid of the consequences, so they worked with Fan Feng and Jiang Jing to frame Prince Liu Bao, who was deposed as King of Jiyin. In March of the fourth year of Yanguang, Emperor An passed away. Liu Yi, the Marquis of Beixiang, became the emperor. Because Liu Bao, the king of Jiyin, was deposed, he was not allowed to attend the funeral in person at Emperor An's mourning hall. He wailed and refused to eat, and all officials inside and outside mourned for it. When Emperor Liu Yi passed away, the Empress Dowager Yan's brother, the Chariot and Cavalry General Yan Xian and Jiang Jing, together with Liu An and Chen Da, reported to the Empress Dowager that they would not announce the mourning secretly, but planned to conscript another prince from various kingdoms as emperor. Liu Bao closed the palace gates tightly and stationed troops to defend himself. On the fourth day of November, an earthquake occurred in sixteen places in the capital and prefectures. That night, nineteen people including Sun Cheng from the Zhonghuang Gate worked together to kill Jiang Jing, Liu An, Chen Da and others, and welcomed Liu Bao, the King of Jiyin, under the west bell of Deyang Hall, and he ascended the throne at the age of eleven. The ministers and ministers followed Chengyu to Nangong, climbed onto the cloud platform, and summoned all the officials. The minister ordered Liu Guang and others to report: Emperor Xiaoan, a man of sage and virtue, abandoned the world prematurely. The emperor is the orthodox successor and should inherit the ancestral temple and the state. However, due to the interference of treacherous ministers, the emperor became a vassal king from a prince. All civil and military officials in the world were disappointed. Fortunately, destiny follows a normal pattern. Although the Marquis of Beixiang was established as emperor, he would not live forever, and the Han family's virtues and fortunes were outstanding. Close ministers offer advice and suggestions, support the left and right wings, and work together internally and externally, in line with the will of the gods of heaven and earth. The emperor succeeded to the throne, followed tradition, became the master of the suburban temple, inherited the heroes and martyrs of his ancestors, acted out of heaven's will, and fulfilled the people's wishes below. However, he came to the throne in a hurry and there are many missing regulations. Please allow us to organize the rituals according to the rules and perform them separately. The emperor ordered: Yes! So he summoned all officials and officials, and sent Huben Lang and Yu Linshi to guard the gates of the South and North Palaces. When the Yan Xian brothers heard that King Ji Yin was the emperor, they led troops into the North Palace. Shangshu Guo Zhen fought with them and killed Yan Xian's younger brother Wei Wei Yan Jing. On the fifth day of the lunar month, envoys were sent to the palace to seize the seal. The emperor went to the Jiade Palace and sent his censor Shi Chijie to arrest Yan Xian and his younger brothers Chengmen School Captain Yan Yao and Zhijinwu Yan Yan and put them in prison for execution. On the sixth day of the lunar month, the palace gate was opened and the heavy troops guarding the gate were removed. On the ninth day of the lunar month, an order was issued to the commander-in-chief: Only close relatives of Yan Xian and Jiang Jing should be punished, and the rest must be forgiven and exempted without further investigation.
target: In the first year of Yongning, Liu Bao, son of Emperor An, was made crown prince. His mother, Mrs. Li, had been killed by Queen Yan. In the third year of Yanguang, the prince's wet nurse Wang Nan and kitchen supervisor Bing Ji were killed after being framed by Wang Sheng, Jiang Jing, and Fan Feng. Liu Bao sighed repeatedly, leading Wang Sheng and others to fear consequences and frame him, resulting in his deposition as King of Jiyin. When Emperor An died in March of the fourth year of Yanguang, Liu Yi became emperor. Liu Bao was barred from attending the funeral, causing him to wail and refuse food, moving officials inside and outside. After Liu Yi's death, Empress Dowager Yan's brother Yan Xian and Jiang Jing plotted to secretly not announce the mourning and conscript another prince. Liu Bao closed the palace gates and defended himself. On the fourth day of November, an earthquake struck sixteen places. That night, Sun Cheng and others killed Jiang Jing, Liu An, and Chen Da, welcoming Liu Bao to ascend the throne at age eleven. The ministers reported that due to treacherous ministers, the emperor had become a vassal king, but destiny favored the Han family. The emperor succeeded to the throne according to heaven's will and the people's wishes. He ordered the organization of rituals. Yan Xian's brothers led troops into the North Palace but were fought by Guo Zhen, who killed Yan Jing. On the fifth day, envoys seized the seal, and the emperor arrested and executed Yan Xian and his brothers. On the sixth day, the palace gates were opened. On the ninth day, an order was issued that only close relatives of Yan Xian and Jiang Jing would be punished.

source: Get approval. A major epidemic occurred in the capital. Under the order of the minister, those who followed Chengyu to Nangong were given increased official ranks and were given various rewards of cloth. On the second day of the first spring of the first year of Yongjian's reign, the edict stated: "The late emperor was a sage and virtuous man, but he did not enjoy the throne for a long time and abandoned his great achievements prematurely." The treacherous and evil people take advantage of the opportunity to cause chaos, causing resentment among the common people, disturbing the harmony of heaven and earth, and causing epidemics. I inherited the great cause, but failed to stabilize the country and tide over the difficulties. However, the most important thing in governing a country is to assess and carry forward virtues and benefits, eliminate accumulated resentments and bad habits, and start a new life. Now a general amnesty is being granted to all men, with titles of two for each man, three for fathers, three elders, filial brothers, and Litian, and one for refugees who automatically return to the throne; widows, widows, orphans, singles, terminally ill, poor, and unable to survive are each given five dendrobiums of millet; women who observe integrity are each given three bolts of silk.

target: Sima Fu, courtesy name Shuda, was Emperor Xuan's second brother. He was one of the "Bada" (Eight Talents) along with his brothers, known for their fame. He was open-minded, tolerant, and held no grudges. When Yin Wu of Chenliu, a nationally known figure who had been punished, was visited by Sima Fu, they ate and lived together, earning praise. After Emperor Wu of Wei died, Sima Fu advised the crown prince against excessive mourning, emphasizing his responsibilities to the ancestral temple and feudal states. When ministers gathered weeping without forming a procession, Sima Fu sternly organized them, completed funeral arrangements, and supported the crown prince's ascension as Emperor Wen. During official selections, Sima Fu opposed nepotism, advocating for recruiting talented individuals nationwide.
