source: When Emperor Gaozu started to raise troops, Ren Ao followed Zhidan as a guest and became the censor, and stayed in Fengdan for two years. Zhisu became the king of election, marched eastward to attack Xiang Yu, and appointed Ao as the governor of Shangdang County. Chen Xi rebelled, but Ren Ao held on and was granted the title of Marquis of Guang'a, with a settlement of 1,800 households. After high school, he served as the imperial censor. Removed in three years. Emperor Xiaowen died in the first year of his reign, and Mi was given the title Yihou. The Marquis was passed on to his son, and then to his great-grandson Ren Yue. He was removed from the Marquis State because of the crime of being sour and disrespectful in the wine offered at the Taichang Temple. At the beginning, Ren Ao was dismissed, and Pingyang Marquis Cao Zhuo replaced Ren Ao as the imperial censor. After the death of Empress Gao, she and her ministers jointly annihilated the Lu family. Later, he was dismissed from office for violating the law and appointed Huainan Prime Minister Zhang Cang as the imperial censor.
target: He died of anger after being outmaneuvered. Subsequent prime ministers were competent but unremarkable.

source: Zhang Er, a native of Daliang. When he was young, he was a diner of Wei Gongzi Wuji. Later, he lost his household registration and became anonymous and wandered to the outside world. There was a daughter of a wealthy family in Waihuang who was very beautiful and looked down upon her husband, so she secretly escaped to the home of one of her father's former guests. Her father's guest said: "You must marry a good husband, so marry Zhang Er." So, she followed this advice, severed her relationship with her ex-husband, and married Zhang Er. This woman's family gave Zhang Er a lot of money, which enabled him to make friends with many guests and become the magistrate of Waihuang County. Chen Yu was from Daliang and loved Confucianism. He visited Kuxing in Zhao State several times, where the wealthy Gongcheng family married his daughter to him. Chen Yu was young, so he regarded Zhang Er as his father, and the two formed a life-and-death friendship. When Emperor Gaozu was still a commoner, he had a relationship with Zhang Er. After Qin destroyed Wei, it offered a reward of one thousand gold for the capture of Zhang Er and five hundred gold for the capture of Chen Yu. So the two changed their surnames and came to Chendi together to serve as lowly gatekeepers. One time, a minor official thought Chen Yu had made a mistake and beat him with a whip. Chen Yu was not convinced and wanted to resist, but Zhang Er secretly stepped on Chen Yu's feet to make him endure the beating. When the clerk left, Zhang Er scolded Chen Yu and said, "What did I tell you back then?" Now after receiving a little insult, you want to fight with a petty official? Chen Yu admitted his mistake. Chen She revolted in Qixian County and invaded Chen Di. Zhang Er and Chen Yu reported their names and asked to see Chen She. Chen She and his cronies Hu Su had heard many times that Zhang Er and Chen Yu were capable, and were very happy to see them. The heroes of Chen County advised Chen She: General, you are wearing strong armor and holding a sharp sword. You led the army to attack the violent Qin Dynasty and rebuilt the country of Chu. Your merits are immeasurable and you should be made the king of Chu. Chen She asked Zhang and Chen what they thought of this, and they replied: General, you are brave and brave, putting your own life and death aside to eliminate harm for the people of the world. Now he has just arrived in Chen and proclaimed himself king, revealing his selfishness in front of the world. I hope that the general will not become the king, and quickly lead the troops to the west, and send people to establish descendants of the six countries and establish party members for himself.
target: Zhang Er, a native of Daliang, was once a retainer of Wei nobleman Wuji. After losing his household registration, he wandered to Waihuang, where a wealthy family's daughter left her husband on the advice of her father's guest and married Zhang Er with a substantial dowry. This allowed him to befriend many guests and become the magistrate of Waihuang County. Chen Yu, also from Daliang, was a Confucian scholar who married into a wealthy family in Zhao. He regarded Zhang Er as a father figure, and they formed a life-and-death friendship. When Emperor Gaozu was a commoner, he had ties with Zhang Er. After Qin destroyed Wei, a reward was offered for Zhang Er and Chen Yu, so they changed their names and became gatekeepers in Chendi. When a minor official whipped Chen Yu for a mistake, Zhang Er stopped him from retaliating, advising patience. When Chen She revolted, Zhang Er and Chen Yu joined him. They advised Chen She not to declare himself king prematurely but to establish descendants of the six states to win support. Chen She ignored them and made himself king. Later, they persuaded Chen She to let them lead troops to capture Zhao territory.

source: In addition, Zhang Er and Chen Yu complained that King Chen did not appoint them as generals, but made them captains, so they proposed to the military officials: King Chen may not necessarily appoint the descendants of the Six Kingdoms as kings. Now that the general has captured dozens of cities across the land and is stationed alone in Hebei, he may not be able to rule unless he becomes king. Moreover, the King of Chen believed the slander and ordered you to return to Chen. I am afraid you will not be able to escape disaster. I hope the general will not miss this opportunity. Wu Chen accepted this suggestion and declared himself King of Zhao. Chen Yu was appointed as the general and Zhang Er as the prime minister. Wu Chen sent someone to report to King Chen. King Chen was furious and wanted to kill Wu Chen and his family, and then send troops to attack. King Chen's prime minister, Lord Fang, remonstrated and said: "Qin has not yet been eliminated, and now we are killing the families of military officials and others. This is tantamount to establishing another enemy like Qin." It is better to take advantage of the situation and send people to congratulate them, so that the military officials can immediately lead the army to the west to attack Qin. King Chen followed his strategy and placed only the military officials and other family members under house arrest in the palace. He named Zhang Er's son Zhang Ao the king of Chengdu, sent envoys to congratulate Zhao, and urged the Zhao army to march westward and enter the pass.
target: They recruited soldiers and won over local heroes, capturing many cities. Wu Chen declared himself King of Zhao, with Chen Yu as general and Zhang Er as prime minister. Chen She initially opposed but later confirmed Wu Chen's title under advice.

source: Asked again: Do you know what their purpose is? Yan Jiang replied: I want to save their king Tang. Zhao's servant smiled and said, "You don't know what they really think." At that time, Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu captured dozens of cities in the country without using any troops. All three of them wanted to ascend the throne of the king. How can the status of a monarch and a minister be compared? Considering that the general situation had just stabilized, he first established the military minister as king based on his age to stabilize the people of Zhao. Now that the country is stable, the two of them also want to divide the country and become kings on their own, but the opportunity is not yet ripe. Now you imprison King Tread. On the surface, the two of them want to save King Tread, but in fact they hope that Yan will kill King Zhao so that they can divide the land of Zhao and become king. With the strength of Zhao State, it can easily defeat Yan State, let alone two wise kings united. If you attack the State of Yan on the charge of killing King Tiao, the State of Yan will soon be destroyed. General Yan thought his words were reasonable, so he returned King Zhao. The servant himself drove back with King Zhao. After Li Liang captured Changshan, he came back and reported to King T'ao, who ordered Li Liang to capture Taiyuan. Li Liang led his troops to Shiyi, but it was difficult to advance because Qin was heavily guarded at Jingxing. The leader of the Qin army lied that Qin II sent an envoy to Li Liang to send an unsealed letter. The letter said: Li Liang once followed me, and I use him very much. If Li Liang can rebel against Zhao and submit to Qin, he will be forgiven of Li Liang's sins and given a high official and generous salary. Li Liang was also very suspicious when he saw the letter. Don't believe it. So he returned to Handan, preparing to ask for military support. On the way, I met Wang Tong's sister, followed by more than a hundred people. Li Liang saw it from a distance and thought it was King Zhao, so he knelt down by the road. King Zhao's sister was drunk and did not know that he was a general, so she sent a knight to thank Li Liang. Li Liang has always had a high status. After he got up, he felt that he had lost face in front of his subordinates. One of the followers said: "Everyone in the world is against Qin. Whoever has the ability will be the first to become king." Besides, the status of King Tang has always been lower than that of the general. Now that their girl dares not to get out of the car and salute the general when she sees him, please let us chase her and kill her! Because Li Liang received Qin's letter, he had the idea of ​​​​anti-Zhao but was hesitant. After hearing this, he was furious and immediately sent people to hunt down King Zhao's sister, and led the army to attack Handan. Handan was completely unprepared, and Li Liangjing killed the military minister. Many people in Tongguo informed Zhang Er and Chen Yu, so they were able to escape. They packed up the remaining Tong army and gathered tens of thousands of troops. A guest advised Zhang Er and Chen Yu: "You two are from a foreign land. It is difficult to get the people of Zhao to join you." It would be better to establish the descendants of King Zhao of the Six Kingdoms as kings and complete the great cause of restoration in the name of assisting him. So he found Zhao's descendant Dan Xie, made him the king of Dan, and lived in Xindu. Li Liang raised his troops to attack Chen Yu, but was defeated by Chen Yu.
target: Wu Chen was captured by Yan forces, but a clever servant convinced the Yan general that Zhang Er and Chen Yu secretly wanted Wu Chen dead to divide Zhao, so Yan released him. Li Liang, a Zhao general, rebelled after feeling insulted by Wu Chen's sister, killed Wu Chen, and attacked Handan. Zhang Er and Chen Yu escaped, gathered troops, and established Zhao Xie, a descendant of Zhao royalty, as king. Li Liang was defeated by Chen Yu and fled to Qin general Zhang Han, who razed Handan.

source: Li Liang raised his troops to attack Chen Yu, but was defeated by Chen Yu. Li Liang fled to Qin general Zhang Han. Zhang Han led his army to Handan, moved the people in Nabu to Hanoi, and razed the city of Handan to the ground. Zhang Er and Wang Danxie fled to Julu City together and were surrounded by Wang Li. Chen Yu gathered Changshan's army in the north, added tens of thousands of people, and stationed himself north of Julu. Zhang Han was stationed at Jiyuan, south of Julu, and built a channel on the river to transport military supplies for Wang Li. Wang Li's army had sufficient food and immediately attacked Julu. However, Julu City ran out of food. Zhang Er repeatedly sent people to ask Chen Yu to send troops to relieve the siege. Chen Yu believed that his troops were too small to compete with the Qin soldiers and did not dare to send troops. After being besieged for several months, Zhang Er was furious and resentful of Chen Yu. He sent Zhang Dao and Chen Shi to rebuke Chen Yu and said: "You and I were life-and-death friends at first, but now the lives of King Zhao and I are at stake. You have tens of thousands of troops, but you refuse to save us. Why don't you rush to the Qin army and die with us?" Maybe there is still a glimmer of hope for survival. Chen Yu said: I don’t want to die together, but I want to avenge King Zhao and Jun Zhang. If everyone goes to die now, it is equivalent to sending meat into the tiger's mouth. What good will it do? Zhang Yan and Chen Shi said: The situation is urgent now. We can only keep our word through life and death. How can we care about what will happen in the future? Chen Yu said: It doesn't matter if I die, but what's the benefit? So they sent 5,000 men, led by Zhang Dao and Chen Shi, to attack the Qin army, but the entire army was destroyed. During the rest of the time, Yan, Qi, and Chu heard that King Zhao was in danger and all came to help him. Zhang Ao also regained the land of Dai in the north, recruited more than 10,000 people, and set up camp near Chen Yu's army. Xiang Yu's army blocked Zhang Han's passage many times, causing Wang Li's army to lack food and grass. Xiang Yu's entire army crossed the river and defeated Zhang Han's army. Only then did the armies of various princes dare to attack the Qin army and captured Wang Li. Zhang Er and Tan Xie were rescued from Julu. As soon as Zhang Er met Chen Yu, he blamed Chen Yu and asked where Zhang Yan and Chen Shi were. Chen Yu said: Zhang Yan and Chen Shi asked me to fight to the death with the Qin army. I asked them to lead five thousand people to attack the Qin army to try, but the entire army was destroyed. Zhang Er didn't believe it, thinking that Chen Yu had killed the two men, and questioned Chen Yu many times. Chen Yu said angrily: I didn't expect your resentment towards me to be so deep! Do you think I can't bear to part with this title of general? So he took off the seal and asked to return it to Zhang Er, but Zhang Er refused to accept it.
target: Zhang Er and Zhao Xie were besieged in Julu by Qin forces. Chen Yu, stationed nearby, refused to send troops, believing his forces too weak. Zhang Er sent envoys to rebuke him, but Chen Yu only sent 5,000 men, who were annihilated. After Xiang Yu defeated the Qin army, Zhang Er blamed Chen Yu for the deaths of the envoys, leading to a bitter rift. Chen Yu offered his seal to Zhang Er, who accepted it after persuasion, taking command of Chen Yu's army. Chen Yu left in anger, and the two became enemies.

source: When Zhang Er returned to his kingdom, Chen Yu became even more angry and said: "Zhang Er and I have equal merits. Now he has been made a king, and I have been made a marquis." When Tian Rong of the Qi State betrayed the Chu State, Chen Yu sent an envoy Xia Shuo to persuade Tian Rong: Xiang Yu is the ruler of the world, but it is unfair. He gave good lands to other kings and generals, but moved King Tread to a bad place. King Tread still lives in Dai County! I hope you can lend me some troops and would like to use Nanpi as a vassal screen. Tian Rongzheng wanted to establish party members, so he sent troops to Chen Yu. Chen Yu recruited soldiers from three counties to attack Zhang Er, the king of Changshan. Zhang Er was defeated and fled, saying: The King of Han and I have friendship, but Xiang Yu's power is strong, and I am entrusted by King Xiang, so I plan to go to Chu. Duke Gan said: When the king of Han entered the pass, the five stars in the sky gathered in the east well. Shujing is a divided territory of Qin, and whoever arrives first will become hegemonic. Although Chu is now powerful, the world still belongs to Han in the end. So Zhang Er fled to Han Dynasty. The king of Han led his troops to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties and surrounded Zhang Han in Feiqiu. Zhang Er paid homage to the King of Han, who treated him very favorably. Chen Yu defeated Zhang Er, regained all the land, and brought the king back from Dai County, where he was still the king. King Zhao was grateful to Chen Yu and named him acting king. Chen Yu thought that the King of Zhao was weak and the country was in the early stages of peace, so he stayed to assist the King of Zhao, and sent the Prime Minister Guo Xia to garrison Dai. In the second year of the Han Dynasty, King Shujin of Han attacked the state of Chu. He sent someone to inform Zhao, asking him to send troops to attack Chu together. Chen Yu said: I will send troops only if the Han kills Zhang Er. So the king of Han found a man who looked like Zhang Er, killed him, and gave his head to Chen Yu, who then sent troops to aid Mo. As a result, the Han army was defeated by the Chu army west of Pengcheng. Chen Yu heard about Zhang Er's fake death and betrayed Mo. Han sent Zhang Er and Han Xin to capture Zhao's Jingxing, killed Chen Yu at the bank of the Sang River, and pursued him to Xiangguo and killed the king of Zhao, Dan Xie. In the summer of the fourth year, Mo made Zhang Er the king of Tong. In the autumn of the fifth year, Zhang Er died, and the Han Dynasty named him Mi King Jing. His son Zhang Ao inherited the throne and married Princess Lu Yuan, the eldest daughter of Emperor Gaozu, as his queen. In the seventh year of the Han Dynasty, Emperor Gaozu came to Zhao from Pingcheng. King Tong personally served him with food and drinks in the morning and evening, with a very humble attitude and the courtesy of a son-in-law.
target: After Xiang Yu divided the realm, Zhang Er was made King of Changshan, while Chen Yu received only three counties. Chen Yu, resentful, allied with Tian Rong of Qi to attack Zhang Er, who fled to Han. The Han king treated him well. Chen Yu later demanded Zhang Er's death before aiding Han, but the Han king sent a fake head. After Han's defeat, Chen Yu learned the truth and abandoned Han. Han later sent Zhang Er and Han Xin to defeat and kill Chen Yu and Zhao Xie. Zhang Er was made King of Zhao and died in the fifth year of Han. His son Zhang Ao succeeded him and married Princess Lu Yuan.

source: So Gaozu arrested King Zhao and other people who were trying to rebel. A dozen people including Chang Wu rushed to commit suicide by cutting their necks. Only Zhishang cursed angrily: Who told you to do this? Now Yusi has not rebelled, but he has been arrested together. If you are dead, who will prove that King Zhao did not rebel? Together with King Zhao, they were taken to Ken'an in a sealed prison car. Guan Gao said to the jailer: "This is what we people did. King Zhao doesn't know." The jailer beat him thousands of times with whips and stung him with red-hot iron. Guan Gao was covered with wounds, but he didn't say a word. Empress Lu said several times that King Zhao was the husband of Princess Lu Yuan and would not rebel. Emperor Gaozu said angrily: If Zhang Ao ruled the world, would he care about your daughter? Tingwei reported Guan Gao's confession to Emperor Gaozu, and Emperor Gaozu said: "What a strong man!" Anyone who is familiar with him can ask him privately. Zhongdafu Xiegong said: I know him well. He is a person in Zhao who pays attention to honor and integrity and never breaks his promise. Emperor Gaozu asked Xie Gongzhijie to ask in front of his chair. Guangao raised his head and looked at Xie Gong, chatting happily as usual. During the conversation, Duke Xie asked King Zhao if it was true that he had not rebelled. Guan Gao said: How can a human being not love his parents, wife and children? Now that all three members of my family are going to be executed for this, will I use my relatives to protect King Tang? It is indeed because King Tang did not rebel, it was just what we did. He told the whole story in detail and the situation that King Tong didn't know about at all. So Duke Xie told Gaozu what Guan Gao said, and Gaozu pardoned King Zhao. Emperor Gaozu appreciated Guangao's ability and courage to act and keep his word, so he asked Duke Xie to tell Guangao: "Zhang Ao has been released. The emperor appreciates you very much, so he pardons you." Guan Gao said: The reason why I will not die is to prove that King Tang did not rebel. Now that King Tong has been released, my responsibility has been fulfilled. But as a minister with a reputation for usurpation, how could he still have the dignity to serve the emperor? So he cut his neck and committed suicide. After Zhang Fang was released from prison, he still respected Princess Lu Yuan as before, and was named Marquis of Xuanping by Emperor Gaozu. At that time, Emperor Gaozu appreciated the guests of the king very much. They were either appointed as prime ministers of the princes or as county guards. It is recorded in "The Biography of Uncle Tian". By the time of Xiaohui, Gaohou, Emperor Wen, and Emperor Jing, the descendants of King Zhao's guests had become officials worth two thousand shi. At the beginning, during the reign of Emperor Xiaohui, King Hui of Qi dedicated Chengyang County to Princess Lu Yuan and honored her as the Queen Mother. In the first year of the reign of Emperor Gao, Empress Dowager Lu Yuan passed away. Six years later, Zhang Ao, the Marquis of Xuanping, also passed away. Empress Dowager Lu appointed Zhang Ao's son Zhang Yan as King of Lu because his mother was the Queen Mother of Qi.
target: Emperor Gaozu treated Zhang Ao rudely, angering his ministers Guan Gao and Zhao Wu, who plotted to kill Gaozu. Zhang Ao refused to participate. The plot failed, and Guan Gao took full blame, enduring torture to prove Zhang Ao's innocence. Gaozu eventually pardoned Zhang Ao and admired Guan Gao's loyalty, but Guan Gao committed suicide. Zhang Ao remained respectful to Princess Lu Yuan and was made Marquis of Xuanping. His descendants held various titles, though some were later stripped due to crimes.

source: By the time of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, Zhang Sheng was removed from his title for being convicted, and the feudal state was abolished. During the Yuanguang period, Zhang Guangguo, Zhang Yan's grandson, was granted the title of Marquis of Suiling. After his death, his son Zhang Chang succeeded to the throne. During the Taichu period, Zhang Chang was dismissed from his title for committing the crime of disrespect, and his feudal state was abolished. In the second year of the Yuan Dynasty of Xiaoping, in order to promote prosperity, Zhang Qingji, the great-great-grandson of Zhang Ao, was granted the title of Marquis of Xuanping, with thousands of households in the city. Praising said: Zhang Er and Chen Yu are recognized as sages by the world. Their guests and servants are all heroes in the world. No matter which country they are in, they all have the status of minister. But Zhang Er and Chen Yu trusted each other when they were poor and humble at first, and they were close friends of life and death. Is there anything to doubt? When they had high positions and competed for power, they finally killed each other. Why were they so admiring and trusting in the past, but now they betray each other?
target: The historian comments that Zhang Er and Chen Yu were initially life-and-death friends but turned against each other over power, illustrating the shame of fair-weather friendships.

source: Zhang Liang's courtesy name is Zifang, and his ancestors are Korean. My grandfather opened land and became the prime minister of Han Zhaohou, King Xuanhui and King Xiangai. His father, Zhang Ping, was the prime minister of King Li and King Hui. In the twenty-third year of King Hui's reign, Zhang Ping died. Twenty years after his death, Qin subjugated Han. Zhang Liang was young and had not been an official in Han. When Han died, Zhang Liang had 300 slaves in his family. His younger brother died without being buried. He used all his family wealth to seek assassins to kill the King of Qin and avenge Han because his father had been the Prime Minister of Han for five generations. Zhang Liang once studied etiquette in Huaiyang. He traveled eastward to meet Lord Canghai and found a strong man who made an iron vertebra weighing 120 kilograms. The Emperor of Qin went on a tour to Bolang Sand. Zhang Liang and his assassins ambushed the Emperor of Qin and accidentally hit the passenger car. Emperor Qin was furious and searched the world on a large scale, eager to find the thief. Zhang Liang then changed his name and fled to Xiapi. Zhang Liang once had time to take a leisurely stroll on the Xiapi Bridge. An old man, wearing coarse cloth, walked up to Zhang Liang and deliberately dropped his shoes under the bridge. He turned back and said to Zhang Liang: "Children, go down and pick up your shoes!"
target: Zhang Liang, courtesy name Zifang, was of Korean ancestry. His grandfather and father served as prime ministers to five generations of Han kings. After Qin conquered Han, Zhang Liang, though young and never an official, used his family wealth to hire an assassin to avenge Han. He ambushed the First Emperor at Bolangsha but struck the wrong carriage. Forced to flee, he changed his name and hid in Xiapi. On a bridge in Xiapi, an old man deliberately dropped his shoe and ordered Zhang Liang to retrieve it. Zhang Liang complied despite his initial anger.

source: Five days later, when the rooster crows, go. The old man arrived first again and yelled angrily: "You're late, what's the matter?" Go, come back early in five days. Five days later, Zhang Liang went there in the middle of the night. After a while, the old man also came and said with a smile: "It should be the same." He took out a book and said: If you read it, you can become the teacher of the king. Rise ten years later. Thirteen years later, the young man came to see me. The yellow stone at the foot of Jibei Gucheng Mountain was me. Then he left and disappeared. After dawn, I read the book. It was "Tai Gong's Art of War".
target: The old man later gave him a book, the "Tai Gong's Art of War," and predicted he would become a teacher to a king. Zhang Liang studied it diligently.

source: Rise ten years later. Thirteen years later, the young man came to see me. The yellow stone at the foot of Jibei Gucheng Mountain was me. Then he left and disappeared. After dawn, I read the book. It was "Tai Gong's Art of War". Zhang Liang was surprised and often recited it. Living in Xiapi, he loves to fight against injustice. Xiang Bo once killed someone and took refuge with Zhang Liang. Ten years later, Chen She and others started an uprising, and Zhang Liang also gathered more than a hundred young men. Jing Ju established himself as the false king of Chu and stayed in Liu. Zhang Liang wanted to follow him and met Pei Gong on the road. Peigong led thousands of people to capture Xiapi, and Tuidan followed him. Centipede worshiped the retired emperor and became the general of the stable. Egg King lectured Pei Gong on "Tai Gong's Art of War" many times. Pei Gong was very happy and often adopted his strategies. Zhang Liang told others, but they didn't understand. Zhang Liang said: Pei Gong is probably a talent given by heaven. Then he followed him and never left. Duke Pei went to Xue, met with Xiang Liang, and together they supported King Huai of Chu. Zhang Liang persuaded Xiang Liang: "You have established a descendant of Chu. Mr. Han, Hengyang Jun, has become a virtuous man. He can be established as king and have many party members." Xiang Liang sent Zhang Liang to find Han Cheng and establish him as King of Han.
target: During the uprisings, Zhang Liang gathered followers and joined Pei Gong (Liu Bang). He frequently advised Pei Gong using the Art of War, and Pei Gong often adopted his strategies. Zhang Liang believed Pei Gong was a heaven-sent talent and remained with him. He later persuaded Xiang Liang to establish Han Cheng as King of Han, and Zhang Liang became Han's Minister of Education.

source: Xiang Liang sent Zhang Liang to find Han Cheng and establish him as King of Han. Zhang Liang was appointed as Han Situ, and he and the King of Han led more than a thousand people to the west to conquer Han. They captured several cities, and Qin recovered them all. They went back and forth in Yingchuan to fight guerrillas. When Pei Gong went south from Luoyang, Zhang Liang led his troops to follow Pei Gong and captured more than ten cities in Han to attack Yang Xiong's army. Peigong then ordered Han Wangcheng to stay in Yangzhai, and he and Zhang Liang went south to capture Wan and west to enter Wuguan. Pei Gong wanted to attack Qin's army at Ziguan with 20,000 men. Qiang Liang said: Qin's army is still strong and should not be underestimated. I heard that the guard general is the son of a butcher, and is easily swayed by merchants and villains. He hoped that Pei Gong would stay in the fort for the time being and send people ahead to prepare meals for 50,000 people. He also placed more flags on the mountains, set up suspicious soldiers, and sent Li Shiqi to seduce the Qin generals with heavy evidence. The generals of Qin really wanted to unite and attack Shengyang in the west, and Pei Gong wanted to obey them. Zhang Liang said: "This is just a rebellion by the generals. I'm afraid the soldiers will not obey." It would be dangerous to disobey, so it would be better to attack them while they are lax. Pei Gong then led his troops to attack the Qin army and won a great victory. Chasing them to Lantian and fighting again, the Qin soldiers were completely defeated. So when they arrived in Xianyang, Prince Qin Ying surrendered to Duke Pei. When Pei Gong entered Qin, his palace was filled with curtains, dogs, horses, treasures, thousands of women, and he wanted to stay there. Fan Sha advised him, but Pei Gong refused to listen.
target: Zhang Liang advised Pei Gong against attacking Qin's strong forces directly, suggesting instead to bribe the Qin general and attack when the troops were lax. This led to a great victory and Qin's surrender. When Pei Gong was tempted by the luxuries of Qin's palace, Zhang Liang urged him to leave, warning that indulgence would harm his cause. Pei Gong heeded this and returned to Bashang.

source: Zhang Liang said: Does Pei Gong really want to betray King Xiang? Pei Gong said: There is a villain who advised me to hold the pass and not let the princes in, but I can become the king of Qin, so I listened to him. Zhang Liang said: Does Pei Gong think he can defeat King Xiang? Pei Gong was silent and said, "What should we do now?" Zhang Liang then invited Xiang Bo to see Pei Gong. Pei Gong and Xiang Bo drank wine, congratulated him on his birthday and arranged marriage, and asked Xiang Bo to explain to Xiang Yu in detail that the reason why Pei Gong did not dare to betray King Xiang and controlled the pass was to guard against other thieves. Xiang Yu later gave up, and the incident was recorded in "Yu Zhuan". In the first year of the Han Dynasty, Pei Gong became the king of Han and took over the land of Bashu. He rewarded Zhang Liang with a hundred yi of gold and two measures of pearls. Zhang Liang dedicated all of them to Xiang Bo. The king of Han then asked Zhang Liang to send generous gifts to Xiang Bo and asked him to request the land in Hanzhong. King Xiang agreed. When the King of Han went to the feudal state, Zhang Liang was sent to Baozhong and sent Zhang Liang back to Han. Zhang Liang then persuaded the king of Han to burn down the plank road to show to the world that he had no intention of returning, so as to stabilize King Xiang's heart. Then he asked Zhang Liang to go back. While walking, burn the plank road. When Zhang Liang returned to Han, he heard that Xiang Yu would not let Han Wangcheng return to his country because Zhang Liang followed the Han king, so he went east with him and went to Pengcheng to kill him. At that time, the King of Han returned to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties. Zhang Liang wrote to Xiang Yu, saying: The King of Han neglected his duty and wanted to occupy Guanzhong. He stopped as agreed and did not dare to go east again. He also sent Qi's counter-written letter to Xiang Yu, saying: Qi and Fang will destroy Chu together. Xiang Yu therefore went north to attack Qi. Zhang Liang returned to Han Dynasty from the small road. The king of Han appointed Zhang Liang as the Marquis of Xin, and he attacked Chu from Shu. When they arrived at Pengcheng, the king of Han failed and returned. When he arrived at Xiayi, the King of Han dismounted his horse and leaned on the saddle and asked: "I want to give up Guan Yishu to others. Who can make meritorious deeds with me?" Zhang Liang said: Jiujiang King Bu, a fierce general of Chu, had a conflict with King Xiang. Peng Yue and Qi King Tian Rong rebelled in Liang. These two people can be used in emergencies. Among the generals of the Han Dynasty, only Han Xin could deliver important tasks and stand alone. If the land of Guandong is to be given up to these three people, Chu can break it. The King of Han then sent Sui He to persuade King Bu of Jiujiang, and also sent people to unite with Peng Yue. When King Bao of Wei rebelled, he sent Han Xin to lead troops to attack north, and then captured Yan, Dai, Qi, and Zhao. However, it was the power of these three people that finally defeated Chu.
target: During the Hongmen Banquet crisis, Zhang Liang refused to abandon Pei Gong and helped reconcile with Xiang Yu through Xiang Bo. Later, when Pei Gong became King of Han, Zhang Liang advised burning the plank road to show no intention of returning east, stabilizing Xiang Yu. He also recommended using Han Xin, Peng Yue, and King Bu of Jiujiang to defeat Chu.

source: However, it was the power of these three people that finally defeated Chu. Zhang Liang was often ill and did not lead troops specifically. He often served as a planning minister and was always by his side. In the third year of the Han Dynasty, Xiang Yu urgently besieged the King of Han in Rongyang. The King of Han was worried and panicked, and planned with Li Shiqi to weaken the power of Chu. Li Sheng said: In the past Tang defeated Jie and granted his descendants the title of Qi; King Wu killed Zhou and granted his descendants the title of Song. Now Qin cannot follow the great road and has destroyed the six kingdoms, leaving no place to stand. Your Majesty is really able to re-establish the descendants of the Six Kingdoms. They are all grateful to your Majesty for your virtue and righteousness and are willing to be your slaves.
target: Zhang Liang opposed enfeoffing descendants of the six kingdoms, arguing it would undermine support for the Han king.

source: If the king can spend tens of thousands of catties of gold, make counter-questions, alienate their monarchs and ministers, and make them suspicious, King Xiang will be jealous and listen to slander, and he will definitely kill each other among himself. If Han takes advantage of the opportunity and leads his army to attack, he will surely destroy Chu. The King of Han agreed, so he gave Chen Ping 40,000 kilograms of gold and allowed him to do his work without any hesitation. Chen Ping spent a lot of money to question the Chu army, threatening that general Zhong Limei and others led troops for King Xiang and made great contributions, but in the end they could not cede territory and become king. He wanted to join forces with Han to remove Xiang's family and divide his territory to become king.
target: He convinced the king to destroy the seals prepared for this purpose. He also advised granting titles to Han Xin and others to secure their loyalty.

source: In the second year, Hou Xin of Huaiyin destroyed Qi and established himself as the false king of Qi. He sent envoys to inform the king of Han. The King of Han cursed angrily, and Chen Ping secretly stepped on the King of Han's feet. The king of Han understood this, so he treated the Qi envoy favorably and asked Zhang Liang to make Han Xin king of Qi. So Chen Ping was granted the title of Chanfu Township. Using his strategy, Chu was finally destroyed. In the sixth year of the Han Dynasty, someone wrote a letter to the King of Chu, Han Xin, for his rebellion. Emperor Gao asked the generals, and the generals said: Send troops quickly to bury that little boy alive. Zhihu was silent. When I asked Su Nuan, Su Nuan repeatedly declined and said, "What do the generals say?"
target: After the Han dynasty was established, Zhang Liang was granted the title of Marquis of Liu. He declined a larger fief, citing his lack of military exploits.

source: He fell on his sword and died. King Xiang was angry and killed Wang Ling's mother. Wang Ling finally followed the King of Han to pacify the world. Because he was friendly with Yong Chi, who was Gaozu's enemy, and Wang Ling had no intention of obeying Mo, he later granted Wang Ling the title of Marquis of Anguo. Wang Ling was arbitrary and had no literary talent, and he liked to be outspoken. After serving as Prime Minister You for two years, Emperor Hui died. Empress Gao wanted to make a man named Lu king and asked about the king's mausoleum. Wang Ling said: Emperor Gao killed Baima Mengzhe and said: If he is not the Liu family but becomes king, the whole world will attack him together.
target: He advised the emperor to first enfeoff Yong Chi, a man the emperor resented, to reassure other generals and prevent rebellion. He also supported Liu Jing's proposal to make Guanzhong the capital, arguing its strategic advantages.

source: In the twelfth year of the Han Dynasty, the emperor returned from defeating Yingbu. He became even more ill and wanted to change the prince more and more. Zhang Liang refused to listen to his advice and did not go to court because of illness. Taifu Shusun quoted ancient stories and sacrificed his life to fight for the crown prince's throne. The emperor pretended to agree to him, but still wanted to change the prince. When there is a banquet, wine is served and the prince serves. The four people followed the prince, all in their eighties, with snow-white hair and eyebrows, and distinguished clothes. The emperor was surprised and asked: "What is this for?" Four people came forward to answer, each saying his or her name. The emperor was surprised and said: I invited you, you ran away from me, why are you hanging out with my son now? The four said: Your Majesty despises the scholars and loves to scold them. We are righteous and will not be insulted, so we are afraid and run away. Now I heard that the prince is benevolent and filial, respects and cherishes the scholars, and there is no one in the world who would not stretch their necks and be willing to die for the prince, so we came here. The emperor said: I am honored to trouble you all and finally come to train and protect the prince. The four of them finished their birthday wishes and left. The emperor watched them off and called Mrs. Qi to point it out to her and said: I want to change to the prince. These four people will assist him. Their wings are already established and it is difficult to shake them. Lu is really your master. Mrs. Qi cried, and the emperor said: Dance Chu dance for me, and I will sing Chu songs for you. Sings: The swan flies high and rushes thousands of miles. The wings are ready and they can travel across the world. Crossing the four seas, so what! There are bows and arrows, but what’s the use? After singing a few songs, Mrs. Qi sobbed and cried. The emperor stood up and walked away, taking away the wine. In the end, the prince was not replaced. This was due to Zhang Liang's recruitment of these four people. Zhang Liang followed the emperor to attack Dai, and captured Mayi with a clever plan. When he established Xiao Xiangguo, he calmly discussed many things about the world with the emperor. He did not talk about the rise and fall of the world, so he did not record it. Zhang Liang then declared: "My family has been the prime minister of Han for generations. When Han died, he spared no expense in his fortune to avenge Han's power against Qin. The world was shocked." Now, with his three-inch tongue, he is the emperor's teacher, and he is granted the title of ten thousand households, and he is ranked among the nobles. This is the ultimate for common people, and it is enough for Zhang Liang. I hope to give up the worldly affairs and travel with Chisongzi. So he studied Taoism and wanted to practice and become an immortal. When Emperor Gao died, Empress Lu thought Zhang Liang was virtuous, so she forced him to give him a salary, saying: "Life is like a fleeting moment, why do you suffer like this?" Zhang Liang had no choice but to accept it reluctantly. Died six years later. Mi was given the title Marquis Wencheng.
target: When the emperor wanted to depose the crown prince, Zhang Liang initially refused to intervene. Pressed by Empress Lü, he suggested recruiting four reclusive sages to support the prince. The emperor, seeing the prince had their support, abandoned the plan. Zhang Liang later withdrew from worldly affairs, studying Taoism and seeking immortality. He died six years after Emperor Gao, receiving the posthumous title Marquis Wencheng.

source: His sister-in-law hated Chen Ping for not farming at home and said, "It's just like eating chaff." It’s better not to have such a brother-in-law! When Uncle Chen heard this, he drove his wife away. When Chen Ping grew up, he could marry a wife, but no one from the rich would marry him, and he would dislike the poor. A long time later, a rich man in Hulu had a granddaughter. After marrying five times, her husbands died. No one dared to marry her. Su Na wanted to marry her. There was a big funeral in the city, and the Suping family went to help with the funeral arrangements. They left early and came back late to get more rewards. Zhang Fu saw him at the funeral and thought he was extraordinary. Chen Ping also left late for some reason. Zhang Fu followed King Su to his home. He lived in a back alley behind the city wall and used a mat as the door, but there were many dignitaries' cars outside the door. Zhang Fu went back and said to his son Dan Shi: I want to marry my granddaughter to Chen Ping. Zhang Zhong said: Chen Ping was poor and did nothing, and everyone in the county laughed at his behavior. Why did you marry your daughter to him alone? Zhang Fu said: Will a talented person like Chen Ping be poor for a long time? Finally, he married his granddaughter. Because Chen Qian's family was poor, they lent him money to hire him and gave him food and wine to finance his marriage. Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve him carelessly just because he is poor. Serve your brother Uncle Chen as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother. Chen Ping married Zhang's daughter, and his resources became richer and his contacts became more extensive. A community ceremony was held in the village, with Chen Ping presiding over it, and the meat was divided evenly. The elders in the village said: Chen Ruzi is really good at hosting this!
target: Chen Ping, from a poor family, was known for his height and good looks. He married a wealthy woman after a local elder recognized his potential. During village festivals, he divided meat evenly, saying he would govern the world similarly.

source: Zhou Bo, Guan Ying and others framed Chen Ping and said: Although Chen Ping is a handsome man, he is like the jade on his crown, but he may not be talented inside. I heard that Chen Ping had an affair with his sister-in-law when he was at home. He was not tolerated when he served the king of Wei, so he fled to follow Chu. He failed to follow Chu, so he fled to follow Han. Now the king respects him, gives him an official position, and lets him oversee the army. I heard that Chen Ping used generals and sent those with more money to good places and those with less money to bad places. Chen Ping is a capricious and rebellious minister, and I hope Wang will take notice. The king of Han doubted him, blamed his ignorance, and asked: Is this possible? Ignorance said: Yes. The king of Han said: Why do you say he is a wise man? He replied: What I am talking about is talent; what your Majesty is asking about is virtue. Even if he has such virtues as Weisheng and filial piety, it will not be beneficial to the success of victory or defeat. How can your Majesty care about using him? Now that Chu and Han are at war, I recommend a wise scholar just because his strategy can really benefit the country. Is there anything suspicious about having an affair with a sister-in-law and accepting bribes? The King of Han summoned Chen Ping and asked: I heard that your husband served Wei disobediently, served Chu and then left, and now he is friends with me. Can an honest man be so half-hearted? Chen Ping said: I served the King of Wei, but the King of Wei could not listen to me, so I left him to serve King Xiang. King Xiang did not trust others, so he appointed the people he liked, either Xiang or his wife's brother, even if there were talented people, he could not use them. When I was in Chu, I heard that the king of Han was capable of employing people, so I surrendered to the king. If you come naked and don’t accept other people’s money, you won’t have the capital to do things. The minister's plan is indeed applicable, and I hope the king will adopt it. If there is nothing applicable, and the money given by the king is still there, please seal it up and turn it over to the public. I can ask to resign and go home. The King of Han then apologized, bestowed a great deal of property, and became a lieutenant in charge of guarding the army, supervising all the generals.
target: Chen Ping served Wei and then Chu, but fled both when his advice was ignored or he feared execution. He joined Liu Bang, who appointed him a captain despite objections from other generals. Chen Ping explained his past changes of allegiance by saying his former masters could not use him properly. He proposed using gold to sow discord among Xiang Yu's advisors, leading to Xiang Yu's suspicion of his strategist Fan Zeng.

source: When I reached Chen, I was greeted by King Xin of Chu on the suburban road. Zhihu prepared warriors in advance, and when he saw Han Xin, he caught him and tied him up. The matter is in "Xin Zhuan". So he met with the princes in Chen. When he returned to Luoyang, he divided the talismans with the meritorious officials and formulated rewards, and made Chen Ping a Marquis of Household, which lasted for generations. Chen Ping declined and said: This is not my credit. The emperor said: I used your master's strategy to defeat the enemy. What else is it but merit? Chen Ping said: How can I be employed if I am not a minister of Wei Wuwu? The emperor said: Your husband can be said to have never forgotten his roots! Then Wei Wuwu was awarded a reward. The next year, Chen Ping followed the emperor to attack Han Wangxin in Dai. When he arrived at Pingcheng, he was surrounded by the Huns and had nothing to eat for seven days. Emperor Gao adopted Su Nu's clever trick and asked Shan Yuban to explain, and he was able to get out of the siege. Gao Tong escaped, and his plan was so secret that no one in the world knew about it. Emperor Gao passed by Di Ni in the south, climbed the city wall, saw the large houses, and said: What a magnificent county! I have traveled all over the world and I have only seen Luoyang and this Xiang! I turned around and asked the censor: How many household registrations does Qu Ni have? Answer: There were more than 30,000 households in Taiwan at the beginning. After many wars, many people fled and hid. Now there are more than 5,000 households. So he issued an edict to the censor and changed the title of Shunuo Zuqu Nihou to enjoy the tax revenue of the whole county and exempted him from the previous feudal household. Chen Ping followed them from the beginning, and after the world was peaceful, he often followed them as a guard lieutenant to attack Zang Tu, Chen Xi, and Yingbu. A total of six clever tricks were made, and each time they were successful and increased the number of fiefs.
target: Chen Ping advised the emperor to capture Han Xin by feigning a visit to Yunmeng, rather than attacking him directly. He also helped the emperor escape a siege at Pingcheng using a secret plan. He served as a strategist for six major campaigns, each time increasing his fief.

source: Eating it is also a good thing. When the King of Han was defeated in the west of Pengcheng, the Chu army took the Emperor Taishang and Empress Lu as hostages, and used them as sacrifices to serve Empress Lu. Later, after defeating Xiang Ji, he was granted the title of Marquis and was favored by Empress Dowager Lu. When he becomes the prime minister, he does not assume any official duties and supervises the affairs of the palace. He is like a doctor, and all officials make decisions through him. Lu Xuchang framed Chen Ping many times because he planned to arrest Fan Sha for Emperor Gao. He said: "As prime minister, I don't care about anything. I drink fine wine every day and molest women." After hearing this, Chen Ping became more and more indulgent day by day. When Empress Dowager Lu heard about it, she was secretly happy. In front of Lu Xu, Chen Ping said: As the saying goes, women and children cannot be heard. I want to know what kind of relationship you have with me. Don't be afraid of being framed by Lu Xu. Empress Dowager Lu appointed many people named Lu as kings, and Chen Ping pretended to obey. When Empress Dowager Lu died, Chen Ping and Taiwei Zhou Bo conspired to finally kill the people named Lu and establish Emperor Wen. This was Chen Ping's plan. After reviewing the food, he was removed from the position. Emperor Wen established him and appointed Chen Ping as the prime minister.
target: After Emperor Gao's death, Chen Ping pretended to indulge in wine and women to avoid suspicion from Empress Lü. He outwardly complied with her appointing Lü family members as kings, but later conspired with Zhou Bo to eliminate the Lü clan and establish Emperor Wen. As prime minister, he famously told the emperor that a prime minister's role is to oversee officials, not handle specific tasks.

source: So Jianghou himself knew that his talent was far inferior to that of Chen Ping. Soon after, Zhou Bo resigned from the post, and Chen Ping became prime minister alone. In the second year of Xiaowen's reign, Chen Ping passed away and Mi was given the title Xianhou. The descendant passed down to his great-grandson Chen He, who was abandoned in the market for robbing other people's wives. The royal mausoleum was also passed down to the great-great-grandson, and the feudal state was abolished because the sacrifice money was not enough. The Marquis of Piyang was killed by the King of Huainan three years after he was dismissed. Emperor Wen let his son Shenping inherit the title. The king of Zi rebelled, and Piyang was close to Zi. Shenping surrendered to him, and the feudal state was abolished. At first Chen Ping said: I mostly plot in secret, which is prohibited by Taoism. My generation has declined, so forget it. After all, it cannot rise again, because I have many hidden troubles. Later, the great-grandson Chen Zhang became famous because he was a relative of the Wei family. He hoped to have his title renewed, but in the end he did not get it. Zhou Bo, a native of Pei. The ancestors were Kun people who migrated to Pei. Qedong made a living by weaving silkworm-rearing utensils. He often played the flute for people attending funerals, and used his talents as a leader. When Emperor Gaozu had just become Duke of Pei, Bo followed him as Zhongjuan to attack Huling and attacked Fangyou. Fang rebelled, fought with the enemy again, and defeated the enemy. Attack Feng. Attack the Qin army in Cishu. He came back and was stationed in Liuhexiao. Attack Ci again and occupy it. To capture Xiayi, first scale the city wall. He was given the title of Fifth Doctor.
target: Zhou Bo, a simple man from Pei, began as a funeral flutist. He followed Liu Bang from the start, distinguishing himself in battle by often being the first to scale city walls. He served as a general under Emperor Gao, pacifying many regions and capturing numerous enemy officials.

source: When he becomes the prime minister, he does not assume any official duties and supervises the affairs of the palace. He is like a doctor, and all officials make decisions through him. Lu Xuchang framed Chen Ping many times because he planned to arrest Fan Sha for Emperor Gao. He said: "As prime minister, I don't care about anything. I drink fine wine every day and molest women." After hearing this, Chen Ping became more and more indulgent day by day. When Empress Dowager Lu heard about it, she was secretly happy. In front of Lu Xu, Chen Ping said: As the saying goes, women and children cannot be heard. I want to know what kind of relationship you have with me. Don't be afraid of being framed by Lu Xu. Empress Dowager Lu appointed many people named Lu as kings, and Chen Ping pretended to obey. When Empress Dowager Lu died, Chen Ping and Taiwei Zhou Bo conspired to finally kill the people named Lu and establish Emperor Wen. This was Chen Ping's plan.
target: After Emperor Gao's death, Zhou Bo served as Grand Commandant. When Empress Lü died, he and Chen Ping plotted to eliminate the Lü clan.

source: Zhou Bo didn't like reading. Every time he summoned scholars and debaters, he would sit facing east and urge: "Tell me quickly." He simply lacks literary talent to this extent. Zhou Bo pacified Yan and returned. Emperor Gao had passed away. He served Emperor Hui as a prince. In the sixth year of Emperor Hui's reign, the official position of Taiwei was established and Zhou Bo was appointed as Taiwei. Ten years later, Queen Gao passed away. Lu Lu appointed King Tong as the general of Mo Shang, and Lu Chan appointed King Lu as the prime minister. He controlled the power of the country and wanted to endanger the Liu family. Zhou Bo, together with the prime ministers Chen Ping and Zhu Xuhou Zhang, killed everyone surnamed Lu. The matter is in "Gaohou Ji". They then plotted secretly, believing that the young emperor and the kings of Ji, Huaiyang and Hengshan were not the sons of Emperor Hui. Empress Dowager Lu used a trick to pretend that someone else's child was a prince, killed his mother, raised him in the harem, and asked Xiaohui to treat him like a son and establish him as a descendant to strengthen the power of the Lu family.
target: Zhou Bo, as commander of the Northern Army, rallied the soldiers by showing them his seal and declaring loyalty to the Liu family. They killed the Lü kings and established Emperor Wen.

source: Yafu took off his hat and apologized to the emperor. The emperor said: Get up. Yafu walked out quickly in small steps. The emperor saw him off and said: He is dissatisfied and not a minister of the young master. Not long after, Yafu's son bought five hundred Shangfang Jiaxun from the work officer for his father, preparing to be buried with him. The hired workers work hard and are not paid. The hired workers knew that he secretly bought the emperor's utensils, resented him and informed the court that he wanted to rebel. The matter affected Yafu. After the letter was submitted, the emperor asked it to be handed over to the officials for investigation. The officials used the official documents to question Yafu, but Yafu did not answer. The emperor scolded him and said: I don't need you to answer. Summoned to the Tingwei. Tingwei asked, "Why did you build it?" Yafu said: What I bought is a burial vessel. How can it be made? The clerk said: Either you want to rebel on the ground, or you want to rebel underground. The clerk bullied him even more. At first, the officials arrested Yafu. Yafu wanted to commit suicide, but his wife stopped him. So before he could commit suicide, he was imprisoned in the court, where he did not eat for five days and died of vomiting blood. The feudal state was abolished. A year later, the emperor changed the title of Zhou Jian, another son of Jianghou Zhou Bo, to the title of Pingquhou and succeeded Jianghou. He passed it on to his son Jiande and became the crown prince and tutor. He was dismissed from office because the amount of money offered as an aide was insufficient. Later he was found guilty and the feudal state was abolished.
target: Zhou Bo became Right Chancellor but feared his power and resigned. Later accused of rebellion, he was imprisoned and bribed a jailer for advice. He was released after his wife, the emperor's daughter, testified for him. He remarked on the harshness of jailers. His son Zhou Yafu succeeded him.

source: Leave after the ceremony. After leaving the camp gate, the ministers were all frightened. Emperor Wen said: Ah, this is the real general! Previously, Bashang and Thorny Gate were like child's play, and the general would definitely be attacked and captured. As for Yafu, can he invade? Praise him for a long time. More than a month later, all three armies withdrew. He appointed Yafu as lieutenant. Before Emperor Wen died, he warned the prince: If there is an emergency, Zhou Yafu can really be appointed to lead the army. Emperor Wen died, and Yafu became a chariot and cavalry general. In the third year of Emperor Xiaojing's reign, Wu Chu rebelled. As a lieutenant, Yafu performed the duties of a Taiwei and went east to attack Wu Chu. So he asked the emperor: "The Chu soldiers are strong and agile, and it is difficult to compete with them." I hope that by abandoning Liang to it and cutting off their food routes, they can conquer it. The emperor agreed. Yafu set out and arrived at Bashang. Chang She stopped Yafu and said, "General, go eastward to destroy Wu and Chu. If you win, the ancestral temple will be stable. If you fail, the world will be in danger. Can you adopt my opinion?" Yafu got out of the car and asked him after saluting. Zhao She said: The King of Wu has always been rich and has long recruited scholars who are willing to die for service. Now that he knows that the general is going, he will definitely set up an ambush at a narrow and dangerous place, and the secret of war is important. Why doesn't the general go to the right from now on, pass through Lantian, leave Wuguan, and arrive at Luoyang, which is only a day or two away. He can directly enter the weapons warehouse and beat the war drums. When the princes heard this, they thought the general had fallen from the sky. The Taiwei acted according to his plan. When they arrived in Luoyang, they sent a small official to search Sanxingjian, and sure enough they found Wu's ambush. So he asked Zhao She to be the guard. After Yafu arrived, he gathered his troops in Rongyang. Wu Zheng attacked Liang, and Liang was in danger and asked for help. Yafu led his troops to the northeast toward Changyi and built a stronghold to defend it. The king of Liang sent an envoy to request Yafu, but Yafu considered the situation and refused to go. King Liang wrote to Emperor Jing and Emperor Jing issued an edict asking him to save Liang. Yafu disobeyed Shao's order and defended the camp without sending troops. He sent light cavalry, Gong Gaohou and others to cut off the Wu Chu army's rear food route. Wu Chu's soldiers were short of food and hungry, and wanted to retreat. They challenged him many times but refused to go out. At night, there was a commotion in the army, internal attacks and commotion, and they arrived at the tent. Yafu lay still and couldn't get up. After a while, it settled down again. Wu Jun rushed to the southeast corner of the camp, while Yafu Rang guarded the northwest corner. Soon the enemy's elite troops rushed to the northwest and could not attack. Wu Chu's army was short of food, so they withdrew their troops. Yafu sent out elite troops to pursue and defeated Wu Wangbi.
target: Zhou Yafu, known for his strict military discipline, refused to let Emperor Wen enter his camp without proper protocol, earning the emperor's praise as a "true general." During the Rebellion of the Seven States, he advised letting Liang bear the enemy's attack while cutting off their supply routes. He ignored the emperor's order to save Liang, focusing on his strategy, which ultimately defeated Wu and Chu.

source: More than a month later, the Yue people chopped off King Wu's head to report. After a total of three months of attack and defense, Wu Chu was pacified. Then the generals believed that the Taiwei's plan was correct. From then on, there was a conflict between King Xiao of Liang and Yafu. After returning, he appointed Taiwei officers. Five years later, he was promoted to prime minister, and Emperor Jing valued him very much. The emperor abolished Prince Li. Yafu argued resolutely but failed. The emperor therefore distanced himself from him. And every time Liang Xiaowang went to court, he often talked to the Queen Mother about Yafu's shortcomings. Empress Dowager Dou said: The empress's brother Wang Xin can be made a marquis. The emperor reproached him and said: In the past, Nanpi and Zhangwu, the first emperors, did not ennoble themselves as marquises, but when their ministers came to the throne, they would do so. Wang Xin could not do so. Empress Dowager Dou said: In life, everyone acts according to the current situation. When Dou Changjun was still alive, he could not be granted the title of marquis in the end. After his death, his son Peng Zu was granted the title of marquis. I regret it very much.
target: As prime minister, Yafu opposed enfeoffing the queen's brother and Xiongnu defectors, arguing it violated Emperor Gao's rules. The emperor overruled him. Later, Yafu's son bought imperial burial items, and Yafu was accused of rebellion. He starved himself in prison, fulfilling a prophecy that he would die of hunger.

source: Later he was found guilty and the feudal state was abolished. Yafu indeed starved to death. After his death, the emperor made Wang Xin a marquis. In the second year of the Yuanshi period of Emperor Ping, in order to inherit the kingdom of Juesi, Zhou Gong, the son of Zhou Bo's great-great-grandson, was granted the title of Marquis of Jiang, with the title of a thousand households in the city. Zan said: After hearing Zhang Liang's wisdom and bravery, I thought he was tall and majestic, but I didn't know that he looked like a woman. Therefore, Confucius said that people should be judged by their appearance and made mistakes with Ziyu. Scholars all suspect ghosts and gods. For example, Zhang Liang got a book from an old man, which was also strange. Emperor Gaozu was in trouble many times, and Zhang Liang often came to the rescue. Can it be said that it was not God's will? Chen Ping's ambition was expressed in the society, and he defected to the chaotic Chu and Wei, and finally returned to Yimo and became a counselor. When he arrived at Empress Lu, many things happened, but Chen Ping was actually safe and managed to live an old age with wisdom. Wang Ling argued in the court and isolated himself from the world, which was also his own ambition. When Zhou Bo was a commoner, he was a clumsy and mediocre person. When he became a minister, he helped the country in crisis, killed the surname Lu, established Xiaowen, and became the Yi Zhou of the Han Dynasty. How prominent! At first, Empress Lu asked about the choice of prime minister. Gaozu said: Chen Ping is resourceful and Wang Ling is a bit straight-forward, so he can assist him; it must be Zhou Bo who can stabilize the Liu family.
target: The historian comments that Zhang Liang, despite his wisdom, looked like a woman. Chen Ping used clever schemes to survive the Lü clan's rule. Zhou Bo, though crude, stabilized the Han dynasty, fulfilling Emperor Gao's prediction that he would secure the Liu family.

source: Zhang Qian was from Hanzhong. During the Jianyuan period, he was appointed as Lang Guan. People who surrendered to the Xiongnu at that time said that the Xiongnu defeated the Yuezhi King and used the Yuezhi King's head as a drinking vessel. The Yuezhi fled and resented the Huns because they had no one to fight with them. The Han Dynasty was planning to engage in a war to eliminate the Xiongnu. When they heard this, they wanted to send people as envoys to the Yuezhi. However, the Xiongnu Kingdom was the only way to go, so they recruited people who could go as envoys. Zhang Qian was recruited as an envoy to Yuezhi as a Langguan. He left Longxi with Gan Fu, Tangyi's servant. Passing by the Huns, he was intercepted by the Huns and sent to the Shanyu in a conveyor. Shanyu said: The Yueshi are to the north of me. How can the Han Dynasty people send envoys there? If I want to send someone as an envoy to South Vietnam, will the Han Dynasty let our people pass by? Zhang Qian was detained for more than ten years. He married him and gave birth to a son. However, Zhang Qian still insisted on the Han Dynasty and still maintained his status as an envoy. Because he lived in the western part of the Huns, Zhang Qian took the opportunity to lead his subordinates to flee towards the Yueshi. After running west for dozens of days, we arrived in Dawan. Dawan heard that the Han Dynasty was rich in wealth and wanted to have contacts with the Han Dynasty but could not find the opportunity. He was very happy to see Zhang Qian and asked him where he was going. Zhang Qian said: We were sent as an envoy to the Yuezhi on behalf of the Han Dynasty, but the Huns blocked the road and refused to allow passage. Now we are fleeing to your country. I hope that the king can send someone to lead the way and send us there. If we can reach the Yuezhi, after we return to the Han Dynasty, the property that the Han Dynasty will give to the king will be indescribable. Dawan thought it was okay, so he sent them there and sent translators and guides for them. They were sent to Kangju, who sent them to Dayuezhi in a conveyor. At this time, the original King of Dayuezhi had been killed by the Xiongnu, and his wife was made king. Da Yuezhi had made Daxia surrender and ruled over it. The land there was fertile, the produce was abundant, there was no intrusion, and they felt relaxed and happy. They considered themselves far away from the Han Dynasty and did not want to get close to the Han Dynasty. They had no intention of revenge against the Huns. From Yuezhi to Daxia, Zhang Qian never received a clear statement from the Yuezhi King. After staying for more than a year, I had to return. Along the Nanshan Mountains, I wanted to return to the Han Dynasty from the place where the Qiang people lived, but I was intercepted by the Xiongnu again.
target: Zhang Qian, a native of Hanzhong, was appointed as Lang Guan during the Jianyuan period. Hearing from surrendered Xiongnu that the Yuezhi had been defeated by the Xiongnu and sought allies for revenge, the Han Dynasty, planning to attack the Xiongnu, recruited envoys to the Yuezhi. Zhang Qian was recruited and departed with Gan Fu, a servant from Tangyi. Captured by the Xiongnu, he was detained for over ten years, married, and had a son, but he retained his Han envoy status. Escaping westward, he reached Dawan, which aided him due to interest in Han wealth. He was sent via Kangju to Dayuezhi, but the Yuezhi, now settled in fertile Daxia, had no desire for revenge. After over a year without a clear response, Zhang Qian returned but was recaptured by the Xiongnu. He escaped after a year during Xiongnu turmoil, returning to Han with his wife and Gan Fu. He was appointed Taizhong Taifu.

source: Shendu Country is located in the southeast of Daxia, about thousands of miles away. The custom of Nahuo is to live a settled life, which is the same as that of Daxia, but the terrain is low-lying, humid, and the climate is hot. People there rode elephants to fight, and the country was bordered by floods. According to my guess, Daxia was about 12,000 miles away from the Han Dynasty and to the southwest of the Han Dynasty. Now Shendu is thousands of miles southeast of Daxia, and there are products from Shu County. It seems that Shendu is not far from Shu. It is very dangerous for the envoy to Daxia to pass through the Qiang area. The Qiang people hate the Han Dynasty. If you go a little north, you will be captured by the Huns. If you go from Shu County, it will be a convenient road and there will be no intrusion. Emperor Mowu heard that Dayuan, Daxia, Parthia and other countries were big countries with many strange products and lived a settled life, which was the same as the customs of the Han Dynasty. However, the military strength is very weak and they value the property of the Han Dynasty. To the north are the Dayuezhi, Kangju and other countries, which have strong military strength. They can be lured to come to see the Emperor of Han by giving them property and benefits. If we can really do this and use moral power to make them join the Han Dynasty, then the Han Dynasty can expand its territory by more than 10,000 miles. People from some ethnic groups who come to the court will have to go through multiple translations to understand the language. Some ethnic minorities with strange customs will also come to join the Han Dynasty. The prestige and virtue of the Han Dynasty will spread all over the world. Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty was very happy and thought Zhang Qian's words made sense. So he ordered envoys to be sent to explore the road through Shu County and Jianwei County, and they set off in four groups at the same time. Starting from Ranchi all the way, starting from Jedudu all the way, starting from Yiheqiong all the way, and starting from Fen all the way, each has a distance of one or two thousand miles. However, the northern passage was blocked by the clans and Jeduyi, and the southern passage was blocked by Ling and Kunming. Kunming and other ethnic minorities have no rulers and are good at plundering and stealing. Every time they killed passing Han envoys and took away their property, this road finally failed to open. However, I heard that about a thousand miles west of Kunming, there is Chengxiang Kingdom, named Dianyue. Some businessmen from Shu County who privately trade goods have been there. So the Han Dynasty began to communicate with the Dian Kingdom in search of the road to Daxia. At first, the Han Dynasty wanted to communicate with the southwestern barbarians, but stopped this work because it was too expensive. When Zhang Qian said that it was possible to reach Daxia via the Southwest Yi, the Han Dynasty began to open up the route to the Southwest Yi. Zhang Qian followed the general Wei Qing to attack the Huns as a captain. Because he knew where the water and grass were distributed, the army could not lack supplies, so he made Zhang Qian the Marquis of Bowang. This year is the sixth year of Yuanshuo, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty. Two years later, Zhang Qian, as a guard, set out from Youbeiping with General Li Guang to fight against the Huns. General Li was surrounded by the Xiongnu, and the Han army suffered heavy casualties. However, Zhang Qian arrived later than the agreed time and was punished by beheading according to military law. He used his property to redeem himself as a civilian. This year, Husband General Huo Qubing defeated the Xiongnu in the west, killing tens of thousands as far as the Qilian Mountains.
target: Zhang Qian, known for his perseverance and sincerity, visited Dawan, Dayuezhi, Daxia, and Kangju. He reported to Emperor Wu that Daxia had Shu products, suggesting Shendu was near Shu. He proposed a route via Shu to Daxia, avoiding dangerous Qiang and Xiongnu territories. Emperor Wu, intrigued by the wealth of western states, sent envoys to explore Shu routes, but they were blocked by local tribes. Zhang Qian later joined General Wei Qing against the Xiongnu, becoming Marquis of Bowang.

source: The Xiongnu sent troops to attack him but could not defeat him. They even thought Kunmo was a god and stayed away from him. Now Shan Yu had just been defeated by the Han Dynasty and was in a difficult situation, and Kunmo's original place was uninhabited. The ethnic minorities are attached to their homeland and are greedy for the property of the Han Dynasty. If we send more property to Wusun at this time to attract them to come to Shubian to live on their original land, and the Han Dynasty sends a princess to King Wusun as his wife, and the two parties form a brotherly relationship, based on the above analysis of the situation, Wusun will definitely listen to our suggestions, then it will be equivalent to cutting off the right arm of the Xiongnu. By uniting with Wusun, Daxia and other countries west of Wusun can be recruited as your foreign ministers. Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty believed that Zhang Qian was right, and awarded Zhang Qian the official position of Lieutenant General. He led 300 people, each with two horses, driving tens of thousands of cattle and sheep, carrying gold and gifts worth tens of millions, and many deputy envoys accompanying him on a mission to Wusun. If the road is convenient, he will send deputy envoy Chijie to the country next to Wusun. After Zhang Qian arrived at Wusun, he gave Emperor Wu's gifts to King Wusun and conveyed Emperor Wu's wishes, but failed to obtain a clear statement from King Wusun. The specific content is recorded in "The Biography of the Western Regions". Zhang Qian then sent deputy envoys to Dayuan, Kangju, Yuezhi and Daxia respectively. King Wusun sent an interpreter and guide to escort Zhang Qian. Wusun envoys of dozens of people and dozens of horses followed Zhang Qian back to the Han Dynasty to thank Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty. They took the opportunity to let them inspect the situation of the Han Dynasty and understand the vastness of the Han Dynasty. Zhang Qian returned to the Han Dynasty and was awarded a senior official. More than a year later, Zhang Qian passed away. More than a year later, most of the deputy envoys he sent to Tongdaxia and other countries returned to the Han Dynasty together with the envoys from these countries, and the northwest countries began to communicate with the Han Dynasty. However, because Zhang Qian opened the way to the Western Regions, those who later went to the Western Regions as envoys followed Zhang Qian's example and were called Bowang Hou, in order to win the trust of foreign countries, and foreigners trusted them. After that, King Wusun finally married Princess Xuan. At the beginning, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty opened the Book of Changes for divination and said: The divine horse will come from the northwest. He thought it was good to get the Wusun horse, so he named it Tianma. When they got the Dawan Khan-blooded horse again, it was fatter and stronger than the Wusun horse, so they renamed the Wusun horse "Xijima" and the Dawan horse "Tianma".
target: After a failed campaign with Li Guang, he was reduced to commoner status. Following Han victories over the Xiongnu, Zhang Qian advised allying with Wusun to weaken the Xiongnu and recruit western states. Emperor Wu agreed, sending Zhang Qian with gifts to Wusun. Though Wusun did not commit, Zhang Qian sent deputies to other states. Wusun later sent envoys to Han, and Zhang Qian died over a year after returning. After Zhang Qian's missions, Han envoys frequently traveled to the Western Regions, often exaggerating to gain favor. Emperor Wu, seeking Dawan horses, sent Li Guangli as General of Ershi to attack Dawan.

source: Besides, the Ershima is Dawan’s BMW. Finally, he refused to be envoyed to the Han Dynasty. The envoy of the Han Dynasty was furious, cursed and ran away with broken vertebrae of the golden horse. The nobles of Dayuan said angrily: The Han envoys despise us too much! He ordered the Han envoys to leave Dayuan, and asked King Yu Cheng of Shubian to intercept them, kill the Han envoys and seize their belongings. Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty was furious. Yao Dinghan and others who had been on an envoy to Dayuan said: Dayuan's soldiers are weak. If nearly three thousand Han troops are used to shoot at them with strong bows and powerful crossbows, they can be defeated. Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty had sent Zhao Ponu, the Marquis of Zhao Ye, to attack Loulan, and arrived at Loulan with 700 cavalry first and captured the King of Loulan. Therefore, he thought that what Yao Dinghan and others said was reasonable, and wanted to make the brother of his favorite concubine, Mrs. Li, a marquis, so he appointed Li Guangli as his general to attack Dayuan.
target: The first campaign failed due to food shortages, and Li Guangli was ordered to halt at Dunhuang.

source: The troops of the General of the Second Division had already encountered Yanyan to the west. The small countries along the route were in panic and tightly defended their castles. They did not supply the Han army with food and could not be defeated. Those who can be captured will have food to eat, and those who cannot be captured will have to leave in a few days. By the time they reached Yucheng, there were only a few thousand soldiers left, and they were all hungry and tired. They attacked Yucheng City and were defeated, with many casualties. The general of the Second Division discussed with his left and right: We can't capture it until Yucheng, let alone the capital of King Dawan? Just retreat with the troops. It took two years of traveling back and forth. When we returned to Dunhuang, only one-tenth of the soldiers were left. He sent an envoy to write a memorial to the emperor saying: The journey is long and there is a shortage of food. The soldiers were not afraid of war, but of starvation. With few troops, Wan cannot be captured. I hope to withdraw the troops temporarily and send more troops before going back. When Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty heard what had been reported, he became furious and sent envoys to guard Yumen Pass, saying that if any soldier dared to enter the pass, he would be killed immediately! General Li Guangli of the Second Division was afraid and stayed in Dunhuang. In the summer of that year, the Han Dynasty fought against the Xiongnu, and the soldiers of the Hou Po Nu were killed by more than 20,000 people. After discussion, senior officials of the Han Dynasty hoped to call back the troops that attacked Dawan and focus on dealing with the Xiongnu. However, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty believed that since he had sent troops to attack Dayuan, if a small country like Dayuan could not defeat it, countries like Daxia would gradually look down on the Han Dynasty, and the good horses from Dayuan would be stopped from coming to the Han Dynasty. Countries such as Wusun and Luntai would also make it difficult for the Han Dynasty's envoys, and they would laugh at foreign countries. So Deng Guang and others were punished for discussing that the attack on Dawan was particularly inappropriate. The prisoner soldiers were pardoned, and the young men with bad conduct and the cavalry on the border were sent to the army. After more than a year, 60,000 troops were sent from Dunhuang, not counting those who personally brought food and followed the troops to fight. This team contains 100,000 cattle, 30,000 horses, and tens of thousands of donkeys and camels.
target: Despite opposition, Emperor Wu launched a massive second campaign with 60,000 troops, 100,000 cattle, and 30,000 horses. After a 40-day siege, Dawan nobles killed their king and offered horses, ending the war. Li Guangli was made Marquis of Haixi.
