It has been more than 40 years since Emperor Xiaowen reformed the four-baht coin. Since the founding of the Yuan Dynasty, very little has been in circulation. The government often went to the copper-rich mountains to mint coins, and the common people also minted coins secretly, which is incalculable. The more money, the lighter it is; the less material things are, the more expensive they are. Relevant officials said: In the past, they were leather coins, which the princes used to greet each other and pay tribute to the emperor. There are three grades of gold, gold is the upper grade, silver is the middle grade, and copper is the lower grade. Nowadays, the legal weight of half a tael of money is four baht, but some evil people secretly grind the money to obtain copper shavings. The money is thinner and the material is more valuable. People in distant places spend no less on using coins. Just use the skin of a white deer, one foot square, and paint the edges with five colors to make a leather coin, worth 400,000 yuan. When princes and clans met with the emperor to greet each other and pay tribute to the emperor, they must express their allegiance with leather coins before they could pass. Currency made of silver-tin alloy is called platinum.
target: The emperor discussed changing coins to supplement expenses, using white deer skin for leather coins worth 400,000 yuan and silver-tin platinum coins. The government destroyed half-liang coins and recast three baht coins, punishing secret minting with death.

source: Just use the skin of a white deer, one foot square, and paint the edges with five colors to make a leather coin, worth 400,000 yuan. When princes and clans met with the emperor to greet each other and pay tribute to the emperor, they must express their allegiance with leather coins before they could pass. Currency made of silver-tin alloy is called platinum. It is believed that nothing is better for heaven than a dragon, for earth nothing is better than a horse, and for humans there is nothing better than a tortoise. Therefore, there are three grades of platinum: one weighs eight taels, is round, and has a dragon pattern on its front, which is called Bai Zhuan, and is worth three thousand; one is slightly lighter, square, and has a horse pattern on its front, and is worth five hundred; and one is smaller, oval, and has a turtle pattern on its front, and is worth three hundred. Order the government to destroy half of the two coins and recast three baht coins so that the weight is the same as the one engraved on it. Those who secretly minted various kinds of money were punished with death, and countless officials and citizens broke the law. So Shu Guo Xianyang and Kong Wei were appointed as great agricultural ministers to take charge of salt and iron affairs, while Sang Hongyang was favored.
target: Shu Guo Xianyang and Kong Wei were appointed as great agricultural ministers to manage salt and iron, while Sang Hongyang, a merchant's son, became favored.

source: Du Zhou came to review the case, and few people could reverse the case. So they sent censors, court lieutenants, and eunuchs to various countries with different missions to deal with cases of hidden property in counties and counties. They obtained hundreds of millions of people's property, tens of millions of slaves, hundreds of hectares of land in large counties, and more than a hundred hectares in small counties, and the same number of real estate. As a result, most of the middle-class and above-average merchants went bankrupt, and the people settled on good food and clothing and no longer engaged in hoarding. The government gradually became richer because of the money-making business of salt and iron. The Guanzhong area was expanded and left and right auxiliaries were set up. At first, there were a lot of salt and iron officials under the management of Da Nong, so he appointed Captain Shuiheng to be in charge of salt and iron affairs. After Yang Ke encouraged the report of hidden property, Shanglin's property increased, and he appointed Captain Shuiheng to be in charge of Shanglin. Now that Shanglin has enough property, he needs to expand it. At this time, the Guangdong Kingdom planned to use ships to start a war with the Han Dynasty, so it built Kunming Pool on a large scale and built temples around the pool. The building boat is built, more than ten feet high, and the flag is placed on it. It is very spectacular. So the emperor was infected by this style and built the Bailiang Fortress, which was dozens of feet high. The construction of palaces has become more and more magnificent since then. So min money was distributed to various government offices, and Shuiheng, Shaofu, Taipu, and Da Nong each set up agricultural officials, who often cultivated the confiscated land in various counties and counties on the spot. The confiscated slaves and maidservants were distributed to various gardens to feed dogs, horses, and animals, and to various government offices. The official positions were more complicated and more numerous, and there were many criminals and slaves. Therefore, the grain transported to the capital from the Dong River was about four million shi, and the government had to buy part of the grain itself to be able to use it.
target: The government set up salt and iron officials, taxed merchants, and confiscated hidden property. The rich went bankrupt, and the government grew richer through salt and iron. The emperor built Kunming Pool and Bailiang Fortress, expanding palaces. The government used confiscated land and slaves for farming, and the grain transported to the capital reached four million shi.

source: There was a slight drought that year, and the emperor ordered all officials to pray for rain. The fortune teller said: The government should use taxes and taxes for food and clothing. Now Sang Hongyang makes officials sit in the shops and buy and sell goods in order to make profits. Only when the Sanghong sheep is boiled will it rain. After some time, Emperor Wu fell ill and worshiped Sang Hongyang as the imperial censor. Six years after Emperor Zhao's reign, he ordered the prefectures and counties to recommend virtuous and literary people and ask them about the sufferings of the people and the key to political and religious culture. They all responded by hoping to remove Yan Tie, Jiu Guo, and all officials, compete for interests with the world, use frugality to show the world, and then enlightenment can arise. Sang Hongyang criticized them, arguing that these were the great undertakings of the country, which were used to subdue the barbarians, stabilize the borders, and satisfy consumption, and could not be abolished. So he and Prime Minister Qianqiu petitioned to abolish the wine tax. Sang Hongyang thought he had brought great benefits to the country and was arrogant about taking credit. He wanted to seek official positions for his children. He hated the general Huo Guang, so he rebelled against Shangguan Jie and others and was executed. There were no changes in the five generations of Emperor Xuan, Emperor Yuan, Emperor Cheng, Emperor Ai, and Emperor Hu. The Yantie Palace was deposed during the reign of Emperor Yuan, but was restored three years later. Gong Yu said: To make money, copper must be mined. One hundred thousand people do not work in farming every year. Many people break the law and secretly make money, and many people are punished. The rich have a house full of money, but they still don't know how to be satisfied. The people's hearts are shaken, and they abandon the fundamentals of agriculture and pursue commercial interests. There are not half of the people cultivating, and evil cannot be banned because of money. Those who are eager to engage in commerce will cut off agriculture. Officials who mine pearls, jade, gold and silver and make money should be dismissed. Coins should no longer be minted. The laws on selling and paying taxes in kind should be removed. Taxes, salaries, and rewards should be paid in cloth and grain, so that the people can devote themselves wholeheartedly to farming. The people discussing it believed that transactions required money and that cloth could not be divided by size. Gong Yu's suggestion was not adopted. From the fifth year of Emperor Xiaowu's Yuanshou, the three officials began to mint five baht coins. By the first year of Emperor Yuan's reign, there were more than 28 billion yuan in money. When Wang Mang was regent, he changed the system of the Han Dynasty. Because the money of the Zhou Dynasty was balanced by the son and the mother, he changed the big coin to one and a half inches in diameter and weighed twelve baht. The words on the front were "big coin fifty". They also made deed-knife coins and wrong-knife coins. The edge of the Qidao is like a big coin, shaped like a knife, two inches long, and the words on the front are "Qidao Five Hundred". The wrong knife is inlaid with gold and its pattern is engraved with the words "One knife is worth five thousand". There are four types of coins and five baht coins, which are circulated together. Wang Mang officially ascended the throne as emperor. He believed that the character Liu was written with gold and a knife, so he abolished wrong knives, contract knives and five-baht coins, and replaced them with gold, silver, turtle, shell, money and cloth coins, which are called "treasure goods".
target: After Wang Mang became regent, he changed the Han system, creating various coins like big coins, deed-knife coins, and wrong-knife coins. He later abolished these and introduced treasure goods, including gold, silver, turtle, shell, money, and cloth coins. He established six types of coins, each with different values, and implemented credit and five equalizations to control prices. He set up officials in Chang'an and five capitals to manage trade, taxing craftsmen and merchants. He also regulated wine production, with the government making wine and taking seven-tenths of the profit.

source: Every time the currency was changed, people went bankrupt and committed a large number of crimes. Wang Mang executed those who made money privately, and moved those who criticized and slandered the treasures to remote areas. There were too many people who broke the law, and it could not be fully implemented, so he changed the criminal law to reduce the punishment: Those who made spring cloth privately were confiscated and sent to the palace as slaves together with their wives and children; There were even more people who broke the law. When five people were seated in a row without entering the government office, the county prison car was locked and escorted to Zhongguan in Chang'an. Sixty-seven out of ten people died in pain.
target: Despite these measures, the people suffered, and many broke the law. Wang Mang executed those who made private coins and moved critics to remote areas.

source: Six years after making the cloth, the Huns invaded fiercely. Wang Mang recruited prisoners and slaves from all over the world on a large scale, called Zhu Tu Xi Yong. All taxes came from the palace residents, and he collected one-thirtieth of the property tax. He also ordered the ministers to the Huangshou officials in counties and counties to maintain the military horses. The officials transferred all the military horses to the people and asked them to maintain them. The people often violated the ban and were unable to farm and pick mulberry. The corvee was complicated and heavy, and there were droughts and locusts causing trouble. And because the system has not been established, no one from the princes to the petty officials can get their salaries, but they collect taxes privately, bribe their superiors, and do not deal with it tightly. Officials relied on harshness and cruelty to establish their authority, and with Wang Mang's ban, they invaded and plundered the weak common people. The rich cannot protect themselves, and the poor cannot survive, so they band together and become thieves. Depending on the dangers of the mountains and lakes, the officials cannot capture them and conceal the truth. Things get bigger and bigger, so there are often tens of thousands of people in Qing, Xu, Jingchu and other places.
target: The corvee was heavy, and droughts and locusts caused trouble. Officials collected taxes privately, and the rich could not protect themselves, leading to widespread banditry.

source: Those who died in wars, those who were captured by ethnic minorities along the border, those who broke the law, those who died of hunger and disease, and those who cannibalized people. In this way, before Wang Mang was killed, the household registration in the world had been reduced by half. Four years after the conquest of Zhutu Xiyong, the Han army killed Wang Mang. Two years later, Shizu accepted the destiny, eliminated the cumbersome and harsh criminal laws, restored the five-baht coin, and worked with the people of the world to eliminate the old and introduce the new.
target: The Han army killed Wang Mang four years after the conquest of Zhutu Xiyong. Two years later, Shizu restored the five-baht coin and eliminated harsh laws.

source: Praising: "Yi" said: "take out the more and give to the less, weigh the amount of material and then give it fairly", "Book" said "trade with or without", the Zhou Dynasty had the official position of Quanfu, and "Mencius" still criticized dogs and pigs when they eat human food, they don't know how to restrain themselves, and there are people who starve to death in the fields but they don't know how to open warehouses to relieve the people. Therefore, Guanzi's theories on commodities, currencies, and prices, Li Kui's Pingluo method, Sang Hongyang's adjustment of transportation to suppress prices, and Geng Shouchang's establishment of Changpingcang are all for a reason. It’s just that in ancient times, these things were done with moderation, the officials were good, and the laws were implemented, so the people relied on them to benefit, and the world was peaceful. By the time of Emperor Xiaowu, the country's expenses were abundant, and the people did not increase taxes, so their education was not good enough. By the time of Wang Mang, the system was out of whack, evildoers had the power, the officials and the people were being squeezed dry, and the education was even worse.
target: The text praises ancient methods of regulating commodities and prices, noting that during Emperor Xiaowu's time, expenses were met without increasing taxes, but under Wang Mang, the system failed, and the people suffered.

source: Emperor Xiaoai was the grandson of Emperor Yuan of the Han Dynasty and the son of Prince Dingtao Gong. The mother is Ding Ji. He became king at the age of three, and became interested in literature and law as an adult. In the fourth year of Yuanyan's reign, he went to the capital to see Emperor Cheng, and his Fu, Xiang, and lieutenants all came together. At this time, Emperor Cheng's younger brother, Prince Xiao of Zhongshan, also came to see him, but only Fu Tong came. The emperor was puzzled, so he asked King Dingtao. King Dingtao replied: "The imperial court has issued an order. When princes and kings come to court, their officials with a title of two thousand stones should come together." Fu, Xiang, and Lieutenant all have two thousand stones, so they should all come together. The emperor asked him to recite "Poetry", and he was familiar with it and could explain its meaning. Another day, Emperor Cheng asked King Zhongshan: "Which decree is it based on when Fu Tong comes?" King Zhongshan was speechless. I asked him to recite the Book of Documents, but he forgot about it again. Emperor Cheng invited him to dinner, but he was still eating after everyone else had finished. When he left the table, even his garter belt fell off. When Emperor Cheng saw this, he thought King Zhongshan was incompetent, but he liked King Dingtao very much and often praised his talents. At this time, Queen Mother Fu, the grandmother of King Dingtao, accompanied her to the court and privately presented gifts to Emperor Cheng's favorite Zhao Zhaoyi and his uncle, Hussar General and Quyanghou Wanggen. Zhao Zhaoyi and Wang Gen saw that the emperor had no children and wanted to establish a relationship with a suitable prince as soon as possible to maintain their long-term wealth, so they praised King Dingtao and persuaded Emperor Cheng to make him the prince. Emperor Cheng also admired King Dingtao's talents, so he held an adult crowning ceremony for him in the court and sent him back to his fiefdom, Dingtao. He was seventeen years old at this time. In the second year, the emperor sent Jinwu Renhong to act as Dahonglu. With the imperial edict, he summoned King Dingtao and established him as the crown prince. King Dingtao thanked Zhao and said: I am fortunate enough to inherit my late father's vassal status and become the prince of the vassals. However, my talents and virtues are not enough to enter the prince's palace. Your Majesty is holy, virtuous and generous. He respects his ancestors and obeys the gods. He deserves to be blessed by heaven and have many children and grandchildren. I would like to temporarily stay in the Kyoto residence and ask about the emperor's daily life in the morning and evening. After the emperor has a holy heir, he will return to the feudal state and guard the vassal. After the book was written, the emperor said that everything was known. More than a month later, an edict was issued to establish Liu Jing, the grandson of King Xiao of Chu, as King Dingtao, and to offer sacrifices to King Dingtao Gong. This was to reward the prince for paying attention to Zongtao's character. The specific records are in "Hanshu·Biography of Waiqi". In March of the second year of Suihe, Emperor Cheng died. On the fourth day of April, the prince became the emperor and paid a visit to the Temple of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty. Respect the Queen Mother as the Queen Mother and the Queen as the Queen Mother.
target: Emperor Xiaoai, grandson of Emperor Yuan and son of Prince Dingtao Gong, became king at age three and developed an interest in literature and law. In the fourth year of Yuanyan's reign, he visited Emperor Cheng with his officials, while Prince Xiao of Zhongshan came with only one attendant. Emperor Cheng, impressed by King Dingtao's knowledge of the "Poetry" and his explanations, favored him over the incompetent King Zhongshan. Queen Mother Fu, King Dingtao's grandmother, bribed Emperor Cheng's favorites Zhao Zhaoyi and Wang Gen, who, seeing the emperor had no heirs, praised King Dingtao. Emperor Cheng crowned him at seventeen and later made him crown prince. King Dingtao humbly declined but accepted. After Emperor Cheng's death in the second year of Suihe, the prince became emperor, honoring the Queen Mother and issuing amnesties. He honored his grandmother and mother, granted titles to relatives, and dismissed Yuefu for lewd music. He rewarded Wang Gen and others for supporting his succession and granted lands to Wang Liang for mourning.

source: No businessman is allowed to occupy land or serve as an official, and offenders will be punished according to law. Anyone whose land occupation and livestock and maidservants exceeded the quota were not included in the county magistrate's income. The fine embroidery woven by the officials and other officials in Qi San was stopped because it was too complex and too complex to be made, which would harm the female workers, and those that had already been made were not allowed to be presented. The law of appointing a son to be a husband after being appointed to the post of two thousand stone for three years and the law of defamation and false accusation were revoked. Those who live in the inner palace under the age of thirty can get married. Official slaves who are over fifty years old are exempted from the status of slaves and become commoners. The county is not allowed to offer rare birds and animals. Increase the salary of officials below three hundred stones. If the official who presided over the inspection was cruel and cruel, he was immediately removed from office when discovered. Relevant officials may not aggravate or pardon old cases that have been dealt with previously. When a doctor's disciple's parents die, they are given a three-year mourning period when they return home. In autumn, both Quyanghou Wanggen and Chengduhou Wangkuang were guilty. Wang Gen left the capital and went to the fiefdom. Wang Kuang reduced his position to serve as a civilian and returned to his hometown. The edict was issued: "I inherit the important task of unification, and I am afraid of losing my will." Recently, the sun and moon have lost their light, the five elements have lost their movement, and earthquakes often occur in the county. At the same time, the Yellow River burst in Henan and Yingchuan counties, drowning people and destroying houses. My virtue is shallow. I am deeply afraid that the people will suffer. Dr. Guanglu has been sent to inspect the disaster area to collect their names and give the deceased three thousand for the cost of the coffin. Flood-stricken counties and other counties and counties whose incomes have been reduced by more than 40% due to the disaster, and whose people's assets are less than 100,000 yuan, will be exempted from rent and taxes this year. In the first month of spring in the first year of Jianping, the world was pardoned. Zhao Xin, the Marquis of Xincheng, and Marquis of Chengyang, Zhao Yunjin, both of whom were guilty of the crime, were deposed as commoners and moved to western Liaoning. The Empress Dowager issued an edict saying: The Wang family's land, which is owned by my maternal relatives, is not a graveyard, and is all given to the poor for cultivation. In February, the emperor issued an edict saying: I have heard that the holy king was able to make the country peaceful and the people safe, and it was actually his ability to employ talented people. Now the imperial edict is issued to the Grand Sima, Lieutenants, Generals, Zhong Erqian Shi, Zhou Mu, Shou, etc. to recommend one person to each of them. In the third month, give the princes, princesses, princes, prime ministers, prime ministers, generals, two thousand stones in the middle, and money and cloth to the officials and officials in the capital, each with different levels. 冬季，中山孝王太后冯媛、太后弟宜乡侯冯参有罪，全都自杀了。 In the spring and March of the second year, the chief minister was dismissed and the imperial censor was restored. In April of summer, an edict was issued saying: According to the Han family system, the emperor's closest relatives should be treated with the utmost respect.
target: He issued edicts to curb extravagance, limiting land and slave ownership, banning merchants from land and office, and stopping complex embroidery. He revoked certain laws, allowed inner palace residents under thirty to marry, freed slaves over fifty, and banned rare animal tributes. He increased salaries for low-ranking officials and punished corrupt officials. After disasters like earthquakes and floods, he sent officials to aid victims and exempted taxes for the poor. In the first year of Jianping, he pardoned the world, deposed guilty marquises, and gave Wang family lands to the poor. He sought talent, granted money and cloth to officials, and saw the suicide of Empress Dowager Feng and her brother. In the second year, he dismissed the chief minister, restored the imperial censor, and honored his ancestors with new titles and temples.

source: Pardon the exiled criminals in the world. The state pastor was dismissed and the governor was restored. On the fifth day of June, Empress Dowager Ding passed away. The emperor said: I heard that the husband and wife are one. "Poetry" says: Life is different from the inner and outer rooms, and death is the same as the cave of the tomb. After the tomb of Ji Wuzi, the former Lu doctor, was built, his wife Du's funeral was under the west steps. The descendants requested to be buried together and got permission. The burial ceremony has been around since the Zhou Dynasty. Confucius said: The Zhou Dynasty’s ritual articles were so well prepared! I follow the Zhou etiquette. A filial son serves the dead as well as the living. The Empress Dowager should raise her mausoleum in Emperor Gong's cemetery. So Empress Dowager Ding was buried in Dingtao. Fifty thousand people from the nearby counties of Chenliu and Jiyin were recruited to dig the tomb and seal it with soil. Waiting for the imperial edict, Xia Heliang and others prophesied that Han Emperor Gaozu was the spirit of the Red Emperor, saying that the Han family was in decline and should receive destiny again and change its name to Yuan Yi.
target: After Empress Dowager Ding's death, he followed Zhou rites for burial, recruiting 50,000 workers. He initially accepted prophecies to change the era name but later revoked them, punishing the prophets and officials. He faced droughts, fires, and comets, restored sacrifices, and dealt with rebellions.

source: In the spring of four years, a severe drought occurred. According to folklore in Guandong, the Queen Mother of the West's magical plan was passed through the prefectures and states, and she entered the Guan in the west and reached Chang'an. 群众又聚集祭祀西王母，有的夜间持火上屋，击鼓号呼互相惊恐。 In February, the Empress Dowager conferred the title of Marquis of Ruchang on Fu Shang, a servant of her younger brother, and the title of Marquis of Yangxin on the servant Zheng Ye, the son of the Empress Dowager and her younger brother. In March, the prince-in-law Duwei Dong Xian, Guanglu doctor Xifu Gong, and Nanyang prefect Sun Chong were all named marquises for their merits in reporting on King Dongping. Their events are recorded in the "Biography of Dong Xian". In the fifth month of summer, you will be awarded with a title ranging from 2,000 to 600 stones and the rank of a noble man in the world. In June, the emperor's wife was honored as the emperor's wife. In autumn and August, a fire broke out at the north gate of Gonghuang Garden. In the winter, the general was ordered to give two thousand stones to recommend people who were familiar with the art of war and had strategies and considerations. On the first day of the first lunar month in the spring of the first year of Yuanshou, a partial solar eclipse occurred. The emperor issued an edict saying: I inherited the throne, but I am unclear and insensitive. I am worried and toiled late at night and have no time to rest.
target: He granted titles for reporting crimes, honored his wife, and sought military talent. In the first year of Yuanshou, a solar eclipse led to an edict blaming himself and seeking virtuous officials.

source: List my faults and tell them all. You can recommend one person each to the generals, princes, and two thousand stones who are virtuous, upright, and outspoken. Amnesty to the world. On the seventeenth day of the first lunar month, the Empress Dowager Fu passed away. In March, Prime Minister Wang Jia was found guilty and imprisoned to death. In the ninth month of autumn, Ding Ming, the hussar general of the Grand Sima, was dismissed from his post. The bronze turtle and snake on the temple door of Emperor Xiaoyuan and the head of the door shop make a sound. In the first month of the spring of the second year, Dakunmi, the grandson of Chanyu, king of the Xiongnu, came to court. In February, Shanyu was displeased when he returned home. The events are recorded in "The Biography of the Huns". On April 30th in summer, a partial solar eclipse occurred. In May, the three official duties were divided. General Dong Xian of the Great Sima Wei was the Great Sima, Prime Minister Kong Guang was the Great Situ, and the imperial censor Peng Xuan was the Great Sikong and was granted the title of Marquis Changping. Zheng Si Zhi and Si Li were created, and the post of Si Kou was created but has not yet been finalized. On the third day of June, Emperor Ai passed away in Weiyang Palace. On September 18th in autumn, he was buried in Yiling. Ban Gu commented: From being a vassal king to being established as a prince, Emperor Ai of the Han Dynasty was well-versed in literary diction and good at hearing at a young age. Witnessing that when Emperor Cheng of the Han Dynasty, all his titles and salary were transferred to the royal family, and power was transferred to the hands of his relatives, Emperor Ai repeatedly executed ministers in power, intending to strengthen his authority, and used Emperor Wu and Emperor Xuan as the law. He is not sensual by nature, and sometimes watches martial arts dramas involving hand-held wrestling. When he came to the throne, he suffered from fistula, which gradually worsened. He died after being emperor for six years at the age of 20. What a pity!
target: After Empress Dowager Fu's death, he dismissed officials and saw portents. In the second year, Xiongnu envoys visited, and he divided official duties. Emperor Ai died in Weiyang Palace at age 20 after six years as emperor, buried in Yiling. Ban Gu noted his early talent and efforts to strengthen authority but lamented his short reign.

source: Emperor Xuan of the Han Dynasty, great-grandson of Emperor Wu, and grandson of Prince Ru. Prince Ru took in Shi Liangdi and gave birth to Emperor Shi's grandson. His grandson took in Mrs. Wang and gave birth to Emperor Xuan, who was named Zenghuang's grandson. A few months after giving birth, a "witchcraft incident" occurred. The prince, Liang Di, the emperor's grandson, and Mrs. Wang were all killed. The facts are all recorded in "The Legend of the Prince". Even though his great-grandson was still an infant, he was imprisoned. At that time, Bingji was an official of Tingwei and was responsible for handling witchcraft incidents. He was extremely sympathetic to his great-grandson's innocent misfortune, so he ordered the female convicts Zhao Zhengqing from Huaiyang and Hu Zu from Weicheng to exchange breast-feeding and provide them with food and clothing privately. They treated him very kindly. The witchcraft incident could not be concluded for several years. In the second year of the Yuan Dynasty, Emperor Wu was ill and traveled back and forth between Changyang and Wuzha palaces. The astrologers who were watching the clouds said that there was the emperor's energy in Chang'an prison. Emperor Wu sent envoys to inform the various officials in the capital that criminals imprisoned due to witchcraft incidents would be executed regardless of their severity. The emissary ordered Guo Rang to go to the county prison at night for inspection. Bingji closed the prison door so that the envoys could not enter, but his great-grandson Lai Bingji was saved. Later, when there was a general amnesty, Bingji drove his great-grandson to his grandmother Shi Liangdi's home.
target: Emperor Xuan, great-grandson of Emperor Wu, was born into tragedy. His grandfather Prince Ru, grandmother Shi Liangdi, and parents were all killed in the "witchcraft incident" when he was an infant. Imprisoned, he was saved by official Bingji, who arranged for female convicts to nurse him. After a general amnesty, Bingji took him to his grandmother's home.

source: Later, when there was a general amnesty, Bingji drove his great-grandson to his grandmother Shi Liangdi's home. This incident is recorded in "Biography of Bingji" and "Biography of Foreign Relatives". Later, there was an edict, sending officials from Yeting to visit the great-grandson at the historian's home, and ordered Zongzheng to record him in the royal genealogy. At this time, Zhang He, the order of Yeting, was Prince Li's former attendant. He missed Prince Li's old kindness and sympathized with his great-grandson, so he treated his great-grandson considerately and used his personal money to support his great-grandson's education. When he was older, he married the daughter of Xu Guanghan, a court dyer, for his great-grandson. Therefore, his great-grandson relied on the Guanghan brothers and the Shi family of his grandmother's family. He returned from the East China Sea to learn "Poetry" from Zhong Weng. He was talented and never tired of learning. He also had the character of drawing a sword to help when the road was rough. He fought chickens and horses and made many friends. He was familiar with the evil in the alleys and the gains and losses of official governance. He visited the tombs of his ancestors many times to pay his respects, and went to the Sanfu District of Kyoto to understand the people's sentiments. He was once trapped and humiliated in the salt pond of Lianshao County, especially in Du County?
target: Later, Yeting official Zhang He, remembering his loyalty to Prince Li, supported the boy's education and arranged his marriage to Xu Guanghan's daughter. As he grew, Emperor Xuan studied poetry under Zhong Weng, showed talent, and became familiar with both common people's lives and official governance.

source: He visited the tombs of his ancestors many times to pay his respects, and went to the Sanfu District of Kyoto to understand the people's sentiments. He was once trapped and humiliated in the salt pond of Lianshao County, especially in Du County? He traveled between counties, mostly in Xiadu. He went to the imperial court to attend court invitations and lived in Shangguanli, Chang'an. He had hair all over his body and on his feet. He always glowed when sleeping. Every time he went to a bakery to buy cakes, the business of the bakery prospered. People were surprised by this. In April of the first year of Yuanping, Emperor Zhao died without any heirs. General Huo Guang asked the queen to summon the king of Changyi to be the emperor. On June 1, the king of Changyi received the emperor's jade seal and imperial robes, and honored the queen as the empress dowager. On June 28, Queen Huo Guangzou said that King Changyi had behaved lewdly and requested that he be abolished. This incident is recorded in "The Biography of King He of Changyi" and "The Biography of Huo Guang". In the seventh month of autumn, Huo Guang made a memorial and said: In the system of etiquette, people value blood relations, so they respect their ancestors, and if they respect their ancestors, they will respect their ancestors' cause. Emperor Zhao has no heirs, so he should choose a virtuous descendant as his successor.
target: He traveled extensively, visited ancestral tombs, and experienced hardship in Lianshao County. Strange phenomena surrounded him—his body glowed during sleep, and bakeries prospered when he visited. When Emperor Zhao died without heirs, General Huo Guang initially appointed the King of Changyi, but soon deposed him for lewd behavior. Huo Guang then recommended Emperor Xuan, then eighteen, citing his virtue, education, and suitability. The Empress Dowager agreed, and after proper ceremonies, he ascended the throne.

source: The Queen Mother agreed. Zongzheng and Liu De were sent to his great-grandson Shang Guanli's residence to wash his clothes and give him royal clothes. The imperial servants used Lanyu light carriages to greet his great-grandson. He first went to Zongzheng's mansion to fast and salute. On July 25, he entered Weiyang Palace and met with the Empress Dowager. He was first granted the title of Marquis of Yangwu. Later, the county officials presented the national treasure seal and succeeded to the emperor's throne. Jin visited Gaomiao. On the fifth day of August, Prime Minister Yang Chang passed away. In September, there is a general amnesty. On November 19, Queen Xu was established. Money is given to all princes and kings below, and there are certain rewards from officials and people to widows and widowers. The Empress Dowager entered Changle Palace and began to set up garrison guards. In the first month of the spring of the first year of this year, officials from the county and state were recruited and moved to Pingling, the tomb of Emperor Zhao, with assets of more than one million. An envoy was sent to hold the imperial talisman and tell the two thousand stones of the prefecture and the country to manage the government carefully and to educate the people with virtue. 大将军霍光向宣帝叩请还政于君，宣帝谦让再三，仍委霍光以大任。 In terms of rewards for meritorious service, the general Huo Guang was granted the title of 17,000 households, including General Chariot and Cavalry, Guang Luxun, Marquis Fuping, and Anshi Wanhu.
target: Emperor Xuan's reign was marked by careful governance. He initially declined Huo Guang's offer to return power, entrusting him with major responsibilities. He rewarded meritorious officials generously, including Huo Guang, Yang Chang, and others. He issued edicts promoting agriculture, reducing waste, and caring for the poor.

source: On April 29th in the summer, there were forty-nine earthquakes in the county, and landslides and floods occurred in some places. The edict was issued: "The occurrence of any disaster is a warning from heaven and earth." I inherited the great cause, enshrined the ancestral temple, and ruled over the subjects, but failed to be virtuous. Therefore, the Beihai and Langwangya earthquakes destroyed the ancestral temple. I was deeply frightened. The Prime Minister, Yu Shiqi, the princes, Zhong Erqianshi and knowledgeable people put forward suggestions for censorship and eradication of foreign affairs in order to correct my bad behavior. Order Sanfu, Taichang, and Zhongyuan County to each recommend a virtuous and upright person. Some laws and regulations that cause difficulties and inconveniences to the people can be eliminated. I hope they will be mentioned separately. If the damage caused by the earthquake is serious, the rent will be exempted. An amnesty was announced for the whole world. Because the ancestral temple was destroyed by the earthquake, the emperor wore plain clothes and avoided the main hall for five days to express his heavy heart.
target: When earthquakes struck, he wore plain clothes, avoided the main hall, and sought advice from officials.

source: On the eighth day of March in the second year of spring, Huo Guang, the great general of Sima, passed away. The edict states: The Great Sima General Bo Luhou has been with Emperor Xiaowu for more than thirty years, and has assisted Emperor Xiaozhao for more than ten years. He has been loyal to the country many times, and led the Sangong, Jiuqing, officials and other ministers to formulate long-term peace and stability strategies to stabilize the ancestral temple and bring peace to the people of the world.
target: After Huo Guang's death, Emperor Xuan took personal control of government. He established regular reporting systems and tested officials' abilities.

source: This resulted in the imperial court having complete facilities and adequate staffing. The top and bottom are of one heart and one mind, and there is no intention of settling down. In the spring and March of the third year, an edict was issued saying: It has been said that meritorious deeds are not rewarded, and crimes are not punished. Even the emperors of the Tang Dynasty, Yao, Yu and Shun could not transform the world with virtue. Today, Wang Cheng, the Prime Minister of Jiaodong, warmly receives and properly resettles the refugees, so that more than 80,000 refugees have registered their registered residence in Jiaodong. His political achievements are different from those of ordinary people. Now Wang Cheng's salary has been raised to two thousand dan and he has been given the title of Marquis of Guannei. The edict also said: The widowed, lonely, elderly and poor people are the people I have the most sympathy and concern for. In the past, edicts were issued to lend public fields, seeds, and grain rations. Now I will give silk to the widowed and lonely old man. Erqianshi officials should strictly require their staff to pay serious attention to them and not let them lose their regular jobs. Let the Zhongyuan County appoint virtuous and upright people who can go deep among the people and understand the people's sentiments. On the 22nd day of the fourth lunar month in the summer, the Crown Prince was established and the whole country was granted amnesty. He was given the title of Marquis of Guannei, the imperial censor, and the right concubine of the middle two thousand stone ranks. As his father's heir, he was promoted to the first rank in the world.
target: He promoted virtuous officials like Wang Cheng, who resettled refugees. He established the Crown Prince and granted amnesties.

source: The edict said: If we guide the people to put filial piety first, then the world will be harmonious. Nowadays, people sometimes suffer the death of their parents and have to bear the burden of corvee labor, which prevents their parents' bodies from being buried on time, which hurts the filial piety. I deeply sympathize with this. From now on, those whose grandparents or parents are bereaved can be exempted from corvee service, so that they can carry out the funeral procession and carry out the way of the Son of Man. In the fifth month of the Xia Dynasty, an edict was issued saying: The relationship between father and son and the relationship between husband and wife are due to nature. Although there is danger, he is still willing to sacrifice his life and take risks to save others. Sincere love is born in the heart, kindness comes from nature, this is impossible to violate! From now on, parents whose sons hide crimes, husbands whose wives hide crimes, and grandparents whose grandsons hide crimes can be exempted from guilt.
target: He reformed laws to protect filial piety, allowing parents to hide children's crimes and exempting mourners from corvée labor.

source: In the seventh month of autumn, the great Sima Huo Yu rebelled. The edict said: In the former case, Dongzhishi ordered Zhang She to send Li Jing, a wealthy family in Wei County, to report Huo Yun, the Marquis of Guanyang, for treason. I remembered the achievements of General Huo Guang and wanted to make the big thing a trivial matter and urge Huo Yu to change his mind. Now the great Sima Bo, Lu Hou Huo Yu, his mother, Mrs. Xuancheng Hou, and their disciples from Kun, Guanyang Hou Huoyun, Leping Hou Huoshan, their sisters-in-law, General Fan Mingyou of the Liao Dynasty, Changxin Shaofu Deng Guanghan, Zhonglang General Ren Sheng, Cavalry Captain Zhao Ping, Chang'an man Feng Yin and others conspired to commit treason and injustice. Huo Yu's mother also ordered the female maid Chunyu Yan to poison Gong Ai with medicine, and then planned to poison the prince in order to usurp the power of the Han family. Those who are rebellious and disobedient have all obeyed the law. All ordinary participants who were deceived and threatened by Huo without specific criminal facts will be pardoned. On the first day of August, Queen Huo was deposed.
target: The Huo family later rebelled, and Queen Huo was deposed after being implicated in poisoning plots.

source: This is the reason why the late emperor attached great importance to punishment, but some legal officials failed to understand his meaning deeply. Some of those arrested and imprisoned today were severely tortured, and some died in prison due to torture from hunger and cold. Why is it so cruel and inhumane! I am very sad about this. The county is now ordered to report the names, place of origin, title, and residential addresses of those who died in prison due to torture, starvation, and cold every year. The Prime Minister and Censor must report this to the court as an important event at the end of the year.
target: Emperor Xuan continued his reforms, lowering salt prices, improving prison conditions, and requiring annual reports of deaths in custody.

source: I changed the original name from "I'm sick" to "Inquiry". Anyone who has violated taboos before this edict and is guilty will be forgiven. In winter, Zhao Guanghan, the king of Jingzhao, was found guilty and had his head cut in half. In the spring of the third year, because the phoenix gathered on Mount Tai many times, the princes, prime ministers, generals, princes, two thousand stones and gold were rewarded, and the ministers and officials were rewarded with silk, each with different rewards. Reward the officials of the world with the second rank and the common people with the first rank. Women will be rewarded with a certain amount of cattle and wine for every 100 households, and widows and widowers will be given a certain amount of silk for their senior years. In March, an edict was issued saying: I heard that Shun's younger brother Xiang was guilty, and Shun became emperor and granted him the title of "Bi". The closeness of flesh and blood is clear and unbroken, and now the late King of Changyi is granted the title of Marquis of Haihun. He also issued an edict saying: When I was in a humble state, the imperial censor Bingji, Zhonglang generals Shi Zeng and Shi Xuan, Changle guard Xu Shun, and the attendant Guanglu doctor Xu Yanshou all had old favors for me. Also, Zhang He, the late Yeting magistrate, taught me Gong to study literature and classics. He was very kind and his contribution was very great.
target: He built tombs, established temples, and rewarded those who had helped him in his youth, including Bingji, Zhang He, and the female convicts who nursed him.

source: I am not virtuous, so I may not be able to live up to God’s expectations. Five years is now regarded as the first year of Shenjue. Give the world a second-level nobility for those who are diligent in official affairs, a first-level commoner, a number of oxen and wine for women from hundreds of households, and a certain amount of silk for widowers and lonely seniors. The money and materials borrowed for relief will be exempted. There is no land rent in the land I pass through. The Western Qiang rebelled, recruiting light-sentenced prisoners from the Sanfu and Zhongdu prisons, as well as agile archers, Yulin orphans, Hu and Yue horses, officials from Sanhe, Yingchuan, Peijun, Huaiyang, and Runan, knights from Jincheng, Longxi, Tianshui, Anding, Beidi, and Shangjun, and horses from the Qiang region, all gathered in Jincheng. In the fourth month of summer, General Zhao Chongguo and Qiannu General Xu Yanshou were dispatched to attack the Western Qiang. In June, a comet appeared in the east. On the spot, Xin Wuxian, the prefect of Jiuquan, was granted the title of General Po Qiang, and he advanced with General Hou and General Qiannu. The edict was issued: "The military journey is hard, and the transportation of military supplies is troublesome. We now order all princes, princes, barbarian princes and princes who are due to come to court in the first month of next year to be exempted from the court." In autumn, the son of the late great minister Nong Zhuyi was given a hundred catties of gold as a sacrifice to his father. Later general Zhao Chongguo wrote a letter proposing the strategy of farming in the frontier fortress, which was recorded in the "Biography of Zhao Chongguo". In the spring and February of the second year, an edict was issued saying: On the 19th day of the first lunar month the day before yesterday, phoenixes and nectar descended on the capital, followed by tens of thousands of birds. I have no great virtues, but I have repeatedly received blessings from heaven. I deeply feel the grace of heaven and forgive the world. In the fifth month of summer, the Xiqiang surrendered and beheaded the evil tycoon Yang Yu and Chief Fei. The vassal state of Jincheng was established to accommodate the surrendered Qiang. In the autumn, the Huns chased the king and the sages, and brought more than ten thousand people to surrender. Zheng Ji, the captain of the cavalry commander of the Western Regions, was sent to meet the king of Sun Zhu, and defeated the chariot division. They were all made marquises. In September, Sili Xiaowei was spared the crime, thrown into prison, and committed suicide. The Xiongnu Chanyu sent famous kings to the Han Dynasty to offer congratulations on the first month and start the marriage process.
target: Under his rule, the Xiongnu were pacified. Huhanxie Chanyu submitted as a vassal, visiting the court with great ceremony. Emperor Xuan treated him as a guest, rewarding him generously and establishing protectorates for surrendered tribes. The Western Qiang were subdued through military campaigns and farming strategies proposed by General Zhao Chongguo.

source: The emperor held a welcome banquet in Jianzhang Palace to honor Shan Yu. And let Shanyu visit the treasures of the Han Dynasty. In February, Shanyu returned westward after completing his congratulatory mission. The imperial court sent a guard of 16,000 people led by Changle Guards Gaochanghou Dong Zhong, Chariot and Cavalry Commanders Han Chang, and Cavalry Commanders Wei Hu to escort Shan Yu. Shanyu lived in the south of Mu and was stationed in Guanglu City. The imperial edict was issued to the north to support its grain supply. Zhizhi Shanyu was isolated and fled far away, and the Xiongnu became stable from then on. Emperor Xuan issued an edict saying: The former phoenix gathered in Xincai, surrounded by tens of thousands of birds, all standing in awe of the phoenix.
target: Emperor Xuan died in Weiyang Palace after a reign marked by competent administration, military success, and cultural achievements.

source: The personnel, household registration, and tax information reported to the court were inconsistent with the facts and were lied to avoid prosecution. Sangong doesn't care about this. How will I know the true and credible situation? Any requests to reduce the number of followers and officers and use their expenses to support themselves will no longer be implemented. When the censor finds something suspicious when reviewing the materials reported from various places, he must conduct verification and cannot allow the false to be confused with the true. In March, a comet appeared between Wangliangxing and Gedao star areas, and then entered the Purple Palace star area. In April of Xia, an edict was issued saying: The purpose of recommending honest officials is to promote honesty and integrity. Officials with six hundred stones are regarded as officials. When handling cases, they must first seek instructions from the court, and their rank and salary are determined by the court. From now on, officials with six hundred stones cannot be promoted to honest officials. On the seventh day of the twelfth lunar month in winter, Emperor Xuan died in Weiyang Palace. On the 26th, the Queen Mother was honored as the Queen Mother. Ban Gu commented: When Emperor Xuan of the Han Dynasty governed the country, meritorious deeds must be rewarded, and guilty deeds must be punished. Comprehensive examination of names and facts shows that people in politics, literature, and jurisprudence can be proficient in their professions and exert their expertise. As for the skills of craftsmen and tools, few can match them since the reign of Emperor Yuan and Emperor Cheng. From this we can see that in the era of Emperor Xuan, officials were competent in their duties and the people were in peace with their jobs. Being invaded by the Xiongnu, the Huhanxie Chanyu could come to the court, the Zhizhi Chanyu could escape far away, Shen Tianwei could be seen in the Northern Yi, and the Chanyu Muyi could bow his head and declare himself a vassal. The ancestor of the Gongguang clan, whose career is passed down to his heirs, can be said to be the master of Zhongxing, and his virtues are comparable to those of Emperor Gaozong of Yin and King Xuan of Zhou.
target: Ban Gu commented that he rewarded merit, punished guilt, and examined names and facts thoroughly, making officials proficient in their duties and people content in their work. His reign was considered a restoration, with virtues comparable to those of King Xuan of Zhou.

source: Emperor Xiaocheng was the prince of Emperor Yuan. His mother was Empress Wang. When Emperor Yuan was the crown prince, he was born into the emperor in the colorful painting hall of the palace and became his direct grandson. Emperor Xuan liked him very much and named him Taisun. He often placed him under his knees. When he was three years old, his grandfather Emperor Xuan died. Emperor Yuan succeeded to the throne and Emperor Cheng made him the prince. As an adult, he likes to read scriptures, be broad-minded and cautious. He used to live in Guigong, but Emperor Yuan sometimes summoned him urgently. When the prince left the Dragon Tower Gate, he did not dare to cross the emperor's galloping road. He went west to Zhicheng Gate, crossed in front of the city gate, and then turned back to Zuoshimen. Emperor Yuan saw that he was late and asked why. Emperor Cheng told him that he did not dare to cross the Emperor's Chi Road and had to take a detour. Emperor Yuan was very happy and ordered that the Prince could cross the Chi Road. Later, Emperor Yuan thought he was incompetent because he was fond of drinking and enjoying himself. Emperor Yuan decided that Prince Tao Gong was versatile and his mother, Fu Zhaoyi, was favored. Emperor Yuan wanted to make Prince Gong the crown prince. Lai Shizhong Shi Xian protected the prince's family and provided strong assistance. Emperor Xuan of the Yuan Dynasty was spared from deposing because Emperor Xuan was particularly fond of the prince.
target: Emperor Xiaocheng, the son of Emperor Yuan and Empress Wang, was born while his father was crown prince and was greatly favored by his grandfather, Emperor Xuan, who named him Taisun. After Emperor Xuan’s death, Emperor Yuan ascended the throne and made him crown prince. As an adult, he was studious, broad-minded, and cautious. Once, when summoned urgently by his father, he avoided crossing the emperor’s road, taking a detour instead, which pleased Emperor Yuan, who then allowed him to cross. Despite later concerns over his drinking and pleasure-seeking, Emperor Yuan considered deposing him in favor of Prince Tao Gong, but was dissuaded by Shi Xian and the memory of Emperor Xuan’s affection.

source: In May of the first year of Jingning, Emperor Yuan died. On June 22, the prince ascended the throne and paid homage to Gaozu Temple. The empress dowager is respected as the empress dowager, and the empress is the empress dowager. Wang Feng, the Marquis of Yangping, the imperial uncle's imperial guard, was appointed as the Grand Sima and the Grand General, and was in charge of the secretarial affairs. On July 28, relevant personnel stated: It is indecent to be buried with chariots, cattle, horses, and animals and should not be buried with them. Emperor Cheng agreed. In July, there is a general amnesty. On the first day of the first lunar month of the first year of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the emperor's great ancestor mourned a fire in the temple. He made Kuling Liang, the brother of the deceased King of Hejian, the king of Shangjun. A comet appears in the camp star area. He was dismissed from Shanglin and sentenced to prison. In February, when the right general Shi Yao Yin and others were on their way back from an envoy to the Huns, more than a hundred miles away from the frontier fortress, they suddenly encountered a storm and fire, which burned Yao Yin and seven others to death. The princes, prime ministers, generals, princes, queen mothers, princesses, royal lords, and officials were rewarded with two thousand stones of gold. The officials of the clan were given less than one thousand stones to two hundred stones. The men of the clan who were famous in the genealogy, the three elders, the filial piety, the fields, the widows and the widows were all rewarded with money and silk, each with different levels. Fifty households of officials and people were rewarded with some cattle and wine. The edict was issued: Fire fell in the ancestral temple, a comet appeared in the east, and God warned me when I ascended the throne. My fault was serious! "Shangshu" says: In ancient times, when a wise king encountered disaster, he corrected his virtues and behaved according to the celestial phenomena. I hope that all the ministers will work tirelessly and lead the staff to supplement my shortcomings. Advocate tolerance, promote harmony, treat others favorably, and don't be harsh on others. Now a general amnesty is being granted to the whole world, so that the criminals can rehabilitate themselves. He conferred the title of Marquis of Ancheng to his uncles, Guanglu Dafu, and Guannei Marquis Wang Chong.
target: Upon Emperor Yuan’s death in the first year of Jingning, the prince ascended the throne, honoring his mother and grandmother as empress dowagers. He appointed his uncle Wang Feng as Grand Marshal and Grand General, overseeing secretarial affairs. He agreed to stop burying chariots and animals with the dead, granted a general amnesty, and faced various omens: a fire in the ancestral temple, a comet, and a storm that killed envoy Yao Yin.

source: Let's go to the Sixth Stable and the Skill Officer. In summer, a severe drought occurred. Wang Yu of Dongping was guilty and had his enfeoffment of Fan and Kangfu counties reduced. In autumn, Prince Bowang Garden was revoked and given to the clan who came to Beijing to invite him. Reduce the number of horses the emperor rides on. In the spring and March of the third year, all prisoners in the world were pardoned. He was awarded the second level of filial piety and land title, and the relief loan given to those who fled were exempted. In autumn, there is a flood in the pass. In the seventh month, Chen Chigong, a young girl from Mi Shang, heard that the flood was coming. She walked into the Hengcheng Gate, broke into the side door of the palace, and went to the official residence of Weiyang Palace. The officials and the people all rushed to the city. In September, an edict was issued saying: The former county suffered from floods and thousands of people drowned.
target: He rewarded officials and the people, issued an edict acknowledging his faults, and promoted tolerance.

source: I hope that all the ministers will work tirelessly and lead the staff to supplement my shortcomings. Advocate tolerance, promote harmony, treat others favorably, and don't be harsh on others. Now a general amnesty is being granted to the whole world, so that the criminals can rehabilitate themselves. He conferred the title of Marquis of Ancheng to his uncles, Guanglu Dafu, and Guannei Marquis Wang Chong. His uncles Wang Tan, Wang Shang, Wang Li, Wang Gen and Wang Fengshi were given the title of Marquis of Guannei. In the summer of April, with the yellow mist all around, I asked the ministers and officials extensively, hoping that nothing could be hidden.
target: He granted titles to his uncles and faced natural phenomena like yellow mist, swarms of flies, and a shooting star.

source: If the number is more than 300,000, they will be given the rank of five officials, the officials who were already officials will be promoted to the second level, and the ordinary people will be supplemented by the rank of Langguan. Those with a number of more than 100,000 will be exempted from rent for three years. Those with more than 10,000 yuan will be exempted from rent for one year. In the eleventh month of winter, I came to Yongdi and offered sacrifices to the five emperors. In December, an edict was issued saying: General Xie Wannian, who had been a master craftsman for ten thousand years, knew that the terrain of Changling was low and could not be used as the emperor's mausoleum, but he petitioned to build a mausoleum here and build a city to support the mausoleum. He acted cunningly and deceitfully, transporting earth from other places to raise the foundation, wasting money and manpower, rushing to get started, and eager for success, so that the soldiers who participated in the construction were tortured and caused a large number of deaths. The people were extremely tired and the treasury was depleted. Wang Hong, the constant servant, was the chief minister of Nongzhongcheng before. He reported many times that Changling could not be built. Lieutenant Chun Yuchang suggested several times that the construction should be stopped as soon as possible and the relocated households should be returned to their original places.
target: In subsequent years, he conducted suburban sacrifices, established Queen Xu, and dealt with droughts, floods, and rebellions. He reduced taxes, pardoned prisoners, and encouraged agriculture. He faced earthquakes, solar eclipses, and a comet, issuing edicts to seek advice and reform. He moved wealthy households to Changling, deposed Queen Xu, and suppressed uprisings like Zheng Gong’s rebellion. He stopped the costly Changling project, punished the architect Xie Wannian, and rewarded those who advised against it. He continued to face disasters, including fires and floods, and issued edicts against extravagance.

source: The dew fell on the capital, and the people of Chang'an were rewarded with cattle and wine. In the first month of spring in the first year of Suihe, a general amnesty was granted to the whole world. On the 9th day of the second lunar month, an edict was issued saying: I have inherited Taizu's great legacy and have been worshiping the ancestral temple for twenty-five years. My virtue is not enough to stabilize the world. There are many people who are resentful and resentful. I have offended God. I have not yet given birth to a prince, and the world has no core to look up to. Judging from the historical lessons of the past and present, the origin of disasters is often caused by the issue of successors. Wang Xin of Dingtao is my heir. He is kind and filial. He can inherit the order of heaven and continue the sacrifice. Now it is decided to make Xin the crown prince. He granted the title of Marquis of Yixiang to the uncle of the King of Zhongshan, admonishing the official Feng Shen, and increased the number of households in Zhongshan by 30,000 to appease him. The princes and princes were rewarded with gold, and the heirs of the father in the world were given titles, three elders, filial piety, and fields. The rewards were different. The edict also said: I have heard that the king must preserve the descendants of the two kings of the previous dynasty, together with the current king himself, to symbolize the three unities of heaven, earth and man. In the past, King Tang of Shang founded the country as emperor and listed the Xia, Shang and Zhou dynasties, but later the sacrifices were abolished. According to the current examination of his descendants, only Kong Ji is the righteous one, and Kong Ji is specially named the Jiahou of Yin Shao. In the third month, Jijue of Jin Kong was made a duke, and Tong and Zhou Chengxiu were both dukes, with jurisdiction over hundreds of miles each. He came to Yongdi and offered sacrifices to the five emperors. In the fourth month of summer, the General Hussars of the Great Sima was appointed as the Great Sima, and the general officer was dismissed. The imperial censor was named Da Sikong and was granted the title of Liehou. With the increase of Da Sima, Da Sikong's salary is the same as that of the Prime Minister. On the ninth day of the eighth lunar month in autumn, Liu Xing, king of Zhongshan, passed away. In the eleventh month of winter, Liu Jing, the grandson of King Xiao of Chu, was appointed King of Dingtao. Chunyu, the Marquis of Dingling, grew up disobedient and was sentenced to death in prison. Tingwei Kong Guang gave poisonous wine to the deposed queen Xu as an envoy, and he died after drinking the wine. In December, he dismissed the governor of the Ministry and established the state pastoral office, with a salary of 2,000 shi. On February 13th, Prime Minister Zhai Fangjin passed away. On March 18, Emperor Cheng died in Weiyang Palace. The Empress Dowager ordered relevant agencies to restore the northern and southern suburbs of Chang'an. On April 11, he was buried in Yanling.
target: He appointed Liu Xin of Dingtao as crown prince, granted titles to descendants of previous dynasties, and reorganized offices. He died in Weiyang Palace and was buried in Yanling.

source: I hope that all the ministers will work tirelessly and lead the staff to supplement my shortcomings. Advocate tolerance, promote harmony, treat others favorably, and don't be harsh on others. He conferred the title of Marquis of Ancheng to his uncles, Guanglu Dafu, and Guannei Marquis Wang Chong. His uncles Wang Tan, Wang Shang, Wang Li, Wang Gen and Wang Fengshi were given the title of Marquis of Guannei. In the summer of April, with the yellow mist all around, I asked the ministers and officials extensively, hoping that nothing could be hidden.
target: Ban Gu noted his dignified appearance, knowledge, and eloquence, but lamented his indulgence in drink and women, leading to the rise of the Wang family and Wang Mang’s eventual usurpation.

source: Emperor Xiaowen was the fourth son of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty, and his mother was Bo Ji. In the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, Chen Xi was executed and the Dai territory was pacified. He made him the Dai king and made his capital Zhongdu. In the autumn of the seventeenth year of King Dai's reign, Empress Lu passed away, and Zhu Lu planned a coup to seize Liu Han's power. Prime Minister Chen Ping, Taiwei Zhou Bo, Zhu Xuhou Liu Zhang and others jointly killed the Lu family and discussed the appointment of the acting king Liu Heng as the emperor. The historical events are recorded in "Book of Han·Gao Hou Ji and Gao Wu Wang Biography". The ministers sent people to greet the king. After deliberation, Zhang Wu, the king's lieutenant, said: The ministers of the Han Dynasty are all veteran generals from the time of Emperor Gao. They are familiar with military affairs and well versed in intrigues and tricks. In their hearts, they are not satisfied with their current status. They are just afraid of the majesty of Emperor Gao and Empress Lu. Now that Zhu Lu has been executed and blood has been spilled in the capital, it is unbelievable to welcome the king to the capital in the name of proclaiming himself emperor. I hope your Majesty will not go there on the grounds of illness, so as to observe changes in the situation. Lieutenant Song Chang added: Their comments are wrong. The Qin Dynasty was in disarray, heroes arose, and there were no less than ten thousand people who wanted to replace the Qin Dynasty and claim the title of emperor in the south. However, in the end, only the Liu family was able to rule the world. People in the world who harbored evil thoughts were desperate. This was one of them. Emperor Gao made his children kings, and the fiefdoms were intertwined. This became a rock-like core. The world obeyed Liu Han's strength. This was the second one. The establishment of the Han Dynasty abolished the harshness of the Qin Dynasty, reduced punishments, extended kindness and benefits, and made everyone feel at ease, which won the hearts of the people. With the majesty of the Empress Dowager Lu, she established Zhu Lu as the three kings and was good at despotic power. However, the Taiwei Zhou Bo entered the Northern Army with a talisman and called on the soldiers to support the Liu family and oppose Zhu Lu. As a result, the Lu family was wiped out. This shows that Liu Han's regime was given by heaven and could not be changed by a few manpower. Nowadays, although some ministers want to launch a coup, the people are unwilling to listen to them. Can they achieve their goals by relying on a small number of his party members? Inside Kyoto, there is the unity of Zhu Xuhou and Dongmuhou, and outside there are the powers of Wu, Chu, Huainan, Langwangya, Qi and Dai. Nowadays, the only sons of Emperor Gao are the King of Huainan and you, the king. The king lives long, is a sage, benevolent and filial, and is famous all over the world. Therefore, the ministers in the court obey the wishes of the people and want to welcome the king, so the king does not have to worry. Reporting to the Queen Mother on behalf of the king, it was difficult to make a decision for a while. Then he asked someone to divine, and he got a great omen. The fortune teller said: Great, Gengen, I am the king of heaven, Xia Qiguang Zong Yaozu. Dai Wang said: I am already a king, so why do I need to add a king's title?
target: Emperor Xiaowen, the fourth son of Emperor Gaozu of Han, was made King of Dai after the execution of Chen Xi. Following Empress Lu’s death, the Lu clan plotted to seize power but were killed by ministers Chen Ping, Zhou Bo, and others, who then decided to welcome King Dai as emperor. King Dai hesitated, with advisor Zhang Wu warning that the ministers were veteran generals skilled in intrigue and might not be trustworthy. However, Song Chang argued that the Han dynasty’s stability, the people’s loyalty to Liu, and the failure of the Lu clan’s usurpation proved divine support for Liu rule. After divination yielded a favorable omen, King Dai sent Bo Zhao to verify the ministers’ intentions. Zhou Bo confirmed their sincerity, and King Dai proceeded to Chang’an. At Weiqiao, Zhou Bo offered the imperial seal, but King Dai declined, insisting on discussing the matter at the palace. The ministers formally petitioned him to accept the throne, citing his lineage as Emperor Gaozu’s son. After three refusals, he agreed and became emperor.

source: Five days of gathering and drinking are a joy. On the second day of the tenth winter in the first year of Emperor Wen's reign, the emperor met with his ministers at the Gaozu Temple. Sent Chariot General Bo Zhao to Daidi to welcome the Empress Dowager to Beijing. The edict said: In the past, Lu Chan proclaimed himself the prime minister, and Lu Lu was the general. He sent General Guan Ying to lead an army to attack in an attempt to replace Liu Han. General Guan stopped his troops in Xingyang and conspired with the princes to kill the Lu family. Lu Chan wanted to usurp the throne, so Prime Minister Chen Ping, Lieutenant Zhou Bo and others conspired to seize the Northern Army controlled by Lu Chan.
target: Upon ascending the throne, Emperor Wen issued a general amnesty, rewarded those who had suppressed the Lu clan, and restored lands taken by the Lu family. He abolished the Qin law of collective punishment.

source: The princes, princes, and princes who began to receive feudal states also became the ancestors of the feudal states. Succession by descendants from generation to generation is a universal justice. Therefore, Emperor Gaozu established a prince to stabilize the world. It was not Emperor Gao's original intention to give up on the task of establishing a son as prince today and instead choose him from among the princes and clans. It would be inappropriate to elect another person. Prince Qi is the eldest son, kind and generous, so he asks the emperor to make him the crown prince. The emperor finally agreed. Therefore, the people of the world should be given the title of nobility as their father's heirs. General Bo Zhao was granted the title of Marquis of Zhi. In March, the relevant officials asked for the establishment of a queen, and the Empress Dowager said: Make Dou, the mother of the crown prince, the queen. Emperor Wen issued an edict saying: When the spring breeze is gentle, flying animals, plants and other things have the joy of revival. However, the widowed, lonely and poor among our people may be struggling on the edge of death without receiving care and warmth. How can we, as parents of the people, feel at ease? Relief should be discussed. The edict also said: The old man will not be warm if he does not wear a cotton-padded jacket, and he will not be full if he does not eat meat.
target: When officials urged him to appoint a crown prince, he initially declined, citing his own unworthiness and suggesting a virtuous successor from among his relatives or ministers. After repeated requests, he appointed his eldest son, Prince Qi, as crown prince. He also established his consort Dou as empress. The emperor implemented benevolent policies, including tax relief for farmers, care for the elderly, and pardons for minor offenses. He abolished the crime of slander and attempted treason, emphasizing the importance of agriculture and reducing government expenditures.

source: Qihou Zanhe was made a general and sent reinforcements to Xingyang. In the seventh month of autumn, the emperor went from Taiyuan to Chang'an and issued an edict saying: The king of Jibei betrayed the court and harmed the officials and people, and he was the chief culprit. The officials and people in Jibei who planned to submit to the imperial court before the official troops arrived, or who submitted their army, city, or city to the official troops, would be pardoned and allowed to remain in office. Those who are related to Wang Xingju of Jibei will also be pardoned. In August, he captured Xingju, the king of Jibei, and Xingju committed suicide. Those who participated in the Xingju rebellion were pardoned. In the winter of December of the fourth year of Emperor Wen's reign, Prime Minister Guan Ying passed away. In the fifth month of summer, the Liu family of the same clan as Liu Han was exempted from taxes and servitude, and nothing was given to his family. Grant the princes and princes food and towns to each of 2,000 households. In the ninth month of autumn, seven princes named Hui Hui of Qi were made marquises. Jianghou Zhou Bo was guilty and was imprisoned in Tianlao after his arrest. The small and humble Gu Cheng Temple was built. In the spring and February of the fifth year, there was an earthquake. In April of summer, the order for stealing money was abolished and private coining was allowed. The four-baht coin was re-minted. In the winter of the sixth year, in October, the peaches and plums bloomed. In November, the king of Huainan rebelled, deposed the throne and was exiled to Yandao, Shu. He died in Yongdi on the way. In the winter and tenth month of the seventh year, it was ordered that the wives, wives, princes and officials of the princes and officials should not be searched without permission.
target: During his reign, Emperor Wen faced challenges such as the rebellion of King Xingju of Jibei, which was swiftly suppressed, and conflicts with the Xiongnu, whom he managed through defense rather than costly campaigns. He promoted frugality, wearing simple clothes and forbidding lavish decorations. He also reformed the legal system, abolished corporal punishment, and encouraged the recommendation of virtuous officials. In his later years, he issued an edict on his deathbed, advocating simple funerals and urging the people not to mourn excessively.

source: Ba Lingchuan Mountain should be built according to its original appearance, and no new tombs should be built. Everyone from the palace ladies to the following were sent home. The lieutenant Zhou Yafu was appointed as the general of chariots and cavalry, the subordinate Guohan was appointed as the general of generals and generals, and the doctor ordered Zhang Wu to be the general of restoring the mausoleum. Sixteen thousand soldiers from nearby counties and 15,000 internal soldiers were recruited, and handed over to General Zhang Wu for digging tombs and backfilling. Give a certain amount of money and silk to each person from the prince level to those who are filial and loyal to Litian. On the seventh day of June, he was buried in Ba Ling.
target: He was buried in Ba Ling with minimal ceremony, using earthenware vessels and no precious metals.

source: Give a certain amount of money and silk to each person from the prince level to those who are filial and loyal to Litian. On the seventh day of June, he was buried in Ba Ling. Ban Gu commented: Emperor Xiaowen reigned for twenty-three years, and there were no more chariots and cavalry uniforms in the palace and gardens. When the people feel inconvenienced, prohibitions are often relaxed to benefit the people. He once wanted to build a terrace to tell the time, and he called a craftsman to estimate the cost, which would cost a hundred gold. Emperor Wen said: One hundred gold is the property of ten households of a middle-class family. I continue to guard the palace of the late emperor, and I am always afraid that it will be stained. Why build a terrace?
target: Ban Gu praised Emperor Wen for his benevolence, noting that his reign saw prosperity, few imprisonments, and a flourishing of moral virtue.

source: Emperor Zhao of the Han Dynasty was the youngest son of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty. The mother is Zhao Jieyu. She was favored because of her strange aura. When she gave birth to Emperor Zhao, there was also something strange about her. In the last years of Emperor Wu, the violent prince Liu Ju was deposed. King Liu Dan of Yan and King Liu Xu of Guangling both behaved arrogantly. Emperor Wu fell seriously ill in February of the second year of the Yuan Dynasty, so he made Emperor Zhao the prince. He was eight years old at the time.
target: Emperor Zhao of Han, youngest son of Emperor Wu, ascended the throne at age eight after his father’s death in 87 BCE.

source: As a servant, Huo Guang, the captain of the chariot, was appointed as the general of the Sima army. He was ordered by Emperor Wu to assist the young master. Emperor Wu died the next day, and on February 15th, the prince succeeded to the throne and paid homage to the great ancestor in the temple. Princess Eyi, the sister of Emperor Zhao, was granted the title of Tang Muyi, honored as the eldest princess, and was enshrined in the palace. The general Huo Guang presides over the state affairs and is in charge of the secretarial affairs. The chariot and cavalry general Jin Rixi and the left general Shangguan Jie are his deputy. In the sixth month of summer, forgive all sinners in the world. In autumn and July, a comet appears in the eastern sky.
target: Huo Guang, appointed regent, managed state affairs with deputies Jin Rixi and Shangguan Jie. Early reign events included amnesties, a comet sighting, and Xiongnu raids repelled by garrisons.

source: Liu Kuan, the king of Jibei, was guilty and committed suicide. The eldest princess and her clan brothers were given various rewards, and Zhao Jieyu was posthumously given the title of empress dowager, and a Yunyang mausoleum was built for her. In winter, the Xiongnu invaded Shuofang, killing and plundering the officials and civilians. The imperial court sent troops to garrison in Xihe, and left general Shangguan Jie inspected the northern border. In the spring of February of the first year of the First Yuan Dynasty, yellow swans were perched in the Taiye Pond of Jianzhang Palace. The minister thought it was a symbol of auspiciousness and wished the emperor long life.
target: Auspicious signs like yellow swans prompted celebrations, while rebellions in Yizhou and by Liu Ze were suppressed.

source: The two counties of Dan'er and Zhenfan were abolished. In the autumn, Dahong Tian Guangming and Junzheng Wang put down the Yizhou rebellion, beheaded and captured more than 30,000 people, and seized more than 50,000 livestock. In the spring and first month of the sixth year, Emperor Zhao was farming on his own in Shanglin. In February, the imperial edict was issued to ask the virtuous literature recommended by the county and state, to investigate with them the sufferings of the people, and to decide to terminate the monopoly and patent rights of salt, iron, and wine.
