Su Wu, the supervisor of Muduo, was sent as an envoy to the Huns during the reign of Emperor Wu. He was imprisoned by the Huns for nineteen years before returning. He fulfilled his mission and insisted on the Han Dynasty. He appointed Su Wu as a vassal state and gave him one million in money. In summer, when drought occurs, sacrifices are held to pray for rain, and the people temporarily refrain from raising fire to suppress yang and help yin.
target: Reforms reduced taxes, exempted land rent, and provided relief to the poor. In 81 BCE, Emperor Zhao ended state monopolies on salt, iron, and wine after consulting virtuous scholars. Su Wu returned from 19 years of captivity among the Xiongnu and was rewarded.

source: Inform the counties and counties to give them sheep wine as condolences in the first month of every year. Those who died among them were given clothes and quilts, and sacrifices were made with pigs and sheep. The Di people in Wudu rebelled. The imperial court sent Jinwu Ma Shijian, Long'ehou Han Zeng, and Dahonglu Tian Guangming to lead the three assistants and Taichang prisoners to exempt them from their crimes and attack in rebellion. On July 30th in autumn, there will be a partial solar eclipse first and then a total solar eclipse. In August, the first year of the reign was changed to the Yuanfeng year. In September, the eldest princess of Hubei, King Liu Dan of Yan, General Shangguan Jie of the left, Shangguan An, the hussar general of Jiezi, and Sang Hongyang, the imperial censor, were all executed for their rebellion. It turned out that father and son Jie and An were fighting for power with the general Huo Guang and wanted to harm Huo Guang, so they deceived people to write to the court in the name of King Dan of Yan to expose Huo Guang's crimes. Emperor Zhao was fourteen years old at this time and discovered his fraud.
target: In 80 BCE, a major conspiracy involving King Liu Dan of Yan, Princess Eyi, Shangguan Jie, and others to assassinate Huo Guang was foiled. Emperor Zhao, then 14, exposed the plot, leading to executions of the conspirators. Huo Guang’s loyalty was vindicated, and he continued as regent.

source: In the spring and February of the first year of Yuanping, Emperor Zhao issued an edict saying: The world is based on farming and mulberry. In the past period, we have saved money, cut redundant personnel, and reduced additional taxes. As a result, the number of people engaged in farming has increased, but the people are still not self-sufficient. I am deeply disturbed. It is now decided to reduce the oral tax payment. Someone petitioned for a reduction of three-tenths, and the emperor agreed. On February 17, there was a meteor in the morning, as big as the moon, and the stars followed the meteor westward. On April 17th in the summer, Emperor Zhao died in Weiyang Palace. On June 7, he was buried in Pingling. Ban Gu commented: In the past, King Cheng of Zhou inherited the throne with a young son, but there were rumors from Guan and Cai, slandering the Duke of Zhou who served as regent and assisted the young master. When Emperor Zhao succeeded to the throne at a young age, Yan, Yong, and Shangguan also conspired to rebel and slander Huo Guang, who was regent and assistant to the young emperor. King Cheng did not doubt Duke Zhou, and Emperor Zhao appointed Huo Guang. It is remarkable that both monarchs and ministers can become famous in their own time! After Emperor Zhao succeeded Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, he was very happy with his achievements and went on a military expedition. The domestic economy was in depression and the population was reduced by half. However, Huo Guangneng focused on the most urgent tasks, did light corvees and low taxes, and rested with the people. During the Shiyuan and Yuanfeng years, the country made peace with the Xiongnu on the outside and enriched the people on the inside.
target: Subsequent years saw further reforms: tax reductions, amnesties, and agricultural support. Emperor Zhao died in 74 BCE at age 21, buried in Pingling. Ban Gu praised his reign for restoring stability after Emperor Wu’s costly campaigns, implementing light corvée and low taxes, and fostering peace with the Xiongnu while enriching the people.

source: Emperor Jing of Han was the prince of Emperor Wen of Han. His mother is Queen Dou. In June of the seventh year of the Second Yuan Dynasty, Emperor Wen died. On June 9, the prince succeeded to the throne and honored the empress dowager Bo as the empress dowager, and the empress dowager Dou as the empress dowager. In September, a comet appeared in the west. In the winter and tenth month of the first year of Emperor Jingdi's reign, the emperor issued an edict saying: I have often heard that in ancient times, the ancestors who conquered the world had merit, and the ancestors who governed the world had virtue, and rituals and music had their own origins. Singing is used to praise great virtues; dancing is used to express achievements. Offer sacrifices to Emperor Gaozu in the temple and perform the dances of "Wude", "Wen Shi" and "Five Elements". Offer sacrifices to Emperor Hui in the temple and perform the dances of "Wen Shi" and "Five Elements". Emperor Wen reigned over the world, and his government was harmonious, far and near; he eliminated the crime of slandering the emperor, stopped corporal punishment, rewarded the elderly and virtuous, comforted the lonely and helpless, and fulfilled the wishes of his subjects as much as possible; he controlled his hobbies and desires, did not accept donations, did not implicate the wife and children of sinners, did not let innocent people suffer injustice, was strict with himself, and enforced the law impartially; abolished palace punishment, and repatriated beauties in the palace to avoid having no heirs. I am stupid by nature, and I still don’t know all about my father’s merits. Only the above points were failed to be implemented by the ancient sage emperors and sage kings, but Emperor Wen implemented them all. It can be said that great virtues are matched in heaven and earth, blessings are spread all over the world, and everyone is blessed. Its holy brightness is like the sun and menstruation in the sky, but the music and dance of the sacrifice do not match it. I am deeply disturbed. For this reason, the "Zhao De" dance should be performed for Emperor Wen's temple to highlight his virtues. In this way, the merits of our ancestors can be passed down to all generations and will last forever, and I will be infinitely happy. I hope that the prime minister, the princes, Zhong Erqianshi, and the etiquette officials will propose specific etiquette plans. Prime Minister Shen Tujia and others said: Your Majesty always thinks of filial piety, and performs the dance of virtue to show the virtue of Emperor Xiaowen, which is beyond the understanding of the ministers. I would like to discuss this: There is no one who was more successful in founding the country than Emperor Gao, and no one was more benevolent and virtuous than Emperor Wen. Therefore, the Emperor Gao Temple should be the Taizu Temple of the Emperor's family, and the Emperor Wen Temple should be the Taizong Temple of the Emperor's family. The emperors of the Han Dynasty should pay homage to their ancestors from generation to generation. The princes of the prefecture and state should each establish a temple for Emperor Wen of Taizong. The princes and princes sent envoys to Kyoto to offer sacrifices at the ancestral temple. Please announce it to the world. Emperor Jing agreed. The first month of spring. The edict was issued: "In recent years, the situation has been bad. Many people are short of food, and some have died of hunger. I deeply regret it." Some counties have barren land and cannot develop farming; others have vast land, deep pastures, and excellent water conservancy conditions, but cannot be developed by immigrants. To this end, people in areas with infertile soil can be encouraged to move freely to areas with vast and fertile land. In the fourth month of summer, a general amnesty was granted to all the people, and the people were granted a first-level title. Qing Zhai, the imperial censor, was sent to Daixia to make peace with the Huns. In May, an order was issued to reduce the rent of farmland by half.
target: Emperor Jing of Han, son of Emperor Wen and Queen Dou, ascended the throne on June 9 after his father's death in the seventh year of the Second Yuan Dynasty. He honored Empress Dowager Bo and Empress Dowager Dou. In his first year, he issued an edict praising Emperor Wen's virtues—abolishing slander laws, corporal punishment, and palace punishment; rewarding the elderly; and repatriating palace women. He ordered the "Zhao De" dance for Emperor Wen's temple. Prime Minister Shen Tujia proposed establishing Emperor Gao's temple as Taizu and Emperor Wen's as Taizong, with perpetual ancestral worship, which Emperor Jing approved. In subsequent years, Emperor Jing addressed food shortages by encouraging migration to fertile lands, granted amnesties, reduced farmland rent by half, and reformed laws on official bribery and gift acceptance. Comets appeared, and the Empress Dowager died in 144 BC.

source: In the first month of spring, a fire broke out in the main hall of Huaiyang Palace. King Liu Bi of Wu, King Liu Xian of Jiaoxi, King Liu Wu of Chu, King Liu Sui of Zhao, King Liu Biguang of Jinan, King Liu Xian of Zichuan, and King Liu Xiongqu of Jiaodong jointly raised troops to rebel. Emperor Jing ordered a general amnesty for the whole country. He sent Taiwei Zhou Yafu and General Dou Ying to lead the expedition. Chao Cuo, the imperial censor, suggested cutting down the vassal vassal to avoid being too powerful to appease the seven kingdoms that launched a rebellion. On the first day of February, there was a partial solar eclipse. The soldiers commanded by Zhou Yafu and Dou Ying defeated the rebels of the Seven Kingdoms and beheaded more than 100,000 people. Chasing and killing Wu Wang Biyu Dan Tu. Wang Yan of Jiaoxi, Wang Wu of Chu, Wang Sui of Zhao, Wang Biguang of Jinan, Wang Xian of Zichuan, and Wang Xiongqu of Jiaodong all committed suicide. In the sixth month of summer, Emperor Jing issued an edict saying: In the past, King Wu and others rebelled, raised troops to threaten the court, and deceived the officials and the people, so the officials and the people had no choice but to obey.
target: The Seven Kingdoms rebellion led by Liu Bi of Wu and others erupted; Emperor Jing sent Zhou Yafu and Dou Ying to suppress it, resulting in over 100,000 rebel deaths and the suicides of the rebel kings. He pardoned deceived officials and civilians.

source: The princess was selected to marry the Xiongnu Chanyu. In the winter of the sixth year in December, there was thunder and heavy rain. In autumn and September, Queen Bo was deposed. On November 30, winter of the seventh year, there was a partial solar eclipse. In the first month of spring, the deposed crown prince was honored as King Linjiang. In February, the Taiwei officer was dismissed. On the 17th day of the fourth lunar month in the summer, the queen was named Wang. On April 29, Liu Che, King of Jiaodong, was made the crown prince. The first rank of title is given to the heir of his father among the common people. In the summer and April of the Zhongyuan year, a general amnesty was granted to all the people, and the subjects were rewarded with first-level titles. The grandsons of Zhou Ke and Zhou Chang, the former imperial censors, were made marquises. 二年春二月，景帝下令：各侯王去世，派列侯到他的封国进行吊唁，由大鸿胪奏其行迹，朝廷赐予谥号与哀策诔文。 When a prince passed away, the princes and princes were sent as mourning officials to express their condolences, and the senior officials reported their whereabouts, and the court issued mourning edicts. When the King of Qin passed away, he sent Dr. Guanglu to offer condolences and present him with clothes, clothes and utensils. He also presided over the memorial service and established the king's heir. When a marquis passed away, he sent a large and medium-sized official to the mourning hall to offer condolences, preside over memorial activities, and establish an heir. When the above princes died, migrant workers were drafted to dig graves instead of hearses. Grave repairs shall not exceed 300 working days. The Xiongnu entered Yan territory. Change the method of dismemberment for death penalty to discard the corpse, and abolish the method of dismemberment. In March, Linjiang King Liu Rong was guilty of invading Taizong's temple grounds. The lieutenant arrested him and Liu Rong committed suicide. In April in summer, comets appear in the northwest sky. The prince Liu Yue was made King of Guangchuan, and Liu Ji was made King of Jiaodong. In autumn and July, the county governor was renamed the prefect, and the county lieutenant was renamed the captain.
target: He appointed princes, resumed checkpoint inspections, made Liu Rong crown prince (later deposed), and Liu Che crown prince. He reformed mourning rites for princes, changed execution methods, and renamed officials.

source: In the first month of spring, the Queen Mother passed away. During the summer drought, selling alcohol is prohibited. In autumn and September, comets appear in the northwest sky. On September 30th, there was a partial solar eclipse. The prince Liu Cheng was granted the title of King of Qinghe. In the spring and March of the fourth year, Deyang Palace was built. Wei Wan, the imperial censor, reported that tall horses with a height of more than five feet and nine inches and less than ten years old were prohibited from being transported outside the customs. In summer, there is a locust plague.
target: He prohibited tall horses from leaving the empire, faced locust plagues, and built Yangling. He issued edicts against bribery and harsh judgments, reformed official attire, and reduced whipping penalties.

source: In the third month, a general amnesty was granted to the people, and the people were rewarded with a first-class title, two thousand stones, and the title of the princes, with the right concubine as the chief. In summer, the whole country feasts for five days, and people can buy and sell wine. In May, there was an earthquake. On July 30th in autumn, a partial solar eclipse occurred. Tiaohou Zhou Yafu was imprisoned and died in prison. In the winter and October of the second year, an order was issued to revoke the rule that the princes must go to the feudal country. In the spring, the Xiongnu invaded Yanmen, and Feng Jing, the prefect of Yanmen, died in battle. The imperial court sent chariots and horsemen to guard Yanmen. In the spring, due to the bad harvest, Neijun was prohibited from feeding the horses with grain, and those who violated the rules would have their horses confiscated.
target: The Xiongnu invaded, and Zhou Yafu died in prison. He abolished the rule requiring princes to visit fiefs, promoted agriculture, and allowed those with 40,000 yuan assets to become officials.

source: It was originally stipulated that a person with assets of 100,000 yuan could be an official, but this should not be required for honest people. According to the original regulations, businessmen cannot become officials if they have money, and honest people cannot become officials if they have no money. This leads to the fact that honest people have no way to advance, which I feel very sorry for. It is now decreed that those with assets of forty thousand yuan can become officials, so as not to prevent honest people from being able to hold their positions and allow greedy men to occupy their positions for a long time. Autumn, severe drought. In the first month of spring in the third year of the Yuan Dynasty, an edict was issued saying: Agriculture is the foundation of the world. Gold, pearls and jade cannot be eaten when hungry or clothed when cold. They can be used with currency to communicate whether they are available or not, but they cannot be identified and used. Sometimes the harvest is not good this year. I think it is because there are too many people engaged in business and too few people engaged in agriculture. Now the special order of the county must encourage farmers to engage in mulberry farming and plant more trees, so that they can have enough food and clothing. If an official uses his property to hire people to mine gold, pearls and jade, he will be punished as stolen goods. Anyone who fails to investigate this matter will be guilty of the same crime. The crown prince performs a crowning ceremony and rewards the common people who are his father's heirs with a title of one rank. On the 27th of the first lunar month, Emperor Jing died in Weiyang Palace. The imperial edict granted eight horses to each prince and prince. An official's two thousand shi means two catties of gold, and other officials and citizens each have a hundred coins. The palace servants were dismissed and returned to their homes, exempted from lifelong corvee service. On February 6, he was buried in Yangling. Ban Gu commented: Confucius said that people today can also walk on the straight path like they did in the Xia, Shang and Zhou dynasties. This is quite correct. The shortcomings of Zhou and Qin were that the legal network was tight and the laws were strict, but there were still countless people who broke the law and committed crimes. The rise of the Han Dynasty eliminated the burdens and allowed the people to recuperate and recuperate. As for Emperor Wen of the Han Dynasty, he was respectful and frugal, and Emperor Jing followed his previous footsteps. Within fifty or sixty years, he was able to change customs and make the people simple. The Zhou Dynasty praised Chengkang, and the Han Dynasty praised Wenjing. What a beautiful and prosperous age!
target: Emperor Jing died in Weiyang Palace in the first month of the third year of Houyuan, was buried in Yangling, and was praised by Ban Gu for continuing Emperor Wen's frugal policies, leading to a prosperous era comparable to the Zhou dynasty's Chengkang period.

source: Emperor Xiaowu Liu Che was the second son of Emperor Jing. His mother was Wang Meiren, who was made King of Jiaodong when she was four years old. At the age of seven, he was made crown prince, and his mother was made queen. At the age of sixteen, in the first month of the third year after Emperor Jing, Emperor Jing died. On the twenty-seventh day of the first lunar month, the prince succeeded to the throne of the emperor, and the empress dowager Dou was honored as the empress dowager, and the empress was the empress dowager. In March, the Empress Dowager and her brothers Tian Chongfen and Tian Sheng were made marquises. In the tenth month of the winter of the first year of Jianyuan, the prime minister, censors, princes, and princes were ordered to recommend virtuous and upright people who can give the most honest advice. Prime Minister Wei Wan reported: If any of the recommended virtuous people make remarks about Shen Buhai, Shang Yang, Han Fei, Su Qin, or Zhang Yi, which would confuse the state affairs, please stop them.
target: Emperor Xiaowu Liu Che, the second son of Emperor Jing, was born to Wang Meiren. At age four, he was made King of Jiaodong, and at seven, he became crown prince. At sixteen, in the third year of Emperor Jing's reign, his father died, and Liu Che succeeded the throne. He honored Empress Dowager Dou and his mother as empress dowagers, and granted marquis titles to his maternal uncles. In the first year of Jianyuan, he ordered officials to recommend virtuous and upright individuals, but Prime Minister Wei Wan advised against promoting those who studied Legalist or strategist philosophies, which the emperor approved.

source: Prime Minister Wei Wan reported: If any of the recommended virtuous people make remarks about Shen Buhai, Shang Yang, Han Fei, Su Qin, or Zhang Yi, which would confuse the state affairs, please stop them. The emperor agreed. In the second month of spring, the world will be pardoned and the people will be rewarded with one level of nobility. Those who are over eighty years old are exempted from taxes for two members of the family, and those who are over ninety years old are exempted from taxes for the whole family. Issue three baht coins. On the ninth day of April in the summer of the first year of Jianyuan, an edict was issued saying: According to the ancient rules, age is the most important thing in the countryside, and title is the most important thing in the court. In governing the country and educating the people, virtue must be given a prominent position. It can be said that respecting the elders and caring for the elderly in the countryside has been a principle since ancient times. Today, filial sons and grandsons in the world are willing to do their best to support their elders. However, they are forced by external affairs and lack of financial resources internally. Therefore, it seems that filial piety is missing. I deeply sympathize with them. When people are over ninety years old, the court has a system of making porridge and rice with rice and millet. Now it is added that his sons or grandsons are exempted from corvee service, so that they can lead their wives to fulfill their responsibility of supporting the elderly. In the fifth month, an edict was issued saying: The rivers and seas moisten thousands of miles, and the ancestral officials can be ordered to build ancestral temples in the mountains and rivers. It is normal to offer sacrifices every year, and the sacrifices should also be improved. The first offender in the Seven Kingdoms Rebellion was pardoned for his crime of confiscating his wife as a servant of the official family, and was deported. In the seventh month of Autumn, an edict was issued saying: The palace guards will go to the old place to set up a new one, numbering 20,000, and save 10,000. The court's horse-breeding gardens were opened to the poor to graze and collect wood. It was agreed to establish a Mingtang where the emperor declared his political and religious affairs. An envoy was sent to summon Lu Shen Gong in a safe and comfortable vehicle with cloth and jade. In the winter of October of the second year, Zhao Wan, the imperial censor, committed the crime of not reporting to the Empress Dowager. He and his doctor ordered Wang Zang to be imprisoned and committed suicide. Prime Minister Dou Ying and Taiwei Tian Chong were dismissed from their posts. On the first day of February in spring, there is a partial solar eclipse. On April 24th in summer, the night was like day. The establishment of Maoling-eup began. In the spring of the third year, the Yellow River flooded the plains, causing a great famine and causing people to eat each other. The residents who moved to Maoling were given 200,000 yuan and two hectares of land.
target: He pardoned the world, rewarded the people, exempted taxes for the elderly, and issued three-baht coins. Edicts emphasized respect for elders, exempted families of those over ninety from corvée, and improved sacrifices to rivers and seas. He pardoned first offenders in the Seven Kingdoms Rebellion, reduced palace guards, opened horse-breeding gardens to the poor, and planned to build a Mingtang. He summoned the scholar Lu Shen Gong. In the second year, officials Zhao Wan and Wang Zang committed suicide for failing to report to the Empress Dowager, and Prime Minister Dou Ying and Taiwei Tian Chong were dismissed. A partial solar eclipse occurred, and a night was as bright as day. Maoling-eup was established. In the third year, the Yellow River flooded, causing famine and cannibalism. Residents moving to Maoling received funds and land.

source: The establishment of Maoling-eup began. In the spring of the third year, the Yellow River flooded the plains, causing a great famine and causing people to eat each other. The residents who moved to Maoling were given 200,000 yuan and two hectares of land. Build the Benmen Bridge across the Weishui River from Chang'an to Maoling. In autumn and July, a comet appears in the northwest. King Liu Ming of Jichuan committed the crime of killing Taifu and Zhongfu and was deposed and moved to Fangling. The Fujian and Yue soldiers besieged Dong Ou, and Dong Ou asked the Han court for help. The emperor sent Yan, a senior official, to assist him and mobilize the troops stationed in Kuaiji to float to the sea to rescue Dong Ou. Before the soldiers arrived, Minyue retreated. September 2nd, partial solar eclipse. In the summer of the fourth year, a wind blew up the red dust, which was as red as blood. In June, there was a severe drought, and in autumn and September, comets appeared in the northeast. In the spring of the fifth year, three baht coins were abolished and half a liang coin was issued. Set up Doctor of the Five Classics.
target: A comet appeared in the northwest. King Liu Ming of Jichuan was deposed for murder. Minyue besieged Dong Ou, but Han forces caused their retreat. In the fourth year, red dust blew, drought struck, and comets appeared. In the fifth year, three-baht coins were abolished, half-liang coins issued, and Doctors of the Five Classics established.

source: The Fujian and Yue soldiers besieged Dong Ou, and Dong Ou asked the Han court for help. The emperor sent Yan, a senior official, to assist him and mobilize the troops stationed in Kuaiji to float to the sea to rescue Dong Ou. Before the soldiers arrived, Minyue retreated. September 2nd, partial solar eclipse. In the summer of the fourth year, a wind blew up the red dust, which was as red as blood. In June, there was a severe drought, and in autumn and September, comets appeared in the northeast. In the spring of the fifth year, three baht coins were abolished and half a liang coin was issued. Set up Doctor of the Five Classics. In April of summer, the emperor's grandmother Pingyuan Jun passed away. In May, a major locust plague occurred. In the eighth month of autumn, King Liu Yue of Guangchuan and King Liu Cheng of Qinghe both died. On the third day of February in the sixth year of spring, there was a fire in the Gaozu Temple in Liaodong. On April 21st in the summer, a fire broke out in the Gaoyuan Bedroom. The emperor wore plain clothes and blamed himself for five days. On May 26, the Empress Dowager passed away. In autumn and August, the comet appears in the east for a long time. When King Ying of Minyue attacked South Vietnam, the imperial court sent Daxing Wang Hui to lead troops out of Yuzhang, and Da Sinong Han Anguo to lead troops out of Kuaiji to prepare for a counterattack. Before the soldiers arrived, the Yue people killed Ying and surrendered. Wang, Han and others withdrew their troops. In the winter and November of the first year of Yuanguang, the county began to recommend one person each for Xiao and Lian. Wei Lieutenant Li Guang stationed troops at Yunzhong as General Chao Cavalry, and Lieutenant Cheng Bushi stationed troops at Yanmen as General Chao Cavalry. They withdrew their troops in June. In the fourth month of summer, he pardoned the world, rewarded the chief minister with the first level of viscount, and restored the clan status of the clans of the seven kingdoms that had been extinguished due to the crime of rebellion by the seven kingdoms.
target: The emperor's grandmother died, locusts plagued, and two kings died. In the sixth year, fires at Gaozu Temple and Gaoyuan Bedroom led the emperor to blame himself. The Empress Dowager died, and a comet appeared. Minyue attacked South Vietnam, but the Yue people killed their king and surrendered. In the first year of Yuanguang, counties recommended one filial and incorrupt person each. Generals Li Guang and Cheng Bushi withdrew troops. The emperor pardoned the world and restored clans of the Seven Kingdoms.

source: hehe! Only Pushi Deze can have such a prosperous time! Today I have the honor to inherit the great authority. I get up early to seek and stay quiet at night to think. If I look at the ocean and sigh, I don't know how to reach the other shore. Beautiful! How great! Through those actions, the great cause and virtues of the late emperor were carried forward, and he was worthy of Yao and Shun at the top and the three kings at the bottom. My nature is dull and my virtue cannot reach far. This is well known to all the doctors. Wise men understand the rise and fall of kings in ancient and modern times, and receive advice and inquiries. Please write them down in writing and compile them into a volume for my reading. So Dong Zhongshu, Gongsun Hong and others stood out. On July 30th in autumn, there will be a partial eclipse of the sun. In the winter and tenth month of the second year, the emperor went to Yongdi to worship the Five Emperors. In the spring, I issued an edict and asked the ministers: "I once decorated beautiful women to match the Xiongnu Chanyu, and rewarded them generously with gold coins, embroidery, and embroidery. However, after accepting the imperial edict, the Chanyu became arrogant and invaded endlessly." I am deeply disturbed by the murders at the border. Now I want to send troops to attack, what do you think? Daxing Wang Hui suggested that we should attack. In the sixth month of the summer, Han Anguo, the imperial censor, was appointed as the guard general, Weiwei Li Guang was the heroic cavalry general, Sun He, the great servant, was the light chariot general, Daxing Wang Hui was the general general, and the great official Li Xi was the caiguan general. They stationed 300,000 people in the valley of Mayi. They wanted to lure Shan Yu into the fortress and launched an attack unexpectedly. After Shanyu entered the fortress, he immediately exited when he noticed something strange.
target: He issued an edict praising ancient rulers and seeking advice, leading to the rise of Dong Zhongshu and Gongsun Hong. In the second year, the emperor worshipped the Five Emperors and discussed attacking the Xiongnu. Generals stationed 300,000 troops at Mayi to lure the Xiongnu Chanyu, but he escaped. General Wang Hui died in prison.

source: General Wang Hui committed the crime of "not advancing the plan" and was imprisoned and died. In the ninth month of autumn, the whole country was ordered to drink alcohol for five days to comfort the farmers. In the spring of the third year, the Yellow River moved and flowed from the southeast of Dunqiu into the Bohai Sea. In the fifth month of summer, five of Gaozu's meritorious officials were granted the title of marquis. The Yellow River burst in Puyang and flooded sixteen counties. One hundred thousand soldiers were mobilized to block the floods for disaster relief, and Longyuan Palace was built. In the winter of the fourth year, Wei Qihou Dou Ying was found guilty and his head was hung in public. On the seventeenth day of the third lunar month in the spring, Prime Minister Chong died. In April of summer, severe frost damaged crops. In May, there was an earthquake and the world was forgiven. In the first month of spring of the fifth year, Wang De of Hejian passed away. In the summer, corvees from Bashu were recruited to build Nanyi Avenue, and tens of thousands of soldiers were mobilized to build Yanmen Pass. In autumn and July, strong wind uproots trees. On July 14, Queen Chen was deposed, and the witches who incited people and disrupted the court were arrested and beheaded.
target: In the third year, the Yellow River changed course, and five meritorious officials were made marquises. Flooding in Puyang led to disaster relief. In the fourth year, Dou Ying was executed, Prime Minister Chong died, frost damaged crops, and an earthquake occurred. In the fifth year, King Wang De of Hejian died, roads were built, and Queen Chen was deposed.

source: On July 14, Queen Chen was deposed, and the witches who incited people and disrupted the court were arrested and beheaded. August, plague of borers. Among the officials and people, those who understood the affairs of the time and the art of the sages were recruited to Kyoto to take countermeasures, and the towns and counties along the way were provided with food expenses. Order the envoys from each county to be the leader of their team when they come to Beijing. In the winter of the sixth year, taxes began to be levied on merchants' vehicles and ships. In spring, a canal for transporting grain was excavated and connected to the Wei River. The Xiongnu invaded the Shang Valley and plundered the people. The emperor sent the cavalry general Wei Qingbing out of the Shang Valley, the cavalry general Gongsun Aobing to come out, the light cavalry general Gongsun He out of Yunzhong, and the brave cavalry general Li Guang out of Yanmen. Wei Qing went to Longcheng and captured 700 enemy heads. Gongsun Ao and Li Guang were defeated due to command errors and returned home.
target: Talented individuals were recruited. In the sixth year, taxes on merchants' vehicles began. The Xiongnu invaded, and General Wei Qing captured 700 heads, while Gongsun Ao and Li Guang were defeated. The emperor pardoned soldiers for disciplinary violations.

source: I sympathize with the ordinary soldiers who have been implicated. If they want to make atonement and kill the enemy and defend the country again, there will be no conditions and opportunities. Therefore, soldiers in the Yanmen and Daijun armies who committed common disciplinary violations were pardoned. In summer, there was a severe drought and locust plague. In June, I visited Yongdi. In autumn, the Xiongnu plundered the border, and the emperor sent General Han Anguo to station troops in Yuyang. In the eleventh month of the winter of the first year of Shuo, an edict was issued saying: The mission of the officials is to formulate policies and strategies, unify action measures, promote the court's virtues and policies, and change the social atmosphere.
target: In the first year of Shuo, the emperor issued edicts promoting virtue and talent, ordering officials to recommend filial and incorrupt individuals.

source: Those who cannot cultivate and discover talented people are incompetent for their duties and should be dismissed. This memorial was adopted. In December, Liu Fei, King of Jiangdu, passed away. On March 13th in the spring, Queen Wei was established. The edict was issued: I have heard that if the heaven and earth do not change, transformation will not be possible; if the yin and yang do not change, things will not flourish. "Yi" says: Only by adapting to the situation can the people's spirit be lifted up. "Poetry" says: Understand the changes of heaven and earth without losing the way, choose the good and follow it. I appreciate the Tang, Yu, and Yin and Zhou dynasties, and am willing to learn from historical experiences and lessons. Now the world is amnesty and the people are reformed. Some were prosecuted for committing crimes and fleeing in fear of crime or owing official property for a long time. Those who committed the crime three years ago before Emperor Xiaojing were exempted from prosecution. In the autumn of the first year of Yuanshuo, the Huns invaded western Liaoning and killed the prefect of western Liaoning. They also invaded Yuyang and Yanmen, defeated the captains, and killed and plundered more than 3,000 people. General Wei Qing was sent out of Yanmen, and General Li Xi was sent to replace him, and he captured thousands of enemy heads. Nanlu, Huijun of Dongyi, and others led 280,000 subjects to submit to the Han and established Canghai County. King Liu Yu of Lu and King Liu Fa of Changsha both died. In the winter of the second year, King Huainan and King Sichuan were given a few sticks to avoid going to court.
target: Queen Wei was established. In the first year of Yuanshuo, the Xiongnu invaded, and Wei Qing captured thousands of heads. Dongyi submitted, and Canghai County was established. In the second year, the emperor granted titles to princes' sons.

source: The imperial court sent generals Wei Qing and Li Xi out of Yunzhong to Gaoque, and then to Fuli. They captured thousands of enemy heads, recovered Henan, and established Shuofang and Wuyuan counties. On March 30th, there was a partial solar eclipse. In the summer, 100,000 people were recruited to migrate to Shuofang County. They also moved the upper-class people of the county and households with assets of more than three million to Maoling. In the autumn, King Yan committed suicide because he was guilty of the crime. In the spring of the third year, the organizational structure of Canghai County was abolished. In March, an edict was issued saying: Punishment is used to prevent adultery, and respect for virtue is to show the importance of talent. Today's people have not been cultivated in education, and I am happy to work with the scholar-bureaucrats to renew the Han Dynasty's imperial career, and to be respectful and unremitting. Can forgive the world. In summer, the Xiongnu invaded Dai and killed the prefect. Invading Yanmen, killing and plundering more than a thousand people. On the second day of June, the Empress Dowager passed away. In autumn, the conquest of the southwestern barbarians was exempted and Shuofang City was built. The people of the country were ordered to drink alcohol for five days to comfort the people. In the winter of the fourth year, I visited Ganquan. In the summer, the Huns came to Dai, Dingxiang and Shangjun, killing and plundering thousands of people. In the spring of the fifth year, a severe drought occurred. General Wei Qing led six generals and more than 100,000 soldiers to set out at Shuofang and Gaoque, and captured more than 15,000 Xiongnu heads.
target: Wei Qing recovered Henan, establishing Shuofang and Wuyuan counties. People were moved to Shuofang and Maoling. In the third year, Canghai County was abolished, and the Xiongnu invaded Dai and Yanmen. The Empress Dowager died. In the fourth year, the emperor visited Ganquan. In the fifth year, drought struck, and Wei Qing captured over 15,000 Xiongnu heads.

source: In the winter of the fourth year, I visited Ganquan. In the summer, the Huns came to Dai, Dingxiang and Shangjun, killing and plundering thousands of people. In the spring of the fifth year, a severe drought occurred. General Wei Qing led six generals and more than 100,000 soldiers to set out at Shuofang and Gaoque, and captured more than 15,000 Xiongnu heads. In the sixth month of the Xia Dynasty, an edict was issued saying: I once heard that people were taught to use etiquette and cultivated people to enjoy music. Nowadays, etiquette has become corrupted and music has collapsed. I am very sorry. Therefore, the erudite and virtuous people gathered in Kyoto, and the ceremonial officials gave lectures. They collected and cited erudite texts, cited omitted articles, and promoted or destroyed rites, setting them as an example for the world. The Taichang official should consider setting up the virtuous people who participated in this academic ceremony as doctoral disciples. This can not only promote education in the countryside, but also reward talents. Prime Minister Gongsun Hongzou asked the doctor to set up disciples, and more and more people learned etiquette. In autumn, the Xiongnu came to power and killed the captain. In the spring and February of that year, General Wei Qing led six generals and more than 100,000 soldiers to ride out of Dingxiang and beheaded more than 3,000 enemies. After returning to the division, the troops and horses rested and reorganized in Dingxiang, Yunzhong, Yanmen and other places. Forgive the world. In April of summer, Wei Qing once again led six generals and soldiers to the desert at the southern border of the Xiongnu and won a complete victory. Former general Zhao Xin was defeated and surrendered to the Huns. The right general Su Jian's troops collapsed and he fled back alone to redeem himself as a civilian.
target: The emperor promoted education and set up doctoral disciples. In the sixth year, Wei Qing defeated the Xiongnu in the desert, but Zhao Xin surrendered and Su Jian fled. The emperor established martial arts reward officers.

source: Officials in charge of martial arts requested the emperor to set up martial arts reward officers to reward warriors. In the winter and tenth month of the first year of Yuanshou, he went to Yong to offer sacrifices to the Five Emperors. He obtained a white unicorn and wrote "The Song of Bailin". In November, Liu An, the king of Huainan, and Liu Ci, the king of Hengshan, rebelled and were executed. Tens of thousands of party members were executed. In December, there was heavy rain and snow, and civilians froze to death. In the fourth month of summer, there is a general amnesty for the whole world. On April 21st in summer, the crown prince was established.
target: In the first year of Yuanshou, the emperor obtained a white unicorn and wrote a song. Kings of Huainan and Hengshan rebelled and were executed. The crown prince was established. The emperor issued edicts rewarding filial piety and caring for the elderly.

source: The Xiongnu invaded Shanggu and killed hundreds of people. On the eighth day of the third lunar month in the spring, Prime Minister Gongsun Hong passed away. He sent General Huo Qu's sick soldiers out of Longxi to Gaolan Mountain and beheaded more than 8,000 enemies. In summer, the horse was born in Yuwu water. South Vietnam presented tame elephants and talking birds. Generals Huo Qubing and Gongsun Ao marched more than 2,000 miles from the north, passed Juyan, and beheaded more than 30,000 enemies. The Xiongnu entered Yanmen and killed and plundered hundreds of people. He sent guard Zhang Qian and Lang Zhongling Li Guangdu to lead troops out of Youbeiping. Li Guang killed more than 3,000 Xiongnu people, but all 4,000 of his own troops were defeated and fled back alone. He, Gongsun Ao and Zhang Qian did not arrive on time and should be executed to make atonement for their sins as common people. Jiangdu King Liu Jian was guilty and committed suicide. Liu Ji, King of Jiaodong, passed away. In autumn, King Kunxie of the Xiongnu killed King Xiutu and led more than 40,000 of his men to surrender and set up five vassal states for resettlement. Its land is Wuwei and Jiuquan counties. In the spring of three years, a comet appeared in the east. In the fifth month of summer, the world is forgiven. He established Shao Ziqing, King Kang of Jiaodong, as King of Liu'an. Xiao Qing, the great-grandson of the late Prime Minister Xiao He, was granted the title of Marquis. In autumn, the Huns invaded Youbeiping and Dingxiang, killing and plundering thousands of people. Special envoys were sent to persuade flood-stricken counties to plant winter wheat, and a list of officials and people who could be tolerant and caring for the poor was recommended to the court.
target: Generals Huo Qubing and Gongsun Ao captured thousands of Xiongnu heads. The Xiongnu king Kunxie surrendered, and Wuwei and Jiuquan counties were established.

source: In the winter of the fourth year, the official in charge reported that the poor people from Guandong had migrated to Longxi, totaling 725,000 people in Beidi, Xihe, Shangjun, and Kuaiji. The county magistrate wanted to provide food, clothing, and production for them, but the money was insufficient and asked for silver coins to be made into platinum coins and white deer skin coins to meet the national needs. The system of taxing merchants and handicrafts at a rate of 20 to 40% of the value of their goods was implemented. In spring, a comet appears in the northeast. In the summer of the fourth year of Yuanshou, a long star appeared in the northwest. General Wei Qing led four generals out of Dingxiang, and General Huo Qubing came out, each with 50,000 cavalry.
target: In the third year, a comet appeared, and the emperor pardoned the world. In the fourth year, Wei Qing and Huo Qubing defeated the Xiongnu in Mobei, with heavy casualties.

source: General Wei Qing led four generals out of Dingxiang, and General Huo Qubing came out, each with 50,000 cavalry. The infantry was followed by the cavalry, followed by hundreds of thousands of people. Wei Qing went to Mobei to besiege King Shanyu and beheaded 19,000 people. Return to the army in Tianyan Mountain. Huo Qubing fought against King Zuoxian of the Xiongnu and beheaded more than 70,000 enemies. He carved stones in Langjuxu Mountain to commemorate his achievements and returned. Tens of thousands of people died in the battle between the two armies. Former general Li Guang and rear general Shi Qi both failed to arrive at the position as scheduled. Li Guang committed suicide and Shi Qi redeemed himself for the death penalty. On March 11th in the spring of the fifth year, Prime Minister Li Cai committed suicide. There are few horses in the world, and the price of a stallion has been raised to 200,000 yuan. Half a tael of money was scrapped and five baht coins were issued. Migrate the treacherous officials and people from all over the world to live in the frontiers. In the winter and tenth month of the sixth year, rewards were given to officials ranging from the prime minister to two thousand stones of gold, and to servants ranging from one thousand stones to silk. The barbarians were given various brocades. There is no snow or ice in winter rainfall. On the 29th day of the fourth lunar month in the summer, Prince Hong was established as King of Qi, Dan as King of Yan, and Xu as King of Guangling in the ancestral temple. He began to write the imperial edicts one by one to ennoble the princes. In June, an edict was issued saying: In the past, the officials in charge believed that the cheap coins and high prices gave opportunities for evil and evil, and many people abandoned farming and engaged in business. In order to suppress the disparity between the rich and the poor, the currency system was reformed to check evil and mergers.
target: Li Guang committed suicide. In the fifth year, half-liang coins were scrapped, and five-baht coins issued. In the sixth year, the emperor established princes and issued edicts on currency reform. He sent officials to inspect the country and relieve the needy.

source: In the summer and fifth month of the first year of Yuanding, he pardoned the whole country and ordered the whole country to drink happily for five days to comfort the people. Get the tripod above the Fen River. Peng Li, the king of Jidong, was guilty and moved to Shangyong. In the winter of November of the second year, Zhang Tang, the imperial censor, committed suicide. In December, Prime Minister Zhuang Qingzhai was imprisoned and died. In the spring of the second year of Yuanding, Bailiang Terrace was built.
target: In the first year of Yuanding, a tripod was found in the Fen River. In the second year, officials died, and Bailiang Terrace was built.

source: The current flood disaster is moving to the south of the Yangtze River, and the winter is coming. I am worried that the people in the south of the Yangtze River will be hungry and cold. In the Jiangnan area, fire plowing and water plowing were carried out, and Bashu grain was immediately transferred to Jiangling. Doctors and middlemen were sent to various places to inspect and inform the victims that Shu grain had arrived, so as to relieve their worries. Any officials or people who have made outstanding achievements in famine relief must report their deeds to the court in detail. In the winter of the third year, Hangu was moved to Xin'an, and the original address was Hongnong County. In November, it was ordered that anyone who exposed tax evasion would be rewarded with half of the amount they should pay.
target: Floods caused starvation. In the third year, the emperor moved Hangu and ordered tax evasion rewards.

source: In the summer of April, there was hail, and famine broke out in more than a dozen counties in Kanto, and cannibalism occurred. When Liu Shun, the king of Changshan, passed away, his son Bo Xun succeeded him. He was found guilty and moved to Fangling. In the winter and tenth month of the fourth year, I visited Yong and offered sacrifices to the Five Emperors. I was rewarded with the rank of baron, a hundred women, cattle, and some wine. Depart from Xiayang and arrive at Fenyin. On November 8, Hou Tu Temple was built on the east bank of Fenyin. After the ceremony, we arrived at Xingyang. Returning to the capital from Luoyang, he issued an edict: "The Queen's sacrifice will be carried out in Jizhou, and we will look at the Luoshui River of the Yellow River. We will inspect Yuzhou and inspect the old sites of the Zhou Dynasty. The Zhou temple has been closed for worship for a long time." After asking the local elders, he found Ji Jia, a descendant of the Zhou Dynasty. Now Jia is granted the title of Zhou Zinanjun to inherit Zhou's sacrifices.
target: In the fourth year, he built Hou Tu Temple and granted titles to Zhou descendants. In the fifth year, he sacrificed to the sun and moon, found a tripod, and composed songs.

source: One hundred thousand people from the Western Qiang rebelled, made friends with the Xiongnu envoys, attacked Gu'an, and besieged four thousand counties in Mubao. The Xiongnu also invaded Wuyuan and killed the prefect of the Han Dynasty. In the winter and tenth month of the sixth year, 100,000 cavalrymen from Longxi, Tianshui and Anding, as well as soldiers from Weinian, Henan and Hanoi in Kyoto, were sent out. General Li Xi and Lang Zhongling were sent to Xu Ziwei to conquer and pacify the Western Qiang. On the eastward tour, he visited Fengshi County and drove to Tongxiang, Zuoyi County. He was delighted when he heard that the South Vietnamese rebels had been defeated, so he changed the name of this place to Wenxi County. In the spring, I drove to Xinzhong Township in Jixian County and learned that Lu Jia, the rebel prime minister of Yue, had been beheaded, so he changed the name of this place to Huojia County. The remaining troops of Marquis Chiyi had not yet withdrawn, so the emperor immediately ordered him to move to conquer the southwestern barbarians and pacify the Yue territory. So the territory was pacified and divided into nine counties: Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Hepu, Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan, Zhukui and Dan'er. After the southwest was razed and settled, was it designated as a military capital? There are five counties: Ke, Yueyuan, Shenli and Wenshan. In autumn, Yushan, the king of Dongyue, rebelled and attacked and killed the generals of the Han Dynasty. The imperial court sent General Han Shuo of Henghai and Lieutenant Wang Wenshu out of Kuaiji, and General Yang Pu out of Yuzhang to attack the King of Dongyue. They also sent Fuju General Gongsun He's troops out of Jiuyuan, and Xionghe General Zhao Ponu's troops out of Huiju. They both went on an expedition of more than 2,000 miles, but returned without seeing any Xiongnu troops. Therefore, Dunhuang and Zhangye counties were established in Fenwu and Jiuquan areas, and people from the interior were moved to enrich the territory. In the winter of tenth month of the first year of Yuanfeng, the emperor issued an edict saying: The rebel prime minister of South Vietnam and the rebel king of Dongou have been punished. However, the southern barbarians and northern barbarians have not yet been convinced. I am ready to patrol the border, mobilize troops to revitalize the brigade, personally observe the martial arts festival, and set up twelve generals to act as commander-in-chief. Starting from Yunyang, passing through Shangjun, Xihe and Wuyuan in the north, exiting the Great Wall, ascending to Shanyu in the north, arriving at Shuofang, facing Beihe River. He led an army of 180,000 cavalry, and his banners stretched for more than a thousand miles, which shocked the Xiongnu.
target: In the sixth year, Nanyue rebelled, and the emperor sent generals to suppress it. The Western Qiang and Xiongnu invaded. In the first year of Yuanfeng, the emperor patrolled the border, shocking the Xiongnu.

source: Returning to the army, he offered sacrifices to the Yellow Emperor at Qiao Mountain, and then returned to Ganquan. The subjects of Dongyue killed the rebel king Yu Shan and submitted to the Han. Emperor Wu issued an edict saying: The terrain in East Vietnam is dangerous and the population is numerous, which may cause trouble in the future. The people must be moved to the Jianghuai area to live. So all the local residents were moved out. In the first month of spring, I came to Fengshi County. The edict was issued: I sacrificed sacrifices to Huashan Mountain in the West and Mount Song in the Central Mountains. Did I get a tiger-eating beast and a horse? See the stone transformed by Tushan, the mother of Xia Houqi. The next morning I climbed Mount Song in person. The imperial censor, his entourage, and the officials at the temple all heard the sound of the mountain mingling and the valley shouting three long lives. How could I not respond to the mountain god's courtesy to me?
target: Dongyue submitted, and people were moved. He climbed Mount Song, built altars, and issued edicts on reforms.

source: In the winter of the sixth year, I was lucky enough to patrol back to Zhong. In spring, make the first mountain palace. In March, I traveled to the east of the river to offer sacrifices to Houtu. The edict said: I pay my respects to the first mountain because the Kuntian under the mountain produces treasures, some of which are turned into gold. After offering sacrifices to the earth, divine light appeared three times. We now pardon Fenyin County's criminals with capital crimes and below, and reward the poor people all over the world with a piece of cloth. Revolts broke out in Yizhou and Kunming. The emperor pardoned those who committed crimes in Kyoto and ordered them to join the army, and sent General Guo Chang to lead the army to quell the rebellion. In the summer, the people of Kyoto watched the Jiaodian opera at Shanglin Pingle Hall. Autumn brings severe drought and locust plague. In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Taichu, I traveled to Mount Tai.
target: In the first year of Taichu, the emperor revised the calendar and built a palace.

source: In autumn and August, he patrolled Anding County and sent General Li Guangli of the Second Division to recruit the criminals from all over the world who were sent into exile to guard the border and march westward to Dawan. Locusts flew from the east to Dunhuang. In the first month of spring of the second year, Prime Minister Shi Qing passed away. In March, the emperor traveled to Hedong to worship the Houtu God. The people were ordered to drink for five days to rejoice, pray for five days, and offer sacrifices in temples, the specifications of which were the same as those of the wax festival. In the fourth month of summer, an edict was issued saying: I offered sacrifices to Jieshan and prayed for blessings on the land, and the spiritual light induced me to pardon criminals below death row in Fenyin and Anyi. In May, the officials and people’s horses were registered to supplement the horses for carriage and riding. Autumn, locust plague. He sent Junji General Zhao Ponu with 20,000 cavalry out of Shuofang to attack the Xiongnu, and the entire army was wiped out. In the winter of December, Erkuan, the imperial censor, passed away. In the first month of spring of the third year, the emperor went eastward to patrol the sea. In the fourth month of summer, on the way back, he built a seal on Mount Tai and offered sacrifices to Mount Shilu. Guang Luxun and Xu Ziwei were sent to build a series of fortresses outside the Wuyuan Great Wall, northwest to Luqu Mountain, and guerrilla general Han Shuo led the troops to garrison. Lu Bode, the captain of Qiannu, built his residence in Yancheng. In autumn, the Xiongnu invaded Dingxiang and Yunzhong, killing and plundering thousands of people, and destroying the pavilions and barriers built by Guangluxun. They also entered Zhangye and Jiuquan and killed the captains. In the spring of the fourth year, Li Guangli, the general of the Second Division, beheaded the King of Dayuan and won a horse that had sweated thousands of miles. The imperial court wrote "Song of the West Pole Pegasus" to celebrate.
target: In the second year, he sacrificed to Houtu. In the third year, he built fortresses. In the fourth year, Li Guangli beheaded the King of Dayuan.

source: The captain who moved to Hongnong set up a tax card at Wuguan to collect entry and exit tariffs to provide the daily needs of customs officials and guards. In the first month of spring in the first year of Tianhan, the emperor came to Ganquan and offered sacrifices to Mount Tai in the suburbs. In March, he came to Hedong to offer sacrifices to Hou Tu. The Huns returned the Han envoys and sent envoys to offer tribute. In the fifth month of summer, there is a general amnesty for the whole world. In autumn, the city gates were closed to search for those who violated the law and wasted money, and the criminals were assigned to guard the Wuyuan border. In the spring of the second year, I traveled to the East China Sea and returned to China. In the fifth month of summer, the General of the Second Division led 30,000 cavalry out of Jiuquan and fought against King Youxian of the Xiongnu in the Tianshan Mountains, beheading more than 10,000 of the enemy. He also sent General Yin Muyu out of Xihe, and Li Ling, the Cavalry Commander, sent 5,000 infantrymen out of Yanbei to fight Shanyu and beheaded more than 10,000 enemies. Li Ling was defeated and surrendered to the Huns.
target: In the first year of Tianhan, the Xiongnu returned envoys. In the second year, Li Guangli fought the Xiongnu, but Li Ling surrendered. Witchcraft was investigated.

source: Ma Tong's troops reached the Tianshan Mountains, but the Huns retreated and took advantage of the situation to conquer the chariot division. Generals Shang and Ma both withdrew their troops and returned to the court. Li Guangli was defeated and surrendered to the Huns. In June, Prime Minister Liu Quyou was imprisoned and beheaded because his wife was involved in witchcraft. In autumn, there was a locust plague. In September, Gongsun Yong and Hu Qian were found guilty of treason and were executed. In the first month of spring of the fourth year, I came to Donglai and looked at the sea. On the third day of February, a meteorite fell in Yongdi, and its sound was heard four hundred miles away. In March, the emperor plowed the land in person. On the way back, he climbed Mount Tai and repaired the seal.
target: In the third year, the emperor sacrificed at Mount Tai. In the fourth year, he sent generals against the Xiongnu. In the first year of Taishi, Gongsun Ao was executed.

source: In the fourth month of summer, Prince Kun was made king of Changyi. In the ninth month of autumn, it was ordered that the death penalty could be reduced by one degree of death if a ransom of 500,000 yuan was paid. In the first year of Taishi, General Gongsun Ao was found guilty and had his waist cut in half. The officials, people and heroes from the prefectures and states were moved to Maoling and Yunyang. In the sixth month of summer, forgive the sinners in the world. In the first month of spring of the second year, the emperor was on tour. In March, an edict was issued saying: According to the suggestions of relevant officials, I made sacrifices to heaven in the suburbs, climbed Longshou Mountain in the west, and obtained a white unicorn to present to the ancestral temple. Pegasus appeared in the Wowa water, and natural gold appeared in Mount Tai. This should represent auspiciousness and the old method should be changed. Today, the gold is changed into the shape of a cloud with lin feet and horseshoes to match the auspicious sign. Therefore, the princes and kings were given the gold of Linzu and horse hoofs in order of rank. Autumn, drought. In September, those who committed capital crimes could have their death penalty reduced by one degree by paying a ransom of 500,000 yuan. Du Zhou, the imperial censor, passed away. In the first month of the spring of the third year, the emperor went to Ganquan Palace and held a banquet to entertain foreign guests. In February, the whole country was ordered to drink happily for five days. The emperor visited the East China Sea and got a red goose, which he composed "Song of the Red Goose". I'm lucky enough to be riding Langyan and worshiping the sun in Chengshan. Climb Zhifu Mountain and take a boat ride on the sea. There are shouts of "Long Live" in the valleys on the shore. In winter, every household in the place where the reward passes is 5,000 yuan, and each widow and widower is given a piece of cloth. In the spring and March of the fourth year, the emperor visited Mount Tai.
target: In the second year, the emperor obtained a white unicorn and changed gold forms. In the third year, he visited the East China Sea. In the fourth year, he sacrificed at Mount Tai.

source: On October 30th in winter, there will be a partial solar eclipse. In December, the emperor came to Yongdi to worship the Five Emperors and visited Anding and Beidi in the west. In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhenghe, the emperor returned to the capital and arrived at Jianzhang Palace. In March, King Pengzu of Zhao passed away. In November of winter, the three auxiliary cavalry were mobilized to search Shanglin Garden, and the gates of Chang'an were closed to search for traitors. The ban was lifted on the eleventh day. Witchcraft happened. In the first month of the spring of the second year, Prime Minister He was imprisoned and died. In April in summer, strong winds uproot houses and break trees. In the leap month of the second year, Princess Zhuyi and Princess Yangshi, the daughters of Queen Wei, were both sentenced to death for being involved in the crime of witchcraft. In summer, drive to Ganquan. In the seventh month of autumn, according to Dao Hou Han's instructions, envoy Jiang Chong and others unearthed the puppets buried in the ground in the palace of the prince. On July 9, the prince and the queen wanted to kill Jiang Chong when they saw that Jiang Chong had taken advantage of the opportunity to frame him. The prince ordered the deployment of troops to fight with the prime minister Liu Quyou in Chang'an, and tens of thousands of people were killed on both sides. On July 17, the prince fled and the queen committed suicide.
target: In the first year of Zhenghe, witchcraft occurred. In the second year, the crown prince fled and committed suicide. In the third year, Li Guangli surrendered to the Xiongnu.

source: In September, Prince Yan of Zhao Jingsu was made King Qian. The Xiongnu invaded Shanggu and Wuyuan, killing and plundering local officials and people. In the first month of the spring of the third year, he came to Yong and arrived in Anding and Beidi. The Xiongnu invaded Wuyuan and Jiuquan and killed two captains. In March, Li Guangli, the general of the Second Division, led 70,000 troops out of Wuyuan, Shang Qiucheng, the imperial censor, led 20,000 troops out of Xihe, and Hou Ma Tong led 40,000 cavalry out of Jiuquan. Shangqiu formed an army and went to Junji Mountain to engage the enemy and beheaded many of them. Ma Tong's troops reached the Tianshan Mountains, but the Huns retreated and took advantage of the situation to conquer the chariot division. Generals Shang and Ma both withdrew their troops and returned to the court. Li Guangli was defeated and surrendered to the Huns. In June, Prime Minister Liu Quyou was imprisoned and beheaded because his wife was involved in witchcraft. In autumn, there was a locust plague. In September, Gongsun Yong and Hu Qian were found guilty of treason and were executed. In the first month of spring of the fourth year, I came to Donglai and looked at the sea. On the third day of February, a meteorite fell in Yongdi, and its sound was heard four hundred miles away. In March, the emperor plowed the land in person. On the way back, he climbed Mount Tai and repaired the seal. On March 26, a sacrifice was held in Mingtang. On the 29th, sacrifices were made to Shilu Mountain. In June of summer, I returned to Ganquan. On August 30th in autumn, a partial solar eclipse occurred. In the first month of spring of the first year of Hou Yuan Dynasty, he drove to Ganquan to worship the god of Mount Tai in the suburbs, and then came to Anding. Wang Kun of Changyi passed away. In February, an edict was issued saying: I saw a spiritual light from heaven during the festival in the suburbs. When I was patrolling to the north, I saw a group of cranes roosting. At that time, it was not the time for trapping and killing, so I did not go hunting. When worshiping at Taishan Temple, auras and divine shadows appeared together. Therefore forgive the sinners in the world. In June of Xia, Shang Qiucheng, the imperial censor, committed suicide. The servant Shemang Heluo and his younger brother Hou Matong conspired to rebel. The prince-in-law Jin Rishidan, the commander of the carriage, Huo Guang, the commander of the chariot, and Shangguan Jie, the commander of the cavalry, joined forces to conquer. In autumn and July, there were earthquakes and magma gushes out from time to time. In the spring of the second year and the first month of the first lunar month, all princes and kings came to the emperor in Ganquan Palace, and the emperor rewarded the clan. In February, I came to Wuzha Palace in Zhouzhi County. On February 12, Prince Fuling was made the crown prince. On the 14th, Emperor Wu died in Wuzha Palace. The funeral was held in the front hall of Weiyang. On the second day of March, he was buried in Maoling. Ban Gu commented: The Han Dynasty was founded in a turbulent period when heroes were vying for the throne. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty brought order to the chaos, and Emperor Wen and Emperor Jing made recuperation and recuperation his top priority. However, there was still a lack of achievements in the cultural affairs of ancient rituals. In the early days of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, he resolutely dismissed hundreds of schools of thought and advocated Confucianism alone. He also sought advice from others, recommended talented people, and gave them opportunities to make contributions. He established Imperial College, established suburban sacrifices, corrected Shuo, established calendar numbers, and harmonious rhythms, composed poems and music, established Zen confederations, and worshiped hundreds of gods. After inheriting the Zhou Dynasty, he issued orders and articles that can be described in a new way. Inheriting the great achievements of his ancestors, he has the style of the emperors of the Xia, Shang and Zhou dynasties. Even if Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty had such a great talent and strategy, and if he did not change Wen Jing's frugality and put the common people on the throne of Renren, even the emperors praised in "Poems" and "Books" could not surpass him.
target: In the fourth year, the emperor plowed land and repaired Mount Tai. In the first year of Hou Yuan, he pardoned the world. In the second year, he made Prince Fuling crown prince and died in Wuzha Palace. Ban Gu commented: Emperor Wu dismissed hundreds of schools, promoted Confucianism, established Imperial College, and reformed rituals. He inherited ancestral achievements but lacked frugality, which even praised emperors could not surpass.

source: Han Gaozu was a native of Zhongyangli, Fengyi, Peixian County, and his surname was Liu. His mother once closed her eyes and took a nap on the embankment of a pond, and unexpectedly met the god in her dream. At that time, there was thunder and lightning and the sky was dark. His father Taigong went to Tangba to meet his mother and saw a dragon crawling on his mother's body. Soon after, she became pregnant and gave birth to Han Gaozu. Emperor Gaozu had a high nose, raised eyebrows, a beautiful beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left thigh. He is kind, generous and broad-minded. Usually informal, but unwilling to engage in ordinary productive labor. When he grew up, he served as a minor official and became the chief of Sishang Pavilion. But he looked down upon the officials in the government. Emperor Gaozu loved wine and sex. He often went to Wang Po and Wu Ma's hotel to buy wine on credit, and sometimes he was extremely drunk. Wang Po and Wu Ma saw strange phenomena appearing on his body while he was lying drunk. Every time Gaozu drank wine on credit, the hotel always doubled the price of the wine. Later, seeing his mysterious atmosphere when he was drunk, when settling the wine bill at the end of the year, the two families often tore up the IOUs and waived his wine debt. Emperor Gaozu once went to Xianyang, the capital of Qin, to do corvee service and saw the majesty of Qin Shihuang with his own eyes. He sighed and said: A real man should be like this!
target: Han Gaozu, originally named Liu Ji, was born in Peixian County. His mother dreamed of a god during a thunderstorm, and his father saw a dragon on her, leading to his birth. He had a distinctive appearance with a high nose, raised eyebrows, a beautiful beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left thigh. He was generous and broad-minded, disliking ordinary labor, and served as a minor official, often looking down on others. He loved wine and women, frequently buying wine on credit from Wang Po and Wu Ma, who noticed strange phenomena when he was drunk and eventually forgave his debts. While performing corvée in Xianyang, he saw Qin Shihuang and declared, "A real man should be like this.".

source: Lu Gong of Shanfu County was a good friend of the magistrate of Pei County. Because he was hiding from his enemies, he stayed in the magistrate's apartment and later moved his family to Pei County. Some prominent people in Peizhong heard that a friend of the county magistrate had moved to Pei, and they all went to congratulate him. Xiao He is the county magistrate's assistant and is responsible for collecting gifts. I say to all the prominent figures: Anyone who can contribute less than one thousand yuan will sit down in the hall. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty was the chief of the pavilion at this time. He usually looked down on these people, so he mischievously wrote his name on the red envelope and said "ten thousand yuan in congratulations", but actually did not give a penny. When the gift package was delivered, Lu Gong was surprised to see the generous gift and went to the gate to greet him personally. Lu Gong was good at fortune-telling, and when he saw Gaozu's extraordinary appearance, he also respected him very much. He led him into the living room and invited him to sit on the throne. Xiao He said: Liu Ji usually only talks big words and seldom accomplishes good things. Emperor Gaozu had long looked down on these prominent figures in the county, so he sat on the throne without humility and looked at ease. When he was half drunk, Lu Gong asked Gaozu to stay with his eyes. When the banquet was over, he asked Gaozu to stay and slow down. Lu Gong said to Emperor Gaozu: I have been studying physiognomy since I was young. I have seen many people, but none of them are as noble as yours. I hope you will take care of yourself. I have a biological daughter who is willing to marry you. After the guests left, Ms. Lu yelled at Mr. Lu and said, "You always said that my daughter was blessed in life and would marry a noble man in the future." Peiling is on good terms with you, but you want to marry my daughter but you refuse. Why do you want to marry me to Liu Ji today? Lu Gong smiled and said: This is not what you women know. In the end, he married his daughter to Gaozu. Gong Lu's daughter was later Empress Lu, and gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui of Han and Princess Lu Yuan. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty once resigned as the pavilion chief and went home to work on the farm. Queen Lu and her two children lived in a small shed in the field. An old man who was passing by asked him for water, and Queen Lu even let him have a meal. The father-in-law looked at Empress Lu's compliments and said: "My wife is a noble person in the world." Empress Lu asked him to look at the faces of the two children. He looked at Emperor Xiaohui and said: The reason why my wife became a noble person is because of this son. He looked at Princess Lu Yuan again and said that she would be a noble person in the future. After the father-in-law left, Gaozu returned from another farmhouse. Empress Lu told him about the past, saying that the father-in-law, my mother and my son were all high-ranking ministers.
target: Lu Gong, a friend of the Pei County magistrate, moved to the area, and Liu Ji falsely claimed a gift of ten thousand yuan at a gathering. Lu Gong, skilled in physiognomy, recognized Liu Ji's noble appearance and married his daughter to him, despite his wife's objections. This daughter later became Empress Lu, mother of Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan. After resigning as pavilion chief, Liu Ji worked on a farm. An old man predicted that Empress Lu and her children would be noble, and that Liu Ji's destiny was priceless. Liu Ji later wore a distinctive bamboo hat, known as the "Liu Shi Guan.". As pavilion chief, Liu Ji was tasked with sending servants to Lishan, but many escaped. He released them all, and over ten strong men chose to follow him.

source: Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty sent servants to Lishan Mountain for Peixian County as the pavilion chief. Many servants escaped on the way. When he thought about Lishan, they might all run away, so he went to Fengxi Zezhong Pavilion, asked the servants to stop and rest, invited everyone to drink, and let all the servants go at night. He said: Everyone should just run away! I will fly far away from now on! Among the servants, there were more than ten vigorous men who were willing to go with Gaozu. Emperor Gaozu took advantage of the drunkenness and led everyone to escape from the Zezhong trail, and sent one person to explore the road ahead. The pathfinder came back and reported: There is a big snake blocking the road ahead. Let's go back. Emperor Gaozu said drunkenly: Warriors march forward, why should they be afraid? So he went forward himself, drew his sword and killed the snake. The snake was cut into two pieces, and the road was passable. After walking for several miles, Emperor Gaozu was drunk and sleepy, so he lay down on the road. Someone caught up from behind and passed by where Gaozu killed the snake. He saw an old mother crying by the roadside at night. The man asked the reason, and the old mother said: Someone else killed my son. This person said: Who killed my mother’s son? The old mother said: My child is the son of the White Emperor. He turned into a big snake and blocked the road. When he met the son of the Red Emperor, he was beheaded, so I am crying here. This person thought that the old mother was talking nonsense and wanted to cross-examine her, but she disappeared in the blink of an eye. When this man caught up with Gaozu, Gaozu had already woken up. This person told Gaozu about this, and Gaozu was secretly happy and believed that he would become a big success. Those who followed him also grew in awe of him. Qin Shihuang once heard someone say: There is the emperor's cloud in the southeast. So the First Emperor made an eastward tour to suppress this cloud. Emperor Gaozu sometimes hid in the mountains and rivers of Mangdang. When Empress Lu and others went to look for him, it was always easy to find him. Emperor Gaozu felt strange and asked the reason. Queen Lu said: There is a layer of clouds above where you are staying. If you look for the place where the clouds are, you will find it.
target: While fleeing, he killed a large snake blocking the path. An old woman later claimed the snake was the son of the White Emperor, killed by the son of the Red Emperor, which Liu Ji took as a sign of his destiny. Qin Shihuang heard of an emperor's cloud in the southeast and toured to suppress it. Empress Lu could always find Liu Ji by following a cloud above his hiding place, further convincing others of his destiny.

source: In the autumn and seventh month of the first year of Qin II, Chen She revolted in Qixian County, arrived in Chendi, and proclaimed himself the king of Chu. He sent Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu to capture Zhao's territory. In August, Wu Chen proclaimed himself King of Zhao. In various counties and counties, major officials were killed one after another in response to Chen She. In September, the magistrate of Peixian County wanted to respond to Chen She in Peixian County. His aides Xiao He and Cao Shen came forward and said: As an official of the Qin Dynasty, you now want to betray the Qin Dynasty and lead the children of Peizhong to revolt. I am afraid that everyone will not listen. I hope you can recruit those who have fled, and you can get hundreds of people. With the power of these people, you can appeal to the worried children of Peizhong, and the children of Peizhong will not dare not listen. So the magistrate of Peixian County sent Fan Kuai to invite Gaozu. At this time, Gaozu already had hundreds of people. When Fan Kuai and Gaozu came with their troops, Peiling went back on his word. He was afraid that Gaozu would seize his power, so he closed the city and wanted to kill Xiao He and Cao Shen. Xiao He and Cao Shen were afraid and secretly crossed the city wall to seek refuge with Gaozu. Emperor Gaozu then wrote a silk book and shot it on the city. The book told the elders of Peixian County: The whole world has been bullied by the Qin Dynasty for a long time. Although you, the elders, are guarding the city for Pei Ling today, as soon as the rebels from various places arrive, they will use force in Pei land. If you can kill Pei Ling now, elect a leader who is popular among the people, and join the rebel army, you can ensure the safety of your family. Otherwise, the whole family will suffer, which is meaningless. So the elders of Peizhong led their children to kill Peiling, opened the city gate to welcome Gao Zu, and recommended Gao Zu to be the magistrate of Peixian County. Emperor Gaozu thanked him and said: Today is a time of great chaos in the world, and heroes are revolting one after another. If the leaders are not selected properly, they will be completely defeated. I am not a person who is greedy for life and afraid of death, but I am deeply afraid that my virtue and ability will be shallow and I will not be able to protect you, my fathers and brothers. This is a big deal, please choose another capable person. Xiao He and Cao Shen were both civil servants. They were worried about their wealth and life. They were afraid that if they failed to do something, the Qin Dynasty would exterminate the nine tribes in the future, they tried their best to recommend Gaozu. The elders of Peixian County all said: If you hear some strange things about Liu Ji, you may become a nobleman. We have asked the gods for divination, and they all said that there is no one more suitable than Liu Ji. Gaozu resigned many times, but everyone disagreed, so Gaozu was elected as Duke of Pei. Memorial ceremonies were held in Peiting to honor the ancient emperors Huangdi and Chiyou. And sacrifice blood to flags and drums. The flags are all red, because the snake killed is the son of the White Emperor, and the person who kills the snake with the sword is the son of the Red Emperor. So young powerful officials such as Xiao He, Cao Shen, Fan Kuai, etc. all recruited children from Peixian County, and the rebel army quickly expanded to 3,000 people.
