In the same month, Xiang Liang and his brother Xiang Yu rebelled against Wu.
target: In the first year of Qin II, Chen She rebelled, and the Pei County magistrate considered joining. Xiao He and Cao Shen advised him to recruit fugitives, including Liu Ji. When Liu Ji arrived with followers, the magistrate reneged and tried to kill Xiao He and Cao Shen, who fled to Liu Ji. Liu Ji shot a message into the city, urging the elders to kill the magistrate and join the rebellion. They did so, and Liu Ji was elected Duke of Pei after multiple refusals. He honored Huangdi and Chiyou, used red flags, and quickly expanded his army to 3,000 men. Other rebellions followed, including Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu in Wu.

source: In April, Xiang Liang killed Jingju and Qin Jia and stationed troops in Xue. Pei Gong went to Xue Jin to see Xiang Liang. After Pei Gong returned to his original place, he led his troops to attack Feng and regained Feng County. Yong Chi fled to Wei. In May, Xiang Yu returned after capturing Xiangcheng. Xiang Liang recalled all the young generals who were elsewhere. In the sixth month, Duke Pei arrived in Xuedi, and together with Xiang Liang, he made Sun Mixin, the king of Chu Huai, the king of Chu Huai. Qin general Zhang Han broke out and killed Wei Wang Jiu and Qi Wang Tian Dan in Linji. In July, it rained continuously. Duke Pei attacked Kang's father. Zhang Han surrounded Qi general Tian Rong in Dong'a County. Peigong and Xiang Liang led troops to rescue Tian Rong and defeated Qin general Zhang Han in Dong'a. Tian Rong led his troops back, and Peigong and Xiang Yu pursued the Qin soldiers to Chengyang County. They bloodbathed Chengyang and garrisoned in the east of Puyang. They fought against Zhang Han again and defeated the Qin soldiers again. Zhang Han regained his strength and defended Puyang, digging trenches to divert water and stabilize himself. Peigong and Xiang Yu then moved their troops to attack Dingtao. In August, Tian Rong established Tian Dan Zi Tian Shi as the King of Qi. Before Dingtao was captured, Peigong and Xiang Yu took the land to Yongqiu, fought with the Qin soldiers, defeated the Qin soldiers, and killed Li You, the governor of Sanchuan. Returned to attack Waihuang, but failed to capture it. Xiang Liang defeated the Qin army twice and showed his pride. Song Yi reminded him, but Xiang Liang didn't listen. The Qin Dynasty sent additional troops to Zhang Han. In September, Zhang Han secretly attacked Xiang Liang's garrison in Dingtao in the dark, defeated Xiang Liang's army, and killed Xiang Liang. It was rainy and rainy from July to September. Pei Gong and Xiang Yu were attacking Chenliu. When they heard that Xiang Liang was dead, the soldiers were frightened, so they and their general Lu Chen led troops eastward and moved King Huai of Chu from Xuyi to Pengcheng. Lu Chen garrisoned to the east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu garrisoned to the west of Pengcheng, and Peigong garrisoned to Dang County. Wei Bao, Wei Jiu's younger brother, established himself as King of Wei. In the ninth month of the leap year, King Huai merged the armies of Lu Chen and Xiang Yu and put him under his direct command. He appointed Pei Gong as the governor of Dang County and granted the title of Marquis of Wu'an to command the troops of Dang County. Xiang Yu was appointed Duke of Lu, Marquis of Chang'an, Lu Chen was appointed Situ, and Lu Chen's father Lu Qing was appointed Ling Yin. After Qin general Zhang Han defeated Xiang Liang, he thought that the rebel Qin forces in Chu were no longer a threat, so he crossed the river and went north to attack Zhao Wangxie and defeated Zhao Wangxie. King Zhao retreated to defend Julu City, and Qin General Wang Li's troops surrounded Julu. King Zhao asked King Huai of Chu for help many times, and King Huai appointed Song Yi as general, Xiang Yu as deputy general, and Fan Zeng as junior general. Lead the troops north to rescue Zhao Jun. Originally, King Huai had made an appointment with the generals, and whoever could conquer Guanzhong first would be crowned king.
target: Liu Ji's forces grew through various battles, including victories at Huling, Fangyu, and Xue. He faced setbacks, such as Yong Chi's betrayal to Wei, but regained Feng. He joined Xiang Liang, who made Sun Mixin King of Chu Huai. After Xiang Liang's death, Liu Ji and Xiang Yu moved King Huai to Pengcheng. King Huai appointed Liu Ji as Marquis of Wu'an and ordered that whoever first entered Guanzhong would be king. Liu Ji was chosen for his kindness, while Xiang Yu was deemed too violent.

source: Pei Gong led his troops to detour and attack Wancheng at night. All flags and drums ceased, and before dawn, Wancheng was surrounded by three layers. The governor of Nanyang County wanted to kill himself, but his close aide Chen Hui said: It is not time to die yet. So Chen Hui went across the city to see Pei Gong. He said: I heard that I have made an appointment with someone: the man who first entered Xianyang, the capital of Qin, honored me as king, and now I am attacking Wancheng. There were dozens of strongholds in Wan County. The soldiers guarding the city thought they would be executed if they surrendered, so they all climbed to the city to defend it. If the troops attack all day long, both sides will suffer a lot of casualties; if they give up attacking Wan and lead their troops westward, the Qin soldiers in Wan will be completely behind them. A single attack on Wan would delay the promise that whoever enters Xianyang first would be the king; a single step of abandoning Wan would leave behind the possibility of pursuers. For the sake of his subordinates, it is better for me to allow the Wancheng garrison to surrender, make the county garrison a marquis, and still order him to stay where he is. Move his forces westward. The cities in the front that have not yet been captured will definitely respond to the news and welcome the next step. You will be able to pass smoothly with just one step without any worries. Pei Gong said: Very good. In the seventh month, the governor of Nanyang, Ji Qi, surrendered. Pei Gong granted him the title of Marquis of Yin, and granted Chen Hui the title of Qianhu. Leading troops to the west, the momentum is like breaking bamboo. When the troops arrived at Danshui, Qin Gao Wuhou Ji and Xianghou Wang Ling surrendered.
target: Liu Ji advanced westward, defeating Qin forces and accepting surrenders. He entered Wuguan and reached Bashui, where Qin Prince Ying surrendered. Liu Ji spared him, entered Xianyang, and issued the "three chapters of the law," abolishing harsh Qin laws. He refused gifts from the people, winning their support.

source: So Xiang Yu rewarded his soldiers and ordered them to fight tomorrow. At this time, Xiang Yu had an army of 400,000, which was said to be one million. Pei Gong had 100,000 soldiers, and he claimed to have 200,000 soldiers. There was a huge disparity in military strength. Xiang Yu's uncle Zuo Yin, Xiang Bo, was Zhang Liang's old friend. He met Zhang Liang overnight and told Xiang Yu in detail the military facts of tomorrow's attack on Pei Gong. He wanted Zhang Liang to escape the danger with him so that he would not have to die with Pei Gong. Zhang Liang said: I am here as an envoy of the King of Han to submit to Pei Gong. I cannot leave without saying goodbye. It is unjust to say goodbye without saying goodbye. So he and Xiang Bo went to see Pei Gong. Pei Gong and Xiang Bo were about to get married, and he said to Xiang Bo: After I entered the pass, I didn't dare to take away anything. I kept the records of the officials and people, and sealed the Qin Dynasty's treasury to wait for General Xiang Yu. The reason why I sent troops to guard the pass is to guard against other thieves.
target: He guarded Hangu Pass against Xiang Yu, who grew angry. Xiang Yu's uncle Xiang Bo warned Zhang Liang, leading to the Hongmen Banquet, where Liu Ji narrowly escaped assassination. Xiang Yu later entered Xianyang, killed Prince Ying, and burned the palaces, disappointing the people.

source: Overthrowing King Huai of Chu's agreement that the first person to enter Guanzhong would be king, he instead established Peigong as King of Han, with jurisdiction over forty-one counties in Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, with the capital at Nanzheng. Divide Guanzhong into three parts and send three Qin generals to each of them. Zhang Han was appointed King of Yong, with his capital in Feiqiu; Sima Xin was appointed King of Sai, with his capital in Yueyang; Dong Yi was appointed King of Zhai, with his capital in Gaonu. He also granted Chu general Xiaqiu Shenyang the title of King of Henan, with his capital in Luoyang. Zhao general Sima Qiong became the king of Yin, and all were in Chaoge. Dangyang Junying was declared the king of Jiujiang and his capital was in six counties. Gong Ao, the Zhuguo of King Huai, was the King of Linjiang, and his capital was in Jiangling. Fanjun Wu Rui was the king of Hengshan, and his capital was Zhu. Tian'an, the grandson of the former Qi King Tian Jian, became the King of Jibei. He moved King Bao of the Wei Dynasty to be the king of the Western Wei Dynasty, with his capital in Pingyang. Han Guang, the king of Yan Dynasty, became the king of Liaodong. Yan general Zang Tu became the king of Yan, and his capital was Ji. He moved to Qi Wangtian City and became the King of Jiaodong. The generals of Qi, Tiandu, are all kings of Qi, and they are all in Lin? Moved to Zhao Wang Xie as the acting king. Zhang Er, Prime Minister of Zhao, was the King of Changshan. Liu Bang, the king of Han, resented Xiang Yu's violation of his previous agreement to be the king of Dingguanzhong first, and wanted to launch an attack. Xiao He tried to dissuade him, but he stopped. In the fourth month of summer, all the princes bid farewell to Xiang Yu's command and went to their own feudal states. Xiang Yu assigned 30,000 soldiers to the King of Han. Chu and other vassal states had tens of thousands of people who admired the King of Han and were willing to follow him. Zhang Liang bid farewell to the King of Han and returned to Korea. The King of Han personally sent Zhang Liang to Baozhong. When saying goodbye, Zhang Liang suggested that the King of Han burn down the plank road. Firstly, to prevent other princes from peeking into Hanzhong, and secondly, to express to Xiang Yu that the King of Han had no intention of leaving Hanzhong anymore. When the King of Han arrived at Nanzheng, all his officers and men sang in unison and wanted to return to the east; many of them fled back. Han Xin, the captain of Zhisu, also left with the people returning from the east. Xiao He chased Han Xin and recommended him to the king of Han. Xiao He said: If you really want to conquer the world, there is no one with whom to discuss except Han Xin.
target: Xiang Yu violated the agreement, making Liu Ji King of Han in Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, while dividing Guanzhong among three Qin generals. Liu Ji resented this but was dissuaded from attacking. He burned the plank road to show no intention of leaving Hanzhong. Han Xin, recommended by Xiao He, was made general and advised an eastern campaign. Liu Ji defeated Zhang Han and expanded, while rebellions by Tian Rong and others weakened Xiang Yu.

source: Although Xiang Yu had already heard about the Han king's eastward advance, he had already sent all his troops to attack Chu. He wanted to destroy Qi and then attack the Han army. Therefore, the Han king took the opportunity to annex the troops of Wei, Yin and other five princes and attack Chu eastward. When the troops arrived in Waihuang, Peng Yue led 30,000 people to surrender to the Han. The King of Han made Peng Yue Prime Minister of Wei. Let him pacify Liang Di. The king of Han then entered Pengcheng, the capital of Chu Xiang. Collected Xiang Yu's beauties and treasures, and held a cocktail party to celebrate the victory. After hearing the news, Xiang Yu sent another general to attack, and led 30,000 elite troops from Huling, Lu, to Xiao County. They attacked the Han army in the early morning and fought on the Sui River east of Pengcheng Lingbi. The soldiers of Chu surrounded the king of Han three times. A strong wind came from the northwest, breaking trees and breaking houses, flying sand and rocks, making the day look like night, and the Chu army was in chaos. The king of Han took advantage of the chaos and broke through the siege with dozens of cavalry to escape. Traveling through Peixian County, he sent people to look for his family members, but the whole family had fled and their whereabouts were unknown. The King of Han met his son Xiaohui and his daughter Lu Yuan on the way, and they boarded a chariot and left in panic. The Chu cavalry chased the King of Han. Seeing the critical situation, the King of Han pushed his children out of the carriage. Teng Gong put the two men in the car again and finally escaped from the tiger's mouth. Shen Shiqi, the father of the Han Dynasty, the Grand Duke, and his wife, Empress Lu, escaped from the trail and met the Chu army. Xiang Yu placed them as hostages in the army. When the princes saw that the Han army was completely defeated, they all fled. King Xin of Sai and King Yi of Zhai surrendered to Chu, and King Qiong of Yin died. Zhou Luhou, the brother-in-law of the King of Han, led troops and horses to station in Xiayi County, and the King of Han went there to settle down. Gradually the scattered soldiers were gathered and stationed in Dang County. The king of Han went west through Liang and arrived at Yucheng County. He said to Sui He, who asked to see him, "Master, go and persuade Yingbu, king of Jiujiang, to raise an army to rebel against Chu. Xiang Yu will leave his troops to attack Yingbu." As long as Xiang Yu can keep his troops for a few months, I will surely conquer the world. Sui He was ordered to persuade Yingbu, and as expected, Yingbu rebelled against Chu. In the fifth month, the troops of the King of Han were assembled in Xingyang. Xiao He recruited all the old, weak and underage people in Guanzhong to join his army. Han Xin also gathered his soldiers to join forces with the King of Han. At this time, the King of Han regained his military power.
target: Liu Ji's forces grew, and he captured Pengcheng, but Xiang Yu counterattacked, defeating him. Liu Ji regrouped in Xingyang, using strategies like Sui He persuading Yingbu to rebel. He faced a famine in Guanzhong and sent Han Xin to conquer Wei, Zhao, and Qi. After a series of battles, including the siege of Xingyang, Liu Ji escaped using a decoy. He regained Chenggao and confronted Xiang Yu at Guangwu, listing ten crimes. Xiang Yu shot him, but he feigned a minor injury.

source: Guanzhong soldiers rushed to the Chu-Han battlefield in large numbers, while Peng Yue and Tian Heng occupied the Liang area, attacking and harassing the Chu army and cutting off their food channels. After Han Xin captured Qi, he sent someone to tell the king of Han: Qi is close to Chu and its power is too small. If I don't become an acting king, I'm afraid I won't be able to stabilize Qi. The king of Han was furious and wanted to attack him. Zhang Liang said: It is better to take the opportunity to make him the king of Qi and let him guard the land of Qi. In the second month of spring, Zhang Liang was sent with the royal seal to make Han Xin the king of Qi. In the seventh month of autumn, Yingbu was made King of Huainan. In August, the calculation method began to be implemented. The Beibei and Yan people sent a group of brave cavalry to assist the Han army. The King of Han ordered: If a sergeant unfortunately dies in battle, a special person will be sent to dress him, put him in a coffin, and send him back to his hometown. All the people in the world have sincerely surrendered. Xiang Yu knew that he lacked helpers and was about to run out of food and grass. Han Xin led troops to attack the Chu army many times, and he was very worried. The King of Han sent Duke Hou to Chu to persuade Xiang Yu to release the Grand Duke and Empress Lu. So Xiang Yu and the King of Han agreed to divide the world equally, using the chasm as the dividing line, with the west returning to Han and the east returning to Chu.
target: Liu Ji recovered, made Han Xin King of Qi, and Yingbu King of Huainan. With Xiang Yu's resources dwindling, they agreed to divide the world using the chasm. However, Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised Liu Ji to attack, leading to Xiang Yu's eventual defeat.

source: In the winter of tenth month of the fifth year of Emperor Gaozu, the King of Han pursued Xiang Yu to the south of Yangxia, stopped advancing, and made an appointment with Qi King Han Xin and Wei Xiangguo Peng Yue to attack the Chu army. The Han King's troops reached Guling, but Han, Peng and others failed to meet up as scheduled. Xiang Yu led the troops to attack the army of the King of Han and defeated the Han soldiers. The king of Han withdrew his troops and returned to the original fortress, digging a deep ditch to defend himself. The King of Han worriedly said to Zhang Liang: "What should we do if the princes do not want to obey us?" Zhang Liang replied: Even if the Chu army is defeated, Han Xin and Peng Yue will not gain the benefit of increasing their territory. It is reasonable for them not to join forces. If the king can share the fruits of victory with them, they will come to join forces immediately. The appointment of Han Xin as King of Qi was not out of the King's original intention. Han Xin still lacked confidence in the King. Peng Yue originally pacified the Liang region, but later the king made Peng Yue the Prime Minister of Wei because King Bao of Wei came and surrendered. Now that King Bao of Wei is dead, Peng Yue also wants to claim the throne himself, but the king has yet to make a decision. If the area north of Suiyang to Gucheng could be allocated to Peng Yue and he could be crowned king, and the area east of Chen to the Bohai Sea could be allocated to King Han Xin of Qi, whose family was in Chu, he originally wanted to regain his homeland. The king abandoned these two lands to allow Han and Peng to fight on their own, and Chu Xiang would be easily defeated.
target: In the winter of the fifth year, the King of Han pursued Xiang Yu but his allies Han Xin and Peng Yue failed to meet as scheduled. Xiang Yu defeated the Han forces, forcing the king to retreat and fortify his position. Following Zhang Liang's advice to share conquered territories, the king promised Han Xin the lands east of Chen to the Bohai Sea and Peng Yue the area north of Suiyang to Gucheng.

source: The king abandoned these two lands to allow Han and Peng to fight on their own, and Chu Xiang would be easily defeated. So the King of Han sent envoys to inform Han Xin and Peng Yue of the above intentions. As soon as the notice arrived, Han Pengdu led his troops to join forces. In November, Liu Jia invaded Chu and besieged Shouchun. The king of Han also sent people to lure Zhou Yin, the great commander of Chu, to surrender. Zhou Yin rebelled against Chu and violently attacked six counties with troops from Shu County. He led troops from Jiujiang to cooperate with Yingbu and attacked Chengfu County. Yingbu and Liu Jia both joined forces with the King of Han. In the winter of the fifth year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, in December, Han soldiers surrounded Xiang Yu at Gaixia. Xiang Yu heard Chu troops on all sides at night and knew that the Han soldiers had completely controlled the positions around the Chu troops, so he led hundreds of cavalry to abandon the camp and break out. The Chu troops were defeated because they had no master. Guan Ying pursued Xiang Yu in Dongcheng. The land of Chu was completely pacified, but the land of Lu did not surrender. The King of Han led his army to massacre the city, but was moved by the local soldiers' actions to uphold Xiang Yu's integrity, so he stopped the attack and displayed Xiang Yu's head to inform Lu's father and brother, who surrendered. Originally, King Huai made Xiang Yu the Duke of Lu. After Xiang Yu's death, the land of Lu defended him, so Xiang Yu was buried in Gucheng, Jibei with the ceremony of Duke Lu.
target: Both then joined forces. Liu Jia invaded Chu, and Zhou Yin surrendered. In December, Han forces surrounded Xiang Yu at Gaixia. Hearing Chu songs on all sides, Xiang Yu fled with cavalry and was pursued to Dongcheng. The Chu lands were pacified, though Lu initially refused to surrender until shown Xiang Yu's head. Xiang Yu was buried with the rites of Duke of Lu.

source: The King of Han mourned for Xiang Yu and went to mourn for him. The king of Han made Xiang Bo and four other marquises and gave them the surname Liu. People from other places who were plundered and brought to Chu were all sent back to their place of origin. The King of Han returned to Dingtao, entered Han Xin's camp with lightning speed, and deprived Han Xin of his military power. Gong Ao, the king of Linjiang who was originally established by Xiang Yu, died, and his son Wei succeeded him as king and refused to surrender. The king of Han sent Lu Wan and Liu Jia to conquer Linjiang Wangwei. In the spring and first month of the sixth year of Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty, the king of Han honored his brother Liu Bo as the Marquis of Wu Ai. The order was given: The Chu region has been pacified, and the Righteous Emperor has no descendants. In order to appease the people of the Chu region, he decided to appoint another master of the Chu region. King Han Xin of Qi understood the customs and customs of the Chu land, and now he was appointed King of Chu. He governed the Huaibei region, with his capital at Xiapi. Peng Yue, the Marquis of Wei Xiangguo who founded the city, cared about the people of Wei and loved the soldiers. He often defeated the Chu army with a small number and defeated the Chu army several times. He gave the old land of Wei as his fiefdom and named it King of Liang. He was all in Dingtao. He also said in the order: The war has lasted for eight years, causing serious disasters to the people. Today, the world has been unified and stable. All prisoners except those sentenced to death will be pardoned.
target: In the sixth year, the king honored his brother as Marquis of Wu Ai, appointed Han Xin as King of Chu, and made Peng Yue King of Liang. A general amnesty was declared except for capital crimes.

source: Now that the fiefdoms and titles of the princes and princes have been determined, and they share the title of king with the king, there is no distinction between them. In this way, the king's outstanding achievements and virtues cannot be announced to future generations. Therefore, I risked my life and asked for the title of emperor. The King of Han thanked him and said: "I often hear that the emperor's title belongs to the sages. A title that is not worthy of the name should not be obtained." Today, all the princes and kings have elected me to be the emperor. How can I accept it? All the princes and kings reported: The great king has risen among the people, wiped out the Qin Dynasty, and shocked the whole country. Later, he used the remote areas of Bashu as a base to promote mighty virtue from Hanzhong, punish injustice, establish meritorious services, and pacify the sea. The meritorious officials were all given fiefs and food towns, and all were rewarded according to their merits. The king's kindness is spread all over the world, and no other princes can compare with it. Respecting him as emperor is worthy of his name. May the king satisfy the wishes of the people in the world. The King of Han said: If you princes say that it is beneficial for the people of the world for me to become emperor, then I will agree with it. So all the princes and princes, the Marquis of Chang'an, Lu Wan, and three hundred other people, together with Dr. Ji Sijun, Shusun Tong, chose an auspicious day, the third day of the second lunar month, to give the emperor's title. The King of Han, the emperor, was located in Jiyin, north of the Sishui River. Queen Lu was respected as the queen, the prince as the crown prince, and his deceased mother was posthumously named Mrs. Zhaoling.
target: The princes petitioned the king to accept the title of Emperor, which he initially declined but eventually accepted on an auspicious day in the second month. Queen Lu was honored as empress, the prince as crown prince.

source: Queen Lu was respected as the queen, the prince as the crown prince, and his deceased mother was posthumously named Mrs. Zhaoling. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty issued an edict saying: Wu Rui, the former king of Hengshan, his two sons and one nephew raised troops from the Baiyue area to support the princes, destroy the violent Qin Dynasty, and achieve great achievements. The princes made him king. Later, Xiang Yu invaded his land and demoted him to Fanjun. Now Changsha, Yuzhang, Xianglin, Guijun, Nanhai and other places are his fiefdoms, and Fanjun Wu Rui is made the king of Changsha. The edict also said: The former king of Guangdong had inherited the sacrifices of Guangdong, but the Qin Dynasty took away his land, leaving no one to worship the ancestors of Guangdong. The princes attacked Qin and killed all their relatives. They led the soldiers of Fujian to help destroy Qin's righteous move. Xiang Yu was deposed and did not stand. Now I regard the deceased as the king of Fujian and Guangdong, and central Fujian will be placed under his jurisdiction without losing his old position. The emperor of the Han Dynasty was the western capital of Luoyang. In the fifth month of summer, all the soldiers were demobilized and returned home. The emperor issued an edict saying: The sons of princes in Guanzhong will be exempted from taxes and servitude for twelve years, and those who have returned to their native places will be exempted from taxes and servitude for six years. In the past, some people gathered in the mountains and rivers to avoid the Qin Dynasty and were not included in the household registration. Now that the world has been settled, everyone can return to his hometown and restore his original rank, land and housing. Officials in various places must explain the principles according to the laws and must not be forced to insult. Those among the common people who sold themselves as slaves or maidservants to others due to hunger were exempted from their status as slaves and maidservants and became commoners. All military officials and soldiers of the former Qin were exempted from crime. Among them, those who had not committed any crime of aiding Qin but had no title or whose original title was dissatisfied with the officials were given titles as officials, and those who had the original title of officials were increased by one level.
target: Wu Rui was made King of Changsha, and the former King of Guangdong was restored. The capital was established at Luoyang. Soldiers were demobilized, with exemptions from taxes for those in Guanzhong and those returning home. Former slaves were freed, and military officials were granted titles and lands according to merit.

source: The edict was issued saying: The world has been stabilized. Heroes with meritorious services have been granted the title of marquis and newly ascended to the throne of the emperor. However, not all of them have been rewarded according to their merits. Because I have been in the military for nine years, some of them have no time to learn the laws, and some of them accidentally violate the national laws, and in serious cases they are sentenced to death. I deeply sympathize with them. Now I plan to grant amnesty to the whole world. Tian Ken expressed his congratulations and said: What the emperor saw is extremely true. Your Majesty took Han Xin into custody and established his capital in Guanzhong. Qin is a place with a favorable situation, with the Yellow River as its belt, Guanshan Mountain as its danger, and thousands of miles away from the eastern princes. Qin's 20,000 people can resist millions of foreign troops. Qin's situation is convenient. When it wants to send its troops out to conquer the enemy, it has a strong position to build a stronghold. As for the land of Qi, there are the riches of Langyi and Jimo in the east, the dangers of Mount Tai in the south, the Yellow River in the west as a natural moat, and the Bohai Sea in the north for easy defense. This is equivalent to the Eastern and Western Qin Dynasties. If he is not a close relative, he cannot be sent to be the king of Qi. Emperor Gaozu said: This statement is extremely appropriate. Give five hundred catties of gold. Emperor Gaozu returned to Luoyang, pardoned Han Xin, and demoted him to the rank of Marquis of Huaiyin. On December 28, the talismans began to be cut and the heroes Cao Shen and others were made Tonghou. The edict said: Qi is the place where the country has been founded since ancient times. Now it has been changed to a county. It should be restored to a feudal state to enfeoff the princes and kings. General Liu Jia has made great achievements many times, so he can be elected as the king of Qi, Jing and other places with both merit and virtue. On the 21st of the first lunar month in the seventh year of the Han Dynasty, King Xin of Han and others petitioned to make Liu Jia the king of Jing from the fifty-three counties of Dongyang, Zhang, and Wu, and to make Liu Jiao, the emperor's younger brother, Marquis Wenxin, the king of Chu from the thirty-six counties of Dang, Xue, and Tan. On the 27th, Yun Fifty-three counties in Zhong, Yanmen, and Dai counties made the emperor's brother Yixinhou Liu Xi the king of the country. Seventy-three counties in Jiaodong, Jiaoxi, Linzi, Jibei, Boyang, and Chengyang counties made Prince Fei the king of Qi. Thirty-one counties in Taiyuan County were designated as Korea, and King Han's capital was moved to Jinyang. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty had already awarded more than 20 meritorious officials, and the rest were competing for merit, which prevented the awarding work from proceeding normally. The emperor lived in the South Palace. He saw the generals whispering in twos and threes on the road, and asked Zhang Liang why. Zhang Liang said: Your Majesty and they share the world. Now the emperor is the emperor, and those who are rewarded are the old friends and relatives, and those who are killed are all the enemies of the past.
target: In subsequent years, the emperor dealt with various rebellions. Zang Tu of Yan rebelled and was captured. Han Xin of Chu was arrested on suspicion of rebellion and demoted to Marquis of Huaiyin. The emperor established various princes, including Liu Jia as King of Jing and Liu Fei as King of Qi. When generals grew restless over delayed rewards, Zhang Liang advised rewarding the emperor's former enemy Yong Chi first, which calmed everyone. The emperor honored his father as Supreme Emperor.

source: In the ninth month of autumn, the Huns besieged King Xin of Han in Mayi, and Xin surrendered to the Huns. In the winter and tenth month of the seventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, the emperor personally led troops to Tong? The county attacked Han Wangxin who surrendered to the Xiongnu and killed his general. Xin fled to the Xiongnu. Manqiuchen and Wang Huang, the generals of King Xin of Han, jointly declared Zhao Li, the late Zhao queen, as king. They gathered the scattered soldiers of King Xin of Han and joined forces with the Xiongnu to fight against the Han soldiers.
target: The Xiongnu besieged King Xin of Han, who surrendered. The emperor personally led campaigns against the Xiongnu and rebels, suffering defeats and victories.

source: The emperor fought continuously from Jinyang and pursued the victory to reach Loufan. During the severe cold, 20-30% of the soldiers suffered frozen fingers. They had to retreat to Pingcheng and were besieged by the Huns. Seven days later, Chen Ping's beauty trick was used to break through. Fan Kuai was sent to stay behind to stabilize the land. In December, the emperor passed by Zhao when he returned to the court, but he did not give any courtesy to King Zhao. In the same month, the Xiongnu attacked Dai. King Dai abandoned the city and fled, returned to Luoyang, pardoned his sins, and demoted him to the rank of Marquis of Lingyang. On the 21st, the emperor appointed his son Ruyi as acting king.
target: He established his son Ruyi as acting king of Dai. Xiao He constructed magnificent palaces, which initially angered the emperor but was justified as demonstrating imperial authority.

source: Then the capital was moved from Yueyang to Chang'an. Zong Zhengguan was established to order the nine clans. In April of summer, he patrolled to Luoyang. In the winter of the eighth year, the emperor attacked Han Xin's remaining party in Dongyuan. When the troops returned, they passed through the Zhao territory. Zhao Xiangguan and his superiors were disgraced and resentful of the Emperor Gaozu's disrespect to King Zhao when he visited Zhao last winter, so he plotted to kill the emperor.
target: The capital moved to Chang'an. Zhao officials plotted assassination but were exposed. The emperor dealt with Chen Xi's rebellion, personally leading forces to Handan and bribing enemy generals to surrender.

source: The king abandoned these two lands to allow Han and Peng to fight on their own, and Chu Xiang would be easily defeated. So the King of Han sent envoys to inform Han Xin and Peng Yue of the above intentions. As soon as the notice arrived, Han Pengdu led his troops to join forces. In November, Liu Jia invaded Chu and besieged Shouchun. The king of Han also sent people to lure Zhou Yin, the great commander of Chu, to surrender. Zhou Yin rebelled against Chu and violently attacked six counties with troops from Shu County. He led troops from Jiujiang to cooperate with Yingbu and attacked Chengfu County. Yingbu and Liu Jia both joined forces with the King of Han. In the winter of the fifth year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, in December, Han soldiers surrounded Xiang Yu at Gaixia. Xiang Yu heard Chu troops on all sides at night and knew that the Han soldiers had completely controlled the positions around the Chu troops, so he led hundreds of cavalry to abandon the camp and break out. The Chu troops were defeated because they had no master. Guan Ying pursued Xiang Yu in Dongcheng. The land of Chu was completely pacified, but the land of Lu did not surrender. The King of Han led his army to massacre the city, but was moved by the local soldiers' actions to uphold Xiang Yu's integrity, so he stopped the attack and displayed Xiang Yu's head to inform Lu's father and brother, who surrendered. Originally, King Huai made Xiang Yu the Duke of Lu. After Xiang Yu's death, the land of Lu defended him, so Xiang Yu was buried in Gucheng, Jibei with the ceremony of Duke Lu. The King of Han mourned for Xiang Yu and went to mourn for him.
target: In the twelfth year, Han Xin was executed for rebellion in Chang'an. Peng Yue rebelled and was executed. Yingbu of Huainan rebelled; the emperor personally led forces against him, defeating him at Huifou.

source: The emperor pardoned all prisoners in the world who were guilty of less than capital crimes and joined the army; at the same time, he recruited soldiers from the princes and the emperor personally conquered Yingbu. In the winter of the twelfth year in October, the emperor defeated Yingbu's soldiers in Huifou. Yingbu fled, and the emperor's faction gave chase. When the emperor returned to the capital, he passed through his hometown of Peixian County and stopped temporarily. He held a banquet in Peigong and entertained all his old friends, fathers and children to drink. He summoned one hundred and twenty men from Peizhong and taught them how to sing. When the wine was in full swing, the emperor played a musical instrument and sang to himself: The wind is strong and the clouds are flying/Vega the four seas and return home/And the fierce warriors guard the four directions! The sons and daughters all sang together. The emperor danced to the song, was generous and sentimental, and shed tears. To Peidi’s father and brother: Wanderers always miss their hometown. Although I live in Guanzhong, after my death, my soul will still miss my hometown in Peidi. Recalling that I served as Pei Gong and raised troops to overthrow the violent Qin Dynasty, and then conquered the world, I would like to use Pei as my Tang Muyi, exempt the people of Pei from corvee, and not pay taxes to the court from generation to generation. The elders and old friends of Peixian County had a great time drinking together and telling stories about the emperor's past for fun. More than ten days later, the emperor wanted to resign, but Peidi's father and brother insisted on staying. The emperor said: I have many followers, and my father and brother cannot provide for them. Just left. Thousands of people in Peizhong sent the emperor to the west of the county and presented him with farewell gifts. The emperor stayed again and opened his tent to entertain those who were leaving for three days. The fathers and sons of Peixian County all kowtowed in gratitude and said: Peixian County was exempted from taxes and servitude by the emperor's favor, but Feng County failed to receive the favor. I hope the emperor will take care of Feng County. The emperor said: Feng County is the place where I grew up, and I will never forget it.
target: Returning through his hometown of Pei County, the emperor held a grand banquet, sang about returning home in glory, and exempted Pei from taxes. He was wounded by an arrow during the Yingbu campaign and grew ill.

source: If there is an ungrateful person who betrays the emperor and supports his troops, I will mobilize all the people in the world to punish him. I am announcing this to the world so that everyone can understand what I mean. When the emperor attacked Yingbu, he was shot by a stray arrow and fell ill during the battle. The condition gradually worsened. Empress Lu invited a good doctor. The doctor came in and the emperor asked what he thought of the injury. The doctor said: The disease will get better. At this time, the emperor laughed and cursed at the doctor. He said: I use a commoner to carry a three-foot sword to conquer the world. Isn't this destiny? My destiny is in heaven, so what good will it do me if Bian Que, the miracle doctor, is reincarnated! He refused to let the doctor diagnose the disease, rewarded him with fifty pounds of gold, and asked him to leave the palace. Queen Lu asked: Your Majesty, a hundred years later, Prime Minister Xiao He will also pass away. Who can replace him as prime minister? The emperor said: Cao Shen can do it. Empress Lu asked who would succeed Cao Shen, and the emperor said: "Wang Ling can, but he has a somewhat upright character. Chen Ping can help him." Chen Ping was resourceful, but it was difficult for him to serve as prime minister alone. Zhou Bo was old and prudent but not good at diction, but it was Zhou Bo who stabilized Liu Han and allowed him to serve as Taiwei. Empress Lu asked who would succeed him in the future, and the emperor said: "I can't say clearly in the future." Lu Wan and thousands of others waited at the border fortress, hoping that the emperor would recover and go to court to apologize and defend himself against false accusations. On April 25th in the summer, Emperor Gao died in Changle Palace. After hearing the news, Lu Wan fled to the Huns. Empress Lu said to Shen Shiqi: Many generals and emperors were registered as civilians in the past. Later, they became ministers in the north, but they were always dissatisfied. Now they want to fight for the young master again. If they are not killed, the world will be uneasy. Therefore, obituary notices of the emperor's death were not published. Someone heard about the emperor's death and told Li Shang.
target: When Empress Lu asked about successors, he named Cao Shen, then Wang Ling with Chen Ping's assistance, and Zhou Bo as Taiwei. Emperor Gao died in Changle Palace in the fourth month. Empress Lu initially concealed his death to plot against the generals but was persuaded otherwise. He was buried at Changling and posthumously titled Emperor Gao.

source: In the past, the Zhou Dynasty learned from the lessons of the Xia and Shang dynasties. King Wen, King Wu, and Duke Zhou formulated laws and regulations, established five titles such as duke, marquis, uncle, son, and male, and enfeoffed 800 vassal states, among which more than 50 had the same surname as the emperor. Zhou Gong and Kang Shu established vassal vassals in Lu and Wei, each with a radius of hundreds of miles; Jiang Taigong established vassal in Qi, which was also the place where the five princes and nine states were the chief. The "Book of Songs" records the system at that time: The army is used as a fence, and the grand master is used as a wall. Use the princes of the big country as a barrier, and use the royal family with the same surname as a pillar.
target: The Zhou Dynasty learned from the Xia and Shang dynasties. King Wen, King Wu, and Duke Zhou established laws and enfeoffed 800 vassal states, with over fifty sharing the emperor's surname. The system was recorded in the "Book of Songs," describing the army and grand master as a fence and wall, and the princes and royal family as barriers and pillars.

source: Use the princes of the big country as a barrier, and use the royal family with the same surname as a pillar. If one can govern with virtue, the world will be at peace, and the castle of the son of the feudal clan will be strong. The castle cannot be destroyed and the clan cannot be isolated. Otherwise, fear and uneasiness will arise. Therefore, relatives and virtuous people are awarded titles together, and commending and commending people with meritorious deeds is fundamental to the prosperity and decline of the country and the stability of the world, and cannot be changed. Therefore, when the Zhou Dynasty was strong, the Dukes of Zhou and Shao participated in running the country, reaching a state where no one broke the law and the criminal law was put aside; when it declined, the Five Hegemons supported them and guarded the world together. Since King You and King Ping, the country has been declining day by day, and has even become uneasy between powerful vassal states. It has also split into two small kingdoms, the Eastern Zhou Dynasty and the Western Zhou Dynasty. There is a high platform for the emperor to escape debts and refuge, and there are rumors that the guillotine, which symbolizes royal power, has been stolen and hidden. However, the world still calls it the common master, and the powerful princes dare not destroy it. After more than 800 years, all the merits were finally lost, the throne ended with King Nan, the emperor was demoted to a commoner, and died of natural causes. Although the title and throne were lost in the world, the branches and leaves still seemed to be maintained. No one dared to occupy the empty throne. There was no emperor in the world for more than thirty years.
target: When the Zhou was strong, the Dukes of Zhou and Shao governed without crime; when it declined, the Five Hegemons supported it. After King You and King Ping, the country declined, splitting into Eastern and Western Zhou. Despite this, the world still called it the common master, and powerful princes dared not destroy it. source: However, the world still calls it the common master, and the powerful princes dare not destroy it. After more than 800 years, all the merits were finally lost, the throne ended with King Nan, the emperor was demoted to a commoner, and died of natural causes. Although the title and throne were lost in the world, the branches and leaves still seemed to be maintained. No one dared to occupy the empty throne. There was no emperor in the world for more than thirty years. The Qin Dynasty relied on its superior terrain and deceitful troops to annex the six vassal states east of Mount Wei, and won victory in one go. Therefore, it boasted that it knew the world well, thought that one person knew the cause of founding the country, slandered and ridiculed three generations, eradicated and eradicated ancient methods, and secretly gave itself the title of emperor, but its children were ordinary people, with no flesh and blood of the same origin to help them, and no vassal states with land to protect them outside. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose up with a wooden stick, and Liu Bang and Xiang Ji immediately destroyed the Qin Dynasty. Therefore, it is said that the Zhou Dynasty enjoyed the country for too long and the Qin Dynasty did not reach a hundred years, both of which were caused by the power of the country. In the early years of the rise of the Han Dynasty, the world had just been peaceful and there were few clans with the same surname. Emperor Gaozu learned from the experience of the Qin Dynasty, which collapsed due to isolation and helplessness, so he began to divide the territory and establish princes and second-class titles. There are more than a hundred cities and towns among the meritorious officials. The children of the royal family are more noble and have a territory larger than that of the Nine Kingdoms. From Yanmen to the east to the north bank of the Liao River are the states of Yan and Dai. Changshan Mountain to the south, Taihang Mountain to the east, across the river and Jishui, and into the sea, are the states of Qi and Zhao. The Gushui and Swimming areas, including Guishan and Mengshan, were the two kingdoms of Liang and Chu. Containing rivers and lakes in the east and close to Kuaiji, is the Kingdom of Wu. To the north is the Huaihe River, including Mount Lu and Hengshan, and is the Huainan Kingdom. Going south from the Han River to Jiuyi Mountain is the Kingdom of Changsha. The vassal states are connected one after another, surrounded by the north, Shu, and south sides, and bordered by Hu Di and Nanyue. The emperor himself has Hedong, Henan, Hanoi, Dongjun, Yingchuan, and Nanyang, from Jiangling to Bashu in the west, and from Yunzhong to Longxi in the north, including the capital, a total of fifteen counties, among which there are also the fiefdoms of princesses and princes. A large vassal state spans several states and counties, connects dozens of cities, and has the same palace and official system as the capital. It can be said to be overkill. Even so, Emperor Gaozu established the foundation and had no leisure for a day. Emperor Hui's reign was short, and Empress Gao used a woman as regent. However, the country was safe and sound, and there was no excess to worry about. Later, the disaster that destroyed the Lu family and the success of Emperor Wen's imperial career also relied on the power of the princes. However, the feudal lords were originally powerful in their country, and the currents were overflowing. The smaller ones are dissolute and illegal, while the larger ones are rampant and unruly, causing harm to themselves and the country. Therefore, Emperor Wen adopted Jia Yi's suggestion to divide Qi and Zhao, and Emperor Jing adopted Chao Cuo's strategy to weaken Wu, Chu and other states. Emperor Wu implemented his father's plan and issued a favor order, which enabled the princes and kings to allocate part of the households and cities to their children without having to abolish the migration, and the vassal state itself fell apart. From then on, the State of Qi was divided into seven small states, the State of Zhao was divided into six, the State of Liang was divided into five, and the State of Huainan was divided into three.
